Auto-generated by `(catalog)`.  17660 results — 13906 proven (13795 of them installed from a certificate, their proofs not run in this load), 0 support (PSS), 3754 stated without proof (199 axioms, 3555 definitions, 0 assertions).

> **Trust.**  This catalog lists *what* is proven; how much each
> proof still leans on unproved facts is the companion ledger
> [`PROOF-DEBT.md`](PROOF-DEBT.md).  In short: a proof's *bill*
> is the set of `asserted` facts it rests on; an empty bill prints
> `proven modulo 0` (unconditional relative to the kernel -- the
> strongest report), and a non-empty bill carries a `[trust: K]`
> tier equal to its **weakest** leaf's warrant, where `none`
> (a leaf with no warrant at all) is weakest and `proof` strongest.
> The ledger heads with the full glossary and tier table.

- `affine-holomorphic` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([goup_ in cc, gouq_ in cc, gouw_ in cc, goug_ in fun(u, cc)], forall([gouz_ in u], goug_(gouz_) == goup_ + gouq_ * (gouz_ - gouw_)) implies holomorphic-on(u, goug_)))
- `affine-isometry-fixed-point` — forall([m, aa, gs], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies aa subset vec(m) implies is-convex-subset(m, aa) implies is-compact(subspace-ms(nvs-metric-space(m), aa)) implies forsome([hfz_], hfz_ in aa) implies is-affine-isometry-group(m, aa, gs) implies forsome([hfw_ in aa], forall([hfg_ in gs], hfg_(hfw_) = hfw_)))
- `affine-lam-in-fun` — forall([c, lam], c in rr and lam in rr implies vnb-lambda(x, rr, c + lam * x) in fun(rr, rr))
- `affine-primitive-on` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([goup_ in cc, gouq_ in cc, gouw_ in cc, gouf_ in fun(u, cc)], forall([gouz_ in u], gouf_(gouz_) == goup_ * gouz_ + (gouq_ * ((gouz_ - gouw_) * (gouz_ - gouw_))) * recip(2)) implies holomorphic-on(u, gouf_) and forall([gouz_ in u], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, u, gouf_, gouz_, goup_ + gouq_ * (gouz_ - gouw_)))))
- `affine-reparam-ccint-in` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, lrpc_ in rr, lrpd_ in rr, lrpl_ in rr, lrpm_ in rr], 0 < lrpl_ implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpc_ = a implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpd_ = b implies forall([lrpz_ in ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_)], lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpz_ in ccint(a, b)))
- `affine-reparam-continuous-at-sub` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, lrpc_ in rr, lrpd_ in rr, lrpl_ in rr, lrpm_ in rr], 0 < lrpl_ implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpc_ = a implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpd_ = b implies forall([f, lrpg_ in fun(ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_), rr)], forall([lrpz_ in ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_)], lrpg_(lrpz_) == f(lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpz_)) implies forall([lrpt_ in ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_)], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(rr-ms, ccint(a, b)), rr-ms, f, lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpt_) implies is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(rr-ms, ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_)), rr-ms, lrpg_, lrpt_))))
- `affine-reparam-continuous-on` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, lrpc_ in rr, lrpd_ in rr, lrpl_ in rr, lrpm_ in rr], 0 < lrpl_ implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpc_ = a implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpd_ = b implies forall([f, lrpg_ in fun(ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_), rr)], is-continuous-on(f, ccint(a, b)) implies forall([lrpz_ in ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_)], lrpg_(lrpz_) == f(lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpz_)) implies is-continuous-on(lrpg_, ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_))))
- `affine-reparam-image-countable` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, lrpc_ in rr, lrpd_ in rr, lrpl_ in rr, lrpm_ in rr], 0 < lrpl_ implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpc_ = a implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpd_ = b implies forall([lrpe_], is-countable(lrpe_) implies lrpe_ subset ccint(a, b) implies is-countable(image(vnb-lambda(lrpv_, ccint(a, b), (lrpv_ - lrpm_) * recip(lrpl_)), lrpe_)) and image(vnb-lambda(lrpv_, ccint(a, b), (lrpv_ - lrpm_) * recip(lrpl_)), lrpe_) subset ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_)))

- `affine-reparam-not-in-image` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, lrpc_ in rr, lrpd_ in rr, lrpl_ in rr, lrpm_ in rr], 0 < lrpl_ implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpc_ = a implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpd_ = b implies forall([lrpe_], lrpe_ subset ccint(a, b) implies forall([lrpt_ in ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_)], not(lrpt_ in image(vnb-lambda(lrpv_, ccint(a, b), (lrpv_ - lrpm_) * recip(lrpl_)), lrpe_)) implies not(lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpt_ in lrpe_))))
- `affine-reparam-ooint-in` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, lrpc_ in rr, lrpd_ in rr, lrpl_ in rr, lrpm_ in rr], 0 < lrpl_ implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpc_ = a implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpd_ = b implies forall([lrpz_ in ooint(lrpc_, lrpd_)], lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpz_ in ooint(a, b)))
- `affine-reparam-regulated` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, lrpc_ in rr, lrpd_ in rr, lrpl_ in rr, lrpm_ in rr], 0 < lrpl_ implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpc_ = a implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpd_ = b implies lrpc_ < lrpd_ implies forall([f, lrpg_ in fun(ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_), rr)], is-regulated-on(f, a, b) implies forall([lrpz_ in ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_)], lrpg_(lrpz_) == f(lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpz_)) implies is-regulated-on(lrpg_, lrpc_, lrpd_)))
- `affine-reparam-solve` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, lrpc_ in rr, lrpd_ in rr, lrpl_ in rr, lrpm_ in rr], 0 < lrpl_ implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpc_ = a implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpd_ = b implies forall([lrpz_ in ccint(a, b), lrpq_ in rr], lrpz_ - lrpm_ = lrpq_ * lrpl_ implies lrpq_ in ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_) and lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpq_ = lrpz_))

- `ag-mpow-diff-neg` — forall([g], is-abelian-group(g) implies forall([p_ in nn, m_ in nn, n_ in nn], p_ + m_ = n_ implies forall([a in carr(g)], (opr(g))(mpow(abelian-group-as-monoid(g), a, m_), (inv(g))(mpow(abelian-group-as-monoid(g), a, n_))) = (inv(g))(mpow(abelian-group-as-monoid(g), a, p_)))))
- `ag-mpow-diff-nonneg` — forall([g], is-abelian-group(g) implies forall([d_ in nn, n_ in nn, m_ in nn], d_ + n_ = m_ implies forall([a in carr(g)], (opr(g))(mpow(abelian-group-as-monoid(g), a, m_), (inv(g))(mpow(abelian-group-as-monoid(g), a, n_))) = mpow(abelian-group-as-monoid(g), a, d_))))
- `ag-norm-metric-is-metric-space` — forall([g, nm], is-abelian-group(g) implies is-group-norm(nm, opr(g), inv(g), iden(g), carr(g)) implies is-metric-space([carr(g), vnb-lambda([u, v], cartesian(carr(g), carr(g)), nm((opr(g))(u, (inv(g))(v))))]))
- `ag-subgroup-adjoin` — forall([a6g], is-abelian-group(a6g) implies forall([a6h], is-subgroup(a6g, a6h) implies forall([a6b in carr(a6g)], is-subgroup(a6g, {a6y in carr(a6g): forsome([a6p in a6h, a6k in zz], a6y = (opr(a6g))(a6p, zz-act(a6g, a6k, a6b)))}) and a6h subset {a6y in carr(a6g): forsome([a6p in a6h, a6k in zz], a6y = (opr(a6g))(a6p, zz-act(a6g, a6k, a6b)))} and a6b in {a6y in carr(a6g): forsome([a6p in a6h, a6k in zz], a6y = (opr(a6g))(a6p, zz-act(a6g, a6k, a6b)))})))

- `agm-act-fun` — forall([g], is-abelian-group(g) implies act(ag-zz-module(g)) in fun(cartesian(zz, carr(g)), carr(g)))

- `agree-length-prop` — forall([sx_, xs, ys], xs in fun(nn, sx_) implies ys in fun(nn, sx_) implies not(xs = ys) implies agree-length(xs, ys) in nn and not(xs(agree-length(xs, ys)) = ys(agree-length(xs, ys))) and forall([alj_ in nn], alj_ < agree-length(xs, ys) implies xs(alj_) = ys(alj_)))

- `agree-sym` — forall([l, l2, i], length(l2) = length(l) implies forall([mrj_ in nn], 1 <= mrj_ implies mrj_ <= length(l) implies not(mrj_ = i) implies nth(mrj_, l2) = nth(mrj_, l)) implies forall([mrj_ in nn], 1 <= mrj_ implies mrj_ <= length(l2) implies not(mrj_ = i) implies nth(mrj_, l) = nth(mrj_, l2)))
- `aif-coefficient-bound` — forall([u, c, r, phi, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies c in cc implies r in rr implies 0 < r implies forall([aix_ in u], r <= magnitude(aix_ - c)) implies phi in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), phi, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([aim_ in rr], forall([aiy_ in trace(pgam, a, b)], magnitude(phi(aiy_)) <= aim_) implies forall([k in nn], magnitude(line-int(vnb-lambda(aiw_, u, phi(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - c) ^ succ(k)), pgam, dgam, a, b)) <= road-length(dgam, a, b) * (aim_ * recip(r) ^ succ(k)))))
- `aif-cont-affine` — forall([u], u subset cc implies forall([aip_ in cc, aiq_ in cc, aiw_ in cc, h in fun(u, cc)], forall([aix_ in u], h(aix_) == aip_ + aiq_ * (aix_ - aiw_)) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), h, rgy_))))
- `aif-cont-compose` — forall([u], u subset cc implies forall([g in fun(u, cc)], forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), g, rgy_)) implies forall([aiv_], aiv_ subset cc implies forall([aix_ in u], g(aix_) in aiv_) implies forall([aiph_], forall([rgy_ in aiv_], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), aiv_), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), aiph_, rgy_)) implies forall([h in fun(u, cc)], forall([aix_ in u], h(aix_) == aiph_(g(aix_))) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), h, rgy_)))))))
- `aif-cont-const` — forall([u], u subset cc implies forall([aik_ in cc, h in fun(u, cc)], forall([aix_ in u], h(aix_) == aik_) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), h, rgy_))))
- `aif-cont-holo-restrict` — forall([aiv_, g], holomorphic-on(aiv_, g) implies forall([u], u subset aiv_ implies forall([h in fun(u, cc)], forall([aix_ in u], h(aix_) == g(aix_)) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), h, rgy_)))))
- `aif-cont-power-of` — forall([u], u subset cc implies forall([g in fun(u, cc)], forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), g, rgy_)) implies forall([n in nn, h in fun(u, cc)], forall([aix_ in u], h(aix_) == g(aix_) ^ n) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), h, rgy_)))))
- `aif-cont-product` — forall([u], u subset cc implies forall([f, g, h], f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies g in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), g, rgy_)) implies h in fun(u, cc) implies forall([aix_ in u], h(aix_) == f(aix_) * g(aix_)) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), h, rgy_))))
- `aif-cont-recip-shift` — forall([u], u subset cc implies forall([c in cc], forall([aix_ in u], not(aix_ = c)) implies forall([h in fun(u, cc)], forall([aix_ in u], h(aix_) == recip(aix_ - c)) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), h, rgy_)))))
- `aif-cont-scale` — forall([u], u subset cc implies forall([aik_ in cc, g in fun(u, cc)], forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), g, rgy_)) implies forall([h in fun(u, cc)], forall([aix_ in u], h(aix_) == aik_ * g(aix_)) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), h, rgy_)))))
- `aif-cont-shift` — forall([u], u subset cc implies forall([c in cc, h in fun(u, cc)], forall([aix_ in u], h(aix_) == aix_ - c) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), h, rgy_))))
- `aif-cont-sum` — forall([u], u subset cc implies forall([f, g, h], f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies g in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), g, rgy_)) implies h in fun(u, cc) implies forall([aix_ in u], h(aix_) == f(aix_) + g(aix_)) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), h, rgy_))))
- `aif-geometric-partial` — forall([n in nn, aip_, aisv_, aiqv_, aie_], aip_ in cc implies aisv_ in cc implies aiqv_ in cc implies aie_ in cc implies aie_ * (1 - aiqv_ * aisv_) = aisv_ implies cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(aij_, nn, (aip_ * aisv_ ^ succ(aij_)) * aiqv_ ^ aij_), n) = aip_ * aie_ - (aip_ * (aiqv_ * aisv_) ^ n) * aie_)
- `aif-geometric-relation` — forall([w in cc, c in cc, z in cc], not(w = c) implies not(w = z) implies recip(w - z) * (1 - (z - c) * recip(w - c)) = recip(w - c))
- `aif-geometric-remainder` — forall([c in cc, r in rr], 0 < r implies forall([w in cc], r <= magnitude(w - c) implies forall([z in cc], magnitude(z - c) < r implies forall([aip_ in cc, aim_ in rr], magnitude(aip_) <= aim_ implies forall([k in nn], magnitude(cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(aij_, nn, (aip_ * recip(w - c) ^ succ(aij_)) * (z - c) ^ aij_), k) - aip_ * recip(w - z)) in rr and magnitude(cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(aij_, nn, (aip_ * recip(w - c) ^ succ(aij_)) * (z - c) ^ aij_), k) - aip_ * recip(w - z)) <= (aim_ * (magnitude(z - c) * recip(r)) ^ k) * recip(r - magnitude(z - c)))))))

- `amp-vector-exists` — forall([v, s, gg_], is-hilbert-space(v) implies s subset bounded-ops(v, v) implies gg_ in set implies card(gg_) in nn implies gg_ subset vec(v) implies forsome([cqw_ in set, cqf_ in set], is-amplification(v, s, cqw_, cqf_) and forsome([cqx_ in vec(cqw_)], forall([cqa_ in bounded-ops(v, v), cqb_ in bounded-ops(v, v), cqy_ in gg_], ip-norm(v, (vadd(v))(cqa_(cqy_), (vneg(v))(cqb_(cqy_)))) <= ip-norm(cqw_, (vadd(cqw_))((cqf_(cqa_))(cqx_), (vneg(cqw_))((cqf_(cqb_))(cqx_))))))))

- `amp-vector-step` — forall([v, s, w, f_, x_, u_, z_], is-hilbert-space(v) implies s subset bounded-ops(v, v) implies is-amplification(v, s, w, f_) implies x_ in vec(w) implies z_ in vec(v) implies u_ subset vec(v) implies forall([cqa_ in bounded-ops(v, v), cqb_ in bounded-ops(v, v), cqy_ in u_], ip-norm(v, (vadd(v))(cqa_(cqy_), (vneg(v))(cqb_(cqy_)))) <= ip-norm(w, (vadd(w))((f_(cqa_))(x_), (vneg(w))((f_(cqb_))(x_))))) implies forsome([cqw_ in set, cqf_ in set], is-amplification(v, s, cqw_, cqf_) and forsome([cqx_ in vec(cqw_)], forall([cqa_ in bounded-ops(v, v), cqb_ in bounded-ops(v, v), cqy_ in union(u_, pair(z_, z_))], ip-norm(v, (vadd(v))(cqa_(cqy_), (vneg(v))(cqb_(cqy_)))) <= ip-norm(cqw_, (vadd(cqw_))((cqf_(cqa_))(cqx_), (vneg(cqw_))((cqf_(cqb_))(cqx_))))))))
- `amp-vector-step-explicit` — forall([v, s, w, f_, x_, u_, z_], is-hilbert-space(v) implies s subset bounded-ops(v, v) implies is-amplification(v, s, w, f_) implies x_ in vec(w) implies z_ in vec(v) implies u_ subset vec(v) implies forall([cqa_ in bounded-ops(v, v), cqb_ in bounded-ops(v, v), cqy_ in u_], ip-norm(v, (vadd(v))(cqa_(cqy_), (vneg(v))(cqb_(cqy_)))) <= ip-norm(w, (vadd(w))((f_(cqa_))(x_), (vneg(w))((f_(cqb_))(x_))))) implies is-amplification(v, s, hsum(w, v), amp-step(v, w, f_)) and [x_, z_] in vec(hsum(w, v)) and forall([cqa_ in bounded-ops(v, v), cqb_ in bounded-ops(v, v), cqy_ in union(u_, pair(z_, z_))], ip-norm(v, (vadd(v))(cqa_(cqy_), (vneg(v))(cqb_(cqy_)))) <= ip-norm(hsum(w, v), (vadd(hsum(w, v)))(((amp-step(v, w, f_))(cqa_))([x_, z_]), (vneg(hsum(w, v)))(((amp-step(v, w, f_))(cqb_))([x_, z_]))))))
- `amplification-base` — forall([v, s], is-hilbert-space(v) implies s subset bounded-ops(v, v) implies is-amplification(v, s, v, id-rep(v)))
- `amplification-step` — forall([v, s, w, f_], is-hilbert-space(v) implies s subset bounded-ops(v, v) implies is-amplification(v, s, w, f_) implies is-amplification(v, s, hsum(w, v), amp-step(v, w, f_)))
- `analytic-at-from-integral-formula` — forall([u, c, r, phi, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies c in cc implies r in rr implies 0 < r implies forall([aix_ in u], r <= magnitude(aix_ - c)) implies phi in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), phi, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([kap in cc, aiou_], is-open(cc-ms, aiou_) implies ball(cc-ms, c, r) subset aiou_ implies forall([f in fun(aiou_, cc)], forall([z in cc], magnitude(z - c) < r implies f(z) = kap * line-int(vnb-lambda(aiw_, u, phi(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - z)), pgam, dgam, a, b)) implies is-analytic-at(f, aiou_, c))))
- `analytic-at-intro` — forall([algf_, algu_], algf_ in fun(algu_, cc) implies forall([algc_ in fun(nn, cc), alga_ in cc, algr_ in rr], 0 < algr_ implies algr_ < cps-radius(algc_) implies ball(cc-ms, alga_, algr_) subset algu_ implies forall([algz_ in ball(cc-ms, alga_, algr_)], algf_(algz_) = cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, algc_(cpsk_) * (algz_ - alga_) ^ cpsk_))) implies is-open(cc-ms, algu_) implies is-analytic-at(algf_, algu_, alga_)))
- `analytic-continuation` — forall([u], is-open(cc-ms, u) implies is-connected(cc-ms, u) implies forall([f in fun(u, cc)], forall([acnb_ in u], is-analytic-at(f, u, acnb_)) implies forsome([a in u], zeros-accumulate-at(u, f, a)) implies forall([z in u], f(z) = 0)))
- `analytic-deriv` — forall([algf_, algu_], algf_ in fun(algu_, cc) implies forall([algc_ in fun(nn, cc), alga_ in cc, algr_ in rr], 0 < algr_ implies algr_ < cps-radius(algc_) implies ball(cc-ms, alga_, algr_) subset algu_ implies forall([algz_ in ball(cc-ms, alga_, algr_)], algf_(algz_) = cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, algc_(cpsk_) * (algz_ - alga_) ^ cpsk_))) implies is-open(cc-ms, algu_) implies is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, algu_, algf_, alga_, algc_(1))))
- `analytic-from-integral-formula` — forall([u, c, r, phi, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies c in cc implies r in rr implies 0 < r implies forall([aix_ in u], r <= magnitude(aix_ - c)) implies phi in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), phi, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([kap in cc, f], forall([z in cc], magnitude(z - c) < r implies f(z) = kap * line-int(vnb-lambda(aiw_, u, phi(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - z)), pgam, dgam, a, b)) implies forall([z in cc], magnitude(z - c) < r implies cc-series-converges-to(vnb-lambda(aitk_, nn, (kap * line-int(vnb-lambda(aiw_, u, phi(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - c) ^ succ(aitk_)), pgam, dgam, a, b)) * (z - c) ^ aitk_), f(z)))))
- `analytic-holomorphic-ball` — forall([algf_, algu_, alga_], is-analytic-at(algf_, algu_, alga_) implies forsome([algr_ in rr], 0 < algr_ and ball(cc-ms, alga_, algr_) subset algu_ and holomorphic-on(ball(cc-ms, alga_, algr_), restrict(algf_, ball(cc-ms, alga_, algr_)))))
- `analytic-on-holomorphic` — forall([u], is-open(cc-ms, u) implies forall([f in fun(u, cc)], forall([acnb_ in u], is-analytic-at(f, u, acnb_)) implies holomorphic-on(u, f)))
- `analytic-rep-holomorphic` — forall([algf_, algu_], algf_ in fun(algu_, cc) implies forall([algc_ in fun(nn, cc), alga_ in cc, algr_ in rr], 0 < algr_ implies algr_ < cps-radius(algc_) implies ball(cc-ms, alga_, algr_) subset algu_ implies forall([algz_ in ball(cc-ms, alga_, algr_)], algf_(algz_) = cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, algc_(cpsk_) * (algz_ - alga_) ^ cpsk_))) implies holomorphic-on(ball(cc-ms, alga_, algr_), restrict(algf_, ball(cc-ms, alga_, algr_)))))
- `analytic-zeros-finite-in-ball` — forall([u], is-open(cc-ms, u) implies is-connected(cc-ms, u) implies forall([f in fun(u, cc)], forall([acnb_ in u], is-analytic-at(f, u, acnb_)) implies forsome([acne_ in u], not(f(acne_) = 0)) implies forall([acnc_ in cc, acnr_ in rr], closed-ball(cc-ms, acnc_, acnr_) subset u implies card({acnz_ in closed-ball(cc-ms, acnc_, acnr_): f(acnz_) = 0}) in nn)))
- `angle-lt-pi-iff` — forall([anz_, anv_], anz_ in cc implies anv_ in cc implies not(anz_ = 0) implies not(anv_ = 0) implies angle(anz_, anv_) < pi iff 0 < imag-part(anz_ * conjugate(anv_)) or imag-part(anz_ * conjugate(anv_)) = 0 and 0 < real-part(anz_ * conjugate(anv_)))
- `annihilating-is-minimal` — forall([md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies is-commutative-ring(scal(md)) implies forall([v], is-cyclic-vector(md, tt, v) implies forall([k], is-annihilating-poly(md, tt, v, k) implies 1 <= deg(scal(md), k) implies is-minimal-poly(md, tt, k))))
- `annihilating-poly-divides` — forall([md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies is-field-ring(scal(md)) implies forall([v in vec(md), k], is-annihilating-poly(md, tt, v, k) implies forall([q in carr(poly(scal(md)))], poly-op(md, tt, q, v) = vzero(md) implies forsome([gqs_ in carr(poly(scal(md)))], q = (mul(poly(scal(md))))(k, gqs_)))))
- `annulus-cauchy` — forall([u, f, ac in cc, r1 in rr, r2 in rr], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies holomorphic-on(u, f) implies 0 < r1 implies r1 < r2 implies forall([z in cc], r1 <= magnitude(z - ac) implies magnitude(z - ac) <= r2 implies z in u) implies line-int(f, circle-path(ac, r1), circle-deriv(ac, r1), 0, 2 * pi) = line-int(f, circle-path(ac, r2), circle-deriv(ac, r2), 0, 2 * pi))
- `annulus-open` — forall([a in cc, rm in rr, rp in rr], is-open(cc-ms, annulus(a, rm, rp)))
- `annulus-shift-facts` — forall([a in cc, rm in rr, rp in rr], 0 < rm implies forall([y in annulus(a, rm, rp)], not(y - a = 0) and y - a in ball(cc-ms, 0, rp) and recip(y - a) in ball(cc-ms, 0, recip(rm))))
- `annulus-unfold` — forall([a, rm, rp], annulus(a, rm, rp) == {anlz_ in cc: rm < magnitude(anlz_ - a) and magnitude(anlz_ - a) < rp})
- `anti-lam-in-fun` — forall([cf in fun(nn, rr), m in nn], vnb-lambda(x, rr, series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(k, nn, (recip(succ(k)) * cf(k)) * x ^ succ(k)), m)) in fun(rr, rr))
- `anti-term-in-rr` — forall([cf in fun(nn, rr), k in nn, x in rr], (recip(succ(k)) * cf(k)) * x ^ succ(k) in rr)
- `anti-term-lam-in-fun` — forall([cf in fun(nn, rr), x in rr], vnb-lambda(k, nn, (recip(succ(k)) * cf(k)) * x ^ succ(k)) in fun(nn, rr))
- `antiderivable-add` — forall([phi, psi, a, b], is-antiderivable(phi, a, b) implies is-antiderivable(psi, a, b) implies is-antiderivable(vnb-lambda(x, rr, phi(x) + psi(x)), a, b))
- `antiderivable-affine-subst` — forall([phi, ck, lam, p_, q_, aa, bb], phi in fun(rr, rr) implies ck in rr implies lam in rr implies not(lam = 0) implies p_ in rr implies q_ in rr implies p_ < q_ implies is-antiderivable(phi, aa, bb) implies forall([t_ in ccint(p_, q_)], ck + lam * t_ in ccint(aa, bb)) implies forall([t_], t_ in rr and p_ < t_ and t_ < q_ implies aa < ck + lam * t_ and ck + lam * t_ < bb) implies is-antiderivable(vnb-lambda(x, rr, phi(ck + lam * x)), p_, q_))
- `antiderivable-affine-subst-pos` — forall([phi, ck, lam, p_, q_], phi in fun(rr, rr) implies ck in rr implies lam in rr implies 0 < lam implies p_ in rr implies q_ in rr implies p_ < q_ implies is-antiderivable(phi, ck + lam * p_, ck + lam * q_) implies is-antiderivable(vnb-lambda(x, rr, phi(ck + lam * x)), p_, q_))
- `antiderivable-affine-subst-pos-transfer` — forall([phi, psi, ck, lam, p_, q_], phi in fun(rr, rr) implies psi in fun(rr, rr) implies ck in rr implies lam in rr implies 0 < lam implies p_ in rr implies q_ in rr implies p_ < q_ implies is-antiderivable(phi, ck + lam * p_, ck + lam * q_) implies forall([x_ in rr], psi(x_) == phi(ck + lam * x_)) implies is-antiderivable(psi, p_, q_))
- `antiderivable-endpoints` — forall([phi, a, b], is-antiderivable(phi, a, b) implies a in rr and b in rr and a < b)
- `antiderivable-family-choice` — forall([phifam in fun(nn, fun(rr, rr)), a in rr, b in rr], forall([k_ in nn], is-antiderivable(phifam(k_), a, b)) implies forsome([fam in fun(nn, fun(rr, rr))], forall([k_ in nn], is-antiderivative(fam(k_), phifam(k_), a, b))))
- `antiderivable-family-normalized` — forall([phifam in fun(nn, fun(rr, rr)), a in rr, b in rr], forall([k_ in nn], is-antiderivable(phifam(k_), a, b)) implies forsome([fam in fun(nn, fun(rr, rr))], forall([k_ in nn], is-antiderivative(fam(k_), phifam(k_), a, b) and (fam(k_))(a) = 0)))
- `antiderivable-fn-in-fun` — forall([phi, a, b], is-antiderivable(phi, a, b) implies phi in fun(rr, rr))
- `antiderivable-fns-membership` — forall([a, b, phi], phi in antiderivable-fns(a, b) iff phi in fun(rr, rr) and is-antiderivable(phi, a, b))
- `antiderivable-fns-unfold` — forall([a, b], antiderivable-fns(a, b) == {adp_ in fun(rr, rr): is-antiderivable(adp_, a, b)})
- `antiderivable-fns-vector-space` — forall([a, b], a in rr implies b in rr implies a < b implies is-vector-space(rr-fn-space(antiderivable-fns(a, b))))
- `antiderivable-from-deriv` — forall([f, phi, a, b], f in fun(rr, rr) implies phi in fun(rr, rr) implies a in rr and b in rr and a < b implies forall([x_ in rr], is-diff-at(f, x_, phi(x_))) implies is-antiderivable(phi, a, b))
- `antiderivable-integrand-transfer` — forall([phi, psi, a, b], psi in fun(rr, rr) implies is-antiderivable(phi, a, b) implies forall([x_ in rr], psi(x_) == phi(x_)) implies is-antiderivable(psi, a, b))
- `antiderivable-not-degenerate` — forall([phi, a], not(is-antiderivable(phi, a, a)))
- `antiderivable-not-reverse` — forall([phi, a, b], is-antiderivable(phi, a, b) implies not(is-antiderivable(phi, b, a)))
- `antiderivable-scale` — forall([c, phi, a, b], c in rr implies is-antiderivable(phi, a, b) implies is-antiderivable(vnb-lambda(x, rr, c * phi(x)), a, b))
- `antiderivable-sub` — forall([phi, psi, a, b], is-antiderivable(phi, a, b) implies is-antiderivable(psi, a, b) implies is-antiderivable(vnb-lambda(x, rr, phi(x) - psi(x)), a, b))
- `antiderivable-subinterval` — forall([phi, a, b, lo, hi], is-antiderivable(phi, a, b) implies lo in rr implies hi in rr implies a <= lo implies lo < hi implies hi <= b implies is-antiderivable(phi, lo, hi))
- `antiderivable-uniform-limit` — forall([phifam in fun(nn, fun(rr, rr)), psi in fun(rr, rr), a in rr, b in rr], forall([k_ in nn], is-antiderivable(phifam(k_), a, b)) implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([n_ in nn], forall([k_ in nn], n_ <= k_ implies forall([x_ in rr], x_ in ccint(a, b) implies abs(psi(x_) - (phifam(k_))(x_)) <= eps)))) implies is-antiderivable(psi, a, b))
- `antiderivative-add` — forall([f, g, phi, psi, a, b], is-antiderivative(f, phi, a, b) implies is-antiderivative(g, psi, a, b) implies is-antiderivative(vnb-lambda(x, rr, f(x) + g(x)), vnb-lambda(x, rr, phi(x) + psi(x)), a, b))
- `antiderivative-differ-by-constant` — forall([f, g, phi, a, b], is-antiderivative(f, phi, a, b) implies is-antiderivative(g, phi, a, b) implies forsome([cst_ in rr], forall([s_ in ccint(a, b)], f(s_) = g(s_) + cst_)))
- `antiderivative-endpoint-difference` — forall([f, g, phi, a, b], is-antiderivative(f, phi, a, b) implies is-antiderivative(g, phi, a, b) implies f(b) - f(a) = g(b) - g(a))
- `antiderivative-endpoints` — forall([f, phi, a, b], is-antiderivative(f, phi, a, b) implies a in rr and b in rr and a < b)
- `antiderivative-family-uniform-limit` — forall([fam in fun(nn, fun(rr, rr)), phifam in fun(nn, fun(rr, rr)), psi in fun(rr, rr), a in rr, b in rr], a < b implies forall([k_ in nn], is-antiderivative(fam(k_), phifam(k_), a, b) and (fam(k_))(a) = 0) implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([n_ in nn], forall([k_ in nn], n_ <= k_ implies forall([x_ in rr], x_ in ccint(a, b) implies abs(psi(x_) - (phifam(k_))(x_)) <= eps)))) implies forsome([f in fun(rr, rr)], is-antiderivative(f, psi, a, b) and forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([n_ in nn], forall([k_ in nn], n_ <= k_ implies forall([x_ in rr], x_ in ccint(a, b) implies abs(f(x_) - (fam(k_))(x_)) <= eps))))))
- `antiderivative-fn-in-fun` — forall([f, phi, a, b], is-antiderivative(f, phi, a, b) implies phi in fun(rr, rr))
- `antiderivative-increment-bound` — forall([h in fun(rr, rr), phi in fun(rr, rr), a in rr, b in rr, m_ in rr], is-antiderivative(h, phi, a, b) implies forall([x_ in rr], x_ in ccint(a, b) implies abs(phi(x_)) <= m_) implies forall([u in rr, v in rr], u in ccint(a, b) implies v in ccint(a, b) implies u < v implies abs(h(v) - h(u)) <= m_ * (v - u)))
- `antiderivative-integrand-transfer` — forall([f, phi, psi, a, b], psi in fun(rr, rr) implies is-antiderivative(f, phi, a, b) implies forall([x_ in rr], psi(x_) == phi(x_)) implies is-antiderivative(f, psi, a, b))
- `antiderivative-lipschitz` — forall([h in fun(rr, rr), phi in fun(rr, rr), a in rr, b in rr, m_ in rr], is-antiderivative(h, phi, a, b) implies forall([x_ in rr], x_ in ccint(a, b) implies abs(phi(x_)) <= m_) implies forall([u in rr, v in rr], u in ccint(a, b) implies v in ccint(a, b) implies abs(h(v) - h(u)) <= m_ * abs(v - u)))
- `antiderivative-map-in-fun` — forall([f, phi, a, b], is-antiderivative(f, phi, a, b) implies f in fun(rr, rr))
- `antiderivative-pair-close` — forall([f in fun(rr, rr), g in fun(rr, rr), phi in fun(rr, rr), psi in fun(rr, rr), a in rr, b in rr, m_ in rr], is-antiderivative(f, phi, a, b) implies is-antiderivative(g, psi, a, b) implies f(a) = g(a) implies forall([x_ in rr], x_ in ccint(a, b) implies abs(phi(x_) - psi(x_)) <= m_) implies forall([x_ in rr], x_ in ccint(a, b) implies abs(f(x_) - g(x_)) <= m_ * (b - a)))
- `antiderivative-scale` — forall([c, f, phi, a, b], c in rr implies is-antiderivative(f, phi, a, b) implies is-antiderivative(vnb-lambda(x, rr, c * f(x)), vnb-lambda(x, rr, c * phi(x)), a, b))
- `antiderivative-shift-const` — forall([f, phi, a, b, c], f in fun(rr, rr) implies phi in fun(rr, rr) implies a in rr implies b in rr implies c in rr implies is-antiderivative(f, phi, a, b) implies is-antiderivative(vnb-lambda(x_, rr, f(x_) - c), phi, a, b))
- `antiderivative-sub` — forall([f, g, phi, psi, a, b], is-antiderivative(f, phi, a, b) implies is-antiderivative(g, psi, a, b) implies is-antiderivative(vnb-lambda(x, rr, f(x) - g(x)), vnb-lambda(x, rr, phi(x) - psi(x)), a, b))
- `antiderivative-subinterval` — forall([f, phi, a, b, lo, hi], is-antiderivative(f, phi, a, b) implies lo in rr implies hi in rr implies a <= lo implies lo < hi implies hi <= b implies is-antiderivative(f, phi, lo, hi))
- `antiderivative-transfer-ptwise-eq` — forall([f in fun(rr, rr), psi in fun(rr, rr), g, phi, a, b], is-antiderivative(g, phi, a, b) implies forall([x_ in rr], f(x_) = g(x_)) implies forall([x_ in rr], psi(x_) = phi(x_)) implies is-antiderivative(f, psi, a, b))
- `apply-congruence-1` — forall([f, g], f == g implies forall([u], f(u) == g(u)))
- `apply-congruence-2` — forall([f, g], f == g implies forall([u, v], f(u, v) == g(u, v)))
- `approximant-below` — forall([omega, cf, h, n, x], cf in fun(nn, fun(omega, rr-pos-star)) implies forall([x_ in omega], (ptwise-sup(omega, cf))(x_) = h(x_)) implies n in nn implies x in omega implies (cf(n))(x) <= h(x))

- `argument-principle` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([mps_ in set], card(mps_) in nn implies mps_ subset u implies forall([f], holomorphic-on(difference(u, mps_), f) implies forall([c4ax_ in mps_], forsome([c4an_], is-pole(f, c4ax_, c4an_))) implies forall([mzs_ in set], card(mzs_) in nn implies forall([c4ax_ in difference(u, mps_)], f(c4ax_) = 0 implies c4ax_ in mzs_) implies forall([c4ax_ in mzs_], f(c4ax_) = 0) implies forall([c4ax_ in mzs_], forsome([c4am_], has-zero-of-order(difference(u, mps_), f, c4ax_, c4am_))) implies forall([mdp_, mdq_, mds_, mdt_], is-road(mdp_, mdq_, mds_, mdt_) implies trace(mdp_, mds_, mdt_) subset difference(u, union(mzs_, mps_)) implies mdp_(mdt_) = mdp_(mds_) implies null-homotopic(u, mdp_, mds_, mdt_) implies recip((2 * pi) * 1i) * line-int(vnb-lambda(c4az_, difference(u, union(mzs_, mps_)), deriv-on(cc-normed-field, difference(u, mps_), f, c4az_) * recip(f(c4az_))), mdp_, mdq_, mds_, mdt_) = finsum(normed-field-additive-ag(cc-normed-field), vnb-lambda(mqx_, cc, zero-order(difference(u, mps_), f, mqx_) * winding(mdp_, mdq_, mds_, mdt_, mqx_)), mzs_) + finsum(normed-field-additive-ag(cc-normed-field), vnb-lambda(mqx_, cc, -pole-order(f, mqx_) * winding(mdp_, mdq_, mds_, mdt_, mqx_)), mps_))))))

- `ban-sub-sub` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([p in vec(a), w in vec(a)], (vadd(a))(p, (vneg(a))((vadd(a))(p, (vneg(a))(w)))) = w))

- `bary-vertices` — forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gouc_ in cc], (real-part(1) * goua_ + imag-part(1) * goub_) + (1 - real-part(1) - imag-part(1)) * gouc_ = goua_ and (real-part(1i) * goua_ + imag-part(1i) * goub_) + (1 - real-part(1i) - imag-part(1i)) * gouc_ = goub_ and (real-part(0) * goua_ + imag-part(0) * goub_) + (1 - real-part(0) - imag-part(0)) * gouc_ = gouc_)

- `bernstein-partition` — forall([n_ in nn, x_ in rr], series-partial-sum(bernstein-basis(n_, x_), succ(n_)) = 1)
- `bernstein-poly-antiderivable` — forall([f, n_, a, b], f in fun(rr, rr) implies n_ in nn implies not(n_ = 0) implies a in rr and b in rr and a < b implies is-antiderivable(vnb-lambda(x, rr, bernstein-poly(f, n_, x)), a, b))
- `bernstein-poly-unit-coordinate-antiderivable` — forall([g, n_, a, b], g in fun(rr, rr) implies n_ in nn implies not(n_ = 0) implies a in rr and b in rr and a < b implies is-antiderivable(vnb-lambda(x, rr, bernstein-poly(g, n_, (x - a) * recip(b - a))), a, b))
- `bernstein-term-antiderivable` — forall([n_ in nn, a, b, k_, j_], a in rr and b in rr and a < b implies k_ in nn implies j_ in nn implies is-antiderivable(vnb-lambda(x, rr, x ^ j_ * (bernstein-basis(n_, x))(k_)), a, b))
- `bernstein-term-bound` — forall([f_, n_, x_, hh_, delta_, mm_, cc_, l_], f_ in fun(rr, rr) implies n_ in nn implies not(n_ = 0) implies x_ in ccint(0, 1) implies hh_ in rr implies 0 < hh_ implies delta_ in rr implies 0 < delta_ implies mm_ in rr implies 0 <= mm_ implies cc_ in rr implies 0 <= cc_ implies (n_ * n_) * ((delta_ * delta_) * cc_) = mm_ + mm_ implies forall([p_ in ccint(0, 1), q_ in ccint(0, 1)], abs(p_ - q_) <= delta_ implies abs(f_(p_) - f_(q_)) <= hh_) implies forall([z_ in ccint(0, 1)], abs(f_(z_)) <= mm_) implies l_ in nn implies (bernstein-basis(n_, x_))(l_) * (f_(x_) - f_((/)(l_, n_))) <= (bernstein-basis(n_, x_))(l_) * (hh_ + cc_ * ((l_ - n_ * x_) * (l_ - n_ * x_))) and (bernstein-basis(n_, x_))(l_) * ((0 - 1) * (hh_ + cc_ * ((l_ - n_ * x_) * (l_ - n_ * x_)))) <= (bernstein-basis(n_, x_))(l_) * (f_(x_) - f_((/)(l_, n_))))
- `bernstein-uniform-approximation` — forall([f_, eps_], f_ in fun(rr, rr) implies forall([x in ccint(0, 1)], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f_, x)) implies pos-rr(eps_) implies forsome([cap_ in nn], forall([n_, x_], n_ in nn implies cap_ <= n_ implies x_ in ccint(0, 1) implies abs(f_(x_) - bernstein-poly(f_, n_, x_)) <= eps_)))
- `bernstein-uniform-approximation-ccint` — forall([fn_, a, b, ep_], fn_ in fun(rr, rr) implies a in rr and b in rr and a < b implies forall([x_ in ccint(a, b)], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, fn_, x_)) implies pos-rr(ep_) implies forsome([cap_ in nn], forall([n_], n_ in nn and cap_ <= n_ implies forall([x_ in ccint(a, b)], abs(fn_(x_) - bernstein-poly(compose(fn_, vnb-lambda(x, rr, a + (b - a) * x)), n_, (x_ - a) * recip(b - a))) <= ep_))))
- `bernstein-variance` — forall([n_, x_, h_], n_ in nn implies x_ in rr implies forall([k_ in nn], h_(k_) = ((k_ - n_ * x_) * (k_ - n_ * x_)) * (bernstein-basis(n_, x_))(k_)) implies series-partial-sum(h_, succ(n_)) = (n_ * x_) * (1 - x_))
- `bernstein-variance-bound` — forall([n_, x_, h_], n_ in nn implies not(n_ = 0) implies x_ in rr implies forall([k_ in nn], h_(k_) = ((k_ - n_ * x_) * (k_ - n_ * x_)) * (bernstein-basis(n_, x_))(k_)) implies (/)(1, n_) * series-partial-sum(h_, succ(n_)) <= 1)
- `bernstein-weighted-step` — forall([n_, x_, w_, p_, q_, s_], n_ in nn implies x_ in rr implies forall([k_ in zz], w_(k_) in rr) implies forall([k_ in nn], q_(k_) in rr) implies forall([k_ in nn], s_(k_) in rr) implies forall([k_ in nn], p_(k_) = w_(k_) * (bernstein-basis(succ(n_), x_))(k_)) implies forall([k_ in nn], q_(k_) = w_(succ(k_)) * (bernstein-basis(n_, x_))(k_)) implies forall([k_ in nn], s_(k_) = w_(k_) * (bernstein-basis(n_, x_))(k_)) implies series-partial-sum(p_, succ(succ(n_))) = x_ * series-partial-sum(q_, succ(n_)) + (1 - x_) * series-partial-sum(s_, succ(n_)))
- `bessel-inequality` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([ix, e], is-orthonormal-family(v, ix, e) implies forall([x in vec(v)], esum(vnb-lambda(onk_, ix, magnitude((ip(v))(x, e(onk_))) * magnitude((ip(v))(x, e(onk_))))) <= (ip(v))(x, x))))
- `bgf-coef-family` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([gfp], is-cc-linear-on(a, gfp) implies forall([x in vec(a)], forsome([gfc in fun(zz, cc)], forall([gfk_ in nn], gfc(gfk_) = 0) and forall([gfk_ in nn], gfc(-(gfk_ + 1)) = gfp(el-pow(a, x, gfk_)))))))
- `bgf-functional-estimate` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([gfp], is-cc-linear-on(a, gfp) implies forall([bsv_ in vec(a)], magnitude(gfp(bsv_)) <= (vnrm(a))(bsv_)) implies forall([x in vec(a), s in rr], 0 < s implies forall([z in cc], s <= magnitude(z) implies is-invertible-el(a, shift-el(a, z, x))) implies forall([bm in rr], 0 <= bm implies forall([z in cc], magnitude(z) = s implies (vnrm(a))(inverse-el(a, shift-el(a, z, x))) <= bm) implies forall([n in nn], magnitude(gfp(el-pow(a, x, n))) <= (s * s ^ n) * bm)))))
- `bgf-laurent-resolvent` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([gfp], is-cc-linear-on(a, gfp) implies forall([bsv_ in vec(a)], magnitude(gfp(bsv_)) <= (vnrm(a))(bsv_)) implies forall([x in vec(a), gfc in fun(zz, cc)], forall([gfk_ in nn], gfc(gfk_) = 0) implies forall([gfk_ in nn], gfc(-(gfk_ + 1)) = gfp(el-pow(a, x, gfk_))) implies forall([z in cc], (vnrm(a))(x) < magnitude(z) implies laurent-sum(gfc, 0, z) = gfp(inverse-el(a, shift-el(a, z, x)))))))
- `bgf-power-estimate` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([x in vec(a), s in rr], 0 < s implies forall([z in cc], s <= magnitude(z) implies is-invertible-el(a, shift-el(a, z, x))) implies forall([bm in rr], 0 <= bm implies forall([z in cc], magnitude(z) = s implies (vnrm(a))(inverse-el(a, shift-el(a, z, x))) <= bm) implies forall([n in nn], (vnrm(a))(el-pow(a, x, n)) <= (s * s ^ n) * bm))))
- `bgf-psi-conv` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([gfp], is-cc-linear-on(a, gfp) implies forall([bsv_ in vec(a)], magnitude(gfp(bsv_)) <= (vnrm(a))(bsv_)) implies forall([gfs in fun(nn, vec(a)), gfl in vec(a)], converges-to(ba-metric-space(a), gfs, gfl) implies forall([gfh in fun(nn, cc)], forall([gfn_ in nn], gfh(gfn_) = gfp(gfs(gfn_))) implies converges-to(cc-ms, gfh, gfp(gfl))))))
- `bgf-psi-nsum` — forall([n in nn, a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([gfp], is-cc-linear-on(a, gfp) implies forall([y in vec(a), gfh in fun(nn, cc)], forall([gfk_ in nn], gfh(gfk_) = gfp(el-pow(a, y, gfk_))) implies cc-series-partial-sum(gfh, n) = gfp(neumann-sum(a, y, n)))))
- `bgf-psi-zero` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([gfp], is-cc-linear-on(a, gfp) implies gfp(vzero(a)) = 0))
- `bgf-radius-from-estimate` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([x in vec(a), s in rr], 0 < s implies forall([bm in rr], 0 <= bm implies forall([n in nn], (vnrm(a))(el-pow(a, x, n)) <= (s * s ^ n) * bm) implies forall([gft in rr], s < gft implies spectral-radius(a, x) <= gft))))
- `bgf-radius-le-root` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([x in vec(a), n in nn], 1 <= n implies spectral-radius(a, x) <= rpow-star((vnrm(a))(el-pow(a, x, n)), recip-star(n))))
- `bgf-resolvent-circle-bound` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([x in vec(a), s in rr], 0 < s implies forall([z in cc], s <= magnitude(z) implies is-invertible-el(a, shift-el(a, z, x))) implies forsome([bm in rr], 0 <= bm and forall([z in cc], magnitude(z) = s implies (vnrm(a))(inverse-el(a, shift-el(a, z, x))) <= bm))))
- `bgf-vnrm-reverse` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([gfu in vec(a), gfv in vec(a)], abs((vnrm(a))(gfu) - (vnrm(a))(gfv)) <= (vnrm(a))((vadd(a))(gfu, (vneg(a))(gfv)))))
- `bh-act-add` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([r_ in carr(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field)), s_ in carr(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field)), x_ in bounded-ops(v, v)], (bh-act(v))((add(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field)))(r_, s_), x_) = (bh-vadd(v))((bh-act(v))(r_, x_), (bh-act(v))(s_, x_))))
- `bh-act-mul` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([r_ in carr(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field)), s_ in carr(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field)), x_ in bounded-ops(v, v)], (bh-act(v))((mul(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field)))(r_, s_), x_) = (bh-act(v))(r_, (bh-act(v))(s_, x_))))
- `bh-act-one` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in bounded-ops(v, v)], (bh-act(v))(one(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field)), x_) = x_))
- `bh-act-type` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies bh-act(v) in fun(cartesian(cc, bounded-ops(v, v)), bounded-ops(v, v)))
- `bh-act-vadd` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([r_ in carr(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field)), x_ in bounded-ops(v, v), y_ in bounded-ops(v, v)], (bh-act(v))(r_, (bh-vadd(v))(x_, y_)) = (bh-vadd(v))((bh-act(v))(r_, x_), (bh-act(v))(r_, y_))))
- `bh-act-value` — forall([v, c_, t_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies c_ in cc implies t_ in bounded-ops(v, v) implies (bh-act(v))(c_, t_) = bop-scale(v, v, c_, t_))
- `bh-adjoint-map-sub` — forall([v], is-hilbert-space(v) implies forall([sba_ in vec(bh-module(v)), sbb_ in vec(bh-module(v))], (vnb-lambda(ots_, bounded-ops(v, v), op-adjoint(v, v, ots_)))((vadd(bh-module(v)))(sba_, (vneg(bh-module(v)))(sbb_))) = (vadd(bh-module(v)))((vnb-lambda(ots_, bounded-ops(v, v), op-adjoint(v, v, ots_)))(sba_), (vneg(bh-module(v)))((vnb-lambda(ots_, bounded-ops(v, v), op-adjoint(v, v, ots_)))(sbb_)))))
- `bh-adjoint-map-type` — forall([v], is-hilbert-space(v) implies vnb-lambda(ots_, bounded-ops(v, v), op-adjoint(v, v, ots_)) in fun(vec(bh-module(v)), vec(bh-module(v))))
- `bh-algebra-complete` — forall([v], is-hilbert-space(v) implies is-complete(nag-metric-space(cna-as-normed-ag([normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field), bounded-ops(v, v), bh-vadd(v), bop-zero(v, v), bh-vneg(v), bh-act(v), bh-vnrm(v), bh-vmul(v)]))))
- `bh-algebra-is-cba` — forall([v], is-hilbert-space(v) implies is-complex-banach-algebra([normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field), bounded-ops(v, v), bh-vadd(v), bop-zero(v, v), bh-vneg(v), bh-act(v), bh-vnrm(v), bh-vmul(v)]))
- `bh-algebra-is-cna` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies is-complex-normed-algebra([normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field), bounded-ops(v, v), bh-vadd(v), bop-zero(v, v), bh-vneg(v), bh-act(v), bh-vnrm(v), bh-vmul(v)]))
- `bh-algebra-is-uba` — forall([v], is-hilbert-space(v) implies forsome([bnx_ in vec(v)], not(bnx_ = vzero(v))) implies is-unital-banach-algebra([normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field), bounded-ops(v, v), bh-vadd(v), bop-zero(v, v), bh-vneg(v), bh-act(v), bh-vnrm(v), bh-vmul(v), bop-id(v)]))
- `bh-algebra-is-ucsa-tuple` — forall([v], is-hilbert-space(v) implies forsome([bnx_ in vec(v)], not(bnx_ = vzero(v))) implies is-unital-c-star-algebra([normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field), bounded-ops(v, v), bh-vadd(v), bop-zero(v, v), bh-vneg(v), bh-act(v), bh-vnrm(v), bh-vmul(v), bop-id(v), bh-vstar(v)]))
- `bh-algebra-is-uiba` — forall([v], is-hilbert-space(v) implies forsome([bnx_ in vec(v)], not(bnx_ = vzero(v))) implies is-unital-involutive-banach-algebra([normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field), bounded-ops(v, v), bh-vadd(v), bop-zero(v, v), bh-vneg(v), bh-act(v), bh-vnrm(v), bh-vmul(v), bop-id(v), bh-vstar(v)]))
- `bh-algebra-unital-c-star` — forall([v], is-hilbert-space(v) implies forsome([bnx_ in vec(v)], not(bnx_ = vzero(v))) implies is-unital-c-star-algebra(bh-algebra(v)))
- `bh-c-star-identity` — forall([v, t_], is-hilbert-space(v) implies t_ in bounded-ops(v, v) implies opnorm(v, v, bop-comp(v, op-adjoint(v, v, t_), t_)) = opnorm(v, v, t_) * opnorm(v, v, t_))
- `bh-id-linear` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies is-linear-map(bh-module(v), bh-module(v), id-fun(bounded-ops(v, v))))
- `bh-module-act` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies act(bh-module(v)) == bh-act(v))

- `bh-module-scal` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies scal(bh-module(v)) == normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field))
- `bh-module-vadd` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies vadd(bh-module(v)) == bh-vadd(v))
- `bh-module-vec` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies vec(bh-module(v)) == bounded-ops(v, v))
- `bh-module-vneg` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies vneg(bh-module(v)) == bh-vneg(v))

- `bh-ro-act` — forall([v], is-hilbert-space(v) implies act(bh-algebra(v)) == bh-act(v))

- `bh-ro-vstar` — forall([v], is-hilbert-space(v) implies vstar(bh-algebra(v)) == bh-vstar(v))

- `bh-vadd-inv` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies has-inverses(bh-vadd(v), bop-zero(v, v), bh-vneg(v), bounded-ops(v, v)))
- `bh-vadd-type` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies bh-vadd(v) in fun(cartesian(bounded-ops(v, v), bounded-ops(v, v)), bounded-ops(v, v)))
- `bh-vadd-value` — forall([v, s_, t_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies s_ in bounded-ops(v, v) implies t_ in bounded-ops(v, v) implies (bh-vadd(v))(s_, t_) = bop-sum(v, v, s_, t_))
- `bh-vmul-act-left` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([r_ in carr(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field)), x_ in bounded-ops(v, v), y_ in bounded-ops(v, v)], (bh-vmul(v))((bh-act(v))(r_, x_), y_) = (bh-act(v))(r_, (bh-vmul(v))(x_, y_))))
- `bh-vmul-act-right` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([r_ in carr(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field)), x_ in bounded-ops(v, v), y_ in bounded-ops(v, v)], (bh-vmul(v))(x_, (bh-act(v))(r_, y_)) = (bh-act(v))(r_, (bh-vmul(v))(x_, y_))))

- `bh-vmul-type` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies bh-vmul(v) in fun(cartesian(bounded-ops(v, v), bounded-ops(v, v)), bounded-ops(v, v)))
- `bh-vmul-unit-left` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in bounded-ops(v, v)], (bh-vmul(v))(bop-id(v), x_) = x_))
- `bh-vmul-unit-right` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in bounded-ops(v, v)], (bh-vmul(v))(x_, bop-id(v)) = x_))
- `bh-vmul-vadd-left` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in bounded-ops(v, v), y_ in bounded-ops(v, v), z_ in bounded-ops(v, v)], (bh-vmul(v))((bh-vadd(v))(x_, y_), z_) = (bh-vadd(v))((bh-vmul(v))(x_, z_), (bh-vmul(v))(y_, z_))))
- `bh-vmul-vadd-right` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in bounded-ops(v, v), y_ in bounded-ops(v, v), z_ in bounded-ops(v, v)], (bh-vmul(v))(x_, (bh-vadd(v))(y_, z_)) = (bh-vadd(v))((bh-vmul(v))(x_, y_), (bh-vmul(v))(x_, z_))))
- `bh-vmul-value` — forall([v, s_, t_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies s_ in bounded-ops(v, v) implies t_ in bounded-ops(v, v) implies (bh-vmul(v))(s_, t_) = bop-comp(v, s_, t_))
- `bh-vneg-type` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies bh-vneg(v) in fun(bounded-ops(v, v), bounded-ops(v, v)))
- `bh-vneg-value` — forall([v, t_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies t_ in bounded-ops(v, v) implies (bh-vneg(v))(t_) = bop-neg(v, v, t_))
- `bh-vnrm-act` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([r_ in carr(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field)), x_ in bounded-ops(v, v)], (bh-vnrm(v))((bh-act(v))(r_, x_)) = magnitude(r_) * (bh-vnrm(v))(x_)))
- `bh-vnrm-cstar` — forall([v], is-hilbert-space(v) implies forall([x_ in bounded-ops(v, v)], (bh-vnrm(v))((bh-vmul(v))((bh-vstar(v))(x_), x_)) = (bh-vnrm(v))(x_) * (bh-vnrm(v))(x_)))
- `bh-vnrm-nonneg` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in bounded-ops(v, v)], 0 <= (bh-vnrm(v))(x_)))
- `bh-vnrm-submult` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in bounded-ops(v, v), y_ in bounded-ops(v, v)], (bh-vnrm(v))((bh-vmul(v))(x_, y_)) <= (bh-vnrm(v))(x_) * (bh-vnrm(v))(y_)))
- `bh-vnrm-triangle` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in bounded-ops(v, v), y_ in bounded-ops(v, v)], (bh-vnrm(v))((bh-vadd(v))(x_, y_)) <= (bh-vnrm(v))(x_) + (bh-vnrm(v))(y_)))
- `bh-vnrm-type` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies bh-vnrm(v) in fun(bounded-ops(v, v), rr))
- `bh-vnrm-value` — forall([v, t_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies t_ in bounded-ops(v, v) implies (bh-vnrm(v))(t_) = opnorm(v, v, t_))
- `bh-vnrm-vone` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forsome([bnx_ in vec(v)], not(bnx_ = vzero(v))) implies (bh-vnrm(v))(bop-id(v)) = 1)
- `bh-vnrm-vstar` — forall([v], is-hilbert-space(v) implies forall([x_ in bounded-ops(v, v)], (bh-vnrm(v))((bh-vstar(v))(x_)) = (bh-vnrm(v))(x_)))

- `card-union-singleton-nn` — forall([s_ in set, y_ in set], card(s_) in nn implies card(union(pair(y_, y_), s_)) in nn)
- `card-zermelo` — forall([s in set], card(s) in ord and forsome([phi], phi in bijection(s, ord-segment(card(s)))))
- `card-zero-is-empty` — forall([b_ in set], card(b_) = 0 implies b_ = empty-set)
- `carrier-is-closed` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies is-closed(s, pts(s)))
- `carrier-is-open` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies is-open(s, pts(s)))
- `cartesian-in-power-product` — forall([xs, ys, aa, bb], aa in power(xs) implies bb in power(ys) implies cartesian(aa, bb) in power(cartesian(xs, ys)))
- `cartesian-intersection` — forall([aa, bb, cc_, dd], intersection(cartesian(aa, bb), cartesian(cc_, dd)) = cartesian(intersection(aa, cc_), intersection(bb, dd)))
- `cartesian-membership-nth` — forall([a, b, w], w in cartesian(a, b) iff w = [nth(1, w), nth(2, w)] and nth(1, w) in a and nth(2, w) in b)
- `cartesian-mono` — forall([aa, bb, cc_, dd], aa subset cc_ implies bb subset dd implies cartesian(aa, bb) subset cartesian(cc_, dd))
- `cartesian-nth` — forall([x_, aa, bb], x_ in cartesian(aa, bb) implies nth(1, x_) in aa and nth(2, x_) in bb)
- `cartesian-pair-eq` — forall([x_, aa, bb], x_ in cartesian(aa, bb) implies x_ = [nth(1, x_), nth(2, x_)])
- `cartesian3-set` — forall([u, v, w], u in set implies v in set implies w in set implies cartesian(u, v, w) in set)
- `cartesian4-set` — forall([mra1_, mra2_, mra3_, mra4_], mra1_ in set implies mra2_ in set implies mra3_ in set implies mra4_ in set implies cartesian(mra1_, mra2_, mra3_, mra4_) in set)
- `cartesian5-set` — forall([mxa1_, mxa2_, mxa3_, mxa4_, mxa5_], mxa1_ in set implies mxa2_ in set implies mxa3_ in set implies mxa4_ in set implies mxa5_ in set implies cartesian(mxa1_, mxa2_, mxa3_, mxa4_, mxa5_) in set)
- `casorati-weierstrass` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([a in u, f], holomorphic-on(difference(u, singleton(a)), f) implies is-essential-singularity(f, a) implies forall([mrr_ in rr], 0 < mrr_ implies forall([mrv_ in cc, mre_ in rr], 0 < mre_ implies forsome([mrz_ in difference(u, singleton(a))], magnitude(mrz_ - a) < mrr_ and magnitude(f(mrz_) - mrv_) < mre_)))))
- `cauchy-block-estimate` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([c in pts(s), r], pos-rr(r) implies forall([u], u = ball(s, c, r) implies forall([y in u, z in u, d], pos-rr(d) implies forall([eps in rr], r <= d implies d + d = eps implies (dist(s))(y, z) <= eps)))))
- `cauchy-cluster-converges` — forall([s, f], is-cauchy-seq(s, f) and forsome([x], cluster-point(s, f, x)) implies converges(s, f))
- `cauchy-coefficients-radius` — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([c in cc, cifs_ in rr], 0 < cifs_ implies ball(cc-ms, c, cifs_) subset u implies forall([r in rr], 0 < r implies r < cifs_ implies forall([cieg_ in fun(nn, cc)], forall([ciek_ in nn], cieg_(ciek_) = recip((2 * pi) * 1i) * line-int(vnb-lambda(aiw_, trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi), (restrict(f, trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)))(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - c) ^ succ(ciek_)), circle-path(c, r), circle-deriv(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)) implies forall([cierho_ in rr], 0 <= cierho_ implies cierho_ < r implies cierho_ < cps-radius(cieg_))))))
- `cauchy-convex-closed` — forall([u, f], is-convex-cc(u) implies holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([pgam, dgam, a, b], is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies pgam(b) = pgam(a) implies line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b) = 0))
- `cauchy-convex-closed-except` — forall([u, f, goxx_], is-convex-cc(u) implies is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies goxx_ in u implies holomorphic-on(difference(u, singleton(goxx_)), restrict(f, difference(u, singleton(goxx_)))) implies forall([pgam, dgam, a, b], is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies pgam(b) = pgam(a) implies line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b) = 0))
- `cauchy-convex-primitive` — forall([u, f], is-convex-cc(u) implies holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([gouo_ in u], forsome([goug_ in fun(u, cc)], holomorphic-on(u, goug_) and forall([gouz_ in u], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, u, goug_, gouz_, f(gouz_))))))
- `cauchy-convex-primitive-except` — forall([u, f, goxx_], is-convex-cc(u) implies is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies goxx_ in u implies holomorphic-on(difference(u, singleton(goxx_)), restrict(f, difference(u, singleton(goxx_)))) implies forall([goxo_ in u], forsome([goxg_ in fun(u, cc)], holomorphic-on(u, goxg_) and forall([goxz_ in u], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, u, goxg_, goxz_, f(goxz_))))))
- `cauchy-convex-primitive-of-triangles` — forall([u, f], is-convex-cc(u) implies is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([mrta_ in u, mrtb_ in u, mrtc_ in u], conv3(mrta_, mrtb_, mrtc_) subset u implies tri-int(f, mrta_, mrtb_, mrtc_) = 0) implies forall([mrro_ in u], forsome([mrrg_ in fun(u, cc)], holomorphic-on(u, mrrg_) and forall([mrrz_ in u], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, u, mrrg_, mrrz_, f(mrrz_))))))
- `cauchy-convex-segments` — forall([u, f], is-convex-cc(u) implies holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([goua_ in u, goub_ in u, gouc_ in u], seg-int(f, goua_, gouc_) = seg-int(f, goua_, goub_) + seg-int(f, goub_, gouc_)))
- `cauchy-convex-segments-except` — forall([u, f, goxx_], is-convex-cc(u) implies is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies goxx_ in u implies holomorphic-on(difference(u, singleton(goxx_)), restrict(f, difference(u, singleton(goxx_)))) implies forall([goxa_ in u, goxb_ in u, goxc_ in u], seg-int(f, goxa_, goxc_) = seg-int(f, goxa_, goxb_) + seg-int(f, goxb_, goxc_)))
- `cauchy-convex-segments-of-triangles` — forall([u, f], is-convex-cc(u) implies is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([mrta_ in u, mrtb_ in u, mrtc_ in u], conv3(mrta_, mrtb_, mrtc_) subset u implies tri-int(f, mrta_, mrtb_, mrtc_) = 0) implies forall([mrra_ in u, mrrb_ in u, mrrc_ in u], seg-int(f, mrra_, mrrc_) = seg-int(f, mrra_, mrrb_) + seg-int(f, mrrb_, mrrc_)))
- `cauchy-convex-sub` — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([wnv_], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), wnv_) implies is-convex-cc(wnv_) implies wnv_ subset u implies forall([pgam, dgam, a, b], is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset wnv_ implies pgam(b) = pgam(a) implies line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b) = 0)))
- `cauchy-convex-sub-except` — forall([u, f, cifx_], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies cifx_ in u implies holomorphic-on(difference(u, singleton(cifx_)), restrict(f, difference(u, singleton(cifx_)))) implies forall([cifv_], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), cifv_) implies is-convex-cc(cifv_) implies cifv_ subset u implies forall([pgam, dgam, a, b], is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset cifv_ implies pgam(b) = pgam(a) implies line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b) = 0)))
- `cauchy-criterion-left` — forall([f, x], f in fun(rr, rr) implies x in rr implies forall([eps_], pos-rr(eps_) implies forsome([delta_], pos-rr(delta_) and forall([s_, t_], s_ in rr and x - delta_ <= s_ and s_ < x implies t_ in rr and x - delta_ <= t_ and t_ < x implies abs(f(s_) - f(t_)) <= eps_))) implies forsome([l_], is-left-limit(f, x, l_)))
- `cauchy-criterion-right` — forall([f, x], f in fun(rr, rr) implies x in rr implies forall([eps_], pos-rr(eps_) implies forsome([delta_], pos-rr(delta_) and forall([s_, t_], s_ in rr and x < s_ and s_ <= x + delta_ implies t_ in rr and x < t_ and t_ <= x + delta_ implies abs(f(s_) - f(t_)) <= eps_))) implies forsome([l_], is-right-limit(f, x, l_)))
- `cauchy-derivative-formula` — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([c in cc, cifs_ in rr], 0 < cifs_ implies ball(cc-ms, c, cifs_) subset u implies forall([r in rr], 0 < r implies r < cifs_ implies forall([cierho_ in rr], 0 < cierho_ implies cierho_ < r implies forall([k in nn], (nth-deriv-on(cc-normed-field, ball(cc-ms, c, cierho_), restrict(f, ball(cc-ms, c, cierho_)), k))(c) = factorial(k) * (recip((2 * pi) * 1i) * line-int(vnb-lambda(aiw_, trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi), (restrict(f, trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)))(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - c) ^ succ(k)), circle-path(c, r), circle-deriv(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)))))))
- `cauchy-disc` — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([c in cc, r in rr], 0 < r implies ball(cc-ms, c, r) subset u implies forall([pgam, dgam, a, b], is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset ball(cc-ms, c, r) implies pgam(b) = pgam(a) implies line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b) = 0)))
- `cauchy-disc-except` — forall([u, f, cifx_], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies cifx_ in u implies holomorphic-on(difference(u, singleton(cifx_)), restrict(f, difference(u, singleton(cifx_)))) implies forall([c in cc, r in rr], 0 < r implies ball(cc-ms, c, r) subset u implies forall([pgam, dgam, a, b], is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset ball(cc-ms, c, r) implies pgam(b) = pgam(a) implies line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b) = 0)))
- `cauchy-estimate-center` — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([c in cc, cifs_ in rr], 0 < cifs_ implies ball(cc-ms, c, cifs_) subset u implies forall([r in rr], 0 < r implies r < cifs_ implies forall([ciebd_ in rr], forall([ciey_ in trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)], magnitude(f(ciey_)) <= ciebd_) implies magnitude(f(c)) <= ciebd_))))
- `cauchy-estimate-circle` — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([c in cc, cifs_ in rr], 0 < cifs_ implies ball(cc-ms, c, cifs_) subset u implies forall([r in rr], 0 < r implies r < cifs_ implies forall([ciebd_ in rr], forall([ciey_ in trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)], magnitude(f(ciey_)) <= ciebd_) implies forall([k in nn], magnitude(recip((2 * pi) * 1i) * line-int(vnb-lambda(aiw_, trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi), (restrict(f, trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)))(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - c) ^ succ(k)), circle-path(c, r), circle-deriv(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)) <= ciebd_ * recip(r) ^ k)))))
- `cauchy-estimate-derivative` — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([c in cc, cifs_ in rr], 0 < cifs_ implies ball(cc-ms, c, cifs_) subset u implies forall([r in rr], 0 < r implies r < cifs_ implies forall([cierho_ in rr], 0 < cierho_ implies cierho_ < r implies forall([ciebd_ in rr], forall([ciey_ in trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)], magnitude(f(ciey_)) <= ciebd_) implies forall([k in nn], magnitude((nth-deriv-on(cc-normed-field, ball(cc-ms, c, cierho_), restrict(f, ball(cc-ms, c, cierho_)), k))(c)) <= factorial(k) * (ciebd_ * recip(r) ^ k)))))))
- `cauchy-estimate-from-formula` — forall([u, c, r, phi, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies c in cc implies r in rr implies 0 < r implies forall([aix_ in u], r <= magnitude(aix_ - c)) implies phi in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), phi, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([aim_ in rr], forall([aiy_ in trace(pgam, a, b)], magnitude(phi(aiy_)) <= aim_) implies forall([kap in cc, k in nn], magnitude(kap * line-int(vnb-lambda(aiw_, u, phi(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - c) ^ succ(k)), pgam, dgam, a, b)) <= magnitude(kap) * (road-length(dgam, a, b) * (aim_ * recip(r) ^ succ(k))))))
- `cauchy-estimates` — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([c in cc, hr in rr], 0 < hr implies ball(cc-ms, c, hr) subset u implies forall([bm in rr], forall([z in ball(cc-ms, c, hr)], magnitude(f(z)) <= bm) implies forall([k in nn], magnitude((nth-deriv-on(cc-normed-field, u, f, k))(c)) <= factorial(k) * (bm * recip(hr) ^ k)))))
- `cauchy-estimates-on-ball` — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([c in cc, hr in rr], 0 < hr implies ball(cc-ms, c, hr) subset u implies forall([bm in rr], forall([z in ball(cc-ms, c, hr)], magnitude(f(z)) <= bm) implies forall([rho in rr], 0 < rho implies rho < hr implies forall([k in nn], magnitude((nth-deriv-on(cc-normed-field, ball(cc-ms, c, rho), restrict(f, ball(cc-ms, c, rho)), k))(c)) <= factorial(k) * (bm * recip(hr) ^ k))))))
- `cauchy-integral-formula-centre` — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([c in cc, r in rr], 0 < r implies forall([cmvbr_ in rr], r < cmvbr_ implies ball(cc-ms, c, cmvbr_) subset u implies f(c) = recip((2 * pi) * 1i) * line-int(vnb-lambda(cmvw_, difference(u, singleton(c)), f(cmvw_) * recip(cmvw_ - c)), circle-path(c, r), circle-deriv(c, r), 0, 2 * pi))))
- `cauchy-integral-formula-disc` — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([c in cc, cifs_ in rr], 0 < cifs_ implies ball(cc-ms, c, cifs_) subset u implies forall([r in rr], 0 < r implies r < cifs_ implies forall([z in cc], magnitude(z - c) < r implies f(z) = recip((2 * pi) * 1i) * line-int(vnb-lambda(cifw_, trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi), f(cifw_) * recip(cifw_ - z)), circle-path(c, r), circle-deriv(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)))))
- `cauchy-integral-formula-disc-restrict` — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([c in cc, cifs_ in rr], 0 < cifs_ implies ball(cc-ms, c, cifs_) subset u implies forall([r in rr], 0 < r implies r < cifs_ implies forall([z in cc], magnitude(z - c) < r implies f(z) = recip((2 * pi) * 1i) * line-int(vnb-lambda(aiw_, trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi), (restrict(f, trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)))(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - z)), circle-path(c, r), circle-deriv(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)))))
- `cauchy-kernel-constant-magnitude` — magnitude(recip((2 * pi) * 1i)) = recip(2 * pi)
- `cauchy-kernel-integral-series` — forall([u, c, r, phi, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies c in cc implies r in rr implies 0 < r implies forall([aix_ in u], r <= magnitude(aix_ - c)) implies phi in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), phi, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([z in cc], magnitude(z - c) < r implies cc-series-converges-to(vnb-lambda(aitk_, nn, line-int(vnb-lambda(aiw_, u, phi(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - c) ^ succ(aitk_)), pgam, dgam, a, b) * (z - c) ^ aitk_), line-int(vnb-lambda(aiw_, u, phi(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - z)), pgam, dgam, a, b))))
- `cauchy-kernel-series-absolute` — forall([u, c, r, phi, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies c in cc implies r in rr implies 0 < r implies forall([aix_ in u], r <= magnitude(aix_ - c)) implies phi in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), phi, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([z in cc], magnitude(z - c) < r implies series-converges(vnb-lambda(aitk_, nn, magnitude(line-int(vnb-lambda(aiw_, u, phi(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - c) ^ succ(aitk_)), pgam, dgam, a, b) * (z - c) ^ aitk_)))))
- `cauchy-point-limit` — forall([omega, gs, xq], gs in fun(nn, fun(omega, rr)) implies xq in omega implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([nb in nn], forall([m in nn, q in nn], nb <= m implies nb <= q implies abs((gs(m))(xq) - (gs(q))(xq)) <= eps))) implies (ptwise-liminf(omega, vnb-lambda(rpk_, nn, pos-part(omega, gs(rpk_)))))(xq) in rr and (ptwise-liminf(omega, vnb-lambda(rqk_, nn, neg-part(omega, gs(rqk_)))))(xq) in rr and converges-to(rr-ms, vnb-lambda(k, nn, (gs(k))(xq)), (ptwise-liminf(omega, vnb-lambda(rpk_, nn, pos-part(omega, gs(rpk_)))))(xq) - (ptwise-liminf(omega, vnb-lambda(rqk_, nn, neg-part(omega, gs(rqk_)))))(xq)))
- `cauchy-rapid-subsequence` — forall([s, f, rad], is-cauchy-seq(s, f) and rad in fun(nn, rr) and forall([k in nn], pos-rr(rad(k))) implies forsome([phi in fun(nn, nn)], forall([m in nn, n_ in nn], m < n_ implies phi(m) < phi(n_)) and forall([k in nn], (dist(s))(f(phi(k)), f(phi(succ(k)))) <= rad(k))))
- `cauchy-schwarz-finite` — forall([s], s in set and card(s) in nn implies forall([a in fun(s, rr), b in fun(s, rr)], finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), vnb-lambda(i, s, a(i) * b(i)), s) * finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), vnb-lambda(i, s, a(i) * b(i)), s) <= finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), vnb-lambda(i, s, a(i) * a(i)), s) * finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), vnb-lambda(i, s, b(i) * b(i)), s)))
- `cauchy-schwarz-sqrt` — forall([s], s in set and card(s) in nn implies forall([a in fun(s, rr), b in fun(s, rr)], abs(finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), vnb-lambda(i, s, a(i) * b(i)), s)) <= sqrt(finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), vnb-lambda(i, s, a(i) * a(i)), s)) * sqrt(finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), vnb-lambda(i, s, b(i) * b(i)), s))))
- `cauchy-seq-is-fun` — forall([s, f], is-cauchy-seq(s, f) implies f in fun(nn, pts(s)))
- `cauchy-setoid-is-setoid` — forall([m], is-metric-space(m) implies is-setoid(cauchy-setoid(m)))
- `cauchy-type-integral-deriv` — forall([u, c, r, phi, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies c in cc implies r in rr implies 0 < r implies forall([aix_ in u], r <= magnitude(aix_ - c)) implies phi in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), phi, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([kap in cc, aiou_], is-open(cc-ms, aiou_) implies ball(cc-ms, c, r) subset aiou_ implies forall([f in fun(aiou_, cc)], forall([z in cc], magnitude(z - c) < r implies f(z) = kap * line-int(vnb-lambda(aiw_, u, phi(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - z)), pgam, dgam, a, b)) implies is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, aiou_, f, c, kap * line-int(vnb-lambda(aiw_, u, phi(aiw_) * recip(aiw_ - c) ^ succ(1)), pgam, dgam, a, b)))))
- `cayley-adjoint-of-self-adjoint` — forall([v, gg], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies gg subset cartesian(vec(v), vec(v)) implies is-self-adjoint-graph(v, gg) implies graph-adjoint(v, cayley-graph(v, gg)) = graph-inverse(v, cayley-graph(v, gg)))
- `cayley-at` — forall([w in cc], not(w + 1i = 0) implies cayley(w) = (w - 1i) * recip(w + 1i))

- `cc-fn-vadd-assoc` — forall([u], u subset cc implies forall([a in cc-cont-fns(u), b in cc-cont-fns(u), c in cc-cont-fns(u)], (vnb-lambda([cfa_, cfb_], cartesian(cc-cont-fns(u), cc-cont-fns(u)), vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, cfa_(cfz_) + cfb_(cfz_))))((vnb-lambda([cfa_, cfb_], cartesian(cc-cont-fns(u), cc-cont-fns(u)), vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, cfa_(cfz_) + cfb_(cfz_))))(a, b), c) = (vnb-lambda([cfa_, cfb_], cartesian(cc-cont-fns(u), cc-cont-fns(u)), vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, cfa_(cfz_) + cfb_(cfz_))))(a, (vnb-lambda([cfa_, cfb_], cartesian(cc-cont-fns(u), cc-cont-fns(u)), vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, cfa_(cfz_) + cfb_(cfz_))))(b, c))))
- `cc-fn-vadd-comm` — forall([u], u subset cc implies forall([a in cc-cont-fns(u), b in cc-cont-fns(u)], (vnb-lambda([cfa_, cfb_], cartesian(cc-cont-fns(u), cc-cont-fns(u)), vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, cfa_(cfz_) + cfb_(cfz_))))(a, b) = (vnb-lambda([cfa_, cfb_], cartesian(cc-cont-fns(u), cc-cont-fns(u)), vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, cfa_(cfz_) + cfb_(cfz_))))(b, a)))
- `cc-fn-vadd-neg-left` — forall([u], u subset cc implies forall([a in cc-cont-fns(u)], (vnb-lambda([cfa_, cfb_], cartesian(cc-cont-fns(u), cc-cont-fns(u)), vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, cfa_(cfz_) + cfb_(cfz_))))((vnb-lambda(cfa_, cc-cont-fns(u), vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, -cfa_(cfz_))))(a), a) = vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, 0)))
- `cc-fn-vadd-neg-right` — forall([u], u subset cc implies forall([a in cc-cont-fns(u)], (vnb-lambda([cfa_, cfb_], cartesian(cc-cont-fns(u), cc-cont-fns(u)), vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, cfa_(cfz_) + cfb_(cfz_))))(a, (vnb-lambda(cfa_, cc-cont-fns(u), vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, -cfa_(cfz_))))(a)) = vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, 0)))
- `cc-fn-vadd-zero-left` — forall([u], u subset cc implies forall([a in cc-cont-fns(u)], (vnb-lambda([cfa_, cfb_], cartesian(cc-cont-fns(u), cc-cont-fns(u)), vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, cfa_(cfz_) + cfb_(cfz_))))(vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, 0), a) = a))
- `cc-fn-vadd-zero-right` — forall([u], u subset cc implies forall([a in cc-cont-fns(u)], (vnb-lambda([cfa_, cfb_], cartesian(cc-cont-fns(u), cc-cont-fns(u)), vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, cfa_(cfz_) + cfb_(cfz_))))(a, vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, 0)) = a))
- `cc-four-cancel` — forall([ca_ in cc, cb_ in cc], 4 * ca_ = 4 * cb_ implies ca_ = cb_)
- `cc-four-eps` — forall([fa_ in cc, fb_ in cc, fc_ in cc, fw_ in cc, fr_ in rr, fd_ in rr, fe_ in rr], 0 < fr_ implies fr_ + fr_ = fd_ implies fd_ + fd_ = fe_ implies magnitude(fb_ - fc_) < fr_ implies magnitude(fb_ - fa_) <= fr_ implies magnitude(fc_ - fw_) <= fr_ implies magnitude(fa_ - fw_) < fe_)
- `cc-fr-conv-iff-unif-on-compacta` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([s in fun(nn, cc-cont-fns(u)), f in cc-cont-fns(u)], fr-conv(cc-fn-module(u, cc-cont-fns(u)), cc-exhaust-seminorms(u, cc-cont-fns(u)), s, f) iff unif-on-compacta(u, s, f)))
- `cc-fr-conv-transfer` — forall([u], u subset cc implies forall([fva_ in set], fva_ subset fun(u, cc) implies forall([a in fva_, b in fva_], vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, a(cfz_) + b(cfz_)) in fva_) implies vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, 0) in fva_ implies forall([a in fva_], vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, -a(cfz_)) in fva_) implies forall([c in cc, a in fva_], vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, c * a(cfz_)) in fva_) implies forall([a in fva_, b in fva_], vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, a(cfz_) + -b(cfz_)) in fva_) implies forall([fvb_ in set], fvb_ subset fun(u, cc) implies forall([a in fvb_, b in fvb_], vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, a(cfz_) + b(cfz_)) in fvb_) implies vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, 0) in fvb_ implies forall([a in fvb_], vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, -a(cfz_)) in fvb_) implies forall([c in cc, a in fvb_], vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, c * a(cfz_)) in fvb_) implies forall([a in fvb_, b in fvb_], vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, a(cfz_) + -b(cfz_)) in fvb_) implies forall([s], forall([i in nn], s(i) in fva_) implies forall([i in nn], s(i) in fvb_) implies forall([f in fva_], f in fvb_ implies fr-conv(cc-fn-module(u, fva_), cc-exhaust-seminorms(u, fva_), s, f) implies fr-conv(cc-fn-module(u, fvb_), cc-exhaust-seminorms(u, fvb_), s, f))))))
- `cc-fraction-common-denominator` — forall([k in nn, aa, c], is-subring-of-cc(aa) implies c in fun(nn, {anfq_ in cc: forsome([anfa_ in aa, anfb_ in aa], not(anfb_ = 0) and anfq_ * anfb_ = anfa_)}) implies forsome([cdd_ in aa], not(cdd_ = 0) and forall([anj_ in nn], anj_ < k implies cdd_ * c(anj_) in aa)))
- `cc-fraction-field-sub` — forall([aa], cc-fraction-field(aa) subset {anfq_ in cc: forsome([anfa_ in aa, anfb_ in aa], not(anfb_ = 0) and anfq_ * anfb_ = anfa_)})
- `cc-fraction-field-sup` — forall([aa], {anfq_ in cc: forsome([anfa_ in aa, anfb_ in aa], not(anfb_ = 0) and anfq_ * anfb_ = anfa_)} subset cc-fraction-field(aa))
- `cc-functional-continuous-of-bound` — forall([v, f, m_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies is-cc-linear-functional(v, f) implies m_ in rr implies 0 <= m_ implies forall([bcx_ in vec(v)], magnitude(f(bcx_)) <= m_ * ip-norm(v, bcx_)) implies is-continuous(ip-metric-space(v), cc-ms, f))
- `cc-geometric-alternating` — forall([algg_ in fun(nn, cc)], forall([algj_ in nn], algg_(algj_) = num(-1) ^ algj_) implies forall([algz_ in cc], magnitude(algz_) < 1 implies cc-series-converges(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, algg_(cpsk_) * algz_ ^ cpsk_)) and cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, algg_(cpsk_) * algz_ ^ cpsk_)) = recip(1 + algz_)))
- `cc-half-plane-open` — forall([aomu_, aouu_], aomu_ in cc implies aouu_ in cc implies is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), {aohw_ in cc: 0 < real-part(aomu_ * (aohw_ - aouu_))}))
- `cc-has-compact-exhaustion` — forsome([kx], is-compact-exhaustion(cc-ms, kx))
- `cc-hat-ball-complement-open` — forall([m in rr], difference(cc-hat, closed-ball(cc-ms, 0, m)) in cc-hat-opens)
- `cc-hat-ball-open` — forall([x in cc, r], pos-rr(r) implies ball(cc-ms, x, r) in cc-hat-opens)
- `cc-hat-converges-iff` — forall([f in fun(nn, cc), x in cc], top-converges-to(cc-hat-top, f, x) iff converges-to(cc-ms, f, x))
- `cc-hat-converges-inf-iff` — forall([f in fun(nn, cc)], top-converges-to(cc-hat-top, f, cc-inf) iff forall([m in rr], forsome([n in nn], forall([k in nn], n <= k implies m <= magnitude(f(k))))))
- `cc-hat-in-set` — cc-hat in set
- `cc-hat-membership` — forall([x], x in cc-hat iff x in cc or x = cc-inf)
- `cc-hat-nbhd-finite` — forall([u in cc-hat-opens, x in cc], x in u implies forsome([r], pos-rr(r) and forall([y in cc], magnitude(y - x) < r implies y in u)))
- `cc-hat-nbhd-inf` — forall([u in cc-hat-opens], cc-inf in u implies forsome([m in rr], forall([y in cc], m < magnitude(y) implies y in u)))
- `cc-hat-opens-membership` — forall([u], u in cc-hat-opens iff u in power(cc-hat) and (u subset cc and is-open(cc-ms, u) or forsome([kh_], kh_ subset cc and is-compact(subspace-ms(cc-ms, kh_)) and u = difference(cc-hat, kh_))))
- `cc-hol-bounded-equicontinuous` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([a], cc-hol-bounded(u, a) implies forall([z0 in u, eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([del], pos-rr(del) and forall([f in a, z in u], magnitude(z - z0) < del implies magnitude(f(z) - f(z0)) < eps)))))
- `cc-hol-bounded-mono` — forall([u, ca6b_], cc-hol-bounded(u, ca6b_) implies forall([ca6a_], ca6a_ subset ca6b_ implies cc-hol-bounded(u, ca6a_)))
- `cc-hol-bounded-subseq` — forall([u, s], cc-hol-bounded(u, image(s, nn)) implies forall([phi], strictly-mono-nn(phi) implies cc-hol-bounded(u, image(subseq(s, phi), nn))))
- `cc-hol-fn-module-is-module` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies is-module(cc-fn-module(u, cc-hol-fns(u))))
- `cc-hol-fns-add` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([a in cc-hol-fns(u), b in cc-hol-fns(u)], vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, a(cfz_) + b(cfz_)) in cc-hol-fns(u)))
- `cc-hol-fns-add-neg` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([a in cc-hol-fns(u), b in cc-hol-fns(u)], vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, a(cfz_) + -b(cfz_)) in cc-hol-fns(u)))
- `cc-hol-fns-closed` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([s in fun(nn, cc-hol-fns(u)), f in cc-cont-fns(u)], fr-conv(cc-fn-module(u, cc-cont-fns(u)), cc-exhaust-seminorms(u, cc-cont-fns(u)), s, f) implies f in cc-hol-fns(u)))
- `cc-hol-fns-frechet` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies is-frechet-structure(cc-normed-field, cc-fn-module(u, cc-hol-fns(u)), cc-exhaust-seminorms(u, cc-hol-fns(u))))
- `cc-hol-fns-membership` — forall([u, h], h in cc-hol-fns(u) iff h in fun(u, cc) and holomorphic-on(u, h))
- `cc-hol-fns-neg` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([a in cc-hol-fns(u)], vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, -a(cfz_)) in cc-hol-fns(u)))
- `cc-hol-fns-scale` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([c in cc, a in cc-hol-fns(u)], vnb-lambda(cfz_, u, c * a(cfz_)) in cc-hol-fns(u)))

- `cc-hol-fns-unfold` — forall([u], cc-hol-fns(u) == {ccf_ in fun(u, cc): holomorphic-on(u, ccf_)})
