- `cc-hol-seminorms-family` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies is-seminorm-family(cc-normed-field, cc-fn-module(u, cc-hol-fns(u)), cc-exhaust-seminorms(u, cc-hol-fns(u))))
- `cc-holomorphic-deriv-estimate` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([y in cc, q in rr], 0 < q implies ball(cc-ms, y, 2 * q) subset u implies forall([bm in rr], forall([cmy_ in ball(cc-ms, y, 2 * q)], magnitude(f(cmy_)) <= bm) implies magnitude(deriv-on(cc-normed-field, u, f, y)) <= bm * recip(q)))))
- `cc-holomorphic-lipschitz-at-centre` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([c in cc, q in rr], 0 < q implies ball(cc-ms, c, 3 * q) subset u implies forall([bm in rr], forall([cmy_ in ball(cc-ms, c, 3 * q)], magnitude(f(cmy_)) <= bm) implies forall([z in ball(cc-ms, c, q)], magnitude(f(z) - f(c)) <= (bm * recip(q)) * magnitude(z - c))))))
- `cc-hom-add` — forall([s, fa, fb], is-hom-top-space(s, metric-top(cc-ms), fa) implies is-hom-top-space(s, metric-top(cc-ms), fb) implies is-hom-top-space(s, metric-top(cc-ms), vnb-lambda(ctv_, pts(s), fa(ctv_) + fb(ctv_))))
- `cc-hom-const` — forall([s, cc_], is-top-space(s) implies cc_ in cc implies is-hom-top-space(s, metric-top(cc-ms), vnb-lambda(ctv_, pts(s), cc_)))
- `cc-hom-equalizer-closed` — forall([s, fa, fb], is-hom-top-space(s, metric-top(cc-ms), fa) implies is-hom-top-space(s, metric-top(cc-ms), fb) implies is-top-closed(s, {ctp_ in pts(s): fa(ctp_) = fb(ctp_)}))
- `cc-hom-local` — forall([s, fa], is-hom-top-space(s, metric-top(cc-ms), fa) implies forall([cp_ in pts(s), ce_ in rr], 0 < ce_ implies forsome([ctw_ in opens(s)], cp_ in ctw_ and forall([ctq_ in ctw_], ctq_ in pts(s) and magnitude(fa(cp_) - fa(ctq_)) < ce_))))
- `cc-hom-mul` — forall([s, fa, fb], is-hom-top-space(s, metric-top(cc-ms), fa) implies is-hom-top-space(s, metric-top(cc-ms), fb) implies is-hom-top-space(s, metric-top(cc-ms), vnb-lambda(ctv_, pts(s), fa(ctv_) * fb(ctv_))))
- `cc-hom-of-local` — forall([s, fa], is-top-space(s) implies fa in fun(pts(s), cc) implies forall([cp_ in pts(s), ce_ in rr], 0 < ce_ implies forsome([ctw_ in opens(s)], cp_ in ctw_ and forall([ctq_ in ctw_], ctq_ in pts(s) and magnitude(fa(cp_) - fa(ctq_)) < ce_))) implies is-hom-top-space(s, metric-top(cc-ms), fa))
- `cc-hom-separate` — forall([s, fa, fb, ch, p], is-hom-top-space(s, metric-top(cc-ms), fa) implies is-hom-top-space(s, metric-top(cc-ms), fb) implies forall([ctc_ in ch], fa(ctc_) = fb(ctc_)) implies p in pts(s) implies not(fa(p) = fb(p)) implies forsome([ctw_ in opens(s)], p in ctw_ and ctw_ subset complement-in(pts(s), ch)))
- `cc-hurwitz` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies is-connected(cc-ms, u) implies forall([s in fun(nn, cc-hol-fns(u))], forall([k in nn, z in u], not((s(k))(z) = 0)) implies forall([f in fun(u, cc)], unif-on-compacta(u, s, f) implies forsome([hcc_ in cc], forall([hcz_ in u], f(hcz_) = hcc_)) or forall([z in u], not(f(z) = 0)))))
- `cc-hurwitz-circle-gap` — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([c in cc, r in rr], 0 < r implies forall([hdq_ in rr], r < hdq_ implies ball(cc-ms, c, hdq_) subset u implies forall([hda_ in cc], forall([hdy_ in ball(cc-ms, c, hdq_)], not(hdy_ = c) implies not(f(hdy_) = hda_)) implies forsome([hdm_ in rr], 0 < hdm_ and forall([hdy_ in trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)], hdm_ <= magnitude(f(hdy_) - hda_)))))))
- `cc-hurwitz-disc-bound` — forall([u, g], holomorphic-on(u, g) implies forall([c in cc, r in rr], 0 < r implies forall([hdq_ in rr], r < hdq_ implies ball(cc-ms, c, hdq_) subset u implies forall([hda_ in cc], forall([hdy_ in ball(cc-ms, c, hdq_)], not(g(hdy_) = hda_)) implies forall([hdm_ in rr], 0 < hdm_ implies forall([hdy_ in trace(circle-path(c, r), 0, 2 * pi)], hdm_ <= magnitude(g(hdy_) - hda_)) implies hdm_ <= magnitude(g(c) - hda_))))))
- `cc-hurwitz-eventually` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies is-connected(cc-ms, u) implies forall([s in fun(nn, cc-hol-fns(u)), f in fun(u, cc)], unif-on-compacta(u, s, f) implies not(forsome([hcc_ in cc], forall([hcz_ in u], f(hcz_) = hcc_))) implies forall([hza_ in cc, hzc_ in u], f(hzc_) = hza_ implies forall([hzr_ in rr], 0 < hzr_ implies forsome([hzn_ in nn], forall([hzk_ in nn], hzn_ <= hzk_ implies forsome([hzz_ in u], hzz_ in ball(cc-ms, hzc_, hzr_) and (s(hzk_))(hzz_) = hza_)))))))
- `cc-hurwitz-injective` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies is-connected(cc-ms, u) implies forall([s in fun(nn, cc-hol-fns(u))], forall([k in nn, z in u, w in u], (s(k))(z) = (s(k))(w) implies z = w) implies forall([f in fun(u, cc)], unif-on-compacta(u, s, f) implies forsome([hcc_ in cc], forall([hcz_ in u], f(hcz_) = hcc_)) or forall([z in u, w in u], f(z) = f(w) implies z = w))))
- `cc-hurwitz-local` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([s in fun(nn, cc-hol-fns(u)), f in fun(u, cc)], unif-on-compacta(u, s, f) implies forall([hza_ in cc, hzc_ in u], f(hzc_) = hza_ implies forall([hzp_ in rr], 0 < hzp_ implies forall([hzx_ in u], hzx_ in ball(cc-ms, hzc_, hzp_) implies not(hzx_ = hzc_) implies not(f(hzx_) = hza_)) implies forall([hzr_ in rr], 0 < hzr_ implies forsome([hzn_ in nn], forall([hzk_ in nn], hzn_ <= hzk_ implies forsome([hzz_ in u], hzz_ in ball(cc-ms, hzc_, hzr_) and (s(hzk_))(hzz_) = hza_))))))))
- `cc-hurwitz-value` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies is-connected(cc-ms, u) implies forall([s in fun(nn, cc-hol-fns(u)), hza_ in cc], forall([k in nn, z in u], not((s(k))(z) = hza_)) implies forall([f in fun(u, cc)], unif-on-compacta(u, s, f) implies forsome([hcc_ in cc], forall([hcz_ in u], f(hcz_) = hcc_)) or forall([z in u], not(f(z) = hza_)))))
- `cc-im-add` — forall([z in cc, w in cc], imag-part(z + w) = imag-part(z) + imag-part(w))
- `cc-im-dist-le` — forall([z in cc, w in cc], abs(imag-part(z) - imag-part(w)) <= magnitude(z - w))
- `cc-im-i-mul` — forall([aoz_ in cc], imag-part(1i * aoz_) = real-part(aoz_))
- `cc-im-mul` — forall([z in cc, w in cc], imag-part(z * w) = real-part(z) * imag-part(w) + imag-part(z) * real-part(w))
- `cc-im-of-real` — forall([g4wz_ in rr], imag-part(g4wz_) = 0)
- `cc-im-real-mul` — forall([c_ in rr, z in cc], imag-part(c_ * z) = c_ * imag-part(z))
- `cc-im-sub` — forall([z_, w_], z_ in cc implies w_ in cc implies imag-part(z_ - w_) = imag-part(z_) - imag-part(w_))
- `cc-im-unif-cauchy-on-compact` — forall([kk], kk subset cc implies is-compact(subspace-ms(cc-ms, kk)) implies forall([dq], is-dense-seq(subspace-ms(cc-ms, kk), dq) implies forall([t], forall([k in nn, z in kk], (t(k))(z) in cc) implies forall([x in kk, eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([del], pos-rr(del) and forall([k in nn, y in kk], magnitude(y - x) < del implies magnitude((t(k))(y) - (t(k))(x)) < eps))) implies forall([j in nn], forsome([lm in rr], converges-to(rr-ms, vnb-lambda(cmk_, nn, imag-part((t(cmk_))(dq(j)))), lm))) implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([cap in nn], forall([i in nn], cap <= i implies forall([j in nn], cap <= j implies forall([z in kk], abs(imag-part((t(i))(z)) - imag-part((t(j))(z))) < eps))))))))
- `cc-im-zero` — imag-part(0) = 0
- `cc-in-cc-hat` — forall([z in cc], z in cc-hat)
- `cc-inf-in-cc-hat` — cc-inf in cc-hat
- `cc-int-abs-bound` — forall([pphi_, pwf_, paw_, pabs_, pbh_, a, b], pphi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies is-primitive(pwf_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), real-part(pphi_(pat_))), a, b) implies is-primitive(paw_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), imag-part(pphi_(pat_))), a, b) implies is-primitive(pbh_, pabs_, a, b) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pabs_(pay_) == magnitude(pphi_(pay_))) implies magnitude(cc-int(pphi_, a, b)) <= pw-int(pabs_, a, b))
- `cc-int-adjacent` — forall([a, b], a in rr implies b in rr implies forall([pcv_ in ooint(a, b), pphi_, pwf_, paw_], pphi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies is-primitive(pwf_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), real-part(pphi_(pat_))), a, b) implies is-primitive(paw_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), imag-part(pphi_(pat_))), a, b) implies cc-int(pphi_, a, b) = cc-int(restrict(pphi_, ccint(a, pcv_)), a, pcv_) + cc-int(restrict(pphi_, ccint(pcv_, b)), pcv_, b)))
- `cc-int-affine-subst` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, lrpc_ in rr, lrpd_ in rr, lrpl_ in rr, lrpm_ in rr], 0 < lrpl_ implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpc_ = a implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpd_ = b implies lrpc_ < lrpd_ implies forall([pphi_, lrpb_], pphi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies lrpb_ in fun(ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_), cc) implies forall([lrpz_ in ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_)], lrpb_(lrpz_) == lrpl_ * pphi_(lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpz_)) implies forall([pwf_, paw_], is-primitive(pwf_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), real-part(pphi_(pat_))), a, b) implies is-primitive(paw_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), imag-part(pphi_(pat_))), a, b) implies cc-int(lrpb_, lrpc_, lrpd_) = cc-int(pphi_, a, b))))
- `cc-int-as-line-int` — forall([u, f, a, b], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies a in rr implies b in rr implies a < b implies ccint(a, b) subset u implies cc-int(f, a, b) = line-int(f, vnb-lambda(gmt_, ccint(a, b), gmt_), vnb-lambda(gmt_, ccint(a, b), 1), a, b))
- `cc-int-compare-primitive` — forall([u, f, gdr, gpr, a, b], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies a in rr implies b in rr implies a < b implies ccint(a, b) subset u implies holomorphic-on(u, gpr) implies gdr in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), gdr, rgy_)) implies forall([hbz_ in u], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, u, gpr, hbz_, gdr(hbz_))) implies forall([gmy_ in ccint(a, b)], magnitude(f(gmy_)) <= real-part(gdr(gmy_))) implies magnitude(cc-int(f, a, b)) <= real-part(gpr(b) - gpr(a)))
- `cc-int-complex-mul` — forall([a, b], a in rr implies b in rr implies forall([pphi_, pchi_, pcw_ in cc], pphi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies pchi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pchi_(pay_) == pcw_ * pphi_(pay_)) implies forall([pwf_, paw_], is-primitive(pwf_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), real-part(pphi_(pat_))), a, b) implies is-primitive(paw_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), imag-part(pphi_(pat_))), a, b) implies cc-int(pchi_, a, b) = pcw_ * cc-int(pphi_, a, b))))
- `cc-int-congruence` — forall([pphi_, ppsi_, a, b, lig1_, lig2_], is-primitive(lig1_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), real-part(pphi_(pat_))), a, b) implies is-primitive(lig2_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), imag-part(pphi_(pat_))), a, b) implies ppsi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies forall([liy_ in ccint(a, b)], pphi_(liy_) == ppsi_(liy_)) implies cc-int(pphi_, a, b) = cc-int(ppsi_, a, b))
- `cc-int-in-cc` — forall([a, b], a in rr implies b in rr implies forall([pphi_, pwf_, paw_], is-primitive(pwf_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), real-part(pphi_(pat_))), a, b) implies is-primitive(paw_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), imag-part(pphi_(pat_))), a, b) implies cc-int(pphi_, a, b) in cc))
- `cc-int-in-cc-of-continuous` — forall([u, f, a, b], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies a in rr implies b in rr implies a < b implies ccint(a, b) subset u implies cc-int(f, a, b) in cc)
- `cc-int-linear-combination` — forall([u, f1, f2, p, q], u subset cc implies f1 in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f1, rgy_)) implies p in rr implies q in rr implies p < q implies ccint(p, q) subset u implies f2 in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f2, rgy_)) implies forall([c in cc, h in fun(u, cc)], forall([gmv_ in u], h(gmv_) == f1(gmv_) + c * f2(gmv_)) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), h, rgy_)) and cc-int(h, p, q) = cc-int(f1, p, q) + c * cc-int(f2, p, q)))
- `cc-int-of-derivative` — forall([u, gdr, gpr, a, b], u subset cc implies gdr in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), gdr, rgy_)) implies a in rr implies b in rr implies a < b implies ccint(a, b) subset u implies holomorphic-on(u, gpr) implies forall([hbz_ in u], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, u, gpr, hbz_, gdr(hbz_))) implies cc-int(gdr, a, b) = gpr(b) - gpr(a))
- `cc-int-real-mul` — forall([a, b], a in rr implies b in rr implies forall([pphi_, pchi_, pcc_ in rr], pphi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies pchi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pchi_(pay_) == pcc_ * pphi_(pay_)) implies forall([pwf_, paw_], is-primitive(pwf_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), real-part(pphi_(pat_))), a, b) implies is-primitive(paw_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), imag-part(pphi_(pat_))), a, b) implies cc-int(pchi_, a, b) = pcc_ * cc-int(pphi_, a, b))))
- `cc-int-reflect` — forall([a, b], a in rr implies b in rr implies forall([pphi_, prb_], pphi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies prb_ in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], prb_(pay_) == pphi_(a + b - pay_)) implies forall([pwf_, paw_], is-primitive(pwf_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), real-part(pphi_(pat_))), a, b) implies is-primitive(paw_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), imag-part(pphi_(pat_))), a, b) implies cc-int(prb_, a, b) = cc-int(pphi_, a, b))))
- `cc-int-split` — forall([u, f, a, b], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies a in rr implies b in rr implies a < b implies ccint(a, b) subset u implies forall([c in rr], a < c implies c < b implies cc-int(f, a, b) = cc-int(f, a, c) + cc-int(f, c, b)))
- `cc-int-sum` — forall([a, b], a in rr implies b in rr implies forall([pphi_, ppsi_, pchi_], pphi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies ppsi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies pchi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pchi_(pay_) == pphi_(pay_) + ppsi_(pay_)) implies forall([pwf_, paw_, pauh_, pbw_], is-primitive(pwf_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), real-part(pphi_(pat_))), a, b) implies is-primitive(paw_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), imag-part(pphi_(pat_))), a, b) implies is-primitive(pauh_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), real-part(ppsi_(pat_))), a, b) implies is-primitive(pbw_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), imag-part(ppsi_(pat_))), a, b) implies cc-int(pchi_, a, b) = cc-int(pphi_, a, b) + cc-int(ppsi_, a, b))))
- `cc-int-unfold` — forall([pphi_, a, b], cc-int(pphi_, a, b) == pw-int(vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), real-part(pphi_(pat_))), a, b) + pw-int(vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), imag-part(pphi_(pat_))), a, b) * 1i)
- `cc-int-value` — forall([a, b], a in rr implies b in rr implies forall([pphi_, pwf_, paw_], is-primitive(pwf_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), real-part(pphi_(pat_))), a, b) implies is-primitive(paw_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), imag-part(pphi_(pat_))), a, b) implies cc-int(pphi_, a, b) = pwf_(b) - pwf_(a) + (paw_(b) - paw_(a)) * 1i))
- `cc-invertible-det-nonzero` — forall([s], is-invertible-mat(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field), 2, s) implies not(entry(s, 1, 1) * entry(s, 2, 2) - entry(s, 1, 2) * entry(s, 2, 1) = 0))

- `cc-limit-finsum` — forall([ix, w in set], card(w) in nn implies w subset ix implies forall([u in fun(nn, fun(ix, cc)), lv in fun(ix, cc)], forall([b5k_ in w], converges-to(cc-ms, vnb-lambda(b5m_, nn, (u(b5m_))(b5k_)), lv(b5k_))) implies converges-to(cc-ms, vnb-lambda(b5m_, nn, finsum(normed-ag-as-abelian-group(cc-nag), u(b5m_), w)), finsum(normed-ag-as-abelian-group(cc-nag), lv, w))))
- `cc-limit-lincomb` — forall([s_ in fun(nn, cc), t_ in fun(nn, cc), h in fun(nn, cc), lv in cc, mv in cc, cpdc_ in cc, cpdd_ in cc], forall([cpdj_ in nn], h(cpdj_) = cpdc_ * s_(cpdj_) + cpdd_ * t_(cpdj_)) implies converges-to(cc-ms, s_, lv) implies converges-to(cc-ms, t_, mv) implies converges-to(cc-ms, h, cpdc_ * lv + cpdd_ * mv))
- `cc-limit-magnitude-le` — forall([s_ in fun(nn, cc), lv in cc, bd in rr], converges-to(cc-ms, s_, lv) implies forall([n_ in nn], magnitude(s_(n_)) <= bd) implies magnitude(lv) <= bd)

- `cc-limit-quotient` — forall([c6a_ in fun(nn, cc), c6b_ in fun(nn, cc), c6p_ in cc, c6q_ in cc], not(c6q_ = 0) implies forall([c6i_ in nn], not(c6b_(c6i_) = 0)) implies converges-to(cc-ms, c6a_, c6p_) implies converges-to(cc-ms, c6b_, c6q_) implies converges-to(cc-ms, vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, c6a_(c6k_) * recip(c6b_(c6k_))), c6p_ * recip(c6q_)))
- `cc-limit-shift` — forall([s_ in fun(nn, cc), h in fun(nn, cc), lv in cc], forall([cpdj_ in nn], h(cpdj_) = s_(succ(cpdj_))) implies converges-to(cc-ms, s_, lv) implies converges-to(cc-ms, h, lv))

- `cc-limit-unique` — forall([f in fun(nn, cc), lm1 in cc, lm2 in cc], converges-to(cc-ms, f, lm1) implies converges-to(cc-ms, f, lm2) implies lm1 = lm2)
- `cc-lincomb-add` — forall([n, b1, b2, g], n in nn implies b1 in fun(interval(1, n), cc) implies b2 in fun(interval(1, n), cc) implies g in fun(interval(1, n), cc) implies cc-lincomb(n, b1, g) + cc-lincomb(n, b2, g) = cc-lincomb(n, vnb-lambda(amj_, interval(1, n), b1(amj_) + b2(amj_)), g))

- `cc-lincomb-unit` — forall([n, g, i], n in nn implies g in fun(interval(1, n), cc) implies i in interval(1, n) implies cc-lincomb(n, vnb-lambda(amj_, interval(1, n), if(amj_ = i, 1, 0)), g) = g(i))
- `cc-lincomb-zero-coefficients` — forall([n, g], n in nn implies g in fun(interval(1, n), cc) implies cc-lincomb(n, vnb-lambda(amj_, interval(1, n), 0), g) = 0)
- `cc-lincomb-zero-generators` — forall([n, b, g], n in nn implies forall([amk_ in interval(1, n)], b(amk_) in cc) implies forall([amk_ in interval(1, n)], g(amk_) = 0) implies cc-lincomb(n, b, g) = 0)
- `cc-line-dot-cross` — forall([aop_, aoq_, aou_, aos_], aop_ in cc implies aoq_ in cc implies aou_ in cc implies aos_ in rr implies real-part(conjugate(1i * (aop_ - aoq_)) * (aop_ + aos_ * (aoq_ - aop_) - aou_)) = imag-part((aoq_ - aou_) * conjugate(aop_ - aou_)))

- `cc-linear-functional-kernel-submodule` — forall([v, f], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies is-cc-linear-functional(v, f) implies is-submodule(v, preimage(ip-metric-space(v), f, closed-ball(cc-ms, 0, 0))))
- `cc-linear-functional-laws` — forall([v, f], is-cc-linear-functional(v, f) implies f in fun(vec(v), cc) and forall([hlx_ in vec(v), hly_ in vec(v)], f((vadd(v))(hlx_, hly_)) = f(hlx_) + f(hly_)) and forall([hlc_ in cc, hlx_ in vec(v)], f((act(v))(hlc_, hlx_)) = hlc_ * f(hlx_)))
- `cc-linear-functional-zero-neg` — forall([v, f], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies is-cc-linear-functional(v, f) implies f(vzero(v)) = 0 and forall([x_ in vec(v)], f((vneg(v))(x_)) = -f(x_)))
- `cc-locally-convex-separation` — forall([m, ix, pf, u, x0, c], is-seminorm-family-on(cc-normed-field, m, ix, pf) implies u in opens(seminorm-top(m, ix, pf)) implies x0 in u implies is-convex-subset(m, c) implies forsome([kc0_], kc0_ in c) implies forall([kdz_ in c], not(kdz_ in u)) implies forsome([ccf_], is-k-linear(m, ccf_) and is-hom-top-space(seminorm-top(m, ix, pf), cc-sn-top, ccf_) and forall([ccz_ in c], real-part(ccf_(ccz_)) < real-part(ccf_(x0)))))
- `cc-log-char` — forall([clgw_ in cc, clgz_ in cc], -pi < imag-part(clgz_) implies imag-part(clgz_) < pi implies cc-exp(clgz_) = clgw_ implies cc-log(clgw_) = clgz_)
- `cc-log-deriv` — forall([clhb_ in cc], not(imag-part(clhb_) = 0 and real-part(clhb_) <= 0) implies is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, {cxsu_ in cc: not(imag-part(cxsu_) = 0 and real-part(cxsu_) <= 0)}, vnb-lambda(clhw_, {cxsu_ in cc: not(imag-part(cxsu_) = 0 and real-part(cxsu_) <= 0)}, cc-log(clhw_)), clhb_, recip(clhb_)))
- `cc-log-exp` — forall([clgz_ in cc], -pi < imag-part(clgz_) implies imag-part(clgz_) < pi implies cc-log(cc-exp(clgz_)) = clgz_)
- `cc-log-exp-small` — forall([c6z_ in cc], magnitude(c6z_) <= num(1/2) implies not(imag-part(cc-exp(c6z_)) = 0 and real-part(cc-exp(c6z_)) <= 0) and cc-log(cc-exp(c6z_)) = c6z_)
- `cc-log-holomorphic` — holomorphic-on({cxsu_ in cc: not(imag-part(cxsu_) = 0 and real-part(cxsu_) <= 0)}, vnb-lambda(clhw_, {cxsu_ in cc: not(imag-part(cxsu_) = 0 and real-part(cxsu_) <= 0)}, cc-log(clhw_)))
- `cc-log-holomorphic-at` — forall([clha_ in cc], not(imag-part(clha_) = 0 and real-part(clha_) <= 0) implies forsome([clhp_ in rr], 0 < clhp_ and ball(cc-ms, clha_, clhp_) subset {cxsu_ in cc: not(imag-part(cxsu_) = 0 and real-part(cxsu_) <= 0)} and holomorphic-on(ball(cc-ms, clha_, clhp_), vnb-lambda(clhx_, ball(cc-ms, clha_, clhp_), cc-log(clhx_)))))
- `cc-log-holomorphic-near-one` — forall([algr_ in rr], 0 < algr_ implies algr_ * (1 + pi) <= pi implies holomorphic-on(ball(cc-ms, 1, algr_), vnb-lambda(algz_, ball(cc-ms, 1, algr_), cc-log(algz_))))
- `cc-log-holomorphic-scale` — forall([algr_ in rr], 0 < algr_ implies algr_ * (1 + pi) <= pi implies forall([algs_ in rr], 0 < algs_ implies holomorphic-on(ball(cc-ms, algs_, algs_ * algr_), vnb-lambda(algz_, ball(cc-ms, algs_, algs_ * algr_), cc-log(algz_)))))
- `cc-log-im-near-one` — forall([clhd_ in rr], 0 < clhd_ implies forall([clhr_ in rr], 0 < clhr_ implies clhr_ * (1 + pi) <= pi implies clhr_ * (1 + clhd_) <= clhd_ implies forall([clhz_ in ball(cc-ms, 1, clhr_)], not(imag-part(clhz_) = 0 and real-part(clhz_) <= 0) and -clhd_ < imag-part(cc-log(clhz_)) and imag-part(cc-log(clhz_)) < clhd_)))
- `cc-log-in-slit` — forall([clgw_ in cc], not(imag-part(clgw_) = 0 and real-part(clgw_) <= 0) implies cc-log(clgw_) in cc and -pi < imag-part(cc-log(clgw_)) and imag-part(cc-log(clgw_)) < pi)
- `cc-log-mul` — forall([clhu_ in cc], not(imag-part(clhu_) = 0 and real-part(clhu_) <= 0) implies forall([clhv_ in cc], not(imag-part(clhv_) = 0 and real-part(clhv_) <= 0) implies -pi < imag-part(cc-log(clhu_)) + imag-part(cc-log(clhv_)) implies imag-part(cc-log(clhu_)) + imag-part(cc-log(clhv_)) < pi implies cc-log(clhu_ * clhv_) = cc-log(clhu_) + cc-log(clhv_)))
- `cc-log-of-deriv-on-ball` — forall([cmlr_ in rr], 0 < cmlr_ implies cmlr_ <= 1 implies forall([cmlg_ in fun(ball(cc-ms, 1, cmlr_), cc)], forall([cmlw_ in ball(cc-ms, 1, cmlr_)], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, ball(cc-ms, 1, cmlr_), cmlg_, cmlw_, recip(cmlw_))) implies cmlg_(1) = 0 implies forall([cmlz_ in ball(cc-ms, 1, cmlr_)], cc-log(cmlz_) = cmlg_(cmlz_))))
- `cc-log-one` — cc-log(1) = 0
- `cc-log-one-minus` — forall([clhr_ in rr], 0 < clhr_ implies clhr_ * (1 + pi) <= pi implies forall([clhz_ in cc], magnitude(clhz_) < clhr_ implies cc-log(1 - clhz_) = -cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(clhk_, nn, recip-star(clhk_) * clhz_ ^ clhk_))))

- `closed-family-souslin` — forall([s], is-polish(s) implies forall([sv in fun(nstar, power(pts(s)))], forall([p in nstar], is-closed(s, sv(p))) implies forsome([x], x in souslin-set(s, sv)) implies is-souslin(s, souslin-set(s, sv))))
- `closed-graph-theorem` — forall([fld, m1, fam1, m2, fam2, tt], is-nontrivially-valued(fld) implies is-frechet-structure(fld, m1, fam1) implies is-frechet-structure(fld, m2, fam2) implies has-closed-graph(m1, fam1, m2, fam2, tt) implies is-cont-lin(m1, fam1, m2, fam2, tt))

- `closed-iff-contains-accumulation-points` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([a], a subset pts(s) implies is-closed(s, a) iff forall([x], is-accumulation-point(s, a, x) implies x in a)))

- `closed-meet` — forall([t, ks, ch], is-top-space(t) implies is-top-closed(t, ks) implies forall([kca_ in ch], is-top-closed(t, kca_)) implies is-top-closed(t, {kub_ in ks: forall([kca_ in ch], kub_ in kca_)}))
- `closed-op-adjoint-compose-dom-dense` — forall([v, dd, ff], is-hilbert-space(v) implies is-submodule(v, dd) implies is-dense(ip-metric-space(v), dd) implies ff in fun(dd, vec(v)) implies forall([bax_ in dd, bay_ in dd], ff((vadd(v))(bax_, bay_)) = (vadd(v))(ff(bax_), ff(bay_))) implies forall([bac_ in cc, bax_ in dd], ff((act(v))(bac_, bax_)) = (act(v))(bac_, ff(bax_))) implies is-closed-graph(v, {bgp_ in cartesian(vec(v), vec(v)): nth(1, bgp_) in dd and nth(2, bgp_) = ff(nth(1, bgp_))}) implies is-dense(ip-metric-space(v), graph-dom(v, graph-compose(v, graph-adjoint(v, {bgp_ in cartesian(vec(v), vec(v)): nth(1, bgp_) in dd and nth(2, bgp_) = ff(nth(1, bgp_))}), {bgp_ in cartesian(vec(v), vec(v)): nth(1, bgp_) in dd and nth(2, bgp_) = ff(nth(1, bgp_))}))))

- `closed-op-adjoint-compose-self-adjoint` — forall([v, dd, ff], is-hilbert-space(v) implies is-submodule(v, dd) implies is-dense(ip-metric-space(v), dd) implies ff in fun(dd, vec(v)) implies forall([bax_ in dd, bay_ in dd], ff((vadd(v))(bax_, bay_)) = (vadd(v))(ff(bax_), ff(bay_))) implies forall([bac_ in cc, bax_ in dd], ff((act(v))(bac_, bax_)) = (act(v))(bac_, ff(bax_))) implies is-closed-graph(v, {bgp_ in cartesian(vec(v), vec(v)): nth(1, bgp_) in dd and nth(2, bgp_) = ff(nth(1, bgp_))}) implies is-self-adjoint-graph(v, graph-compose(v, graph-adjoint(v, {bgp_ in cartesian(vec(v), vec(v)): nth(1, bgp_) in dd and nth(2, bgp_) = ff(nth(1, bgp_))}), {bgp_ in cartesian(vec(v), vec(v)): nth(1, bgp_) in dd and nth(2, bgp_) = ff(nth(1, bgp_))})))
- `closed-open-approx-union` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([mu], is-measure(pts(s), borel-sets(s), mu) implies mu(pts(s)) in rr implies forall([g in fun(nn, borel-sets(s))], forall([n in nn, eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([f, u], is-closed(s, f) and is-open(s, u) and f subset g(n) and g(n) subset u and mu(complement-in(u, f)) <= eps)) implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([f, u], is-closed(s, f) and is-open(s, u) and f subset big-union(n_, nn, g(n_)) and big-union(n_, nn, g(n_)) subset u and mu(complement-in(u, f)) <= eps)))))

- `cnf-line-submodule` — forall([m, p], is-seminorm(cc-normed-field, m, p) implies forall([cny in vec(m)], is-submodule(m, {cnw_ in vec(m): forsome([cnr_ in cc], cnw_ = (act(m))(cnr_, cny))})))

- `cnf-seed-linear` — forall([m, p], is-seminorm(cc-normed-field, m, p) implies forall([cny in vec(m)], is-k-linear-on(m, {cnw_ in vec(m): forsome([cnr_ in cc], cnw_ = (act(m))(cnr_, cny))}, vnb-lambda(cnu_, {cnw_ in vec(m): forsome([cnr_ in cc], cnw_ = (act(m))(cnr_, cny))}, iota(cnt_, cnt_ in cc and forsome([cnq_ in cc], cnu_ = (act(m))(cnq_, cny) and cnt_ = cnq_ * p(cny)))))))
- `cnvd-cact-comm` — forall([v, c_, d_, x_], is-complex-normed-vector-space(v) implies c_ in cc implies d_ in cc implies x_ in vec(v) implies (cact(v))(c_, (cact(v))(d_, x_)) = (cact(v))(d_, (cact(v))(c_, x_)))
- `cnvd-cact-vneg` — forall([v, c_, x_], is-complex-normed-vector-space(v) implies c_ in cc implies x_ in vec(v) implies (cact(v))(c_, (vneg(v))(x_)) = (vneg(v))((cact(v))(c_, x_)))

- `cnvd-norm-zero-vector` — forall([v, x_], is-complex-normed-vector-space(v) implies x_ in vec(v) implies (vnrm(v))(x_) = 0 implies x_ = vzero(v))

- `cnvdms-dist-sum-le` — forall([w, a_, b_, c_, e_], is-complex-normed-vector-space(w) implies a_ in vec(w) implies b_ in vec(w) implies c_ in vec(w) implies e_ in vec(w) implies (dist(cnvs-metric-space(w)))((vadd(w))(a_, b_), (vadd(w))(c_, e_)) <= (dist(cnvs-metric-space(w)))(a_, c_) + (dist(cnvs-metric-space(w)))(b_, e_))
- `cnvs-act-neg-scalar` — forall([v], is-complex-normed-vector-space(v) implies forall([q_, x_], q_ in rr implies x_ in vec(v) implies (act(v))(-q_, x_) = (vneg(v))((act(v))(q_, x_))))

- `col-equiv-identity-in-elem-gen` — forall([r, n, a], is-ring(r) implies n in nn implies a in mat(n, n, carr(r)) implies col-equiv(r, n, a, identmat(r, n)) implies a in elem-gen(r, n))

- `comb-kk-null-ind` — forall([m_ in nn, r], is-commutative-ring(r) implies forall([x in carr(r), y in carr(r), k_ in zz], k_ < 0 implies (comb-kk(r, x, y, m_))(k_) = zero(r)))

- `commutant-el-closed-star` — forall([b], is-unital-involutive-banach-algebra(b) implies forall([t], t subset vec(b) implies forall([gncz_ in t], (vstar(b))(gncz_) in t) implies is-closed-star-subalgebra-set(b, commutant-el(b, t))))

- `commutant-membership` — forall([v, s, t_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies t_ in commutant(v, s) iff t_ in bounded-ops(v, v) and forall([vna_ in s], bop-comp(v, t_, vna_) = bop-comp(v, vna_, t_)))

- `commutes-adjoint-compose-iff` — forall([v, gg, s_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies gg subset cartesian(vec(v), vec(v)) implies s_ in bounded-ops(v, v) implies forall([bga_ in vec(v), bgb_ in vec(v)], [bga_, bgb_] in graph-compose(v, graph-adjoint(v, gg), gg) implies [s_(bga_), s_(bgb_)] in graph-compose(v, graph-adjoint(v, gg), gg)) iff forall([bga_ in vec(v), bgb_ in vec(v)], forsome([bgz_ in vec(v)], [bga_, bgz_] in gg and forall([ugc_ in vec(v), ugd_ in vec(v)], [ugc_, ugd_] in gg implies (ip(v))(ugc_, bgb_) = (ip(v))(ugd_, bgz_))) implies forsome([bgz_ in vec(v)], [s_(bga_), bgz_] in gg and forall([ugc_ in vec(v), ugd_ in vec(v)], [ugc_, ugd_] in gg implies (ip(v))(ugc_, s_(bgb_)) = (ip(v))(ugd_, bgz_)))))

- `compact-finite-union` — forall([n in nn, s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([fy], forall([i in nn], i <= n implies fy(i) subset pts(s)) implies forall([i in nn], i <= n implies is-compact(subspace-ms(s, fy(i)))) implies is-compact(subspace-ms(s, {ucy_ in pts(s): forsome([uci_ in nn], uci_ <= n and ucy_ in fy(uci_))}))))
- `compact-hausdorff-closed` — forall([t, ks], is-hausdorff(t) implies ks subset pts(t) implies is-compact-t(subspace-top(t, ks)) implies is-top-closed(t, ks))

- `compact-op-eigen-not-separated` — forall([v, t_, e, lm, d_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies is-compact-op(v, v, t_) implies e in fun(nn, vec(v)) implies lm in fun(nn, cc) implies forall([un_ in nn], ip-norm(v, e(un_)) = 1) implies forall([oi_ in nn, oj_ in nn], oi_ < oj_ implies (ip(v))(e(oi_), e(oj_)) = 0) implies forall([en_ in nn], t_(e(en_)) = (act(v))(lm(en_), e(en_))) implies pos-rr(d_) implies forall([ln_ in nn], d_ <= magnitude(lm(ln_))) implies falsity)
- `compact-op-intro` — forall([v, w, t_], is-complex-inner-product-space(w) implies t_ in bounded-ops(v, w) implies forall([f in fun(nn, vec(v))], forall([nq_ in nn], ip-norm(v, f(nq_)) <= 1) implies forsome([phq_], strictly-mono-nn(phq_) and forsome([lq_], forall([bq_ in fun(nn, vec(w))], forall([nq_ in nn], bq_(nq_) = t_(f(phq_(nq_)))) implies converges-to(ip-metric-space(w), bq_, lq_))))) implies is-compact-op(v, w, t_))
- `compact-op-no-separated` — forall([v, w, t_, f, d_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies is-complex-inner-product-space(w) implies is-compact-op(v, w, t_) implies f in fun(nn, vec(v)) implies forall([nq_ in nn], ip-norm(v, f(nq_)) <= 1) implies pos-rr(d_) implies forall([iq_ in nn, jq_ in nn], iq_ < jq_ implies d_ <= ip-norm(w, (vadd(w))(t_(f(iq_)), (vneg(w))(t_(f(jq_)))))) implies falsity)
- `compact-op-norm-limit` — forall([v, w, t_, tk], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies is-hilbert-space(w) implies t_ in bounded-ops(v, w) implies tk in fun(nn, bounded-ops(v, w)) implies forall([k in nn], is-compact-op(v, w, tk(k))) implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([kq_ in nn], forall([xq_ in vec(v)], ip-norm(v, xq_) <= 1 implies ip-norm(w, (vadd(w))(t_(xq_), (vneg(w))((tk(kq_))(xq_)))) <= eps))) implies is-compact-op(v, w, t_))
- `compact-op-scale` — forall([v, w, c_, t_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies is-complex-inner-product-space(w) implies c_ in cc implies is-compact-op(v, w, t_) implies is-compact-op(v, w, bop-scale(v, w, c_, t_)))
- `compact-op-seq` — forall([v, w, t_, f], is-complex-inner-product-space(w) implies is-compact-op(v, w, t_) implies f in fun(nn, vec(v)) implies forall([nq_ in nn], ip-norm(v, f(nq_)) <= 1) implies forsome([phq_], strictly-mono-nn(phq_) and forsome([lq_], forall([bq_ in fun(nn, vec(w))], forall([nq_ in nn], bq_(nq_) = t_(f(phq_(nq_)))) implies converges-to(ip-metric-space(w), bq_, lq_)))))
- `compact-op-seq-r` — forall([v, w, t_, f, r_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies is-complex-inner-product-space(w) implies is-compact-op(v, w, t_) implies r_ in rr implies 0 <= r_ implies f in fun(nn, vec(v)) implies forall([nq_ in nn], ip-norm(v, f(nq_)) <= r_) implies forsome([phq_], strictly-mono-nn(phq_) and forsome([lq_], forall([bq_ in fun(nn, vec(w))], forall([nq_ in nn], bq_(nq_) = t_(f(phq_(nq_)))) implies converges-to(ip-metric-space(w), bq_, lq_)))))
- `compact-op-subseq-hyp` — forall([v, w, t_, f, g], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies is-complex-inner-product-space(w) implies is-compact-op(v, w, t_) implies f in fun(nn, vec(v)) implies forall([nq_ in nn], ip-norm(v, f(nq_)) <= 1) implies g in fun(nn, vec(w)) implies forall([n_ in nn], g(n_) = t_(f(n_))) implies forall([phi], strictly-mono-nn(phi) implies forsome([psi], strictly-mono-nn(psi) and forsome([p in pts(ip-metric-space(w))], converges-to(ip-metric-space(w), subseq(subseq(g, phi), psi), p)))))
- `compact-op-sum` — forall([v, w, s_, t_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies is-complex-inner-product-space(w) implies is-compact-op(v, w, s_) implies is-compact-op(v, w, t_) implies is-compact-op(v, w, bop-sum(v, w, s_, t_)))
- `compact-open-margin` — forall([kk, u], kk subset u implies is-open(cc-ms, u) implies is-compact(subspace-ms(cc-ms, kk)) implies forsome([cme_], pos-rr(cme_) and forall([cmz_ in kk], ball(cc-ms, cmz_, cme_) subset u)))
- `compact-ops-membership` — forall([kqv_, kqw_, tqz_], tqz_ in compact-ops(kqv_, kqw_) iff tqz_ in bounded-ops(kqv_, kqw_) and is-compact-op(kqv_, kqw_, tqz_))

- `compact-t-continuous-onto` — forall([s, t, f], is-hom-top-space(s, t, f) implies is-compact-t(s) implies forall([tpy_ in pts(t)], forsome([tpx_ in pts(s)], f(tpx_) = tpy_)) implies is-compact-t(t))

- `companion-congruence` — forall([fr], is-ring(fr) implies forall([nv_ in nn, av_], forall([i_ in interval(1, nv_)], av_(i_) in carr(fr)) implies forall([bv_], forall([i_ in interval(1, nv_)], bv_(i_) in carr(fr)) implies forall([i_ in interval(1, nv_)], av_(i_) = bv_(i_)) implies companion(fr, av_, nv_) = companion(fr, bv_, nv_))))

- `complete-of-dominated-metric` — forall([s], is-complete(s) implies forall([t], is-metric-space(t) implies pts(t) = pts(s) implies forall([dmp_ in pts(t), dmq_ in pts(t)], (dist(s))(dmp_, dmq_) <= (dist(t))(dmp_, dmq_)) implies forall([dmp_ in pts(t), dmq_ in pts(t)], (dist(t))(dmp_, dmq_) <= 2 * (dist(s))(dmp_, dmq_)) implies is-complete(t)))

- `completion-lift-bounded` — forall([md, fq], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-inner-product-form(md, fq) implies forall([t1, b1], t1 in fun(pts(form-ms(md, fq)), pts(form-ms(md, fq))) implies b1 in rr implies 0 <= b1 implies forall([g4u_ in pts(form-ms(md, fq)), g4w_ in pts(form-ms(md, fq))], (dist(form-ms(md, fq)))(t1(g4u_), t1(g4w_)) <= b1 * (dist(form-ms(md, fq)))(g4u_, g4w_)) implies forall([g4v_ in pts(form-ms(md, fq)), g4z_ in pts(form-ms(md, fq))], t1((vadd(md))(g4v_, g4z_)) = (vadd(md))(t1(g4v_), t1(g4z_))) implies forall([g4c_ in cc, g4v_ in pts(form-ms(md, fq))], t1((act(md))(g4c_, g4v_)) = (act(md))(g4c_, t1(g4v_))) implies forall([g4v_ in pts(form-ms(md, fq))], fq(t1(g4v_), t1(g4v_)) <= (b1 * b1) * fq(g4v_, g4v_)) implies completion-lift(form-ms(md, fq), t1) in bounded-ops(hilbert-completion(md, fq), hilbert-completion(md, fq))))

- `completion-lift-id` — forall([md, fq], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-inner-product-form(md, fq) implies forall([t1, b1], t1 in fun(pts(form-ms(md, fq)), pts(form-ms(md, fq))) implies b1 in rr implies 0 <= b1 implies forall([g4u_ in pts(form-ms(md, fq)), g4w_ in pts(form-ms(md, fq))], (dist(form-ms(md, fq)))(t1(g4u_), t1(g4w_)) <= b1 * (dist(form-ms(md, fq)))(g4u_, g4w_)) implies forall([g4v_ in pts(form-ms(md, fq))], t1(g4v_) = g4v_) implies forall([xx in vec(hilbert-completion(md, fq))], (completion-lift(form-ms(md, fq), t1))(xx) = xx)))

- `const-road-line-int` — forall([u, f, c, a, b], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies c in u implies a in rr implies b in rr implies a < b implies line-int(f, vnb-lambda(cgq_, ccint(a, b), c), vnb-lambda(cgq_, ccint(a, b), 0), a, b) = 0)
- `constant-off-compact-uniformly-continuous` — forall([s, t, f], is-continuous(s, t, f) implies forall([k], k subset pts(s) implies is-compact(subspace-ms(s, k)) implies forsome([cv], forall([x in pts(s)], not(x in k) implies f(x) = cv)) implies is-uniformly-continuous(s, t, f)))
- `constant-piece-regulated-on` — forall([u in rr, v in rr], u < v implies forall([f in fun(rr, rr), cv in rr], forall([t_], t_ in rr and u < t_ and t_ < v implies f(t_) = cv) implies is-regulated-on(restrict(f, ccint(u, v)), u, v)))
- `cont-agree-off-pt` — forall([fa, fb, pt in rr], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, fa, pt) implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, fb, pt) implies forall([x in rr], not(x = pt) implies fa(x) = fb(x)) implies fa(pt) = fb(pt))
- `cont-on-in-fun` — forall([f, itdm_], is-continuous-on(f, itdm_) implies f in fun(itdm_, rr))
- `cont-on-of-total` — forall([itdm_], itdm_ subset rr implies forall([itg_ in fun(rr, rr)], forall([ity_ in rr], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, itg_, ity_)) implies forall([f in fun(itdm_, rr)], forall([itz_ in itdm_], f(itz_) = itg_(itz_)) implies is-continuous-on(f, itdm_))))
- `cont-on-transfer-ptwise-eq` — forall([itdm_], itdm_ subset rr implies forall([f, itg_], f in fun(itdm_, rr) implies is-continuous-on(itg_, itdm_) implies forall([itz_ in itdm_], f(itz_) = itg_(itz_)) implies is-continuous-on(f, itdm_)))
- `cont-transfer-ptwise-eq` — forall([f, g, a], f in fun(rr, rr) implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, g, a) implies forall([x in rr], f(x) = g(x)) implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, a))
- `continuous-abs-bounded-on-ccint` — forall([f, a, b], f in fun(rr, rr) implies a in rr implies b in rr implies a <= b implies forall([x in ccint(a, b)], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, x)) implies forsome([m_ in rr], 0 <= m_ and forall([z_ in ccint(a, b)], abs(f(z_)) <= m_)))
- `continuous-at-iff-sequential` — forall([s, t, f, a], is-metric-space(s) implies is-metric-space(t) implies f in fun(pts(s), pts(t)) implies a in pts(s) implies is-continuous-at(s, t, f, a) iff forall([sq in sqn(pts(s))], converges-to(s, sq, a) implies converges-to(t, compose(f, sq), f(a))))
- `continuous-at-implies-sequential` — forall([s, t, f, a], is-metric-space(s) implies is-metric-space(t) implies f in fun(pts(s), pts(t)) implies a in pts(s) implies is-continuous-at(s, t, f, a) implies forall([sq in sqn(pts(s))], converges-to(s, sq, a) implies converges-to(t, compose(f, sq), f(a))))
- `continuous-at-left-limit` — forall([f, x], f in fun(rr, rr) implies x in rr implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, x) implies is-left-limit(f, x, f(x)))
- `continuous-at-local` — forall([f in fun(rr, rr), g in fun(rr, rr), t_ in rr, rho in rr], 0 < rho implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, g, t_) implies forall([x_ in rr], abs(x_ - t_) <= rho implies f(x_) = g(x_)) implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, t_))
- `continuous-at-right-limit` — forall([f, x], f in fun(rr, rr) implies x in rr implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, x) implies is-right-limit(f, x, f(x)))
- `continuous-at-subspace-abs` — forall([cdw_, cdp_, cdx_], cdw_ subset rr implies is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(rr-ms, cdw_), rr-ms, cdp_, cdx_) implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([cdd_], pos-rr(cdd_) and forall([cdy_ in cdw_], abs(cdx_ - cdy_) <= cdd_ implies abs(cdp_(cdx_) - cdp_(cdy_)) <= eps))))
- `continuous-bounded-above-on-ccint` — forall([f, a, b], f in fun(rr, rr) implies a in rr implies b in rr implies a <= b implies forall([x in ccint(a, b)], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, x)) implies forsome([k_ in rr], forall([z_ in ccint(a, b)], f(z_) <= k_)))
- `continuous-constant-on-closure` — forall([u, f, c], u subset cc implies f in fun(closure(cc-ms, u), cc) implies forall([x in closure(cc-ms, u)], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), closure(cc-ms, u)), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, x)) implies c in cc implies forall([z in u], f(z) = c) implies forall([x in closure(cc-ms, u)], f(x) = c))
- `continuous-image-of-compact` — forall([s, t, fqf_], is-continuous(s, t, fqf_) implies forall([aqa_], aqa_ subset pts(s) implies is-compact(subspace-ms(s, aqa_)) implies is-compact(subspace-ms(t, image(fqf_, aqa_)))))
- `continuous-image-polish-souslin` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([e], e subset pts(s) implies forall([t], is-complete(t) implies is-separable(t) implies forall([h], is-continuous(t, subspace-ms(s, e), h) implies image(h, pts(t)) = e implies is-souslin(s, e)))))
- `continuous-implies-closed-preimage` — forall([s, t, f], is-continuous(s, t, f) implies forall([a], is-closed(t, a) implies is-closed(s, preimage(s, f, a))))
- `continuous-implies-open-preimage` — forall([s, t, f], is-continuous(s, t, f) implies forall([v], is-open(t, v) implies is-open(s, preimage(s, f, v))))
- `continuous-into-subspace-ambient` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([e], e subset pts(s) implies forall([t, h], is-continuous(t, subspace-ms(s, e), h) implies is-continuous(t, s, h))))
- `continuous-is-antiderivable` — forall([f, a, b], f in fun(rr, rr) implies a in rr implies b in rr implies a < b implies forall([x_ in ccint(a, b)], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, x_)) implies is-antiderivable(f, a, b))
- `continuous-is-continuous-at` — forall([s, t, f], is-continuous(s, t, f) implies forall([a in pts(s)], is-continuous-at(s, t, f, a)))
- `continuous-is-regulated` — forall([f, a, b], f in fun(rr, rr) implies a in rr implies b in rr implies a < b implies forall([x_ in ccint(a, b)], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, x_)) implies is-regulated(f, a, b))
- `continuous-nonneg-left` — forall([g, aa, th], g in fun(rr, rr) implies aa in rr implies th in rr implies aa < th implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, g, th) implies forall([x], x in rr and aa < x and x < th implies 0 <= g(x)) implies 0 <= g(th))
- `continuous-nonpos-right` — forall([g, th, bb], g in fun(rr, rr) implies th in rr implies bb in rr implies th < bb implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, g, th) implies forall([x], x in rr and th < x and x < bb implies g(x) <= 0) implies g(th) <= 0)
- `continuous-on-abs-bwd` — forall([cdw_, cdp_], cdw_ subset rr implies cdp_ in fun(cdw_, rr) implies forall([cdx_ in cdw_, eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([cdd_], pos-rr(cdd_) and forall([cdy_ in cdw_], abs(cdx_ - cdy_) <= cdd_ implies abs(cdp_(cdx_) - cdp_(cdy_)) <= eps))) implies is-continuous-on(cdp_, cdw_))
- `continuous-on-abs-fwd` — forall([cdw_, cdp_], cdw_ subset rr implies is-continuous-on(cdp_, cdw_) implies forall([cdx_ in cdw_, eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([cdd_], pos-rr(cdd_) and forall([cdy_ in cdw_], abs(cdx_ - cdy_) <= cdd_ implies abs(cdp_(cdx_) - cdp_(cdy_)) <= eps))))
- `continuous-on-compose-path` — forall([u, f, pgam, a, b], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies is-path(pgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies is-continuous-on(vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), real-part(f(pgam(pat_)))), ccint(a, b)) and is-continuous-on(vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), imag-part(f(pgam(pat_)))), ccint(a, b)))
- `continuous-on-compose-regulated` — forall([u, f, pgam, a, b], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies is-path(pgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies is-regulated-on(vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), real-part(f(pgam(pat_)))), a, b) and is-regulated-on(vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), imag-part(f(pgam(pat_)))), a, b))
- `continuous-on-implies-regulated-on` — forall([f, a, b], a in rr implies b in rr implies a < b implies is-continuous-on(f, ccint(a, b)) implies is-regulated-on(f, a, b))
- `continuous-on-left-limit-within` — forall([f, rqw_], rqw_ subset rr implies is-continuous-on(f, rqw_) implies forall([rqx_ in rqw_], is-left-limit-within(f, rqw_, rqx_, f(rqx_))))
- `continuous-on-of-derivs-on-ccint` — forall([lo_, hi_, ff_, hh_], lo_ in rr implies hi_ in rr implies hh_ in fun(ccint(lo_, hi_), rr) implies forall([y_ in ccint(lo_, hi_)], hh_(y_) = ff_(y_)) implies forall([x_ in ccint(lo_, hi_)], forsome([l_], has-deriv-at(ff_, x_, l_))) implies is-continuous-on(hh_, ccint(lo_, hi_)))
- `continuous-on-right-limit-within` — forall([f, rqw_], rqw_ subset rr implies is-continuous-on(f, rqw_) implies forall([rqx_ in rqw_], is-right-limit-within(f, rqw_, rqx_, f(rqx_))))
- `continuous-partials-dir-deriv` — forall([n, u, f, p], n in nn implies is-open(nvs-metric-space(rn(n)), u) implies f in fun(u, rr) implies forall([i in interval(1, n), x in u], has-dir-deriv(rn(n), f, x, rn-unit(n, i), (p(i))(x))) implies forall([i in interval(1, n), x in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nvs-metric-space(rn(n)), u), rr-ms, p(i), x)) implies forall([x in u, eta in vec(rn(n))], has-dir-deriv(rn(n), f, x, eta, finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), vnb-lambda(i, interval(1, n), eta(i) * (p(i))(x)), interval(1, n)))))
- `continuous-partials-dir-deriv-continuous` — forall([n, u, f, p], n in nn implies is-open(nvs-metric-space(rn(n)), u) implies f in fun(u, rr) implies forall([i in interval(1, n), x in u], has-dir-deriv(rn(n), f, x, rn-unit(n, i), (p(i))(x))) implies forall([i in interval(1, n), x in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nvs-metric-space(rn(n)), u), rr-ms, p(i), x)) implies forall([eta in vec(rn(n)), x in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nvs-metric-space(rn(n)), u), rr-ms, vnb-lambda(y, u, finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), vnb-lambda(i, interval(1, n), eta(i) * (p(i))(y)), interval(1, n))), x)))
- `continuous-partials-estimate` — forall([n, u, f, p, a], n in nn implies is-open(nvs-metric-space(rn(n)), u) implies f in fun(u, rr) implies a in u implies forall([i in interval(1, n), x in u], has-dir-deriv(rn(n), f, x, rn-unit(n, i), (p(i))(x))) implies forall([i in interval(1, n), x in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nvs-metric-space(rn(n)), u), rr-ms, p(i), x)) implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([delta], pos-rr(delta) and forall([eta in vec(rn(n))], (vnrm(rn(n)))(eta) <= delta implies abs(f((vadd(rn(n)))(a, eta)) - f(a) - finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), vnb-lambda(i, interval(1, n), eta(i) * (p(i))(a)), interval(1, n))) <= (vnrm(rn(n)))(eta) * eps))))
- `continuous-real-near` — forall([s, f], is-continuous(s, rr-ms, f) implies forall([xc in pts(s), eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([del], pos-rr(del) and forall([b in pts(s)], (dist(s))(b, xc) < del implies f(b) <= f(xc) + eps and f(xc) <= f(b) + eps))))
- `continuous-uniform-near-compact` — forall([s, t, f], is-continuous(s, t, f) implies forall([k], k subset pts(s) implies is-compact(subspace-ms(s, k)) implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([delta], pos-rr(delta) and forall([x in k, y in pts(s)], (dist(s))(x, y) <= delta implies (dist(t))(f(x), f(y)) <= eps)))))
- `continuous-uniformly-continuous-on-ccint` — forall([f, a, b, eps], f in fun(rr, rr) implies a in rr implies b in rr implies a <= b implies pos-rr(eps) implies forall([x in ccint(a, b)], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, x)) implies forsome([d_ in rr], 0 < d_ and forall([p_ in ccint(a, b), q_ in ccint(a, b)], abs(p_ - q_) <= d_ implies abs(f(p_) - f(q_)) <= eps)))
- `conull-countable-inter` — forall([omega, ca, mu, f_], is-measure(omega, ca, mu) implies f_ in fun(nn, ca) implies forall([k in nn], is-conull(omega, ca, mu, f_(k))) implies is-conull(omega, ca, mu, complement-in(omega, big-union(n_, nn, complement-in(omega, f_(n_))))))
- `conull-superset` — forall([omega, ca, mu, a_, b_], is-measure(omega, ca, mu) implies is-conull(omega, ca, mu, a_) implies b_ in ca implies a_ subset b_ implies is-conull(omega, ca, mu, b_))
- `conv-hull-contains` — forall([m, e], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies e subset vec(m) implies e subset conv-hull(m, e))
- `conv-hull-convex` — forall([m, e], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies e subset vec(m) implies is-convex-subset(m, conv-hull(m, e)))
- `conv-hull-convex-step` — forall([k in nn, m, e], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies e subset vec(m) implies forall([u in conv-hull(m, e), w in conv-level(m, e, k), s in rr], 0 <= s implies s <= 1 implies (vadd(m))((act(m))(1 - s, u), (act(m))(s, w)) in conv-hull(m, e)))
- `conv-hull-elim` — forall([m, e, z in conv-hull(m, e)], forsome([k in nn], z in conv-level(m, e, k)))
- `conv-hull-finite-totally-bounded` — forall([m], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies forall([a in set], card(a) in nn implies a subset vec(m) implies is-totally-bounded-in(nvs-metric-space(m), conv-hull(m, a))))
- `conv-hull-intro` — forall([m, e, k, z], k in nn implies z in conv-level(m, e, k) implies z in conv-hull(m, e))
- `conv-hull-least` — forall([m, e, ck], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies e subset vec(m) implies is-convex-subset(m, ck) implies e subset ck implies conv-hull(m, e) subset ck)
- `conv-hull-sub-vec` — forall([m, e], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies e subset vec(m) implies conv-hull(m, e) subset vec(m))
- `conv-hull-totally-bounded` — forall([m], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies forall([e], e subset vec(m) implies is-totally-bounded-in(nvs-metric-space(m), e) implies is-totally-bounded-in(nvs-metric-space(m), conv-hull(m, e))))
- `conv-hull-unfold` — forall([m, e], conv-hull(m, e) == big-union(cvn_, nn, conv-level(m, e, cvn_)))
- `conv-join-convex` — forall([m, c, a], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies is-convex-subset(m, c) implies a in vec(m) implies is-convex-subset(m, conv-join(m, c, a)))
- `conv-join-elim` — forall([m, c, a, z in conv-join(m, c, a)], z in vec(m) and forsome([y in c, t in rr], 0 <= t and t <= 1 and z = (vadd(m))((act(m))(1 - t, y), (act(m))(t, a))))
- `conv-join-intro` — forall([m, c, a, y, t], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies y in vec(m) implies a in vec(m) implies y in c implies t in rr implies 0 <= t implies t <= 1 implies (vadd(m))((act(m))(1 - t, y), (act(m))(t, a)) in conv-join(m, c, a))
- `conv-join-totally-bounded` — forall([m], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies forall([c, a], c subset vec(m) implies a in vec(m) implies is-totally-bounded-in(nvs-metric-space(m), c) implies is-totally-bounded-in(nvs-metric-space(m), conv-join(m, c, a))))
- `conv-join-unfold` — forall([m, c, a], conv-join(m, c, a) == {cjz_ in vec(m): forsome([cjy_ in c, cjt_ in rr], 0 <= cjt_ and cjt_ <= 1 and cjz_ = (vadd(m))((act(m))(1 - cjt_, cjy_), (act(m))(cjt_, a)))})
- `conv-join-with-point-convex` — forall([m], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies forall([c, a], is-convex-subset(m, c) implies a in vec(m) implies is-convex-subset(m, union(conv-join(m, c, a), pair(a, a)))))
- `conv-level-in-convex` — forall([k in nn, m, e, ck], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies e subset vec(m) implies is-convex-subset(m, ck) implies e subset ck implies conv-level(m, e, k) subset ck)
- `conv-level-is-set` — forall([n in nn, m, e], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies e subset vec(m) implies conv-level(m, e, n) in set)
- `conv-level-sub-vec` — forall([n in nn, m, e], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies e subset vec(m) implies conv-level(m, e, n) subset vec(m))
- `conv-level-succ-elim` — forall([m, e, n, z], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies e subset vec(m) implies n in nn implies z in conv-level(m, e, succ(n)) implies z in vec(m) and forsome([x in conv-level(m, e, n), y in e, t in rr], 0 <= t and t <= 1 and z = (vadd(m))((act(m))(1 - t, x), (act(m))(t, y))))
- `conv-level-succ-intro` — forall([m, e, n, x, y, t], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies e subset vec(m) implies n in nn implies x in conv-level(m, e, n) implies x in vec(m) implies y in e implies y in vec(m) implies t in rr implies 0 <= t implies t <= 1 implies (vadd(m))((act(m))(1 - t, x), (act(m))(t, y)) in conv-level(m, e, succ(n)))
- `conv3-avoids-vertex` — forall([goxa_ in cc, goxb_ in cc, goxc_ in cc], not(imag-part((goxb_ - goxa_) * conjugate(goxc_ - goxa_)) = 0) implies forall([goxt_ in rr], 0 < goxt_ implies goxt_ <= 1 implies not(goxa_ in conv3(goxa_ + goxt_ * (goxb_ - goxa_), goxb_, goxc_)) and not(goxa_ in conv3(goxa_ + goxt_ * (goxb_ - goxa_), goxc_, goxa_ + goxt_ * (goxc_ - goxa_)))))
- `conv3-cross-weights` — forall([aoa_, aob_, aoc_], aoa_ in cc implies aob_ in cc implies aoc_ in cc implies forall([aoz_ in conv3(aoa_, aob_, aoc_)], forsome([aot_ in rr], 0 <= aot_ and imag-part((aob_ - aoz_) * conjugate(aoa_ - aoz_)) = aot_ * imag-part((aob_ - aoc_) * conjugate(aoa_ - aoc_))) and forsome([aot_ in rr], 0 <= aot_ and imag-part((aoc_ - aoz_) * conjugate(aob_ - aoz_)) = aot_ * imag-part((aoc_ - aoa_) * conjugate(aob_ - aoa_))) and forsome([aot_ in rr], 0 <= aot_ and imag-part((aoa_ - aoz_) * conjugate(aoc_ - aoz_)) = aot_ * imag-part((aoa_ - aob_) * conjugate(aoc_ - aob_)))))
- `conv3-in-convex` — forall([u], is-convex-cc(u) implies forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gouc_ in cc], goua_ in u implies goub_ in u implies gouc_ in u implies conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_) subset u))
- `conv3-intro` — forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gouc_ in cc, goul_ in ccint(0, 1), goum_ in ccint(0, 1), goun_ in ccint(0, 1), gouz_], (goul_ + goum_) + goun_ = 1 implies gouz_ = (goul_ * goua_ + goum_ * goub_) + goun_ * gouc_ implies gouz_ in conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_))
- `conv3-is-convex` — forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gouc_ in cc], is-convex-cc(conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_)))
- `conv3-member-iff` — forall([goua_, goub_, gouc_, gouz_], gouz_ in conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_) iff gouz_ in cc and forsome([goul_ in ccint(0, 1), goum_ in ccint(0, 1), goun_ in ccint(0, 1)], (goul_ + goum_) + goun_ = 1 and gouz_ = (goul_ * goua_ + goum_ * goub_) + goun_ * gouc_))
- `conv3-mid-in` — forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gouc_ in cc, goux_ in conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_), gouy_ in conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_)], cc-mid(goux_, gouy_) in conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_))
- `conv3-near-vertex` — forall([goxa_ in cc, goxb_ in cc, goxc_ in cc, goxz_ in conv3(goxa_, goxb_, goxc_)], magnitude(goxz_ - goxa_) <= magnitude(goxb_ - goxa_) + magnitude(goxc_ - goxa_))
- `conv3-seg-trace` — forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gouc_ in cc, goux_ in conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_), gouy_ in conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_)], trace(seg-path(goux_, gouy_), 0, 1) subset conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_))
- `conv3-sub-hull` — forall([goua_ in cc, goub_ in cc, gouc_ in cc, goux_ in conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_), gouy_ in conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_), gouz_ in conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_)], conv3(goux_, gouy_, gouz_) subset conv3(goua_, goub_, gouc_))

- `convex-comb-diff` — forall([chga, chra, chgb, chrb, chsa, chsb], chga in cc implies chra in cc implies chgb in cc implies chrb in cc implies chsa in rr implies chsb in rr implies chga + chsa * (chra - chga) - (chgb + chsb * (chrb - chgb)) = chga - chgb + (chsb * (chra - chga - (chrb - chgb)) + (chsa - chsb) * (chra - chga)))
- `convex-combination-at-one` — forall([m], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies forall([y, a], y in vec(m) implies a in vec(m) implies (vadd(m))((act(m))(1 - 1, y), (act(m))(1, a)) = a))

- `convex-combination-regroup` — forall([m], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies forall([y1, y2, a, s, t1, t2, lam], y1 in vec(m) implies y2 in vec(m) implies a in vec(m) implies s in rr implies t1 in rr implies t2 in rr implies lam in rr implies (1 - ((1 - s) * t1 + s * t2)) * (1 - lam) = (1 - s) * (1 - t1) implies (1 - ((1 - s) * t1 + s * t2)) * lam = s * (1 - t2) implies (vadd(m))((act(m))(1 - s, (vadd(m))((act(m))(1 - t1, y1), (act(m))(t1, a))), (act(m))(s, (vadd(m))((act(m))(1 - t2, y2), (act(m))(t2, a)))) = (vadd(m))((act(m))(1 - ((1 - s) * t1 + s * t2), (vadd(m))((act(m))(1 - lam, y1), (act(m))(lam, y2))), (act(m))((1 - s) * t1 + s * t2, a))))

- `convex-regroup-coefficients` — forall([s, t1, t2], s in rr implies 0 <= s implies s <= 1 implies t1 in rr implies 0 <= t1 implies t1 <= 1 implies t2 in rr implies 0 <= t2 implies t2 <= 1 implies 0 <= (1 - s) * t1 + s * t2 and (1 - s) * t1 + s * t2 <= 1 and forsome([lam in rr], 0 <= lam and lam <= 1 and (1 - ((1 - s) * t1 + s * t2)) * (1 - lam) = (1 - s) * (1 - t1) and (1 - ((1 - s) * t1 + s * t2)) * lam = s * (1 - t2)))
- `convex-shift` — forall([m, a, x0], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies is-convex-subset(m, a) implies x0 in vec(m) implies is-convex-subset(m, {shy_ in vec(m): (vadd(m))(shy_, x0) in a}))

- `coordinatewise-diagonal-subseq` — forall([ms], is-ms-sequence(ms) implies forall([n in nn], seq-compact(ms(n))) implies forall([seq in fun(nn, product-carrier(ms))], forsome([delta], strictly-mono-nn(delta) and forsome([l in product-carrier(ms)], forall([n in nn], converges-to(ms(n), vnb-lambda(k, nn, ((subseq(seq, delta))(k))(n)), l(n)))))))

- `coset-norm-act-le` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([ii], is-two-sided-ideal(a, ii) implies forall([c in quotient(qmod-setoid(uba-as-module(a), ii)), lam in cc], coset-norm(a, ii, (act(quotient-module(uba-as-module(a), ii)))(lam, c)) <= magnitude(lam) * coset-norm(a, ii, c))))

- `coset-norm-le` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([ii], is-two-sided-ideal(a, ii) implies forall([c in quotient(qmod-setoid(uba-as-module(a), ii)), u in c], coset-norm(a, ii, c) <= (vnrm(a))(u))))

- `der-tapp` — forall([tt, g, h, l, l2, i], h in nn implies l in tuples(expr-set) implies l2 in tuples(expr-set) implies length(l2) = length(l) implies i in nn implies 1 <= i implies i <= length(l) implies forall([mrj_ in nn], 1 <= mrj_ implies mrj_ <= length(l) implies not(mrj_ = i) implies nth(mrj_, l2) = nth(mrj_, l)) implies eapp(h, l) in clt implies eapp(h, l2) in clt implies [g, enc-qeq(nth(i, l), nth(i, l2))] in derivable(tt) implies [g, enc-qeq(eapp(h, l), eapp(h, l2))] in derivable(tt))
- `der-tuple-eq-decompose` — forall([tt, g, a, b, f], g in ctx-set implies enc-eq(enc-list(a), enc-list(b)) in clf implies f in clf implies length(a) = length(b) implies [g, enc-eq(enc-list(a), enc-list(a))] in derivable(tt) implies [g, enc-eq(enc-list(b), enc-list(b))] in derivable(tt) implies length(a) = 0 and f = enc-truth or [0, f] in tf-set(a, b) implies [g, enc-iff(enc-eq(enc-list(a), enc-list(b)), f)] in derivable(tt))
- `der-union-binary` — forall([tt, g, x, a, b], g in ctx-set implies x in clt implies a in clt implies b in clt implies [g, enc-eq(a, a)] in derivable(tt) implies [g, enc-eq(b, b)] in derivable(tt) implies [g, enc-iff(enc-in(x, enc-union([a, b])), enc-or(enc-in(x, a), enc-in(x, b)))] in derivable(tt))
- `der-union-decompose` — forall([tt, g, x, l, f], g in ctx-set implies enc-in(x, enc-union(l)) in clf implies [0, f] in rf-set(4, x, l) implies forall([md14i_ in nn], 1 <= md14i_ implies md14i_ <= length(l) implies [g, enc-eq(nth(md14i_, l), nth(md14i_, l))] in derivable(tt)) implies [g, enc-iff(enc-in(x, enc-union(l)), f)] in derivable(tt))

- `deriv-holomorphic-bridge` — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies holomorphic-on(u, vnb-lambda(cifdw_, u, deriv-on(cc-normed-field, u, f, cifdw_)))) implies forall([mrhv_, mrhg_, mrhd_], holomorphic-on(mrhv_, mrhg_) implies mrhd_ in fun(mrhv_, cc) implies forall([mrhz_ in mrhv_], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, mrhv_, mrhg_, mrhz_, mrhd_(mrhz_))) implies holomorphic-on(mrhv_, mrhd_))

- `equicont-dense-limit-continuous` — forall([s, t, fam, dq], is-complete(t) implies is-equicontinuous(s, t, fam) implies is-dense-seq(s, dq) implies forall([m in nn], forsome([y in pts(t)], converges-to(t, vnb-lambda(k, nn, (fam(k))(dq(m))), y))) implies forsome([g], converges-ptwise-to(s, t, fam, g) and is-continuous(s, t, g)))
- `equicont-dense-ptwise-limit` — forall([s, t, fam, dq], is-complete(t) implies is-equicontinuous(s, t, fam) implies is-dense-seq(s, dq) implies forall([m in nn], forsome([y in pts(t)], converges-to(t, vnb-lambda(k, nn, (fam(k))(dq(m))), y))) implies forall([x in pts(s)], forsome([y in pts(t)], converges-to(t, vnb-lambda(k, nn, (fam(k))(x)), y))))
- `equicont-ptwise-implies-uniform` — forall([s, t, fam, g], is-compact(s) implies is-equicontinuous(s, t, fam) implies converges-ptwise-to(s, t, fam, g) implies converges-uniformly-to(s, t, fam, g))
- `equicont-ptwise-limit-continuous` — forall([s, t, fam, g], is-equicontinuous(s, t, fam) implies converges-ptwise-to(s, t, fam, g) implies is-continuous(s, t, g))
- `equicont-set-compact-ptwise-iff-uniform` — forall([s, t, es, fam, g], is-compact(s) implies is-equicontinuous-set(s, t, es) implies fam in fun(nn, es) implies converges-ptwise-to(s, t, fam, g) iff converges-uniformly-to(s, t, fam, g))
- `equicont-subseq` — forall([s, t, fam, phi], is-equicontinuous(s, t, fam) implies strictly-mono-nn(phi) implies is-equicontinuous(s, t, subseq(fam, phi)))
- `equicontinuous-ptwise-implies-compact-unif` — forall([t, ee, d, p, f, k], is-top-space(t) implies is-equicontinuous-t(t, ee) implies is-directed-set(d) implies p in fun(pts(d), ee) implies f in ee implies forall([pwx_ in pts(t)], net-converges-to(metric-top(rr-ms), d, vnb-lambda(pwl_, pts(d), (p(pwl_))(pwx_)), f(pwx_))) implies k subset pts(t) implies is-compact-t(subspace-top(t, k)) implies net-unif-conv-on(d, p, f, k))
- `equicontinuous-set-sequence` — forall([s, t, es, fam], is-equicontinuous-set(s, t, es) implies fam in fun(nn, es) implies is-equicontinuous(s, t, fam))
- `equiv-mul-both` — forall([r], is-ring(r) implies forall([m, n, a, u, v], a in mat(m, n, carr(r)) implies is-invertible-mat(r, m, u) implies is-invertible-mat(r, n, v) implies mat-equiv(r, m, n, a, matmul(r, matmul(r, u, a), v))))

- `eqv-and-l` — forall([jj, tt, x], rw-and-l(jj, eqv(tt), x) implies x in rw-univ implies x in eqv(tt))

- `eqv-bind-dom` — forall([jj, tt, x], rw-bind-dom(jj, eqv(tt), x) implies x in rw-univ implies x in eqv(tt))
- `eqv-desc-body` — forall([jj, tt, x], rw-desc-body(jj, eqv(tt), x) implies x in rw-univ implies x in eqv(tt))
- `eqv-ex` — forall([jj, tt, x], rw-ex(jj, eqv(tt), x) implies x in rw-univ implies x in eqv(tt))

- `eqv-f-open` — forall([tt, g, a, b], [2, g, a, b] in eqv(tt) implies a in clf and b in clf and [g, enc-iff(a, b)] in derivable(tt))
- `eqv-if-cond` — forall([jj, tt, x], rw-if-cond(jj, eqv(tt), x) implies x in rw-univ implies x in eqv(tt))
- `eqv-if-else` — forall([jj, tt, x], rw-if-else(jj, eqv(tt), x) implies x in rw-univ implies x in eqv(tt))
- `eqv-if-then` — forall([jj, tt, x], rw-if-then(jj, eqv(tt), x) implies x in rw-univ implies x in eqv(tt))
- `eqv-iff-l` — forall([jj, tt, x], rw-iff-l(jj, eqv(tt), x) implies x in rw-univ implies x in eqv(tt))
- `eqv-iff-r` — forall([jj, tt, x], rw-iff-r(jj, eqv(tt), x) implies x in rw-univ implies x in eqv(tt))
- `eqv-imp-l` — forall([jj, tt, x], rw-imp-l(jj, eqv(tt), x) implies x in rw-univ implies x in eqv(tt))
- `eqv-imp-r` — forall([jj, tt, x], rw-imp-r(jj, eqv(tt), x) implies x in rw-univ implies x in eqv(tt))
- `eqv-in-power` — forall([tt], eqv(tt) in power(rw-univ))
- `eqv-iota-body` — forall([jj, tt, g, a, b], rw-desc-body(jj, eqv(tt), [1, g, enc-iota(a), enc-iota(b)]) implies [1, g, enc-iota(a), enc-iota(b)] in rw-univ implies [1, g, enc-iota(a), enc-iota(b)] in eqv(tt))
- `eqv-not` — forall([jj, tt, x], rw-not(jj, eqv(tt), x) implies x in rw-univ implies x in eqv(tt))
- `eqv-or-l` — forall([jj, tt, x], rw-or-l(jj, eqv(tt), x) implies x in rw-univ implies x in eqv(tt))
- `eqv-or-r` — forall([jj, tt, x], rw-or-r(jj, eqv(tt), x) implies x in rw-univ implies x in eqv(tt))
- `eqv-pred` — forall([jj, tt, x], rw-pred(jj, eqv(tt), x) implies x in rw-univ implies x in eqv(tt))
- `eqv-rel-l` — forall([jj, tt, x], rw-rel-l(jj, eqv(tt), x) implies x in rw-univ implies x in eqv(tt))
- `eqv-rel-r` — forall([jj, tt, x], rw-rel-r(jj, eqv(tt), x) implies x in rw-univ implies x in eqv(tt))
- `eqv-rws-closed` — forall([tt, jj], jj subset eqv(tt) implies rws-closed(jj, eqv(tt)))
- `eqv-sep-body` — forall([jj, tt, x], rw-sep-body(jj, eqv(tt), x) implies x in rw-univ implies x in eqv(tt))
- `eqv-t-intro` — forall([tt, g, a, b], a in clt implies b in clt implies [g, enc-qeq(a, b)] in derivable(tt) implies [1, g, a, b] in eqv(tt))
- `eqv-t-open` — forall([tt, g, a, b], [1, g, a, b] in eqv(tt) implies a in clt and b in clt and [g, enc-qeq(a, b)] in derivable(tt))
- `eqv-tapp` — forall([jj, tt, x], rw-tapp(jj, eqv(tt), x) implies x in rw-univ implies x in eqv(tt))
- `eqv-tbind-body` — forall([jj, tt, x], rw-tbind-body(jj, eqv(tt), x) implies x in rw-univ implies x in eqv(tt))
- `eqv-top` — forall([jj, tt, x], jj subset eqv(tt) implies rw-top(jj, eqv(tt), x) implies x in rw-univ implies x in eqv(tt))
- `eqv-unfold` — forall([mrt_], eqv(mrt_) == {mrx_ in rw-univ: eqv-ok(mrt_, mrx_)})
- `essential-of-finite-extension` — forall([omega, ca, cb, rho, nu, es], is-local-measure(omega, ca, cb, rho) implies empty-set in cb implies is-measure(omega, ca, nu) implies forall([lxe_ in cb], nu(lxe_) = rho(lxe_)) implies es in ca implies nu(es) in rr implies forsome([a], is-sigma-union-of(cb, a) and a subset es and is-locally-null(ca, cb, rho, difference(es, a))))
- `essential-witness-agree` — forall([omega, ca, cb, rho, es, a, a2], is-local-measure(omega, ca, cb, rho) implies empty-set in cb implies es in ca implies is-sigma-union-of(cb, a) implies a subset es implies is-locally-null(ca, cb, rho, difference(es, a)) implies is-sigma-union-of(cb, a2) implies a2 subset es implies is-locally-null(ca, cb, rho, difference(es, a2)) implies (method-i-outer(omega, cb, rho))(a) = (method-i-outer(omega, cb, rho))(a2))
- `essential-witness-le` — forall([omega, ca, cb, rho, es, a, a2], is-local-measure(omega, ca, cb, rho) implies empty-set in cb implies es in ca implies is-sigma-union-of(cb, a) implies a subset es implies is-locally-null(ca, cb, rho, difference(es, a)) implies is-sigma-union-of(cb, a2) implies a2 subset es implies is-locally-null(ca, cb, rho, difference(es, a2)) implies (method-i-outer(omega, cb, rho))(a) <= (method-i-outer(omega, cb, rho))(a2))
- `esum-as-esup-prefix` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr-pos-star)], esum(f) = esup(image(vnb-lambda(pfn_, nn, finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, f, ord-segment(pfn_))), nn)))
- `esum-bounded-implies-finite` — forall([f in fun(dom(f), rr-pos-star)], forsome([m in rr], forall([s], s in set and card(s) in nn and s subset dom(f) implies finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, f, s) <= m)) implies esum(f) in rr)
- `esum-cartesian` — forall([ii, jj in set, h, g, a], h in fun(cartesian(ii, jj), rr-pos-star) implies g in fun(ii, fun(jj, rr-pos-star)) implies forall([i_ in ii, j_ in jj], (g(i_))(j_) = h([i_, j_])) implies a in fun(ii, rr-pos-star) implies forall([i_ in ii], a(i_) = esum(g(i_))) implies esum(h) = esum(a))
- `esum-cartesian-ge` — forall([ii, jj, h, g, gt, a, p1, p2], h in fun(cartesian(ii, jj), rr-pos-star) implies g in fun(ii, fun(jj, rr-pos-star)) implies forall([i_ in ii, j_ in jj], (g(i_))(j_) = h([i_, j_])) implies gt in fun(jj, fun(ii, rr-pos-star)) implies forall([i_ in ii, j_ in jj], (gt(j_))(i_) = (g(i_))(j_)) implies a in fun(ii, rr-pos-star) implies forall([i_ in ii], a(i_) = esum(g(i_))) implies p1 in fun(cartesian(ii, jj), ii) implies p2 in fun(cartesian(ii, jj), jj) implies forall([w_ in cartesian(ii, jj)], w_ = [p1(w_), p2(w_)]) implies esum(a) <= esum(h))
- `esum-cartesian-le` — forall([ii, jj, h, g, a, p1, p2], h in fun(cartesian(ii, jj), rr-pos-star) implies g in fun(ii, fun(jj, rr-pos-star)) implies forall([i_ in ii, j_ in jj], (g(i_))(j_) = h([i_, j_])) implies a in fun(ii, rr-pos-star) implies forall([i_ in ii], a(i_) = esum(g(i_))) implies p1 in fun(cartesian(ii, jj), ii) implies p2 in fun(cartesian(ii, jj), jj) implies forall([w_ in cartesian(ii, jj)], w_ = [p1(w_), p2(w_)]) implies esum(h) <= esum(a))
- `esum-constant-positive-not-finite` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr-pos-star), c in rr], 0 < c implies forall([mvk_ in nn], f(mvk_) = c) implies not(esum(f) in rr))
- `esum-finite-iff-bounded` — forall([f in fun(dom(f), rr-pos-star)], esum(f) in rr iff forsome([m in rr], forall([s], s in set and card(s) in nn and s subset dom(f) implies finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, f, s) <= m)))
- `esum-finite-implies-bounded` — forall([f in fun(dom(f), rr-pos-star)], esum(f) in rr implies forsome([m in rr], forall([s], s in set and card(s) in nn and s subset dom(f) implies finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, f, s) <= m)))
- `esum-finsum-le` — forall([ix, jx, g, gt, a], g in fun(ix, fun(jx, rr-pos-star)) implies gt in fun(jx, fun(ix, rr-pos-star)) implies forall([i_ in ix, j_ in jx], (gt(j_))(i_) = (g(i_))(j_)) implies a in fun(ix, rr-pos-star) implies forall([i_ in ix], a(i_) = esum(g(i_))) implies forall([s_ in set], card(s_) in nn implies s_ subset ix implies finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, a, s_) <= esum(vnb-lambda(tbj_, jx, finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, gt(tbj_), s_)))))
- `esum-in` — forall([f in fun(dom(f), rr-pos-star)], esum(f) in rr-pos-star)
- `esum-inj-le` — forall([j, ix, ph, g, h], forall([nej_ in j], ph(nej_) in ix) implies forall([x_ in j, y_ in j], ph(x_) = ph(y_) implies x_ = y_) implies g in fun(ix, rr-pos-star) implies h in fun(j, rr-pos-star) implies forall([x_ in j], h(x_) = g(ph(x_))) implies esum(h) <= esum(g))
- `esum-le-ptwise` — forall([dd, f, g], f in fun(dd, rr-pos-star) implies g in fun(dd, rr-pos-star) implies forall([z_ in dd], f(z_) <= g(z_)) implies esum(f) <= esum(g))
- `esum-least` — forall([f in fun(dom(f), rr-pos-star), b], b in rr-pos-star and forall([s], s in set and card(s) in nn and s subset dom(f) implies finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, f, s) <= b) implies esum(f) <= b)
- `esum-nn-add-le` — forall([f, g], f in fun(nn, rr-pos-star) implies g in fun(nn, rr-pos-star) implies esum(vnb-lambda(oak_, nn, eplus(f(oak_), g(oak_)))) <= eplus(esum(f), esum(g)))
- `esum-nn-even-odd-le` — forall([f, g, h], f in fun(nn, rr-pos-star) implies g in fun(nn, rr-pos-star) implies h in fun(nn, rr-pos-star) implies forall([q in nn], g(q) = f(2 * q)) implies forall([q in nn], h(q) = f(succ(2 * q))) implies esum(f) <= eplus(esum(g), esum(h)))
- `esum-nn-flatten-le` — forall([oaa, ofl, otl], oaa in fun(nn, fun(nn, rr-pos-star)) implies ofl in fun(nn, rr-pos-star) implies otl in fun(nn, rr-pos-star) implies forall([m_ in nn], ofl(m_) = (oaa(nnfst(m_)))(nnsnd(m_))) implies forall([i_ in nn], otl(i_) = esum(oaa(i_))) implies esum(ofl) <= esum(otl))
- `esum-nn-le-of-prefixes` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr-pos-star), b in rr-pos-star], forall([n in nn], finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, f, ord-segment(n)) <= b) implies esum(f) <= b)
- `esum-nn-le-termwise` — forall([f, g], f in fun(nn, rr-pos-star) implies g in fun(nn, rr-pos-star) implies forall([k in nn], f(k) <= g(k)) implies esum(f) <= esum(g))
- `esum-nn-prefix-le` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr-pos-star), n in nn], finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, f, ord-segment(n)) <= esum(f))
- `esum-nn-superadditive` — forall([f, g, h], f in fun(nn, rr-pos-star) implies g in fun(nn, rr-pos-star) implies h in fun(nn, rr-pos-star) implies forall([k in nn], eplus(f(k), g(k)) <= h(k)) implies eplus(esum(f), esum(g)) <= esum(h))
- `esum-nn-tail-small` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr-pos-star)], esum(f) in rr implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([n in nn], forall([g in fun(nn, rr-pos-star)], forall([j in nn], g(j) <= f(n + j)) implies esum(g) <= eps))))
- `esum-nn-term-le` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr-pos-star), k in nn], f(k) <= esum(f))
- `esum-nn-transfer-le` — forall([ix, m, ph, g, h], m in set implies forall([nen_ in m], nen_ in nn) implies forall([nej_ in m], ph(nej_) in ix) implies forall([x_ in m, y_ in m], ph(x_) = ph(y_) implies x_ = y_) implies g in fun(ix, rr-pos-star) implies h in fun(nn, rr-pos-star) implies forall([nen_ in m], h(nen_) = g(ph(nen_))) implies forall([nen_ in nn], not(nen_ in m) implies h(nen_) = 0) implies esum(h) <= esum(g))
- `esum-nn-two-support` — forall([h in fun(nn, rr-pos-star)], forall([q in nn], h(succ(succ(q))) = 0) implies esum(h) = eplus(h(0), h(succ(0))))
- `esum-nn-type` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr-pos-star)], esum(f) in rr-pos-star)
- `esum-nn-zero` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr-pos-star)], forall([ozn in nn], f(ozn) = 0) implies esum(f) = 0)
- `esum-one-term` — forall([h in fun(nn, rr-pos-star), m in nn], forall([k in nn], not(k = m) implies h(k) = 0) implies esum(h) = h(m))
- `esum-one-term-prefix` — forall([h in fun(nn, rr-pos-star), m in nn], forall([k in nn], not(k = m) implies h(k) = 0) implies forall([n in nn], finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, h, ord-segment(n)) <= h(m) and (n <= m implies finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, h, ord-segment(n)) = 0)))
- `esum-partial-sum-type` — forall([f, s], f in fun(dom(f), rr-pos-star) implies s in set and card(s) in nn and s subset dom(f) implies finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, f, s) in rr-pos-star)
- `esum-real-add-le` — forall([dd, f, g, h], f in fun(dd, rr) implies g in fun(dd, rr) implies h in fun(dd, rr) implies forall([z_ in dd], 0 <= f(z_)) implies forall([z_ in dd], 0 <= g(z_)) implies forall([z_ in dd], 0 <= h(z_)) implies forall([z_ in dd], h(z_) <= f(z_) + g(z_)) implies esum(f) in rr implies esum(g) in rr implies esum(h) in rr and esum(h) <= esum(f) + esum(g))
- `esum-real-le-ptwise` — forall([dd, f, g], f in fun(dd, rr) implies g in fun(dd, rr) implies forall([z_ in dd], 0 <= f(z_)) implies forall([z_ in dd], f(z_) <= g(z_)) implies esum(g) in rr implies esum(f) in rr and esum(f) <= esum(g))
- `esum-scale` — forall([c in rr], 0 <= c implies forall([dd, f in fun(dd, rr-pos-star)], esum(vnb-lambda(esz_, dd, etimes(c, f(esz_)))) = etimes(c, esum(f))))
- `esum-scale-ptwise` — forall([c in rr], 0 <= c implies forall([dd, g, h], g in fun(dd, rr-pos-star) implies h in fun(dd, rr-pos-star) implies forall([z_ in dd], h(z_) = etimes(c, g(z_))) implies esum(h) = etimes(c, esum(g))))
- `esum-subadditive` — forall([dd, f, g, h], f in fun(dd, rr-pos-star) implies g in fun(dd, rr-pos-star) implies h in fun(dd, rr-pos-star) implies forall([z_ in dd], h(z_) <= eplus(f(z_), g(z_))) implies esum(h) <= eplus(esum(f), esum(g)))
- `esum-sums-to-cc` — forall([g in fun(dom(g), rr)], forall([z_ in dom(g)], 0 <= g(z_)) implies esum(g) in rr implies sums-to(cc-nag, g, esum(g)))
- `esum-superadditive` — forall([dd, f, g, h], f in fun(dd, rr-pos-star) implies g in fun(dd, rr-pos-star) implies h in fun(dd, rr-pos-star) implies forall([z_ in dd], eplus(f(z_), g(z_)) <= h(z_)) implies eplus(esum(f), esum(g)) <= esum(h))
- `esum-superlevel-finite` — forall([ix, g in fun(ix, rr-pos-star)], esum(g) in rr implies forall([d], pos-rr(d) implies card({nex_ in ix: d <= g(nex_)}) in nn))
- `esum-support-enum` — forall([ix, g in fun(ix, rr)], g in fun(ix, rr-pos-star) implies esum(g) in rr implies forsome([nem_, neph_], nem_ in set and forall([nen_ in nem_], nen_ in nn) and neph_ in bijection(nem_, {nex_ in ix: 0 < g(nex_)})))
- `esum-swap` — forall([ix, jx, g, gt, a, b], g in fun(ix, fun(jx, rr-pos-star)) implies gt in fun(jx, fun(ix, rr-pos-star)) implies forall([i_ in ix, j_ in jx], (gt(j_))(i_) = (g(i_))(j_)) implies a in fun(ix, rr-pos-star) implies forall([i_ in ix], a(i_) = esum(g(i_))) implies b in fun(jx, rr-pos-star) implies forall([j_ in jx], b(j_) = esum(gt(j_))) implies esum(a) = esum(b))
- `esum-swap-le` — forall([ix, jx, g, gt, a, b], g in fun(ix, fun(jx, rr-pos-star)) implies gt in fun(jx, fun(ix, rr-pos-star)) implies forall([i_ in ix, j_ in jx], (gt(j_))(i_) = (g(i_))(j_)) implies a in fun(ix, rr-pos-star) implies forall([i_ in ix], a(i_) = esum(g(i_))) implies b in fun(jx, rr-pos-star) implies forall([j_ in jx], b(j_) = esum(gt(j_))) implies esum(a) <= esum(b))
- `esum-tail-small` — forall([dd, f in fun(dd, rr-pos-star)], esum(f) in rr implies forall([dl], pos-rr(dl) implies forsome([tq_ in set], card(tq_) in nn and tq_ subset dd and esum(vnb-lambda(tlz_, dd, if(tlz_ in tq_, 0, f(tlz_)))) < dl)))
- `esum-upper` — forall([f in fun(dom(f), rr-pos-star), s], s in set and card(s) in nn and s subset dom(f) implies finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, f, s) <= esum(f))
- `esup-const-image` — forall([c in rr-pos-star], esup(image(vnb-lambda(mru_, nn, c), nn)) = c)
- `esup-empty` — esup(empty-set) = 0
- `esup-eplus-eq` — forall([u, v], u in fun(nn, rr-pos-star) implies v in fun(nn, rr-pos-star) implies forall([n in nn], u(n) <= u(succ(n))) implies forall([n in nn], v(n) <= v(succ(n))) implies esup(image(vnb-lambda(n_, nn, eplus(u(n_), v(n_))), nn)) = eplus(esup(image(u, nn)), esup(image(v, nn))))

- `etimes-mono-star` — forall([p_ in rr-pos-star, q_ in rr-pos-star, s_ in rr-pos-star, t_ in rr-pos-star], p_ <= q_ implies s_ <= t_ implies etimes(p_, s_) <= etimes(q_, t_))
