- `ext-abs-nonzero` — forall([k, f, md, n, u], is-fin-ext(k, f, md, n, u) implies forall([xi in carr(f)], not(xi = zero(f)) implies not(ext-abs(k, f, md, n, u, xi) = 0)))
- `ext-abs-one` — forall([k, f, md, n, u], is-fin-ext(k, f, md, n, u) implies ext-abs(k, f, md, n, u, one(f)) = 1)
- `ext-abs-root-scalar` — forall([k, f, md, n, u], is-fin-ext(k, f, md, n, u) implies forall([x4l in carr(k)], ext-abs-root(k, f, md, n, u, (act(md))(x4l, one(f))) = (fnrm(k))(x4l)))
- `ext-abs-scalar` — forall([k, f, md, n, u], is-fin-ext(k, f, md, n, u) implies forall([x4l in carr(k)], ext-abs(k, f, md, n, u, (act(md))(x4l, one(f))) = (fnrm(k))(x4l) ^ n))
- `ext-abs-type` — forall([k, f, md, n, u], is-fin-ext(k, f, md, n, u) implies forall([xi in carr(f)], ext-abs(k, f, md, n, u, xi) in rr and 0 <= ext-abs(k, f, md, n, u, xi)))
- `ext-abs-zero` — forall([k, f, md, n, u], is-fin-ext(k, f, md, n, u) implies ext-abs(k, f, md, n, u, zero(f)) = 0)
- `ext-add-ge-left` — forall([a, b], a in rr-star implies b in rr-star implies 0 <= a implies b <= ext-add(b, a))
- `ext-add-ge-right` — forall([a, b], a in rr-star implies b in rr-star implies 0 <= a implies b <= ext-add(a, b))
- `ext-add-in` — forall([x, y], x in rr-star implies y in rr-star implies ext-add(x, y) in rr-star)
- `ext-add-le-eplus` — forall([a, b, c, d], a in rr-star implies b in rr-star implies c in rr-pos-star implies d in rr-pos-star implies a <= c implies b <= d implies ext-add(a, b) <= eplus(c, d))
- `ext-add-neg-inf-left` — forall([y], not(y = pos-inf) implies ext-add(neg-inf, y) = neg-inf)
- `ext-add-neg-inf-right` — forall([y], not(y = pos-inf) implies ext-add(y, neg-inf) = neg-inf)
- `ext-add-pos-inf-left` — forall([y], ext-add(pos-inf, y) = pos-inf)
- `ext-add-pos-inf-right` — forall([y], ext-add(y, pos-inf) = pos-inf)
- `ext-add-real` — forall([x, y], x in rr implies y in rr implies ext-add(x, y) = x + y)
- `ext-add-zero-left` — forall([y in rr-star], ext-add(0, y) = y)
- `ext-add-zero-right` — forall([y in rr-star], ext-add(y, 0) = y)
- `ext-mult-mat-add` — forall([k, f, md, n, u], is-fin-ext(k, f, md, n, u) implies forall([xi in carr(f), eta in carr(f)], mult-mat(md, n, u, f, (add(f))(xi, eta)) = matadd(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(k), mult-mat(md, n, u, f, xi), mult-mat(md, n, u, f, eta))))
- `ext-mult-mat-mul` — forall([k, f, md, n, u], is-fin-ext(k, f, md, n, u) implies forall([xi in carr(f), eta in carr(f)], mult-mat(md, n, u, f, (mul(f))(xi, eta)) = matmul(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(k), mult-mat(md, n, u, f, eta), mult-mat(md, n, u, f, xi))))
- `ext-mult-mat-one` — forall([k, f, md, n, u], is-fin-ext(k, f, md, n, u) implies mult-mat(md, n, u, f, one(f)) = identmat(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(k), n))
- `ext-mult-mat-rigid` — forall([k, f, md, n, u], is-fin-ext(k, f, md, n, u) implies forall([b in mat(n, n, carr(k))], forall([cgx_ in carr(f)], matmul(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(k), b, mult-mat(md, n, u, f, cgx_)) = matmul(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(k), mult-mat(md, n, u, f, cgx_), b)) implies det(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(k), n, b) = zero(k) implies b = zeromat(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(k), n, n)))
- `ext-mult-mat-scalar` — forall([k, f, md, n, u], is-fin-ext(k, f, md, n, u) implies forall([x4l in carr(k)], mult-mat(md, n, u, f, (act(md))(x4l, one(f))) = matscale(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(k), x4l, identmat(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(k), n))))
- `ext-mult-mat-spec` — forall([k, f, md, n, u], is-fin-ext(k, f, md, n, u) implies forall([xi in carr(f)], mult-mat(md, n, u, f, xi) in mat(n, n, carr(k)) and map-seq(mult-op(f, xi), n, u) = matact(md, mult-mat(md, n, u, f, xi), u)))
- `ext-mult-op-hom` — forall([k, f, md, n, u], is-fin-ext(k, f, md, n, u) implies forall([xi in carr(f)], is-hom-module(md, md, mult-op(f, xi))))
- `ext-neg-add-down` — forall([a, b], a in rr-star implies b in rr-star implies not(a = neg-inf) implies not(b = neg-inf) implies ext-neg(ext-add(a, b)) = ext-add(ext-neg(a), ext-neg(b)))
- `ext-neg-add-up` — forall([a, b], a in rr-star implies b in rr-star implies not(a = pos-inf) implies not(b = pos-inf) implies ext-neg(ext-add(a, b)) = ext-add(ext-neg(a), ext-neg(b)))
- `ext-neg-gt-flip` — forall([a, b], a in rr-star implies b in rr implies -b < a implies ext-neg(a) < b)
- `ext-neg-in` — forall([x in rr-star], ext-neg(x) in rr-star)
- `ext-neg-lt-flip` — forall([a, b], a in rr-star implies b in rr implies a < -b implies b < ext-neg(a))
- `ext-neg-neg-inf` — ext-neg(neg-inf) = pos-inf
- `ext-neg-pos-inf` — ext-neg(pos-inf) = neg-inf
- `ext-neg-real` — forall([x in rr], ext-neg(x) = -x)
- `ext-neg-real-back` — forall([x in rr-star], ext-neg(x) in rr implies x in rr)
- `ext-neg-to-neg-inf` — forall([x in rr-star], ext-neg(x) = neg-inf implies x = pos-inf)
- `ext-neg-to-pos-inf` — forall([x in rr-star], ext-neg(x) = pos-inf implies x = neg-inf)
- `ext-neg-zero` — ext-neg(0) = 0
- `ext-psum-cond-succ` — forall([x, n in nn, c_], forsome([k_ in nn], k_ < succ(n) and x(k_) = c_) iff forsome([k_ in nn], k_ < n and x(k_) = c_) or x(n) = c_)
- `ext-psum-eventually` — forall([x, m in nn], forall([k_ in nn], x(k_) in rr-star) implies forall([k_ in nn], m <= k_ implies x(k_) = 0) implies forsome([m_ in nn], forall([n_ in nn], m_ <= n_ implies ext-partial-sum(x, n_) = ext-partial-sum(x, m))))
- `ext-psum-fin` — forall([x, n], not(forsome([k_ in nn], k_ < n and x(k_) = pos-inf)) implies not(forsome([k_ in nn], k_ < n and x(k_) = neg-inf)) implies ext-partial-sum(x, n) == series-partial-sum(x, n))
- `ext-psum-in` — forall([x, n in nn], forall([k_ in nn], x(k_) in rr-star) implies ext-partial-sum(x, n) in rr-star)
- `ext-psum-le-prefix` — forall([n in nn, x, y], forall([k_ in nn], x(k_) in rr-star) implies y in fun(nn, rr-pos-star) implies forall([k_ in nn], x(k_) <= y(k_)) implies ext-partial-sum(x, n) <= finsum(rr-pos-star-add-monoid, y, ord-segment(n)))
- `ext-psum-mono-nonneg` — forall([d in nn, x, m in nn], forall([k_ in nn], x(k_) in rr-star) implies forall([k_ in nn], 0 <= x(k_)) implies ext-partial-sum(x, m) <= ext-partial-sum(x, m + d))
- `ext-psum-neg` — forall([x, n], not(forsome([k_ in nn], k_ < n and x(k_) = pos-inf)) implies forsome([k_ in nn], k_ < n and x(k_) = neg-inf) implies ext-partial-sum(x, n) = neg-inf)
- `ext-psum-negate-down` — forall([n in nn, x, y], forall([k_ in nn], x(k_) in rr-star) implies forall([k_ in nn], y(k_) = ext-neg(x(k_))) implies forall([k_ in nn], not(x(k_) = neg-inf)) implies ext-partial-sum(y, n) = ext-neg(ext-partial-sum(x, n)))
- `ext-psum-negate-up` — forall([n in nn, x, y], forall([k_ in nn], x(k_) in rr-star) implies forall([k_ in nn], y(k_) = ext-neg(x(k_))) implies forall([k_ in nn], not(x(k_) = pos-inf)) implies ext-partial-sum(y, n) = ext-neg(ext-partial-sum(x, n)))
- `ext-psum-not-neg-inf` — forall([x, n in nn], forall([k_ in nn], x(k_) in rr-star) implies forall([k_ in nn], not(x(k_) = neg-inf)) implies not(ext-partial-sum(x, n) = neg-inf))
- `ext-psum-not-pos-inf` — forall([x, n in nn], forall([k_ in nn], x(k_) in rr-star) implies forall([k_ in nn], not(x(k_) = pos-inf)) implies not(ext-partial-sum(x, n) = pos-inf))
- `ext-psum-pos` — forall([x, n], forsome([k_ in nn], k_ < n and x(k_) = pos-inf) implies ext-partial-sum(x, n) = pos-inf)
- `ext-psum-real-terms` — forall([x, n in nn], forall([k_ in nn], x(k_) in rr-star) implies not(forsome([k_ in nn], k_ < n and x(k_) = pos-inf)) implies not(forsome([k_ in nn], k_ < n and x(k_) = neg-inf)) implies forall([j_ in nn], j_ < n implies x(j_) in rr))
- `ext-psum-stable` — forall([d in nn, x, m in nn], forall([k_ in nn], x(k_) in rr-star) implies forall([k_ in nn], m <= k_ implies x(k_) = 0) implies ext-partial-sum(x, m + d) = ext-partial-sum(x, m))
- `ext-psum-succ` — forall([x, n in nn], forall([k_ in nn], x(k_) in rr-star) implies ext-partial-sum(x, succ(n)) = ext-add(ext-partial-sum(x, n), x(n)))
- `ext-psum-zero` — forall([x], ext-partial-sum(x, 0) = 0)
- `ext-real-not-neg-inf` — forall([x in rr], not(x = neg-inf))
- `ext-real-not-pos-inf` — forall([x in rr], not(x = pos-inf))
- `ext-real-of-ge` — forall([x, c], x in rr-star implies c in rr implies c <= x implies not(x = pos-inf) implies x in rr)
- `ext-series-limit-const` — forall([x, l, c], ext-series-converges-to(x, l) implies c in rr-star implies forsome([m_ in nn], forall([n_ in nn], m_ <= n_ implies ext-partial-sum(x, n_) = c)) implies l = c)
- `ext-series-limit-down` — forall([x, l], ext-series-converges-to(x, l) implies forall([cb_ in rr], forsome([m_ in nn], forall([n_ in nn], m_ <= n_ implies ext-partial-sum(x, n_) <= cb_))) implies l = neg-inf)
- `ext-series-limit-le` — forall([x, l, b], ext-series-converges-to(x, l) implies b in rr-pos-star implies forall([n_ in nn], ext-partial-sum(x, n_) <= b) implies l <= b)
- `ext-series-limit-up` — forall([x, l], ext-series-converges-to(x, l) implies forall([cb_ in rr], forsome([m_ in nn], forall([n_ in nn], m_ <= n_ implies cb_ <= ext-partial-sum(x, n_)))) implies l = pos-inf)
- `ext-series-negate` — forall([x, y, l], ext-series-converges-to(x, l) implies forall([n_ in nn], ext-partial-sum(y, n_) = ext-neg(ext-partial-sum(x, n_))) implies ext-series-converges-to(y, ext-neg(l)))
- `ext-series-sum-finite` — forall([x, l, m in nn], ext-series-converges-to(x, l) implies forall([k_ in nn], x(k_) in rr-star) implies forall([k_ in nn], m <= k_ implies x(k_) = 0) implies l = ext-partial-sum(x, m))
- `ext-series-unbounded-nonneg` — forall([x, l], forall([k_ in nn], x(k_) in rr-star) implies forall([k_ in nn], 0 <= x(k_)) implies forall([cb_ in rr], forsome([k_ in nn], cb_ <= x(k_))) implies ext-series-converges-to(x, l) implies l = pos-inf)
- `extend-const-ccint-fixes` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, icz_ in ccint(a, b), f], (extend-const(f, a, b))(icz_) == f(icz_))
- `extend-const-continuous-at` — forall([a in rr, b in rr], a <= b implies forall([f], is-continuous-on(f, ccint(a, b)) implies forall([ict_ in rr], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, extend-const(f, a, b), ict_))))
- `extend-const-deriv-bwd` — forall([a in rr, b in rr], a <= b implies forall([f in fun(ccint(a, b), rr), icx_ in ooint(a, b), icl_], is-diff-at(extend-const(f, a, b), icx_, icl_) implies has-deriv-at(f, icx_, icl_)))
- `extend-const-deriv-fwd` — forall([a in rr, b in rr], a <= b implies forall([f in fun(ccint(a, b), rr), icx_ in ooint(a, b), icl_], has-deriv-at(f, icx_, icl_) implies is-diff-at(extend-const(f, a, b), icx_, icl_)))
- `extend-const-deriv-iff` — forall([a in rr, b in rr], a <= b implies forall([f in fun(ccint(a, b), rr), icx_ in ooint(a, b), icl_], has-deriv-at(f, icx_, icl_) iff is-diff-at(extend-const(f, a, b), icx_, icl_)))
- `extend-const-fixes` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, icz_ in rr], a <= icz_ implies icz_ <= b implies forall([f], (extend-const(f, a, b))(icz_) == f(icz_)))
- `extend-const-in-fun` — forall([a in rr, b in rr], a <= b implies forall([f in fun(ccint(a, b), rr)], extend-const(f, a, b) in fun(rr, rr)))
- `extend-const-value` — forall([f, a, b, icz_ in rr], (extend-const(f, a, b))(icz_) == f(clamp(a, b, icz_)))
- `extend-positive-functional` — forall([m, t, a, fs, f], is-tvs(rr-normed-field, m, t) implies a in opens(t) implies is-convex-subset(m, a) implies is-submodule(m, fs) implies is-linear-functional-on(m, fs, f) implies forsome([af_ in a], af_ in fs) implies forall([pz_ in a], pz_ in fs implies 0 < f(pz_)) implies forsome([g], is-linear-functional(m, g) and is-hom-top-space(t, seminorm-top(normed-vector-space-as-module(rr-nvs), pair(0, 0), vnb-lambda(nvk_, pair(0, 0), vnrm(rr-nvs))), g) and extends-on(fs, g, f) and forall([x in a], 0 < g(x))))
- `extends-on-trans` — forall([s, t, g2, g1, f], s subset t implies extends-on(t, g2, g1) implies extends-on(s, g1, f) implies extends-on(s, g2, f))
- `extremal-meet` — forall([m, ks, ch], is-module(m) implies is-convex-subset(m, ks) implies forall([kca_ in ch], is-extremal-subset(m, kca_, ks)) implies forsome([kuz_], kuz_ in {kub_ in ks: forall([kca_ in ch], kub_ in kca_)}) implies is-extremal-subset(m, {kub_ in ks: forall([kca_ in ch], kub_ in kca_)}, ks))
- `extremal-subset-inter` — forall([v, ix, cf, df], is-module(v) implies scal(v) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies cf in fun(ix, power(vec(v))) implies df in fun(ix, power(vec(v))) implies forall([exl_ in ix], is-extremal-subset(v, cf(exl_), df(exl_))) implies forsome([exz_], exz_ in {exw_ in vec(v): forall([exl_ in ix], exw_ in cf(exl_))}) implies is-extremal-subset(v, {exw_ in vec(v): forall([exl_ in ix], exw_ in cf(exl_))}, {exw_ in vec(v): forall([exl_ in ix], exw_ in df(exl_))}))
- `extremal-subset-preimage` — forall([m1, m2, f, b, a], is-linear-map(m1, m2, f) implies scal(m1) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies is-extremal-subset(m2, b, a) implies forsome([exz_], exz_ in {exw_ in vec(m1): f(exw_) in b}) implies is-extremal-subset(m1, {exw_ in vec(m1): f(exw_) in b}, {exw_ in vec(m1): f(exw_) in a}))
- `extremal-subset-refl` — forall([m, ks], is-convex-subset(m, ks) implies forsome([kz0_], kz0_ in ks) implies is-extremal-subset(m, ks, ks))
- `extremal-subset-singleton-extreme` — forall([m, f, a, e], is-extremal-subset(m, f, a) implies forall([kmp_ in f, kmq_ in f], kmp_ = kmq_) implies e in f implies is-extreme-point(m, a, e))
- `extremal-subset-trans` — forall([v, c, b, a], is-extremal-subset(v, c, b) implies is-extremal-subset(v, b, a) implies is-extremal-subset(v, c, a))
- `extreme-point-exists` — forall([m, t, ks], is-locally-convex-tvs(m, t) implies ks subset vec(m) implies is-convex-subset(m, ks) implies is-compact-t(subspace-top(t, ks)) implies forsome([kz0_], kz0_ in ks) implies forsome([kep_], is-extreme-point(m, ks, kep_)))
- `extreme-point-in-subset` — forall([m, b, a, e], b subset a implies is-extreme-point(m, a, e) implies e in b implies is-extreme-point(m, b, e))
- `extreme-point-is-extreme-state` — forall([a], is-unital-involutive-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([g4kx_ in extreme-points(rfn-module(vec(a)), states(a))], is-extreme-state(a, g4kx_)))
- `extreme-point-of-extremal-subset` — forall([m, b, a, e], is-extremal-subset(m, b, a) implies is-extreme-point(m, b, e) implies is-extreme-point(m, a, e))
- `extreme-point-of-level` — forall([k in nn, m, e, x], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies e subset vec(m) implies is-extreme-point(m, conv-hull(m, e), x) implies x in conv-level(m, e, k) implies x in e)
- `extreme-points-are-pure-states` — forall([a], is-unital-involutive-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([g4kx_], g4kx_ in extreme-points(rfn-module(vec(a)), states(a)) iff is-pure-state(a, g4kx_)))
- `extreme-points-mem` — forall([m, ks, z], z in extreme-points(m, ks) iff z in vec(m) and is-extreme-point(m, ks, z))
- `extreme-points-nonempty` — forall([m, t, ks], is-locally-convex-tvs(m, t) implies ks subset vec(m) implies is-convex-subset(m, ks) implies is-compact-t(subspace-top(t, ks)) implies forsome([kz0_], kz0_ in ks) implies forsome([kep_], kep_ in extreme-points(m, ks)))
- `extreme-points-of-hull-in-set` — forall([m, e, x], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies e subset vec(m) implies is-extreme-point(m, conv-hull(m, e), x) implies x in e)
- `extreme-points-pure-set` — forall([a], is-unital-involutive-banach-algebra(a) implies extreme-points(rfn-module(vec(a)), states(a)) = {g4kp_ in fun(vec(a), cc): is-pure-state(a, g4kp_)})
- `extreme-points-unfold` — forall([m, ks], extreme-points(m, ks) == {kez_ in vec(m): is-extreme-point(m, ks, kez_)})
- `extreme-state-is-extreme-point` — forall([a], is-unital-involutive-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([g4kx_], is-extreme-state(a, g4kx_) implies g4kx_ in extreme-points(rfn-module(vec(a)), states(a))))
- `extreme-state-is-pure` — forall([a], is-unital-involutive-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([f], is-extreme-state(a, f) implies is-pure-state(a, f)))
- `extreme-state-pure` — forall([a], is-unital-involutive-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([f in states(a)], forall([g in states(a), h in states(a), r in rr], 0 < r implies r < 1 implies forall([g4ty_ in vec(a)], f(g4ty_) = r * g(g4ty_) + (1 - r) * h(g4ty_)) implies forall([g4tz_ in vec(a)], g(g4tz_) = f(g4tz_))) implies is-pure-state(a, f)))
- `extreme-value-max` — forall([f, a, b], f in fun(rr, rr) and a in rr and b in rr and a <= b implies forall([x in ccint(a, b)], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, x)) implies forsome([c in ccint(a, b)], forall([x in ccint(a, b)], f(x) <= f(c))))
- `extreme-value-min` — forall([f, a, b], f in fun(rr, rr) and a in rr and b in rr and a <= b implies forall([x in ccint(a, b)], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, x)) implies forsome([c in ccint(a, b)], forall([x in ccint(a, b)], f(c) <= f(x))))
- `fact-sums-concat` — forall([m], is-monoid(m) implies forall([g in fun(carr(m), rr)], forall([x in carr(m)], 0 <= g(x)) implies g(iden(m)) = 0 implies forall([x in carr(m), y in carr(m), z in carr(m)], g((opr(m))((opr(m))(x, y), z)) <= 2 * max(g(x), max(g(y), g(z)))) implies forall([n1 in nn, u1 in fun(nn, carr(m)), n2 in nn, u2 in fun(nn, carr(m))], series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(msi_, nn, g(u1(msi_))), n1) + series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(msi_, nn, g(u2(msi_))), n2) in fact-sums(m, g, (opr(m))(mprod(m, u1, n1), mprod(m, u2, n2))))))

- `finsum-interval-shift` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([n in nn, f in fun(interval(1, succ(n)), carr(ag))], finsum(ag, f, interval(1, succ(n))) = (opr(ag))(f(1), finsum(ag, vnb-lambda(z, interval(1, n), f(succ(z))), interval(1, n)))))
- `finsum-le-termwise` — forall([s], s in set and card(s) in nn implies forall([a in fun(s, rr), b in fun(s, rr)], forall([i in s], a(i) <= b(i)) implies finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), a, s) <= finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), b, s)))

- `finsum-ord-peel` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([n in nn, f in fun(ord-segment(succ(n)), carr(ag))], finsum(ag, f, ord-segment(succ(n))) = (opr(ag))(finsum(ag, f, ord-segment(n)), f(n))))

- `finsum-reindex` — forall([m], is-comm-monoid(m) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([t], t in set and card(t) in nn implies forall([phi in bijection(t, s), f in fun(s, carr(m))], finsum(m, f, s) = finsum(m, vnb-lambda(z, t, f(phi(z))), t)))))

- `finsum-reindex-inverse` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([t], t in set and card(t) in nn implies forall([phi in fun(t, s), psi in fun(s, t)], forall([u_ in t], psi(phi(u_)) = u_) implies forall([v_ in s], phi(psi(v_)) = v_) implies forall([f in fun(s, carr(ag))], finsum(ag, f, s) = finsum(ag, vnb-lambda(z, t, f(phi(z))), t))))))
- `finsum-reindex-inverse-ptwise` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([t], t in set and card(t) in nn implies forall([phi in fun(t, s), psi in fun(s, t)], forall([u_ in t], psi(phi(u_)) = u_) implies forall([v_ in s], phi(psi(v_)) = v_) implies forall([ff], forall([z_ in s], ff(z_) in carr(ag)) implies finsum(ag, ff, s) = finsum(ag, vnb-lambda(z, t, ff(phi(z))), t))))))
- `finsum-ring-distrib-left` — forall([rng], is-commutative-ring(rng) implies forall([r in carr(rng), s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f in fun(s, carr(rng))], (mul(rng))(r, finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rng), f, s)) = finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rng), vnb-lambda(z, s, (mul(rng))(r, f(z))), s))))
- `finsum-ring-distrib-left-gen` — forall([rng], is-ring(rng) implies forall([r in carr(rng), s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f in fun(s, carr(rng))], (mul(rng))(r, finsum(ring-additive-ag(rng), f, s)) = finsum(ring-additive-ag(rng), vnb-lambda(z, s, (mul(rng))(r, f(z))), s))))

- `finsum-ring-distrib-right-gen` — forall([rng], is-ring(rng) implies forall([r in carr(rng), s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([f in fun(s, carr(rng))], (mul(rng))(finsum(ring-additive-ag(rng), f, s), r) = finsum(ring-additive-ag(rng), vnb-lambda(z, s, (mul(rng))(f(z), r)), s))))
- `finsum-ring-scalar-zz` — forall([rng], is-commutative-ring(rng) implies forall([r in carr(rng), c in zz, a in carr(rng)], (mul(rng))(r, zz-act(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rng), c, a)) = zz-act(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rng), c, (mul(rng))(r, a))))
- `finsum-rr-const` — forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([c in rr, f in fun(s, rr)], forall([z in s], f(z) = c) implies finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), f, s) = c * card(s)))
- `finsum-rr-const-cls` — forall([mas_ in set], card(mas_) in nn implies mas_ in {mcs_ | forall([c in rr, f in set], forall([z in mcs_], f(z) = c) implies finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), f, mcs_) = c * card(mcs_))})
- `finsum-rr-continuous-at` — forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([h in fun(s, fun(rr, rr)), g in fun(rr, fun(s, rr)), t0 in rr], forall([w in s], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, h(w), t0)) implies forall([t in rr, w in s], (g(t))(w) = (h(w))(t)) implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, vnb-lambda(t, rr, finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), g(t), s)), t0)))

- `finsum-rr-lt-termwise` — forall([s in set], card(s) in nn implies forall([a in fun(s, rr), b in fun(s, rr)], forall([w in s], a(w) < b(w)) implies forsome([k], k in s) implies finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), a, s) < finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), b, s)))
- `finsum-rr-lt-termwise-cls` — forall([mas_ in set], card(mas_) in nn implies mas_ in {mcs_ | forall([a in set, b in set], forall([w in mcs_], a(w) in rr and b(w) in rr and a(w) < b(w)) implies finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), a, mcs_) in rr and finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), b, mcs_) in rr and finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), a, mcs_) <= finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), b, mcs_) and (forsome([k], k in mcs_) implies finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), a, mcs_) < finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), b, mcs_)))})

- `hahn-banach-seminorm` — forall([m, p, s, f, fld], is-module(m) implies is-normed-field(fld) implies fld = rr-normed-field or fld = cc-normed-field implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(fld) implies is-seminorm(fld, m, p) implies is-submodule(m, s) implies is-k-linear-on(m, s, f) implies forall([x in s], (fnrm(fld))(f(x)) <= p(x)) implies forsome([ff], is-k-linear(m, ff) and extends-on(s, ff, f) and forall([x in vec(m)], (fnrm(fld))(ff(x)) <= p(x))))
- `hahn-banach-seminorm-rr` — forall([m, p, s, f], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies is-seminorm(rr-normed-field, m, p) implies is-submodule(m, s) implies is-k-linear-on(m, s, f) implies forall([x in s], (fnrm(rr-normed-field))(f(x)) <= p(x)) implies forsome([ff], is-k-linear(m, ff) and extends-on(s, ff, f) and forall([x in vec(m)], (fnrm(rr-normed-field))(ff(x)) <= p(x))))
- `half-geometric-facts` — vnb-lambda(n, nn, num(1/2) ^ n) in fun(nn, rr) and forall([k in nn], (vnb-lambda(n, nn, num(1/2) ^ n))(k) = num(1/2) ^ k and 0 < num(1/2) ^ k) and forall([k in nn], num(1/2) ^ succ(k) <= num(1/2) ^ k) and forall([nq in nn], series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(n, nn, num(1/2) ^ n), nq) <= 2)
- `half-magnitude` — forall([goux_ in cc], magnitude(num(1/2) * goux_) = num(1/2) * magnitude(goux_))
- `half-power-anti` — forall([j in nn, k in nn], j <= k implies num(1/2) ^ k <= num(1/2) ^ j)
- `half-power-facts` — forall([k in nn], num(1/2) ^ k in rr and 0 < num(1/2) ^ k and num(1/2) ^ succ(k) = num(1/2) * num(1/2) ^ k)
- `half-power-small` — forall([a in rr], forall([k in nn], a <= num(1/2) ^ k) implies a <= 0)
- `half-sq-fixed-point` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([y in vec(a)], (vnrm(a))(y) < 1 implies forsome([z in vec(a)], (vnrm(a))(z) < 1 and z = (act(a))(num(1/2), (vadd(a))(y, (vmul(a))(z, z))))))
- `half-sq-fixed-unique` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([y in vec(a), u in vec(a)], (vnrm(a))(u) < 1 implies u = (act(a))(num(1/2), (vadd(a))(y, (vmul(a))(u, u))) implies forall([w in vec(a)], (vnrm(a))(w) < 1 implies w = (act(a))(num(1/2), (vadd(a))(y, (vmul(a))(w, w))) implies u = w)))
- `harmonic-minus-log-identity` — forall([egn_ in nn], series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(egj_, nn, recip(succ(egj_))), succ(egn_)) - log(succ(egn_)) = 1 - series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(egk_, nn, log(succ(succ(egk_))) - log(succ(egk_)) - recip(succ(succ(egk_)))), egn_))
- `has-deriv-at-affine` — forall([hdr_], pos-rr(hdr_) implies forall([f, hdc_ in rr, hdm_ in rr, hdx_ in rr], restrict(f, ooint(hdx_ - hdr_, hdx_ + hdr_)) in fun(ooint(hdx_ - hdr_, hdx_ + hdr_), rr) implies forall([hbx_ in ooint(hdx_ - hdr_, hdx_ + hdr_)], f(hbx_) == hdc_ + hdm_ * hbx_) implies has-deriv-at(f, hdx_, hdm_)))
- `has-deriv-at-affine-chain` — forall([crr_], pos-rr(crr_) implies forall([g, h, crp_ in rr, crq_ in rr, crx_ in rr, crm_], restrict(h, ooint(crx_ - crr_, crx_ + crr_)) in fun(ooint(crx_ - crr_, crx_ + crr_), rr) implies forall([cry_ in ooint(crx_ - crr_, crx_ + crr_)], h(cry_) == g(crp_ + crq_ * cry_)) implies has-deriv-at(g, crp_ + crq_ * crx_, crm_) implies has-deriv-at(h, crx_, crm_ * crq_)))
- `has-deriv-at-chain` — forall([crr_], pos-rr(crr_) implies forall([f, g, h, crx_, crl_, crm_], restrict(h, ooint(crx_ - crr_, crx_ + crr_)) in fun(ooint(crx_ - crr_, crx_ + crr_), rr) implies forall([cry_ in ooint(crx_ - crr_, crx_ + crr_)], h(cry_) == g(f(cry_))) implies has-deriv-at(f, crx_, crl_) implies has-deriv-at(g, f(crx_), crm_) implies has-deriv-at(h, crx_, crm_ * crl_)))
- `has-deriv-at-const` — forall([hdr_], pos-rr(hdr_) implies forall([f, hdc_ in rr, hdx_ in rr], restrict(f, ooint(hdx_ - hdr_, hdx_ + hdr_)) in fun(ooint(hdx_ - hdr_, hdx_ + hdr_), rr) implies forall([hbx_ in ooint(hdx_ - hdr_, hdx_ + hdr_)], f(hbx_) == hdc_) implies has-deriv-at(f, hdx_, 0)))
- `has-deriv-at-difference` — forall([hdr_], pos-rr(hdr_) implies forall([f, g, h, hdx_, hdl_, hdm_], restrict(h, ooint(hdx_ - hdr_, hdx_ + hdr_)) in fun(ooint(hdx_ - hdr_, hdx_ + hdr_), rr) implies restrict(g, ooint(hdx_ - hdr_, hdx_ + hdr_)) in fun(ooint(hdx_ - hdr_, hdx_ + hdr_), rr) implies forall([hbx_ in ooint(hdx_ - hdr_, hdx_ + hdr_)], h(hbx_) == f(hbx_) - g(hbx_)) implies has-deriv-at(f, hdx_, hdl_) implies has-deriv-at(g, hdx_, hdm_) implies has-deriv-at(h, hdx_, hdl_ - hdm_)))
- `has-deriv-at-identity` — forall([hdr_], pos-rr(hdr_) implies forall([f, hdx_ in rr], restrict(f, ooint(hdx_ - hdr_, hdx_ + hdr_)) in fun(ooint(hdx_ - hdr_, hdx_ + hdr_), rr) implies forall([hbx_ in ooint(hdx_ - hdr_, hdx_ + hdr_)], f(hbx_) == hbx_) implies has-deriv-at(f, hdx_, 1)))
- `has-deriv-at-iff-diff-at` — forall([f in fun(rr, rr), a, icl_], has-deriv-at(f, a, icl_) iff is-diff-at(f, a, icl_))
- `has-deriv-at-iff-one-sided` — forall([f, osx_, osl_], has-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_) iff has-right-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_) and has-left-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_))
- `has-deriv-at-iff-within-ooint` — forall([f, osx_, osl_], has-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_) iff forsome([osv_], pos-rr(osv_) and has-deriv-at-within(f, ooint(osx_ - osv_, osx_ + osv_), osx_, osl_)))
- `has-deriv-at-implies-left` — forall([f, osx_, osl_], has-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_) implies has-left-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_))
- `has-deriv-at-implies-right` — forall([f, osx_, osl_], has-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_) implies has-right-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_))
- `has-deriv-at-in-rr` — forall([f, a, icl_], has-deriv-at(f, a, icl_) implies icl_ in rr)
- `has-deriv-at-intro` — forall([f, a, icl_, ice_], pos-rr(ice_) implies is-diff-on(rr-normed-field, ooint(a - ice_, a + ice_), restrict(f, ooint(a - ice_, a + ice_)), a, icl_) implies has-deriv-at(f, a, icl_))
- `has-deriv-at-local` — forall([icr_], pos-rr(icr_) implies forall([f, g, icx_, icl_], restrict(f, ooint(icx_ - icr_, icx_ + icr_)) in fun(ooint(icx_ - icr_, icx_ + icr_), rr) implies forall([hbx_ in ooint(icx_ - icr_, icx_ + icr_)], f(hbx_) == g(hbx_)) implies has-deriv-at(g, icx_, icl_) implies has-deriv-at(f, icx_, icl_)))
- `has-deriv-at-maps-into` — forall([f, crx_, crl_], has-deriv-at(f, crx_, crl_) implies forall([crd_], pos-rr(crd_) implies forall([crb_], pos-rr(crb_) implies forsome([crw_], pos-rr(crw_) and crw_ <= crb_ and forall([cry_ in ooint(crx_ - crw_, crx_ + crw_)], f(cry_) in ooint(f(crx_) - crd_, f(crx_) + crd_))))))
- `has-deriv-at-of-eps-bound` — forall([eg_, ec_, er_, el_], ec_ in rr implies pos-rr(er_) implies el_ in rr implies forall([et_ in ooint(ec_ - er_, ec_ + er_)], eg_(et_) in rr) implies forall([ee_], pos-rr(ee_) implies forsome([ed_], pos-rr(ed_) and forall([et_ in ooint(ec_ - er_, ec_ + er_)], abs(et_ - ec_) < ed_ implies abs(eg_(et_) - eg_(ec_) - (et_ - ec_) * el_) <= ee_ * abs(et_ - ec_)))) implies has-deriv-at(eg_, ec_, el_))
- `has-deriv-at-of-one-sided` — forall([f, osx_, osl_], has-right-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_) implies has-left-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_) implies has-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_))
- `has-deriv-at-of-within-ooint` — forall([osx_, osr_], pos-rr(osr_) implies forall([f, osl_], has-deriv-at-within(f, ooint(osx_ - osr_, osx_ + osr_), osx_, osl_) implies has-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_)))
- `has-deriv-at-product` — forall([icr_], pos-rr(icr_) implies forall([f, g, h, icx_, icl_, icm_], restrict(h, ooint(icx_ - icr_, icx_ + icr_)) in fun(ooint(icx_ - icr_, icx_ + icr_), rr) implies forall([hbx_ in ooint(icx_ - icr_, icx_ + icr_)], h(hbx_) == f(hbx_) * g(hbx_)) implies has-deriv-at(f, icx_, icl_) implies has-deriv-at(g, icx_, icm_) implies has-deriv-at(h, icx_, icl_ * g(icx_) + icm_ * f(icx_))))
- `has-deriv-at-pt-in-rr` — forall([f, a, icl_], has-deriv-at(f, a, icl_) implies a in rr)
- `has-deriv-at-real-mul` — forall([hdr_], pos-rr(hdr_) implies forall([g, h, hdc_ in rr, hdx_, hdm_], restrict(h, ooint(hdx_ - hdr_, hdx_ + hdr_)) in fun(ooint(hdx_ - hdr_, hdx_ + hdr_), rr) implies forall([hbx_ in ooint(hdx_ - hdr_, hdx_ + hdr_)], h(hbx_) == hdc_ * g(hbx_)) implies has-deriv-at(g, hdx_, hdm_) implies has-deriv-at(h, hdx_, hdc_ * hdm_)))
- `has-deriv-at-shrink` — forall([f, a, icl_], has-deriv-at(f, a, icl_) implies forall([icr_], pos-rr(icr_) implies forsome([icw_], pos-rr(icw_) and icw_ <= icr_ and is-diff-on(rr-normed-field, ooint(a - icw_, a + icw_), restrict(f, ooint(a - icw_, a + icw_)), a, icl_))))
- `has-deriv-at-sum` — forall([icr_], pos-rr(icr_) implies forall([f, g, h, icx_, icl_, icm_], restrict(h, ooint(icx_ - icr_, icx_ + icr_)) in fun(ooint(icx_ - icr_, icx_ + icr_), rr) implies forall([hbx_ in ooint(icx_ - icr_, icx_ + icr_)], h(hbx_) == f(hbx_) + g(hbx_)) implies has-deriv-at(f, icx_, icl_) implies has-deriv-at(g, icx_, icm_) implies has-deriv-at(h, icx_, icl_ + icm_)))
- `has-deriv-at-to-within-ooint` — forall([f, osx_, osl_], has-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_) implies forall([osr_], pos-rr(osr_) implies forsome([osv_], pos-rr(osv_) and osv_ <= osr_ and has-deriv-at-within(f, ooint(osx_ - osv_, osx_ + osv_), osx_, osl_))))
- `has-deriv-at-unique` — forall([f, a, icl_, icm_], has-deriv-at(f, a, icl_) implies has-deriv-at(f, a, icm_) implies icl_ = icm_)
- `has-deriv-at-value-in-rr` — forall([f, hdx_, hdl_], has-deriv-at(f, hdx_, hdl_) implies f(hdx_) in rr)
- `has-dir-deriv-add` — forall([m, u, f, eta, xi, p, q, a], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies is-open(nvs-metric-space(m), u) implies f in fun(u, rr) implies eta in vec(m) implies xi in vec(m) implies forall([x in u], has-dir-deriv(m, f, x, eta, p(x))) implies forall([x in u], has-dir-deriv(m, f, x, xi, q(x))) implies a in u implies is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nvs-metric-space(m), u), rr-ms, p, a) implies is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nvs-metric-space(m), u), rr-ms, q, a) implies has-dir-deriv(m, f, a, (vadd(m))(eta, xi), p(a) + q(a)))
- `has-dir-deriv-scale` — forall([m, f, a, eta, k, dl], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies a in vec(m) implies eta in vec(m) implies k in rr implies has-dir-deriv(m, f, a, eta, dl) implies has-dir-deriv(m, f, a, (act(m))(k, eta), k * dl))
- `has-dir-deriv-shift` — forall([sm_, sf_, sb_, se_, st_, sl_], is-normed-vector-space(sm_) implies sb_ in vec(sm_) implies se_ in vec(sm_) implies st_ in rr implies has-dir-deriv(sm_, sf_, (vadd(sm_))(sb_, (act(sm_))(st_, se_)), se_, sl_) implies has-deriv-at(seg-curve(sm_, sf_, sb_, se_), st_, sl_))
- `has-dir-deriv-step` — forall([dm_, df_, db_, de_, dlam_, dll_, dc_], is-normed-vector-space(dm_) implies db_ in vec(dm_) implies de_ in vec(dm_) implies dlam_ in rr implies dll_ in rr implies dc_ in rr implies forall([tt_ in rr], abs(tt_) <= abs(dlam_) implies forsome([dd_], has-dir-deriv(dm_, df_, (vadd(dm_))(db_, (act(dm_))(tt_, de_)), de_, dd_) and abs(dd_ - dll_) <= dc_)) implies abs(df_((vadd(dm_))(db_, (act(dm_))(dlam_, de_))) - df_(db_) - dlam_ * dll_) <= dc_ * abs(dlam_))
- `has-finite-subcover-classes` — forall([s, c], has-finite-subcover(s, c) iff forsome([tpg_], tpg_ subset c and card(tpg_) in nn and big-union(tpv_, tpg_, tpv_) == pts(s)))
- `has-left-deriv-at-in-rr` — forall([f, osx_, osl_], has-left-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_) implies osl_ in rr)
- `has-left-deriv-at-intro` — forall([f, osx_, osl_, osr_], pos-rr(osr_) implies has-deriv-at-within(f, ocint(osx_ - osr_, osx_), osx_, osl_) implies has-left-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_))
- `has-left-deriv-at-local` — forall([osr_], pos-rr(osr_) implies forall([f, g, osx_, osl_], restrict(f, ocint(osx_ - osr_, osx_)) in fun(ocint(osx_ - osr_, osx_), rr) implies forall([osy_ in ocint(osx_ - osr_, osx_)], f(osy_) == g(osy_)) implies has-left-deriv-at(g, osx_, osl_) implies has-left-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_)))
- `has-left-deriv-at-pt-in-rr` — forall([f, osx_, osl_], has-left-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_) implies osx_ in rr)
- `has-left-deriv-at-shrink` — forall([f, osx_, osl_], has-left-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_) implies forall([osr_], pos-rr(osr_) implies forsome([osv_], pos-rr(osv_) and osv_ <= osr_ and has-deriv-at-within(f, ocint(osx_ - osv_, osx_), osx_, osl_))))
- `has-left-deriv-at-sum` — forall([osr_], pos-rr(osr_) implies forall([f, g, h, osx_, osl_, osm_], restrict(h, ocint(osx_ - osr_, osx_)) in fun(ocint(osx_ - osr_, osx_), rr) implies forall([osy_ in ocint(osx_ - osr_, osx_)], h(osy_) == f(osy_) + g(osy_)) implies has-left-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_) implies has-left-deriv-at(g, osx_, osm_) implies has-left-deriv-at(h, osx_, osl_ + osm_)))
- `has-left-deriv-at-unique` — forall([f, osx_, osl_, osm_], has-left-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_) implies has-left-deriv-at(f, osx_, osm_) implies osl_ = osm_)
- `has-right-deriv-at-in-rr` — forall([f, osx_, osl_], has-right-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_) implies osl_ in rr)
- `has-right-deriv-at-intro` — forall([f, osx_, osl_, osr_], pos-rr(osr_) implies has-deriv-at-within(f, coint(osx_, osx_ + osr_), osx_, osl_) implies has-right-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_))
- `has-right-deriv-at-local` — forall([osr_], pos-rr(osr_) implies forall([f, g, osx_, osl_], restrict(f, coint(osx_, osx_ + osr_)) in fun(coint(osx_, osx_ + osr_), rr) implies forall([osy_ in coint(osx_, osx_ + osr_)], f(osy_) == g(osy_)) implies has-right-deriv-at(g, osx_, osl_) implies has-right-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_)))
- `has-right-deriv-at-pt-in-rr` — forall([f, osx_, osl_], has-right-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_) implies osx_ in rr)
- `has-right-deriv-at-shrink` — forall([f, osx_, osl_], has-right-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_) implies forall([osr_], pos-rr(osr_) implies forsome([osv_], pos-rr(osv_) and osv_ <= osr_ and has-deriv-at-within(f, coint(osx_, osx_ + osv_), osx_, osl_))))
- `has-right-deriv-at-sum` — forall([osr_], pos-rr(osr_) implies forall([f, g, h, osx_, osl_, osm_], restrict(h, coint(osx_, osx_ + osr_)) in fun(coint(osx_, osx_ + osr_), rr) implies forall([osy_ in coint(osx_, osx_ + osr_)], h(osy_) == f(osy_) + g(osy_)) implies has-right-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_) implies has-right-deriv-at(g, osx_, osm_) implies has-right-deriv-at(h, osx_, osl_ + osm_)))
- `has-right-deriv-at-unique` — forall([f, osx_, osl_, osm_], has-right-deriv-at(f, osx_, osl_) implies has-right-deriv-at(f, osx_, osm_) implies osl_ = osm_)
- `hausdorff-compare` — forall([m, m1, c, lam, es], is-metric-space(m) implies is-metric-space(m1) implies pts(m1) = pts(m) implies c in rr implies 0 < c implies forall([x in pts(m), y in pts(m)], (dist(m))(x, y) <= c * (dist(m1))(x, y)) implies lam in rr implies 0 < lam implies es in power(pts(m)) implies (hausdorff(m, lam))(es) <= etimes(epow(c, lam), (hausdorff(m1, lam))(es)))
- `hausdorff-delta-below` — forall([m, d, rho, lam, es], is-metric-space(m) implies pos-rr(d) implies rho in rr implies 0 < rho implies lam in rr implies rho < lam implies es in power(pts(m)) implies etimes(rpow-star(d, rho - lam), (method-ii-delta(m, power(pts(m)), hausdorff-pm(m, lam), d))(es)) <= (method-ii-delta(m, power(pts(m)), hausdorff-pm(m, rho), d))(es))
- `hausdorff-dim-local` — forall([m, r, lam], is-separable(m) implies pos-rr(r) implies forsome([mhx_], mhx_ in pts(m)) implies forall([x in pts(m)], is-hausdorff-dim(m, ball(m, x, r), lam)) implies is-hausdorff-dim(m, pts(m), lam))
- `hausdorff-dim-not-lt` — forall([m, es, l1, l2], is-hausdorff-dim(m, es, l1) implies is-hausdorff-dim(m, es, l2) implies not(l1 < l2))
- `hausdorff-dim-unique` — forall([m, es, l1, l2], is-hausdorff-dim(m, es, l1) implies is-hausdorff-dim(m, es, l2) implies l1 = l2)
- `hausdorff-metric-outer-measure` — forall([m, lam], is-metric-space(m) implies lam in rr implies 0 < lam implies is-metric-outer-measure(m, hausdorff(m, lam)))
- `hausdorff-phi-compare` — forall([m, m1, c, phi], is-metric-space(m) implies is-metric-space(m1) implies pts(m1) = pts(m) implies c in rr implies 0 < c implies forall([x in pts(m), y in pts(m)], (dist(m))(x, y) <= c * (dist(m1))(x, y)) implies is-doubling(phi) implies forsome([mhk_], pos-rr(mhk_) and forall([es in power(pts(m))], (hausdorff-phi(m, phi))(es) <= etimes(mhk_, (hausdorff-phi(m1, phi))(es)))))
- `hausdorff-phi-subspace` — forall([m, ys, phi, es], is-metric-space(m) implies is-doubling(phi) implies ys subset pts(m) implies es subset ys implies (hausdorff-phi(subspace-ms(m, ys), phi))(es) = (hausdorff-phi(m, phi))(es))
- `hausdorff-pm-premeasure` — forall([m, lam], is-metric-space(m) implies lam in rr implies 0 < lam implies is-premeasure(pts(m), power(pts(m)), hausdorff-pm(m, lam)))
- `hausdorff-pm-value` — forall([m, lam, a in power(pts(m))], (hausdorff-pm(m, lam))(a) == epow(diam(m, a), lam))
- `hausdorff-positive-infinite` — forall([m, lam, rho, es], is-metric-space(m) implies lam in rr implies rho in rr implies 0 < rho implies rho < lam implies es in power(pts(m)) implies 0 < (hausdorff(m, lam))(es) implies (hausdorff(m, rho))(es) = pos-inf)
- `hausdorff-scale-pos` — forall([m, lam, es], is-metric-space(m) implies lam in rr implies 0 < lam implies es in power(pts(m)) implies 0 < (hausdorff(m, lam))(es) implies forsome([mhd_], pos-rr(mhd_) and not((method-ii-delta(m, power(pts(m)), hausdorff-pm(m, lam), mhd_))(es) = 0)))

- `hom-ring-pre-type` — forall([a, b, c, k], is-ring(b) implies k in hom-ring(c, a) implies vnb-lambda(hmpf_, hom-ring(a, b), compose(hmpf_, k)) in fun(hom-ring(a, b), hom-ring(c, b)))
- `hom-ringoid-compose` — forall([a, b, c, f, g], is-hom-ringoid(a, b, f) implies is-hom-ringoid(b, c, g) implies is-hom-ringoid(a, c, compose(g, f)))
- `hom-ringoid-id` — forall([a], is-ringoid(a) implies is-hom-ringoid(a, a, id-fun(carr(a))))
- `hom-ringoid-in-set` — forall([a, b], is-ringoid(a) implies is-ringoid(b) implies hom-ringoid(a, b) in set)
- `hom-ringoid-member-iff` — forall([a, b, f], f in hom-ringoid(a, b) iff f in fun(carr(a), carr(b)) and is-hom-ringoid(a, b, f))
- `hom-ringoid-post-type` — forall([a, b, c, h], is-ringoid(a) implies h in hom-ringoid(b, c) implies vnb-lambda(hmpf_, hom-ringoid(a, b), compose(h, hmpf_)) in fun(hom-ringoid(a, b), hom-ringoid(a, c)))
- `hom-ringoid-pre-type` — forall([a, b, c, k], is-ringoid(b) implies k in hom-ringoid(c, a) implies vnb-lambda(hmpf_, hom-ringoid(a, b), compose(hmpf_, k)) in fun(hom-ringoid(a, b), hom-ringoid(c, b)))
- `hom-semigroup-compose` — forall([a, b, c, f, g], is-hom-semigroup(a, b, f) implies is-hom-semigroup(b, c, g) implies is-hom-semigroup(a, c, compose(g, f)))
- `hom-semigroup-id` — forall([a], is-semigroup(a) implies is-hom-semigroup(a, a, id-fun(carr(a))))
- `hom-semigroup-in-set` — forall([a, b], is-semigroup(a) implies is-semigroup(b) implies hom-semigroup(a, b) in set)
- `hom-semigroup-member-iff` — forall([a, b, f], f in hom-semigroup(a, b) iff f in fun(carr(a), carr(b)) and is-hom-semigroup(a, b, f))
- `hom-semigroup-post-type` — forall([a, b, c, h], is-semigroup(a) implies h in hom-semigroup(b, c) implies vnb-lambda(hmpf_, hom-semigroup(a, b), compose(h, hmpf_)) in fun(hom-semigroup(a, b), hom-semigroup(a, c)))
- `hom-semigroup-pre-type` — forall([a, b, c, k], is-semigroup(b) implies k in hom-semigroup(c, a) implies vnb-lambda(hmpf_, hom-semigroup(a, b), compose(hmpf_, k)) in fun(hom-semigroup(a, b), hom-semigroup(c, b)))
- `hom-setoid-compose` — forall([a, b, c, f, g], is-hom-setoid(a, b, f) implies is-hom-setoid(b, c, g) implies is-hom-setoid(a, c, compose(g, f)))
- `hom-setoid-id` — forall([a], is-setoid(a) implies is-hom-setoid(a, a, id-fun(pts(a))))
- `hom-setoid-in-set` — forall([a, b], is-setoid(a) implies is-setoid(b) implies hom-setoid(a, b) in set)
- `hom-setoid-member-iff` — forall([a, b, f], f in hom-setoid(a, b) iff f in fun(pts(a), pts(b)) and is-hom-setoid(a, b, f))
- `hom-setoid-post-type` — forall([a, b, c, h], is-setoid(a) implies h in hom-setoid(b, c) implies vnb-lambda(hmpf_, hom-setoid(a, b), compose(h, hmpf_)) in fun(hom-setoid(a, b), hom-setoid(a, c)))
- `hom-setoid-pre-type` — forall([a, b, c, k], is-setoid(b) implies k in hom-setoid(c, a) implies vnb-lambda(hmpf_, hom-setoid(a, b), compose(hmpf_, k)) in fun(hom-setoid(a, b), hom-setoid(c, b)))
- `hom-spectral-radius-le` — forall([a, b, f], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies is-unital-banach-algebra(b) implies is-alg-hom(a, b, f) implies forall([x in vec(a)], spectral-radius(b, f(x)) <= spectral-radius(a, x)))
- `hom-sum-ag` — forall([n in nn, md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies forall([g], forall([gbi_ in ord-segment(n)], g(gbi_) in vec(md)) implies tt(sum-ag(module-vector-ag(md), g, n)) = sum-ag(module-vector-ag(md), vnb-lambda(gti_, nn, tt(g(gti_))), n)))
- `hom-top-space-compose` — forall([s, t, w, f, g], is-hom-top-space(s, t, f) implies is-hom-top-space(t, w, g) implies is-hom-top-space(s, w, compose(g, f)))
- `hom-top-space-id` — forall([s], is-top-space(s) implies is-hom-top-space(s, s, id-fun(pts(s))))
- `hom-top-space-in-set` — forall([a, b], is-top-space(a) implies is-top-space(b) implies hom-top-space(a, b) in set)
- `hom-top-space-member-iff` — forall([a, b, f], f in hom-top-space(a, b) iff f in fun(pts(a), pts(b)) and is-hom-top-space(a, b, f))
- `hom-top-space-post-type` — forall([a, b, c, h], is-top-space(a) implies h in hom-top-space(b, c) implies vnb-lambda(hmpf_, hom-top-space(a, b), compose(h, hmpf_)) in fun(hom-top-space(a, b), hom-top-space(a, c)))
- `hom-top-space-pre-type` — forall([a, b, c, k], is-top-space(b) implies k in hom-top-space(c, a) implies vnb-lambda(hmpf_, hom-top-space(a, b), compose(hmpf_, k)) in fun(hom-top-space(a, b), hom-top-space(c, b)))
- `hom-top-space-ptwise-eq` — forall([s, t, g, h], is-hom-top-space(s, t, g) implies h in fun(pts(s), pts(t)) implies forall([tpq_ in pts(s)], h(tpq_) = g(tpq_)) implies is-hom-top-space(s, t, h))
- `hom-uniformly-continuous-compose` — forall([a, b, c, f, g], is-uniformly-continuous-arrow(a, b, f) implies is-uniformly-continuous-arrow(b, c, g) implies is-uniformly-continuous-arrow(a, c, compose(g, f)))
- `hom-uniformly-continuous-id` — forall([a], is-metric-space(a) implies is-uniformly-continuous-arrow(a, a, id-fun(pts(a))))
- `hom-uniformly-continuous-in-set` — forall([a, b], is-metric-space(a) implies is-metric-space(b) implies hom-uniformly-continuous(a, b) in set)
- `hom-uniformly-continuous-member-iff` — forall([a, b, f], f in hom-uniformly-continuous(a, b) iff f in fun(pts(a), pts(b)) and is-uniformly-continuous-arrow(a, b, f))
- `hom-uniformly-continuous-post-type` — forall([a, b, c, h], is-metric-space(a) implies h in hom-uniformly-continuous(b, c) implies vnb-lambda(hmpf_, hom-uniformly-continuous(a, b), compose(h, hmpf_)) in fun(hom-uniformly-continuous(a, b), hom-uniformly-continuous(a, c)))
- `hom-uniformly-continuous-pre-type` — forall([a, b, c, k], is-metric-space(b) implies k in hom-uniformly-continuous(c, a) implies vnb-lambda(hmpf_, hom-uniformly-continuous(a, b), compose(hmpf_, k)) in fun(hom-uniformly-continuous(a, b), hom-uniformly-continuous(c, b)))
- `hom-uniformly-continuous-subset-hom-continuous` — forall([a, b], is-metric-space(a) implies is-metric-space(b) implies hom-uniformly-continuous(a, b) subset hom-continuous(a, b))
- `hom-vector-space-compose` — forall([a, b, c, f, g], is-hom-vector-space(a, b, f) implies is-hom-vector-space(b, c, g) implies is-hom-vector-space(a, c, compose(g, f)))
- `hom-vector-space-id` — forall([a], is-vector-space(a) implies is-hom-vector-space(a, a, id-fun(vec(a))))
- `hom-vector-space-in-set` — forall([a, b], is-vector-space(a) implies is-vector-space(b) implies hom-vector-space(a, b) in set)
- `hom-vector-space-member-iff` — forall([a, b, f], f in hom-vector-space(a, b) iff f in fun(vec(a), vec(b)) and is-hom-vector-space(a, b, f))
- `hom-vector-space-post-type` — forall([a, b, c, h], is-vector-space(a) implies h in hom-vector-space(b, c) implies vnb-lambda(hmpf_, hom-vector-space(a, b), compose(h, hmpf_)) in fun(hom-vector-space(a, b), hom-vector-space(a, c)))
- `hom-vector-space-pre-type` — forall([a, b, c, k], is-vector-space(b) implies k in hom-vector-space(c, a) implies vnb-lambda(hmpf_, hom-vector-space(a, b), compose(hmpf_, k)) in fun(hom-vector-space(a, b), hom-vector-space(c, b)))
- `homog-elem-nonneg` — forall([m, p, x, r], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies is-convex-functional(m, p) implies x in vec(m) implies r in homog-set(m, p, x) implies 0 <= r)
- `homog-inf-le-p` — forall([m, p, x], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies is-convex-functional(m, p) implies x in vec(m) implies inf(homog-set(m, p, x)) <= p(x))
- `homog-inf-nonneg` — forall([m, p, x], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies is-convex-functional(m, p) implies x in vec(m) implies 0 <= inf(homog-set(m, p, x)))
- `homog-inf-scale` — forall([m, p, x, c], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies is-convex-functional(m, p) implies x in vec(m) implies c in rr implies 0 < c implies inf(homog-set(m, p, (act(m))(c, x))) = c * inf(homog-set(m, p, x)))
- `homog-inf-subadditive` — forall([m, p, x, y], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies is-convex-functional(m, p) implies x in vec(m) implies y in vec(m) implies inf(homog-set(m, p, (vadd(m))(x, y))) <= inf(homog-set(m, p, x)) + inf(homog-set(m, p, y)))
- `homog-inf-zero` — forall([m, p], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies is-convex-functional(m, p) implies inf(homog-set(m, p, vzero(m))) = 0)
- `homog-minorant-dominates` — forall([m, p, s, f, z], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies is-convex-functional(m, p) implies is-submodule(m, s) implies is-linear-functional-on(m, s, f) implies forall([dmz_ in s], f(dmz_) <= p(dmz_)) implies z in s implies f(z) <= inf(homog-set(m, p, z)))
- `homog-minorant-sublinear` — forall([m, p], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies is-convex-functional(m, p) implies is-sublinear(m, homog-minorant(m, p)))
- `homog-p-in-set` — forall([m, p, x], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies is-convex-functional(m, p) implies x in vec(m) implies p(x) in homog-set(m, p, x))
- `homog-point-at-inf` — forall([u in cc], homog-point(u, 0) = cc-inf)
- `homog-point-cover` — forall([w in cc-hat], forsome([u in cc, v in cc], not(u = 0 and v = 0) and w = homog-point(u, v)))
- `homog-point-finite` — forall([u in cc, v in cc], not(v = 0) implies homog-point(u, v) = u * recip(v))
- `homog-point-in-cc-hat` — forall([u in cc, v in cc], homog-point(u, v) in cc-hat)
- `homog-point-scale` — forall([u in cc, v in cc, k in cc], not(k = 0) implies homog-point(k * u, k * v) = homog-point(u, v))
- `homog-point-sphere-eq` — forall([a in cc, b in cc, c in cc, d in cc], magnitude(a) * magnitude(a) + magnitude(b) * magnitude(b) = 1 implies magnitude(c) * magnitude(c) + magnitude(d) * magnitude(d) = 1 implies homog-point(a, b) = homog-point(c, d) implies forsome([hr_ in cc], magnitude(hr_) = 1 and c = hr_ * a and d = hr_ * b))
- `homog-set-elim` — forall([m, p, x, r in homog-set(m, p, x)], r in rr and forsome([hmt_ in rr], 0 < hmt_ and p((act(m))(hmt_, x)) <= hmt_ * r))
- `homog-set-glb` — forall([m, p, z], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies is-convex-functional(m, p) implies z in vec(m) implies inf(homog-set(m, p, z)) in rr and forall([lbw_ in homog-set(m, p, z)], inf(homog-set(m, p, z)) <= lbw_) and forall([lbb_ in rr], forall([lbw_ in homog-set(m, p, z)], lbb_ <= lbw_) implies lbb_ <= inf(homog-set(m, p, z))))
- `homog-set-intro` — forall([m, p, x, r, t], r in rr implies t in rr implies 0 < t implies p((act(m))(t, x)) <= t * r implies r in homog-set(m, p, x))
- `homog-set-scale` — forall([m, p, x, c, r], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies is-convex-functional(m, p) implies x in vec(m) implies c in rr implies 0 < c implies r in homog-set(m, p, x) implies c * r in homog-set(m, p, (act(m))(c, x)))
- `homog-set-sum` — forall([m, p, x, y, r, r2], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies is-convex-functional(m, p) implies x in vec(m) implies y in vec(m) implies r in homog-set(m, p, x) implies r2 in homog-set(m, p, y) implies r + r2 in homog-set(m, p, (vadd(m))(x, y)))
- `homog-set-unfold` — forall([m, p, x], homog-set(m, p, x) == {hmr_ in rr: forsome([hmt_ in rr], 0 < hmt_ and p((act(m))(hmt_, x)) <= hmt_ * hmr_)})
- `homog-set-unscale` — forall([m, p, x, c, r], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies is-convex-functional(m, p) implies x in vec(m) implies c in rr implies 0 < c implies r in homog-set(m, p, (act(m))(c, x)) implies recip(c) * r in homog-set(m, p, x))
- `homog-set-zero` — forall([m, p, r], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies is-convex-functional(m, p) implies r in rr implies 0 < r implies r in homog-set(m, p, vzero(m)))
- `homog-value` — forall([m, p, z in vec(m)], (homog-minorant(m, p))(z) == inf(homog-set(m, p, z)))
- `homotopic-refl` — forall([u, pgam, a, b], is-path(pgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies homotopic(u, pgam, pgam, a, b))
- `homotopic-sym` — forall([u, pgam, prho, a, b], homotopic(u, pgam, prho, a, b) implies homotopic(u, prho, pgam, a, b))
- `homotopic-traces` — forall([u, pgam, prho, a, b], homotopic(u, pgam, prho, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u and trace(prho, a, b) subset u)
- `homotopic-trans` — forall([u, pgam, prho, pq, a, b], homotopic(u, pgam, prho, a, b) implies homotopic(u, prho, pq, a, b) implies homotopic(u, pgam, pq, a, b))
- `homotopy-chain-line-int` — forall([chq_ in nn, u, f, pgam, dgam, a, b, chm_, chn_, chtq_, chxq_], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies chn_ in nn implies forall([chj_ in nn], chj_ <= succ(chn_) implies is-road(poly-road(chtq_, chxq_(chj_), chm_), poly-der(chtq_, chxq_(chj_), chm_), a, b)) implies good-approx(u, pgam, poly-road(chtq_, chxq_(0), chm_), a, b) implies forall([chj_ in nn], chj_ <= chn_ implies good-approx(u, poly-road(chtq_, chxq_(chj_), chm_), poly-road(chtq_, chxq_(succ(chj_)), chm_), a, b)) implies chq_ <= succ(chn_) implies line-int(f, poly-road(chtq_, chxq_(chq_), chm_), poly-der(chtq_, chxq_(chq_), chm_), a, b) = line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b))
- `homotopy-line-int` — forall([u, f, pgam, dgam, prho, drho, a, b], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies holomorphic-on(u, f) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies is-road(prho, drho, a, b) implies homotopic(u, pgam, prho, a, b) implies line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b) = line-int(f, prho, drho, a, b))
- `homotopy-polygon-chain` — forall([u, pgam, prho, a, b], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies homotopic(u, pgam, prho, a, b) implies forsome([chm_ in nn, chn_ in nn, chtq_ in fun(nn, rr), chxq_ in fun(nn, fun(nn, cc))], forall([chj_ in nn], chj_ <= succ(chn_) implies is-road(poly-road(chtq_, chxq_(chj_), chm_), poly-der(chtq_, chxq_(chj_), chm_), a, b)) and good-approx(u, pgam, poly-road(chtq_, chxq_(0), chm_), a, b) and forall([chj_ in nn], chj_ <= chn_ implies good-approx(u, poly-road(chtq_, chxq_(chj_), chm_), poly-road(chtq_, chxq_(succ(chj_)), chm_), a, b)) and good-approx(u, prho, poly-road(chtq_, chxq_(succ(chn_)), chm_), a, b)))
- `homotopy-winding` — forall([z, pgam, dgam, prho, drho, a, b], z in cc implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies is-road(prho, drho, a, b) implies homotopic(difference(cc, singleton(z)), pgam, prho, a, b) implies winding(pgam, dgam, a, b, z) = winding(prho, drho, a, b, z))
- `hopf-coords-continuous` — forall([s, u1, u2, x], is-continuous-at(s, cc-ms, u1, x) implies is-continuous-at(s, cc-ms, u2, x) implies is-continuous-at(s, cc-ms, vnb-lambda(hcz_, pts(s), 2 * (u1(hcz_) * conjugate(u2(hcz_)))), x) and is-continuous-at(s, rr-ms, vnb-lambda(hcz_, pts(s), magnitude(u1(hcz_)) * magnitude(u1(hcz_)) - magnitude(u2(hcz_)) * magnitude(u2(hcz_))), x))
- `hopf-factors-through-bijection` — forsome([g in fun(unit-sphere-cr, cc-hat)], g in bijection(unit-sphere-cr, cc-hat) and forall([u in cc2-sphere], g(hopf-map(u)) = homog-point(nth(1, u), nth(2, u))))
- `hopf-fibre-equiv` — forall([u in cc2-sphere, v in cc2-sphere], hopf-map(u) = hopf-map(v) iff homog-equiv(u, v))
- `hopf-fibre-iff` — forall([u in cc2-sphere, v in cc2-sphere], hopf-map(u) = hopf-map(v) iff forsome([hr_ in cc], magnitude(hr_) = 1 and v = [hr_ * nth(1, u), hr_ * nth(2, u)]))
- `hopf-fibre-pair` — forall([a in cc, b in cc, c in cc, d in cc], magnitude(a) * magnitude(a) + magnitude(b) * magnitude(b) = 1 implies magnitude(c) * magnitude(c) + magnitude(d) * magnitude(d) = 1 implies 2 * (a * conjugate(b)) = 2 * (c * conjugate(d)) implies magnitude(a) * magnitude(a) - magnitude(b) * magnitude(b) = magnitude(c) * magnitude(c) - magnitude(d) * magnitude(d) implies forsome([hr_ in cc], magnitude(hr_) = 1 and c = hr_ * a and d = hr_ * b))
- `hopf-magnitude-first` — forall([a in cc, b in cc], magnitude(2 * (a * conjugate(b))) = 2 * (magnitude(a) * magnitude(b)))
- `hopf-map-continuous` — forall([s, u1, u2, x], is-continuous-at(s, cc-ms, u1, x) implies is-continuous-at(s, cc-ms, u2, x) implies is-continuous-at(s, cc-ms, vnb-lambda(hcz_, pts(s), nth(1, hopf-map([u1(hcz_), u2(hcz_)]))), x) and is-continuous-at(s, rr-ms, vnb-lambda(hcz_, pts(s), nth(2, hopf-map([u1(hcz_), u2(hcz_)]))), x))
- `hopf-map-continuous-at-product` — forall([p2hw_ in cartesian(cc, cc)], is-continuous-at(product2-ms(cc-ms, cc-ms), product2-ms(cc-ms, rr-ms), vnb-lambda(p2hv_, cartesian(cc, cc), hopf-map(p2hv_)), p2hw_))
- `hopf-map-continuous-product` — is-continuous(product2-ms(cc-ms, cc-ms), product2-ms(cc-ms, rr-ms), vnb-lambda(p2hv_, cartesian(cc, cc), hopf-map(p2hv_)))
- `hopf-map-in-cr` — forall([w in cartesian(cc, cc)], hopf-map(w) in cartesian(cc, rr))
- `hopf-map-pair` — forall([a in cc, b in cc], hopf-map([a, b]) = [2 * (a * conjugate(b)), magnitude(a) * magnitude(a) - magnitude(b) * magnitude(b)])
- `hopf-map-unimodular-scale` — forall([r in cc, a in cc, b in cc], magnitude(r) = 1 implies hopf-map([r * a, r * b]) = hopf-map([a, b]))
- `hopf-maps-sphere` — forall([w in cc2-sphere], hopf-map(w) in unit-sphere-cr)
- `hopf-norm-identity` — forall([a in cc, b in cc], magnitude(2 * (a * conjugate(b))) * magnitude(2 * (a * conjugate(b))) + (magnitude(a) * magnitude(a) - magnitude(b) * magnitude(b)) * (magnitude(a) * magnitude(a) - magnitude(b) * magnitude(b)) = (magnitude(a) * magnitude(a) + magnitude(b) * magnitude(b)) * (magnitude(a) * magnitude(a) + magnitude(b) * magnitude(b)))
- `hopf-norm-identity-point` — forall([w in cartesian(cc, cc)], magnitude(nth(1, hopf-map(w))) * magnitude(nth(1, hopf-map(w))) + nth(2, hopf-map(w)) * nth(2, hopf-map(w)) = (magnitude(nth(1, w)) * magnitude(nth(1, w)) + magnitude(nth(2, w)) * magnitude(nth(2, w))) * (magnitude(nth(1, w)) * magnitude(nth(1, w)) + magnitude(nth(2, w)) * magnitude(nth(2, w))))
- `hopf-onto-sphere` — forall([p in unit-sphere-cr], forsome([w in cc2-sphere], hopf-map(w) = p))
- `hopf-pair-in-cr` — forall([a in cc, b in cc], [2 * (a * conjugate(b)), magnitude(a) * magnitude(a) - magnitude(b) * magnitude(b)] in cartesian(cc, rr))
- `hopf-quotient-factor` — forall([u in cc2-sphere], hopf-quotient-map(hopf-map(u)) = homog-point(nth(1, u), nth(2, u)))
- `hopf-quotient-map-apply` — forall([p in unit-sphere-cr], hopf-quotient-map(p) = homog-point(nth(1, p), 1 - nth(2, p)))

- `hs-ip-family-conj` — forall([v, w], is-hilbert-space(v) implies is-hilbert-space(w) implies forall([s_, t_], is-hilbert-schmidt(v, w, s_) implies is-hilbert-schmidt(v, w, t_) implies forall([ix, e], is-orthonormal-basis(v, ix, e) implies cc-family-sum(vnb-lambda(kqk_, ix, (ip(w))(t_(e(kqk_)), s_(e(kqk_))))) = conjugate(cc-family-sum(vnb-lambda(kqk_, ix, (ip(w))(s_(e(kqk_)), t_(e(kqk_)))))))))
- `hs-ip-family-sums` — forall([v, w], is-hilbert-space(v) implies is-hilbert-space(w) implies forall([s_, t_], is-hilbert-schmidt(v, w, s_) implies is-hilbert-schmidt(v, w, t_) implies forall([ix, e], is-orthonormal-basis(v, ix, e) implies cc-family-sum(vnb-lambda(kqk_, ix, (ip(w))(s_(e(kqk_)), t_(e(kqk_))))) in cc and sums-to(cc-nag, vnb-lambda(kqk_, ix, (ip(w))(s_(e(kqk_)), t_(e(kqk_)))), cc-family-sum(vnb-lambda(kqk_, ix, (ip(w))(s_(e(kqk_)), t_(e(kqk_)))))))))
- `hs-ip-homog-left` — forall([v, w], is-hilbert-space(v) implies is-hilbert-space(w) implies forall([c_, s_, t_], c_ in cc implies is-hilbert-schmidt(v, w, s_) implies is-hilbert-schmidt(v, w, t_) implies hs-ip(v, w, bop-scale(v, w, c_, s_), t_) = c_ * hs-ip(v, w, s_, t_)))

- `hs-ip-unfold` — forall([kqv_, kqw_, kqu_, kqt_], hs-ip(kqv_, kqw_, kqu_, kqt_) == cc-family-sum(vnb-lambda(kqe_, canon-onb(kqv_), (ip(kqw_))(kqu_(kqe_), kqt_(kqe_)))))

- `hs-scale` — forall([v, w], is-hilbert-space(v) implies is-hilbert-space(w) implies forall([c_, t_], c_ in cc implies is-hilbert-schmidt(v, w, t_) implies is-hilbert-schmidt(v, w, bop-scale(v, w, c_, t_))))
- `hs-sum-add-le` — forall([v, w], is-hilbert-space(v) implies is-hilbert-space(w) implies forall([s_, t_], s_ in bounded-ops(v, w) implies t_ in bounded-ops(v, w) implies forall([ix, e], is-orthonormal-basis(v, ix, e) implies hs-sum(v, w, ix, e, bop-sum(v, w, s_, t_)) <= eplus(etimes(2, hs-sum(v, w, ix, e, s_)), etimes(2, hs-sum(v, w, ix, e, t_))))))
- `hs-sum-adjoint` — forall([v, w], is-hilbert-space(v) implies is-hilbert-space(w) implies forall([t_ in bounded-ops(v, w), ix, e], is-orthonormal-basis(v, ix, e) implies forall([jx, f], is-orthonormal-basis(w, jx, f) implies esum(vnb-lambda(kqk_, ix, ip-norm(w, t_(e(kqk_))) * ip-norm(w, t_(e(kqk_))))) = esum(vnb-lambda(kqk_, jx, ip-norm(v, (op-adjoint(v, w, t_))(f(kqk_))) * ip-norm(v, (op-adjoint(v, w, t_))(f(kqk_))))))))
- `hs-sum-adjoint-eq` — forall([v, w], is-hilbert-space(v) implies is-hilbert-space(w) implies forall([t_ in bounded-ops(v, w), ix, e], is-orthonormal-basis(v, ix, e) implies forall([jx, f], is-orthonormal-basis(w, jx, f) implies hs-sum(w, v, jx, f, op-adjoint(v, w, t_)) = hs-sum(v, w, ix, e, t_))))

- `hs-sum-comp-left` — forall([v], is-hilbert-space(v) implies forall([s_, t_], s_ in bounded-ops(v, v) implies t_ in bounded-ops(v, v) implies forall([ix, e], is-orthonormal-basis(v, ix, e) implies hs-sum(v, v, ix, e, bop-comp(v, s_, t_)) <= etimes(opnorm(v, v, s_) * opnorm(v, v, s_), hs-sum(v, v, ix, e, t_)))))

- `hs-sum-in-rps` — forall([v, w], is-hilbert-space(v) implies is-hilbert-space(w) implies forall([t_ in bounded-ops(v, w), ix, e], is-orthonormal-basis(v, ix, e) implies hs-sum(v, w, ix, e, t_) in rr-pos-star))
- `hs-sum-polar` — forall([v, w], is-hilbert-space(v) implies is-hilbert-space(w) implies forall([s_, t_], is-hilbert-schmidt(v, w, s_) implies is-hilbert-schmidt(v, w, t_) implies forall([c_ in cc, ix, e], is-orthonormal-basis(v, ix, e) implies hs-sum(v, w, ix, e, bop-sum(v, w, s_, bop-scale(v, w, c_, t_))) = (hs-sum(v, w, ix, e, s_) + conjugate(c_) * cc-family-sum(vnb-lambda(kqk_, ix, (ip(w))(s_(e(kqk_)), t_(e(kqk_)))))) + (c_ * conjugate(cc-family-sum(vnb-lambda(kqk_, ix, (ip(w))(s_(e(kqk_)), t_(e(kqk_)))))) + (c_ * conjugate(c_)) * hs-sum(v, w, ix, e, t_)))))

- `hs-sum-trunc-tail` — forall([v, w, ix, e, t_, fq_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies is-complex-inner-product-space(w) implies is-orthonormal-family(v, ix, e) implies t_ in bounded-ops(v, w) implies fq_ in set implies card(fq_) in nn implies fq_ subset ix implies hs-sum(v, w, ix, e, bop-sum(v, w, t_, bop-neg(v, w, finsum(normed-ag-as-abelian-group(bop-normed-ag(v, w)), vnb-lambda(tbk_, fq_, rank-one-op(v, w, e(tbk_), t_(e(tbk_)))), fq_)))) = esum(vnb-lambda(tlz_, ix, if(tlz_ in fq_, 0, (vnb-lambda(kqk_, ix, ip-norm(w, t_(e(kqk_))) * ip-norm(w, t_(e(kqk_)))))(tlz_)))))

- `hs-vector-bound` — forall([v, w], is-hilbert-space(v) implies is-hilbert-space(w) implies forall([t_ in bounded-ops(v, w), ix, e], is-orthonormal-basis(v, ix, e) implies forall([jx, f], is-orthonormal-basis(w, jx, f) implies forall([tbx_ in vec(v)], ip-norm(w, t_(tbx_)) * ip-norm(w, t_(tbx_)) <= etimes(ip-norm(v, tbx_) * ip-norm(v, tbx_), hs-sum(v, w, ix, e, t_))))))

- `hsum-diag-adjoint` — forall([w, v, a_, b_], is-hilbert-space(w) implies is-hilbert-space(v) implies a_ in bounded-ops(w, w) implies b_ in bounded-ops(v, v) implies op-adjoint(hsum(w, v), hsum(w, v), hsum-diag(w, v, a_, b_)) = hsum-diag(w, v, op-adjoint(w, w, a_), op-adjoint(v, v, b_)))

- `hsum-in1-apply` — forall([w, v, x_], is-complex-inner-product-space(w) implies is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies x_ in vec(w) implies (hsum-in1(w, v))(x_) = [x_, vzero(v)])

- `lfts-in-fun` — forall([f in lfts], f in fun(cc-hat, cc-hat))

- `lfts-inverse-in` — forall([f in lfts], inverse-bij(f, cc-hat, cc-hat) in lfts)
- `limit-along-at-point` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([t, a, f], a subset pts(s) implies is-uniformly-continuous(subspace-ms(s, a), t, f) implies forall([x in a], is-limit-along(s, t, a, f, x, f(x)))))
- `limit-along-exists` — forall([s, t, a, f], is-complete(t) implies is-dense(s, a) implies is-uniformly-continuous(subspace-ms(s, a), t, f) implies forall([x in pts(s)], forsome([y], is-limit-along(s, t, a, f, x, y))))
- `limit-along-of-continuous-at` — forall([s, t, h, x], is-continuous-at(s, t, h, x) implies forall([a, f], a subset pts(s) implies forall([z in a], h(z) = f(z)) implies is-limit-along(s, t, a, f, x, h(x))))

- `limit-form-add-left` — forall([md, fq, f, g, h], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-inner-product-form(md, fq) implies f in form-cseq(md, fq) implies g in form-cseq(md, fq) implies h in form-cseq(md, fq) implies (limit-form(md, fq))(seq-vadd(md, f, g), h) = (limit-form(md, fq))(f, h) + (limit-form(md, fq))(g, h))
- `limit-form-conj-sym` — forall([md, fq, f, g], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-inner-product-form(md, fq) implies f in form-cseq(md, fq) implies g in form-cseq(md, fq) implies (limit-form(md, fq))(g, f) = conjugate((limit-form(md, fq))(f, g)))
- `limit-form-diag` — forall([md, fq, f], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-inner-product-form(md, fq) implies f in form-cseq(md, fq) implies (limit-form(md, fq))(f, f) in rr and 0 <= (limit-form(md, fq))(f, f))
- `limit-form-embed` — forall([md, fq, x_, y_], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-inner-product-form(md, fq) implies x_ in vec(md) implies y_ in vec(md) implies (limit-form(md, fq))(embed-seq(form-ms(md, fq), x_), embed-seq(form-ms(md, fq), y_)) = fq(x_, y_))
- `limit-form-homog-left` — forall([md, fq, a_, f, h], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-inner-product-form(md, fq) implies a_ in cc implies f in form-cseq(md, fq) implies h in form-cseq(md, fq) implies (limit-form(md, fq))(seq-act(md, a_, f), h) = a_ * (limit-form(md, fq))(f, h))
- `limit-form-iota` — forall([md, fq, f, g], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-inner-product-form(md, fq) implies f in form-cseq(md, fq) implies g in form-cseq(md, fq) implies iota(hcc_, hcc_ in cc and converges-to(cc-ms, seq-form(fq, f, g), hcc_)) in cc and converges-to(cc-ms, seq-form(fq, f, g), iota(hcc_, hcc_ in cc and converges-to(cc-ms, seq-form(fq, f, g), hcc_))))
- `limit-form-prop` — forall([md, fq, f, g], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-inner-product-form(md, fq) implies f in form-cseq(md, fq) implies g in form-cseq(md, fq) implies (limit-form(md, fq))(f, g) in cc and converges-to(cc-ms, seq-form(fq, f, g), (limit-form(md, fq))(f, g)))
- `limit-form-psd` — forall([md, fq], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-inner-product-form(md, fq) implies is-psd-form(cseq-module(md, fq), limit-form(md, fq)))
- `limit-form-rr` — forall([md, fq, f], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-inner-product-form(md, fq) implies f in form-cseq(md, fq) implies converges-to(rr-ms, seq-form(fq, f, f), (limit-form(md, fq))(f, f)))
- `limit-form-type` — forall([md, fq], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-inner-product-form(md, fq) implies limit-form(md, fq) in fun(cartesian(form-cseq(md, fq), form-cseq(md, fq)), cc))
- `limit-form-value` — forall([md, fq, f, g, c], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-inner-product-form(md, fq) implies f in form-cseq(md, fq) implies g in form-cseq(md, fq) implies c in cc implies converges-to(cc-ms, seq-form(fq, f, g), c) implies (limit-form(md, fq))(f, g) = c)
- `limit-of-frequent-value` — forall([s, f, lm, c], converges-to(s, f, lm) implies forall([lfn_ in nn], forsome([lfk_ in nn], lfn_ <= lfk_ and f(lfk_) = c)) implies lm = c)
- `lin-coords-spec` — forall([ndm, ndd, ndu, ndp], forall([ndc1 in mat(1, ndd, ndp), ndc2 in mat(1, ndd, ndp)], lincomb(ndm, ndd, ndc1, ndu) = lincomb(ndm, ndd, ndc2, ndu) implies ndc1 = ndc2) implies forall([ndc in mat(1, ndd, ndp), ndr], ndr = lincomb(ndm, ndd, ndc, ndu) implies lin-coords(ndm, ndd, ndu, ndp, ndr) = ndc))
- `lin-nondegenerate` — forall([a in cc, b in cc, c in cc, d in cc, u in cc, v in cc], not(a * d - b * c = 0) implies not(u = 0 and v = 0) implies not(a * u + b * v = 0 and c * u + d * v = 0))
- `lin-span-act` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([n in nn, u in mat(n, 1, vec(md)), r in carr(scal(md)), x in lin-span(md, n, u)], (act(md))(r, x) in lin-span(md, n, u)))

- `lin-span-member` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([n in nn, u in mat(n, 1, vec(md)), i in interval(1, n)], entry(u, i, 1) in lin-span(md, n, u)))
- `lin-span-sum` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([n in nn, u in mat(n, 1, vec(md)), m in nn, g], forall([gbi_ in ord-segment(m)], g(gbi_) in lin-span(md, n, u)) implies sum-ag(module-vector-ag(md), g, m) in lin-span(md, n, u)))

- `lincomb-coord` — forall([md, n, es, c_], is-module(md) implies n in nn implies es in mat(n, 1, vec(md)) implies generates(md, n, es) implies rel-free(md, n, es) implies c_ in mat(1, n, carr(scal(md))) implies (inverse-bij(vnb-lambda(lcc_, mat(1, n, carr(scal(md))), lincomb(md, n, lcc_, es)), mat(1, n, carr(scal(md))), vec(md)))(lincomb(md, n, c_, es)) = c_)
- `lincomb-empty` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([c, u], lincomb(md, 0, c, u) = vzero(md)))
- `lincomb-in-module` — forall([aa, vv, n, b, w], is-cc-module-over(aa, vv) implies aa subset cc implies n in nn implies b in fun(interval(1, n), aa) implies w in fun(interval(1, n), vv) implies cc-lincomb(n, b, w) in vv)
- `lincomb-in-submodule` — forall([md, sm, n, c, ws], is-module(md) implies is-submodule(md, sm) implies n in nn implies c in mat(1, n, carr(scal(md))) implies ws in mat(n, 1, vec(md)) implies forall([j_ in interval(1, n)], entry(ws, j_, 1) in sm) implies lincomb(md, n, c, ws) in sm)
- `lincomb-krylov` — forall([md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies forall([n in nn, v in vec(md), c in mat(1, n, carr(scal(md)))], lincomb(md, n, c, krylov(md, tt, v, n)) = sum-ag(module-vector-ag(md), vnb-lambda(gpk_, nn, (act(md))(entry(c, 1, succ(gpk_)), op-iter(md, tt, v, gpk_))), n)))
- `lincomb-matact` — forall([md, n, c, pm, es], is-module(md) implies n in nn implies c in mat(1, n, carr(scal(md))) implies pm in mat(n, n, carr(scal(md))) implies es in mat(n, 1, vec(md)) implies lincomb(md, n, c, matact(md, pm, es)) = lincomb(md, n, matmul(scal(md), c, pm), es))
- `lincomb-row-add` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([n, c1, c2, u], c1 in mat(1, n, carr(scal(md))) implies c2 in mat(1, n, carr(scal(md))) implies u in mat(n, 1, vec(md)) implies lincomb(md, n, matadd(scal(md), c1, c2), u) = (vadd(md))(lincomb(md, n, c1, u), lincomb(md, n, c2, u))))

- `lincomb-single-support` — forall([md, n, c, u, i], is-module(md) implies n in nn implies c in mat(1, n, carr(scal(md))) implies u in mat(n, 1, vec(md)) implies i in interval(1, n) implies forall([j_ in interval(1, n)], not(j_ = i) implies entry(u, j_, 1) = vzero(md)) implies lincomb(md, n, c, u) = (act(md))(entry(c, 1, i), entry(u, i, 1)))
- `lincomb-snoc` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([n in nn, c in mat(1, n, carr(scal(md))), u in mat(n, 1, vec(md)), r in carr(scal(md)), x in vec(md)], lincomb(md, succ(n), snoc-row(c, n, r), snoc-col(u, n, x)) = (vadd(md))(lincomb(md, n, c, u), (act(md))(r, x))))

- `lincomb-type` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([n, c, u], c in mat(1, n, carr(scal(md))) implies u in mat(n, 1, vec(md)) implies lincomb(md, n, c, u) in vec(md)))
