- `line-coef-spec` — forall([m, v, u], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies v in vec(m) implies not(v = vzero(m)) implies u in line(m, v) implies line-coef(m, v, u) in rr and u = (act(m))(line-coef(m, v, u), v))
- `line-coef-value` — forall([m, v, u, c], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies v in vec(m) implies not(v = vzero(m)) implies c in rr implies u = (act(m))(c, v) implies line-coef(m, v, u) = c)
- `line-functional-exists` — forall([m, v], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies v in vec(m) implies forsome([f_], is-bounded-linear-functional-on(m, line(m, v), f_) and dual-norm-on(m, line(m, v), f_) <= 1 and f_(v) = (vnrm(m))(v)))
- `line-has-v` — forall([m, v], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies v in vec(m) implies v in line(m, v))
- `line-int-abs-bound` — forall([u, f, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([liab_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr)], forall([liy_ in ccint(a, b)], liab_(liy_) == magnitude(f(pgam(liy_))) * magnitude(dgam(liy_))) implies magnitude(line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b)) <= pw-int(liab_, a, b)))
- `line-int-adjacent` — forall([u, f, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([licv_ in ooint(a, b)], line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b) = line-int(f, restrict(pgam, ccint(a, licv_)), restrict(dgam, ccint(a, licv_)), a, licv_) + line-int(f, restrict(pgam, ccint(licv_, b)), restrict(dgam, ccint(licv_, b)), licv_, b)))
- `line-int-affine-reparam` — forall([u, f, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([lrpc_ in rr, lrpd_ in rr, lrpl_ in rr, lrpm_ in rr], 0 < lrpl_ implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpc_ = a implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpd_ = b implies lrpc_ < lrpd_ implies forall([lrpr_, lrpk_], lrpr_ in fun(ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_), cc) implies lrpk_ in fun(ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_), cc) implies forall([lrpz_ in ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_)], lrpr_(lrpz_) == pgam(lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpz_)) implies forall([lrpz_ in ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_)], lrpk_(lrpz_) == lrpl_ * dgam(lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpz_)) implies line-int(f, lrpr_, lrpk_, lrpc_, lrpd_) = line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b))))
- `line-int-closed-road-of-derivative` — forall([u, f, df, pgam, dgam, a, b], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies df in fun(u, cc) implies forall([hbz_ in u], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, u, f, hbz_, df(hbz_))) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies pgam(b) = pgam(a) implies line-int(df, pgam, dgam, a, b) = 0)
- `line-int-concat` — forall([u, f, pgam, dgam, prho, drho, a, b, c, d], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies is-road(prho, drho, c, d) implies pgam(b) = prho(c) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies trace(prho, c, d) subset u implies line-int(f, juxta(pgam, vnb-lambda(jxs_, ccint(b, b + d - c), prho(c + jxs_ - b)), a, b, b + d - c), juxta(dgam, vnb-lambda(jxs_, ccint(b, b + d - c), drho(c + jxs_ - b)), a, b, b + d - c), a, b + d - c) = line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b) + line-int(f, prho, drho, c, d))
- `line-int-domain-congruence` — forall([u, f], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([pgam, dgam, a, b], is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([wnv_, wng_ in fun(wnv_, cc)], trace(pgam, a, b) subset wnv_ implies forall([wnx_ in trace(pgam, a, b)], wng_(wnx_) == f(wnx_)) implies line-int(wng_, pgam, dgam, a, b) = line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b))))
- `line-int-exists` — forall([u, f, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forsome([pwf_, paw_], is-primitive(pwf_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), real-part((vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), f(pgam(pat_)) * dgam(pat_)))(pat_))), a, b) and is-primitive(paw_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), imag-part((vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), f(pgam(pat_)) * dgam(pat_)))(pat_))), a, b)))
- `line-int-in-cc` — forall([u, f, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b) in cc)
- `line-int-integrand-in-fun` — forall([a, b], a in rr implies b in rr implies forall([pgam, dgam, pf, pad_], pgam in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies dgam in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies pf in fun(pad_, cc) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset pad_ implies vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), pf(pgam(pat_)) * dgam(pat_)) in fun(ccint(a, b), cc)))
- `line-int-interior-congruence` — forall([u, f, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([qgam in fun(ccint(a, b), cc), qdg in fun(ccint(a, b), cc)], forall([t in ccint(a, b)], qgam(t) == pgam(t)) implies forall([t in ooint(a, b)], qdg(t) == dgam(t)) implies line-int(f, qgam, qdg, a, b) = line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b)))
- `line-int-juxta` — forall([u, f, pgam1, dgam1, pgam2, dgam2, a, b, c], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam1, dgam1, a, b) implies is-road(pgam2, dgam2, b, c) implies pgam1(b) = pgam2(b) implies trace(pgam1, a, b) subset u implies trace(pgam2, b, c) subset u implies line-int(f, juxta(pgam1, pgam2, a, b, c), juxta(dgam1, dgam2, a, b, c), a, c) = line-int(f, pgam1, dgam1, a, b) + line-int(f, pgam2, dgam2, b, c))
- `line-int-length-bound` — forall([u, f, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([bnd in rr], forall([bny_ in trace(pgam, a, b)], magnitude(f(bny_)) <= bnd) implies magnitude(line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b)) <= road-length(dgam, a, b) * bnd))
- `line-int-of-derivative` — forall([u, f, df, pgam, dgam, a, b], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies df in fun(u, cc) implies forall([hbz_ in u], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, u, f, hbz_, df(hbz_))) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies line-int(df, pgam, dgam, a, b) = f(pgam(b)) - f(pgam(a)))
- `line-int-of-one` — forall([pgam, dgam, a, b, pf, pad_], is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies pf in fun(pad_, cc) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset pad_ implies forall([pay_ in pad_], pf(pay_) = 1) implies line-int(pf, pgam, dgam, a, b) = pgam(b) - pgam(a))
- `line-int-of-uniform-limit` — forall([u, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([g in fun(u, cc)], forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), g, rgy_)) implies forall([fam], forall([k in nn], fam(k) in fun(u, cc)) implies forall([k in nn, rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), fam(k), rgy_)) implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([aicap_ in nn], forall([k in nn], aicap_ <= k implies forall([aiy_ in trace(pgam, a, b)], magnitude((fam(k))(aiy_) - g(aiy_)) <= eps)))) implies converges-to(cc-ms, vnb-lambda(k, nn, line-int(fam(k), pgam, dgam, a, b)), line-int(g, pgam, dgam, a, b)))))
- `line-int-opposite` — forall([a, b], a in rr implies b in rr implies forall([pgam, dgam, pf, pad_], is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies pf in fun(pad_, cc) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset pad_ implies forall([prgb_, prdb_], prgb_ in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies prdb_ in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], prgb_(pay_) == pgam(a + b - pay_)) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], prdb_(pay_) == -1 * dgam(a + b - pay_)) implies forall([pwf_, paw_], is-primitive(pwf_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), real-part((vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), pf(pgam(pat_)) * dgam(pat_)))(pat_))), a, b) implies is-primitive(paw_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), imag-part((vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), pf(pgam(pat_)) * dgam(pat_)))(pat_))), a, b) implies line-int(pf, prgb_, prdb_, a, b) = -1 * line-int(pf, pgam, dgam, a, b)))))
- `line-int-opposite-road` — forall([u, f, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([lirg_, lird_], lirg_ in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies lird_ in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], lirg_(pay_) == pgam(a + b - pay_)) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], lird_(pay_) == -1 * dgam(a + b - pay_)) implies line-int(f, lirg_, lird_, a, b) = -1 * line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b)))
- `line-int-primitive-road` — forall([u, f, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forsome([wzh_], is-road(wzh_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), f(pgam(pat_)) * dgam(pat_)), a, b) and line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b) = wzh_(b) - wzh_(a)))
- `line-int-scalar` — forall([u, f, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([lic_ in cc, lih_ in fun(u, cc)], forall([liz_ in u], lih_(liz_) == lic_ * f(liz_)) implies line-int(lih_, pgam, dgam, a, b) = lic_ * line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b)))
- `line-int-sum` — forall([u, f, g, pgam, dgam, a, b], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies g in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), g, rgy_)) implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([lih_ in fun(u, cc)], forall([liz_ in u], lih_(liz_) == f(liz_) + g(liz_)) implies line-int(lih_, pgam, dgam, a, b) = line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b) + line-int(g, pgam, dgam, a, b)))
- `line-int-termwise` — forall([u, pgam, dgam, a, b, hf, g], u subset cc implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset u implies forall([twj_ in nn], hf(twj_) in fun(u, cc)) implies forall([twj_ in nn, rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), hf(twj_), rgy_)) implies g in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), g, rgy_)) implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([twcap_ in nn], forall([twk_ in nn], twcap_ <= twk_ implies forall([twy_ in trace(pgam, a, b)], magnitude(cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(twj_, nn, (hf(twj_))(twy_)), twk_) - g(twy_)) <= eps)))) implies cc-series-converges-to(vnb-lambda(twj_, nn, line-int(hf(twj_), pgam, dgam, a, b)), line-int(g, pgam, dgam, a, b)))
- `line-int-unfold` — forall([pf, pgam, dgam, a, b], line-int(pf, pgam, dgam, a, b) == cc-int(vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), pf(pgam(pat_)) * dgam(pat_)), a, b))
- `line-int-value` — forall([f, pgam, dgam, a, b, lig1_, lig2_], is-primitive(lig1_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), real-part(f(pgam(pat_)) * dgam(pat_))), a, b) implies is-primitive(lig2_, vnb-lambda(pat_, ccint(a, b), imag-part(f(pgam(pat_)) * dgam(pat_))), a, b) implies line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b) = lig1_(b) - lig1_(a) + (lig2_(b) - lig2_(a)) * 1i)

- `maximal-ideal-character` — forall([a], is-commutative-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([ii], is-maximal-ideal(a, ii) implies forsome([chi in characters(a)], forall([x in vec(a)], chi(x) = 0 iff x in ii))))
- `maximal-ideal-exists` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([bmj], is-two-sided-ideal(a, bmj) implies not(bmj = vec(a)) implies forsome([bmm_], is-maximal-ideal(a, bmm_) and bmj subset bmm_)))
- `maximal-ideal-kernel` — forall([a], is-commutative-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([ii], is-maximal-ideal(a, ii) implies forsome([chi in characters(a)], {bkx_ in vec(a): chi(bkx_) = 0} = ii)))
- `maximal-left-ideal-closed` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([ii], is-maximal-left-ideal(a, ii) implies is-closed(ba-metric-space(a), ii)))

- `maximal-quotient-norm-magnitude` — forall([a], is-commutative-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([ii], is-maximal-ideal(a, ii) implies forall([x in vec(a), z in cc], class(qmod-setoid(uba-as-module(a), ii), x) = class(qmod-setoid(uba-as-module(a), ii), (act(a))(z, vone(a))) implies (vnrm(quotient-ba(a, ii)))(class(qmod-setoid(uba-as-module(a), ii), x)) = magnitude(z))))
- `maximal-quotient-scalar` — forall([a], is-commutative-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([ii], is-maximal-ideal(a, ii) implies forall([x in vec(a)], forsome([z in cc], class(qmod-setoid(uba-as-module(a), ii), x) = class(qmod-setoid(uba-as-module(a), ii), (act(a))(z, vone(a)))))))
- `maximal-quotient-scalar-unique` — forall([a], is-commutative-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([ii], is-maximal-ideal(a, ii) implies forall([z in cc, w in cc], class(qmod-setoid(uba-as-module(a), ii), (act(a))(z, vone(a))) = class(qmod-setoid(uba-as-module(a), ii), (act(a))(w, vone(a))) implies z = w)))
- `maximum-modulus-connected` — forall([u], is-connected(cc-ms, u) implies forall([f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([a in u], forall([z in u], magnitude(f(z)) <= magnitude(f(a))) implies forall([z in u], f(z) = f(a)))))
- `maximum-modulus-disc` — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies forall([c in cc, cmvbr_ in rr], 0 < cmvbr_ implies ball(cc-ms, c, cmvbr_) subset u implies forall([cmvz_ in ball(cc-ms, c, cmvbr_)], magnitude(f(cmvz_)) <= magnitude(f(c))) implies forall([cmvz_ in ball(cc-ms, c, cmvbr_)], f(cmvz_) = f(c))))
- `mbp-borel-in-product` — forall([s], is-separable(s) implies forall([t], is-separable(t) implies forall([mpe_ in borel-sets(product2-ms(s, t))], mpe_ in product-sigma(pts(s), borel-sets(s), pts(t), borel-sets(t)))))
- `mbp-gen-in-sigma` — forall([omega, ce, mpa_ in ce], mpa_ in power(omega) implies mpa_ in sigma-generated(omega, ce))
- `mbp-open-in-product` — forall([s], is-separable(s) implies forall([t], is-separable(t) implies forall([mpu_], is-open(product2-ms(s, t), mpu_) implies mpu_ in product-sigma(pts(s), borel-sets(s), pts(t), borel-sets(t)))))
- `mbp-product-in-borel` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([t], is-metric-space(t) implies forall([mpe_ in product-sigma(pts(s), borel-sets(s), pts(t), borel-sets(t))], mpe_ in borel-sets(product2-ms(s, t)))))
- `mbp-rect-borel` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([t], is-metric-space(t) implies forall([mpa_ in borel-sets(s), mpb_ in borel-sets(t)], cartesian(mpa_, mpb_) in borel-sets(product2-ms(s, t)))))
- `mbs-borel-is-trace` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([mby_], mby_ subset pts(s) implies forall([mbb_ in borel-sets(subspace-ms(s, mby_))], forsome([mbe_ in borel-sets(s)], mbb_ = intersection(mbe_, mby_)))))
- `mbs-trace-borel` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([mby_], mby_ subset pts(s) implies forall([mbe_ in borel-sets(s)], intersection(mbe_, mby_) in borel-sets(subspace-ms(s, mby_)))))
- `mct-simple-below` — forall([omega, ca, mu, cf, s], is-measure(omega, ca, mu) implies cf in fun(nn, fun(omega, rr-pos-star)) implies forall([n_ in nn], is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, cf(n_))) implies forall([n_ in nn], ptwise-le(omega, cf(n_), cf(succ(n_)))) implies is-simple-fn(omega, ca, s) implies ptwise-le(omega, s, ptwise-sup(omega, cf)) implies simple-integral(omega, mu, s) <= esup(image(vnb-lambda(n_, nn, integral(omega, ca, mu, cf(n_))), nn)))
- `md-recip-power-holomorphic` — forall([a in cc, mdj_ in nn], holomorphic-on(difference(cc, singleton(a)), vnb-lambda(mdv_, difference(cc, singleton(a)), recip(mdv_ - a) ^ succ(mdj_))))
- `md-recip-power-road-zero` — forall([a in cc, mdj_ in nn, mdp_, mdq_, mds_, mdt_], is-road(mdp_, mdq_, mds_, mdt_) implies trace(mdp_, mds_, mdt_) subset difference(cc, singleton(a)) implies mdp_(mdt_) = mdp_(mds_) implies line-int(vnb-lambda(mdv_, difference(cc, singleton(a)), recip(mdv_ - a) ^ succ(succ(mdj_))), mdp_, mdq_, mds_, mdt_) = 0)
- `md-zero-exact` — forall([a in cc], holomorphic-on(difference(cc, singleton(a)), vnb-lambda(mdv_, difference(cc, singleton(a)), 0)) and forall([mdp_, mdq_, mds_, mdt_], is-road(mdp_, mdq_, mds_, mdt_) implies trace(mdp_, mds_, mdt_) subset difference(cc, singleton(a)) implies mdp_(mdt_) = mdp_(mds_) implies line-int(vnb-lambda(mdv_, difference(cc, singleton(a)), 0), mdp_, mdq_, mds_, mdt_) = 0))
- `mean-value-inequality-on-interval` — forall([lo_, hi_, ff_, ll_, bd_], lo_ in rr implies hi_ in rr implies lo_ < hi_ implies ll_ in rr implies bd_ in rr implies forall([x_ in ccint(lo_, hi_)], forsome([l_], has-deriv-at(ff_, x_, l_) and abs(l_ - ll_) <= bd_)) implies abs(ff_(hi_) - ff_(lo_) - ll_ * (hi_ - lo_)) <= bd_ * (hi_ - lo_))
- `measurable-continuous-combination` — forall([omega, ca, s, phi, f, g], is-separable(s) implies is-continuous(product2-ms(s, s), s, phi) implies is-measurable-map(omega, ca, pts(s), borel-sets(s), f) implies is-measurable-map(omega, ca, pts(s), borel-sets(s), g) implies is-measurable-map(omega, ca, pts(s), borel-sets(s), vnb-lambda(mfpx_, omega, phi([f(mfpx_), g(mfpx_)]))))
- `measurable-fn-congruence-ptwise` — forall([omega, ca, f, g], is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, f) implies g in fun(omega, rr-pos-star) implies forall([icx_ in omega], f(icx_) = g(icx_)) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, g))
- `measurable-fn-const` — forall([omega, ca, cc_], is-sigma-algebra(omega, ca) implies cc_ in rr-pos-star implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, vnb-lambda(cx_, omega, cc_)))
- `measurable-fn-eplus` — forall([omega, ca, f, g], is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, f) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, g) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, ptwise-eplus(omega, f, g)))
- `measurable-fn-eplus-of-values` — forall([omega, ca, f, g, h], is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, f) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, g) implies h in fun(omega, rr-pos-star) implies forall([x in omega], h(x) = eplus(f(x), g(x))) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, h))
- `measurable-fn-epow` — forall([omega, ca, f, p_], is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, f) implies p_ in rr implies 0 < p_ implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, ptwise-epow(omega, f, p_)))
- `measurable-fn-etimes` — forall([omega, ca, f, g], is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, f) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, g) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, ptwise-etimes(omega, f, g)))
- `measurable-fn-etimes-cell` — forall([omega, ca, f, g, al, q], is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, f) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, g) implies al in rr implies q in rr implies {x_ in omega: 0 < q and q < f(x_) and al * recip(q) < g(x_)} in ca)
- `measurable-fn-etimes-of-values` — forall([omega, ca, f, g, h], is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, f) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, g) implies h in fun(omega, rr-pos-star) implies forall([x in omega], h(x) = etimes(f(x), g(x))) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, h))
- `measurable-fn-etimes-row` — forall([omega, ca, f, g, al, r], is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, f) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, g) implies al in rr implies r in rr implies {x_ in omega: forsome([k_ in nn], 0 < k_ * r and k_ * r < f(x_) and al * recip(k_ * r) < g(x_))} in ca)
- `measurable-fn-finite-part` — forall([omega, ca, u], is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, u) implies {fp_ in omega: u(fp_) in rr} in ca)

- `measurable-fn-ge` — forall([omega, ca, f], is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, f) implies forall([a in rr], {gx_ in omega: a <= f(gx_)} in ca))
- `measurable-fn-grid-row` — forall([omega, ca, f, g, al, r], is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, f) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, g) implies al in rr implies r in rr implies {x_ in omega: forsome([k_ in nn], k_ * r < f(x_) and al - k_ * r < g(x_))} in ca)
- `measurable-fn-guarded-ge` — forall([omega, ca, f], is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, f) implies forall([a, b, cc_], b in rr implies {x_ in omega: (a < b and b <= cc_) and b <= f(x_)} in ca))
- `measurable-fn-guarded-lt` — forall([omega, ca, f], is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, f) implies forall([p, ixs, b in rr], {x_ in omega: p in ixs and f(x_) < b} in ca))

- `measurable-fn-lower-bound-set` — forall([omega, ca, cf, ixs, b], is-sigma-algebra(omega, ca) implies cf in fun(nn, fun(omega, rr-pos-star)) implies forall([n_ in nn], is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, cf(n_))) implies ixs subset nn implies b in rr implies {x_ in omega: forall([p_ in ixs], b <= (cf(p_))(x_))} in ca)

- `measurable-fn-lt-set` — forall([omega, ca, u, v], is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, u) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, v) implies {x_ in omega: v(x_) < u(x_)} in ca)
- `measurable-fn-of-nonneg-tails` — forall([omega, ca, f], is-sigma-algebra(omega, ca) implies f in fun(omega, rr-pos-star) implies forall([al_ in rr], 0 <= al_ implies {x_ in omega: al_ < f(x_)} in ca) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, f))
- `measurable-fn-pullback-first` — forall([xs, ca, ys, cb, a], is-sigma-algebra(xs, ca) implies is-sigma-algebra(ys, cb) implies is-measurable-fn(xs, ca, a) implies is-measurable-fn(cartesian(xs, ys), product-sigma(xs, ca, ys, cb), vnb-lambda(tw_, cartesian(xs, ys), a(nth(1, tw_)))))
- `measurable-fn-pullback-second` — forall([xs, ca, ys, cb, b], is-sigma-algebra(xs, ca) implies is-sigma-algebra(ys, cb) implies is-measurable-fn(ys, cb, b) implies is-measurable-fn(cartesian(xs, ys), product-sigma(xs, ca, ys, cb), vnb-lambda(tw_, cartesian(xs, ys), b(nth(2, tw_)))))
- `measurable-fn-recip` — forall([omega, ca, h], is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, h) implies forall([rhx_ in omega], h(rhx_) in rr) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, vnb-lambda(rrx_, omega, if(0 < h(rrx_), recip(h(rrx_)), 0))))
- `measurable-fn-sub` — forall([omega, ca, u, v], is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, u) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, v) implies forall([x in omega], v(x) <= u(x)) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, vnb-lambda(dx_, omega, if(u(dx_) in rr, u(dx_) - v(dx_), 0))))
- `measurable-fn-sup` — forall([omega, ca, cf], is-sigma-algebra(omega, ca) implies cf in fun(nn, fun(omega, rr-pos-star)) implies forall([n_ in nn], is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, cf(n_))) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, ptwise-sup(omega, cf)))

- `measurable-fn-tensor` — forall([xs, ca, ys, cb, a, b], is-sigma-algebra(xs, ca) implies is-sigma-algebra(ys, cb) implies is-measurable-fn(xs, ca, a) implies is-measurable-fn(ys, cb, b) implies is-measurable-fn(cartesian(xs, ys), product-sigma(xs, ca, ys, cb), vnb-lambda(tw_, cartesian(xs, ys), etimes(a(nth(1, tw_)), b(nth(2, tw_))))))
- `measurable-limit-open-preimage` — forall([omega, ca, s, fs, f, u], is-sigma-algebra(omega, ca) implies is-metric-space(s) implies fs in fun(nn, fun(omega, pts(s))) implies forall([n in nn], is-measurable-map(omega, ca, pts(s), borel-sets(s), fs(n))) implies f in fun(omega, pts(s)) implies forall([x in omega], converges-to(s, vnb-lambda(k, nn, (fs(k))(x)), f(x))) implies is-open(s, u) implies {mfx_ in omega: f(mfx_) in u} in ca)
- `measurable-map-compose` — forall([omega, ca, omega2, cb, omega3, cg, f, g], is-measurable-map(omega, ca, omega2, cb, f) implies is-measurable-map(omega2, cb, omega3, cg, g) implies is-measurable-map(omega, ca, omega3, cg, compose(g, f)))
- `measurable-map-in-fun` — forall([omega, ca, omega2, cb, f], is-measurable-map(omega, ca, omega2, cb, f) implies f in fun(omega, omega2))

- `measurable-map-of-generators` — forall([xs, ca, ys, ce, f], is-sigma-algebra(xs, ca) implies ys in set implies ce subset power(ys) implies f in fun(xs, ys) implies forall([e in ce], {x_ in xs: f(x_) in e} in ca) implies is-measurable-map(xs, ca, ys, sigma-generated(ys, ce), f))
- `measurable-map-pair` — forall([omega, ca, xs, cx, ys, cy, f, g], is-measurable-map(omega, ca, xs, cx, f) implies is-measurable-map(omega, ca, ys, cy, g) implies is-measurable-map(omega, ca, cartesian(xs, ys), product-sigma(xs, cx, ys, cy), vnb-lambda(mfpx_, omega, [f(mfpx_), g(mfpx_)])))
- `measurable-map-preimage` — forall([omega, ca, omega2, cb, f, b_], is-measurable-map(omega, ca, omega2, cb, f) implies b_ in cb implies {x_ in omega: f(x_) in b_} in ca)
- `measurable-map-ptwise-eq` — forall([omega, ca, ys, cb, f, h], is-measurable-map(omega, ca, ys, cb, f) implies h in fun(omega, ys) implies forall([x in omega], f(x) = h(x)) implies is-measurable-map(omega, ca, ys, cb, h))
- `measurable-map-ptwise-limit` — forall([omega, ca, s, fs, f], is-sigma-algebra(omega, ca) implies is-metric-space(s) implies fs in fun(nn, fun(omega, pts(s))) implies forall([n in nn], is-measurable-map(omega, ca, pts(s), borel-sets(s), fs(n))) implies f in fun(omega, pts(s)) implies forall([x in omega], converges-to(s, vnb-lambda(k, nn, (fs(k))(x)), f(x))) implies is-measurable-map(omega, ca, pts(s), borel-sets(s), f))

- `measure-ball-separable` — forall([s], is-complete(s) implies forall([mu], is-measure(pts(s), borel-sets(s), mu) implies forall([x in pts(s), r], pos-rr(r) implies 0 < mu(ball(s, x, r)) and mu(ball(s, x, r)) in rr) implies forall([r], pos-rr(r) implies forsome([c], pos-rr(c) and forall([x in pts(s), y in pts(s)], c * mu(ball(s, y, r)) <= mu(ball(s, x, r))))) implies forsome([z], z in pts(s)) implies is-separable(s)))
- `measure-below-approx` — forall([omega, ca, mu, f_], is-measure(omega, ca, mu) implies f_ in fun(nn, ca) implies forall([n_ in nn], f_(n_) subset f_(succ(n_))) implies mu(big-union(n_, nn, f_(n_))) in rr implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([k in nn], mu(big-union(n_, nn, f_(n_))) <= mu(f_(k)) + eps)))
- `measure-continuity-from-above` — forall([omega, ca, mu, f_], is-measure(omega, ca, mu) implies f_ in fun(nn, ca) implies forall([n_ in nn], f_(succ(n_)) subset f_(n_)) implies mu(f_(0)) in rr implies mu(complement-in(omega, big-union(n_, nn, complement-in(omega, f_(n_))))) = einf(image(vnb-lambda(n_, nn, mu(f_(n_))), nn)))
- `measure-continuity-from-below` — forall([omega, ca, mu, f_], is-measure(omega, ca, mu) implies f_ in fun(nn, ca) implies forall([n_ in nn], f_(n_) subset f_(succ(n_))) implies mu(big-union(n_, nn, f_(n_))) = esup(image(vnb-lambda(n_, nn, mu(f_(n_))), nn)))
- `measure-countably-subadditive` — forall([omega, ca, mu, f_], is-measure(omega, ca, mu) implies f_ in fun(nn, ca) implies mu(big-union(n_, nn, f_(n_))) <= esum(vnb-lambda(n_, nn, mu(f_(n_)))))
- `measure-finite-subset` — forall([omega, ca, mu, a_, b_], is-measure(omega, ca, mu) implies a_ in ca implies b_ in ca implies a_ subset b_ implies mu(b_) in rr implies mu(a_) in rr)

- `mink-rr-ge-div` — forall([a, b, c], a in rr implies b in rr implies c in rr implies 0 < c implies recip(c) * b <= a implies b <= c * a)
- `mink-rr-le-div` — forall([a, b, c], a in rr implies b in rr implies c in rr implies 0 < c implies a <= recip(c) * b implies c * a <= b)
- `mink-rr-mul-pos` — forall([a, b], a in rr implies b in rr implies 0 < a implies 0 < b implies 0 < a * b)
- `mink-rr-scale-le` — forall([a, b, c], a in rr implies b in rr implies c in rr implies 0 <= c implies a <= b implies c * a <= c * b)
- `mink-scale-in` — forall([m, cs, y, t], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies is-convex-subset(m, cs) implies is-absorbing-subset(m, cs) implies vzero(m) in cs implies y in cs implies t in rr implies 0 <= t implies t <= 1 implies (act(m))(t, y) in cs)
- `mink-set-elim` — forall([m, cs, x, r in mink-set(m, cs, x)], r in rr and 0 < r and forsome([mky_ in cs], x = (act(m))(r, mky_)))

- `mink-set-intro` — forall([m, cs, x, r, y], r in rr implies 0 < r implies y in cs implies x = (act(m))(r, y) implies r in mink-set(m, cs, x))
- `mink-set-neg` — forall([m, cs, x, r], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies is-convex-subset(m, cs) implies is-symmetric-subset(m, cs) implies is-absorbing-subset(m, cs) implies r in mink-set(m, cs, x) implies r in mink-set(m, cs, (act(m))(-1, x)))
- `mink-set-scale` — forall([m, cs, x, c, r], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies is-convex-subset(m, cs) implies is-absorbing-subset(m, cs) implies vzero(m) in cs implies r in mink-set(m, cs, x) implies c in rr implies 0 < c implies c * r in mink-set(m, cs, (act(m))(c, x)))
- `mink-set-sum` — forall([m, cs, x, y, r, s], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies is-convex-subset(m, cs) implies is-absorbing-subset(m, cs) implies vzero(m) in cs implies r in mink-set(m, cs, x) implies s in mink-set(m, cs, y) implies r + s in mink-set(m, cs, (vadd(m))(x, y)))
- `mink-set-unfold` — forall([m, cs, x], mink-set(m, cs, x) == {mkr_ in rr: 0 < mkr_ and forsome([mky_ in cs], x = (act(m))(mkr_, mky_))})
- `mink-set-zero` — forall([m, cs, r], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies is-convex-subset(m, cs) implies is-absorbing-subset(m, cs) implies vzero(m) in cs implies r in rr implies 0 < r implies r in mink-set(m, cs, vzero(m)))
- `mink-value` — forall([m, cs, z in vec(m)], (minkowski-functional(m, cs))(z) == inf(mink-set(m, cs, z)))
- `mink-vzero-in` — forall([m, cs], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies is-convex-subset(m, cs) implies is-symmetric-subset(m, cs) implies is-absorbing-subset(m, cs) implies vzero(m) in cs)
- `minkowski` — forall([omega, ca, mu, f, g], is-measure(omega, ca, mu) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, f) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, g) implies forall([p], p in rr and 1 <= p implies ep-norm(omega, ca, mu, p, ptwise-eplus(omega, f, g)) <= eplus(ep-norm(omega, ca, mu, p, f), ep-norm(omega, ca, mu, p, g))))
- `minkowski-functional-is-seminorm` — forall([m, cs], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies is-convex-subset(m, cs) implies is-symmetric-subset(m, cs) implies is-absorbing-subset(m, cs) implies is-seminorm(rr-normed-field, m, minkowski-functional(m, cs)))
- `minkowski-l2` — forall([s], s in set and card(s) in nn implies forall([a in fun(s, rr), b in fun(s, rr)], sqrt(finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), vnb-lambda(i, s, (a(i) + b(i)) * (a(i) + b(i))), s)) <= sqrt(finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), vnb-lambda(i, s, a(i) * a(i)), s)) + sqrt(finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), vnb-lambda(i, s, b(i) * b(i)), s))))
- `minor-entry` — forall([r, s, p, q, n, u_, v_], is-ring(r) implies n in nn implies s in mat(succ(n), succ(n), carr(r)) implies u_ in interval(1, n) implies v_ in interval(1, n) implies entry(minor(s, p, q, n), u_, v_) = entry(s, if(u_ < p, u_, succ(u_)), if(v_ < q, v_, succ(v_))))

- `monic-poly-in-poly` — forall([fr], is-ring(fr) implies forall([nv_ in nn, av_], forall([i_ in interval(1, nv_)], av_(i_) in carr(fr)) implies monic-poly(fr, av_, nv_) in carr(poly(fr))))

- `morera` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([f in fun(u, cc)], forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([mrta_ in u, mrtb_ in u, mrtc_ in u], conv3(mrta_, mrtb_, mrtc_) subset u implies tri-int(f, mrta_, mrtb_, mrtc_) = 0) implies holomorphic-on(u, f)))

- `onb-unit-multiple` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x in vec(v)], not(x = vzero(v)) implies forsome([c in cc], (ip(v))((act(v))(c, x), (act(v))(c, x)) = 1)))
- `onb-unit-scale-identity` — forall([a_ in rr, b_ in rr, t_ in rr], a_ * a_ = t_ implies a_ * b_ = 1 implies b_ * (b_ * t_) = 1)
- `one-in-interval` — forall([n in nn], 1 in interval(1, succ(n)))
- `one-in-interval-1` — 1 in interval(1, 1)
- `one-minus-sa-square` — forall([b], is-unital-c-star-algebra(b) implies forall([x in vec(b)], (vstar(b))(x) = x implies (vnrm(b))(x) <= 1 implies (vadd(b))(vone(b), (vneg(b))(x)) in sa-squares(b)))
- `one-minus-sq-norm` — forall([b], is-unital-c-star-algebra(b) implies forall([y in sa-squares(b)], (vnrm(b))(y) <= 1 implies (vnrm(b))((vadd(b))(vone(b), (vneg(b))(y))) <= 1))
- `one-minus-square` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([y in vec(a)], (vnrm(a))(y) < 1 implies forsome([b in vec(a)], (vmul(a))(b, b) = (vadd(a))(vone(a), (vneg(a))(y)))))
- `one-parameter-agree-multiples` — forall([n in nn, g, al, psia, psib], is-group(g) implies pos-rr(al) implies psia in fun(rr, carr(g)) implies psib in fun(rr, carr(g)) implies forall([oqr_ in rr, oqu_ in rr], psia(oqr_ + oqu_) = (opr(g))(psia(oqr_), psia(oqu_))) implies forall([oqr_ in rr, oqu_ in rr], psib(oqr_ + oqu_) = (opr(g))(psib(oqr_), psib(oqu_))) implies forall([t in rr], 0 <= t implies t <= al implies psia(t) = psib(t)) implies forall([r in rr], 0 <= r implies r <= al implies psia(n * al + r) = psib(n * al + r)))

- `one-parameter-group-extension-exists-gt` — forall([s, g], is-group-topology(s, g) implies forall([al, phi], is-group-segment(s, g, al, phi) implies forsome([psi], is-one-parameter-group(s, g, psi) and forall([t in ccint(0, al)], psi(t) = phi(t)))))
- `one-parameter-group-extension-unique` — forall([g], is-top-group(g) implies forall([al, phi, psia, psib], is-group-segment(top-group-space(g), top-group-group(g), al, phi) implies is-one-parameter-group(top-group-space(g), top-group-group(g), psia) implies is-one-parameter-group(top-group-space(g), top-group-group(g), psib) implies forall([t in ccint(0, al)], psia(t) = phi(t)) implies forall([t in ccint(0, al)], psib(t) = phi(t)) implies forall([t in rr], psia(t) = psib(t))))
- `one-parameter-group-extension-unique-gt` — forall([s, g], is-group-topology(s, g) implies forall([al, phi, psia, psib], is-group-segment(s, g, al, phi) implies is-one-parameter-group(s, g, psia) implies is-one-parameter-group(s, g, psib) implies forall([t in ccint(0, al)], psia(t) = phi(t)) implies forall([t in ccint(0, al)], psib(t) = phi(t)) implies forall([t in rr], psia(t) = psib(t))))
- `ooint-center` — forall([icy_, ice_], icy_ in rr implies pos-rr(ice_) implies icy_ in ooint(icy_ - ice_, icy_ + ice_))
- `ooint-center-nested` — forall([x in rr, lfv_, lfr_ in rr], pos-rr(lfv_) implies lfv_ <= lfr_ implies ooint(x - lfv_, x + lfv_) subset ooint(x - lfr_, x + lfr_))
- `ooint-elt-in-rr` — forall([a, b, icy_ in ooint(a, b)], icy_ in rr)
- `ooint-inner-radius` — forall([pbu_ in rr, pbv_ in rr, pbt_ in ooint(pbu_, pbv_)], forsome([pbr_], pos-rr(pbr_) and ooint(pbt_ - pbr_, pbt_ + pbr_) subset ccint(pbu_, pbv_)))
- `ooint-interior-radius` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, itx_ in ooint(a, b)], forsome([itr_], pos-rr(itr_) and ooint(itx_ - itr_, itx_ + itr_) subset ooint(a, b)))
- `ooint-membership` — forall([a, b, icy_], icy_ in ooint(a, b) iff icy_ in rr and a < icy_ and icy_ < b)
- `ooint-open` — forall([a, b], a in rr implies b in rr implies is-open(rr-ms, ooint(a, b)))
- `ooint-open-nf` — forall([a, b], a in rr implies b in rr implies is-open(nf-metric-space(rr-normed-field), ooint(a, b)))
- `ooint-reflect-in` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, pay_ in ooint(a, b)], a + b - pay_ in ooint(a, b))
- `ooint-rr-iso-bijection` — vnb-lambda(x, ooint(-1, 1), (/)(x, 1 - abs(x))) in bijection(ooint(-1, 1), rr)
- `ooint-rr-iso-f-den` — forall([x in rr], abs(x) < 1 implies (1 + abs(x * recip(1 - abs(x)))) * (1 - abs(x)) = 1)
- `ooint-rr-iso-f-inv` — forall([x in rr], abs(x) < 1 implies (x * recip(1 - abs(x))) * recip(1 + abs(x * recip(1 - abs(x)))) = x)
- `ooint-rr-iso-f-real` — forall([x in rr], abs(x) < 1 implies x * recip(1 - abs(x)) in rr)
- `ooint-rr-iso-g-den` — forall([s in rr], (1 - abs(s * recip(1 + abs(s)))) * (1 + abs(s)) = 1)
- `ooint-rr-iso-g-inv` — forall([s in rr], (s * recip(1 + abs(s))) * recip(1 - abs(s * recip(1 + abs(s)))) = s)
- `ooint-rr-iso-g-mono` — forall([s in rr, t in rr], s <= t implies s * recip(1 + abs(s)) <= t * recip(1 + abs(t)))
- `ooint-rr-iso-g-small` — forall([s in rr], abs(s * recip(1 + abs(s))) < 1)
- `ooint-rr-iso-left-inverse` — forall([x in ooint(-1, 1)], (/)((/)(x, 1 - abs(x)), 1 + abs((/)(x, 1 - abs(x)))) = x)
- `ooint-rr-iso-odd` — forall([x in ooint(-1, 1)], (/)(-x, 1 - abs(-x)) = -(/)(x, 1 - abs(x)))
- `ooint-rr-iso-right-inverse` — forall([s in rr], (/)(s, 1 + abs(s)) in ooint(-1, 1) and (/)((/)(s, 1 + abs(s)), 1 - abs((/)(s, 1 + abs(s)))) = s)
- `ooint-rr-iso-strict` — forall([x in ooint(-1, 1), y in ooint(-1, 1)], x < y implies (/)(x, 1 - abs(x)) < (/)(y, 1 - abs(y)))
- `ooint-rr-order-iso` — is-order-iso(vnb-lambda(x, ooint(-1, 1), (/)(x, 1 - abs(x))), ooint(-1, 1), rr)

- `op-add-of` — forall([md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies is-commutative-ring(scal(md)) implies forall([p in carr(poly(scal(md))), q in carr(poly(scal(md)))], (op-add(md, tt))(op-of(md, tt, p), op-of(md, tt, q)) = op-of(md, tt, (add(poly(scal(md))))(p, q))))
- `op-adjoint-bound` — forall([v, w, t_, m_, y_], is-hilbert-space(v) implies is-complex-inner-product-space(w) implies t_ in bounded-ops(v, w) implies m_ in rr implies 0 <= m_ implies forall([box_ in vec(v)], ip-norm(w, t_(box_)) <= m_ * ip-norm(v, box_)) implies y_ in vec(w) implies ip-norm(v, (op-adjoint(v, w, t_))(y_)) <= m_ * ip-norm(w, y_))
- `op-adjoint-bounded` — forall([v, w, t_], is-hilbert-space(v) implies is-complex-inner-product-space(w) implies t_ in bounded-ops(v, w) implies op-adjoint(v, w, t_) in bounded-ops(w, v))
- `op-adjoint-comp` — forall([v, s_, t_], is-hilbert-space(v) implies s_ in bounded-ops(v, v) implies t_ in bounded-ops(v, v) implies op-adjoint(v, v, bop-comp(v, s_, t_)) = bop-comp(v, op-adjoint(v, v, t_), op-adjoint(v, v, s_)))
- `op-adjoint-fun` — forall([v, w, t_], is-hilbert-space(v) implies is-complex-inner-product-space(w) implies t_ in bounded-ops(v, w) implies op-adjoint(v, w, t_) in fun(vec(w), vec(v)))

- `op-adjoint-linear` — forall([v, w, t_], is-hilbert-space(v) implies is-complex-inner-product-space(w) implies t_ in bounded-ops(v, w) implies is-linear-op(w, v, op-adjoint(v, w, t_)))
- `op-adjoint-neg` — forall([v, t_], is-hilbert-space(v) implies t_ in bounded-ops(v, v) implies op-adjoint(v, v, bop-neg(v, v, t_)) = bop-neg(v, v, op-adjoint(v, v, t_)))
- `op-adjoint-opnorm-eq` — forall([v, w, t_], is-hilbert-space(v) implies is-hilbert-space(w) implies t_ in bounded-ops(v, w) implies opnorm(w, v, op-adjoint(v, w, t_)) = opnorm(v, w, t_))
- `op-adjoint-opnorm-le` — forall([v, w, t_], is-hilbert-space(v) implies is-complex-inner-product-space(w) implies t_ in bounded-ops(v, w) implies opnorm(w, v, op-adjoint(v, w, t_)) <= opnorm(v, w, t_))

- `op-adjoint-spec` — forall([v, w, t_, y_], is-hilbert-space(v) implies is-complex-inner-product-space(w) implies t_ in bounded-ops(v, w) implies y_ in vec(w) implies (op-adjoint(v, w, t_))(y_) in vec(v) and forall([bax_ in vec(v)], (ip(w))(t_(bax_), y_) = (ip(v))(bax_, (op-adjoint(v, w, t_))(y_))))
- `op-adjoint-sum` — forall([v, w, s_, t_], is-hilbert-space(v) implies is-complex-inner-product-space(w) implies s_ in bounded-ops(v, w) implies t_ in bounded-ops(v, w) implies op-adjoint(v, w, bop-sum(v, w, s_, t_)) = bop-sum(w, v, op-adjoint(v, w, s_), op-adjoint(v, w, t_)))
- `op-adjoint-type` — forall([v, w, t_, y_], is-hilbert-space(v) implies is-complex-inner-product-space(w) implies t_ in bounded-ops(v, w) implies y_ in vec(w) implies (op-adjoint(v, w, t_))(y_) in vec(v))
- `op-adjoint-unfold` — forall([bov_, bow_, bot_], op-adjoint(bov_, bow_, bot_) == vnb-lambda(boy_, vec(bow_), iota(boz_, boz_ in vec(bov_) and forall([box_ in vec(bov_)], (ip(bow_))(bot_(box_), boy_) = (ip(bov_))(box_, boz_)))))
- `op-adjoint-unique` — forall([v, w, t_, g_], is-hilbert-space(v) implies is-complex-inner-product-space(w) implies t_ in bounded-ops(v, w) implies g_ in fun(vec(w), vec(v)) implies forall([bax_ in vec(v), bay_ in vec(w)], (ip(w))(t_(bax_), bay_) = (ip(v))(bax_, g_(bay_))) implies op-adjoint(v, w, t_) = g_)

- `op-alg-mul` — forall([md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies is-commutative-ring(scal(md)) implies mul(op-alg(md, tt)) == op-mul(md, tt))

- `op-eigen-expansion` — forall([v, t_, ix, e, lm], is-hilbert-space(v) implies t_ in bounded-ops(v, v) implies is-orthonormal-basis(v, ix, e) implies lm in fun(ix, cc) implies forall([tfi_ in ix], t_(e(tfi_)) = (act(v))(lm(tfi_), e(tfi_))) implies forall([x in vec(v)], sums-to(ip-normed-ag(v), vnb-lambda(onk_, ix, (act(v))(lm(onk_) * (ip(v))(x, e(onk_)), e(onk_))), t_(x))))
- `op-eval-additive` — forall([md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies is-commutative-ring(scal(md)) implies forall([x in vec(md)], is-hom-abelian-group(ring-additive-ag(op-alg(md, tt)), module-vector-ag(md), vnb-lambda(gex_, ops(md, tt), gex_(x)))))
- `op-finsum-apply` — forall([v, w, fis_, fop_, x_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies is-complex-inner-product-space(w) implies fis_ in set implies card(fis_) in nn implies forall([tqdy_ in fis_], fop_(tqdy_) in bounded-ops(v, w)) implies x_ in vec(v) implies (finsum(normed-ag-as-abelian-group(bop-normed-ag(v, w)), fop_, fis_))(x_) = finsum(normed-ag-as-abelian-group(ip-normed-ag(w)), vnb-lambda(tqdk_, fis_, (fop_(tqdk_))(x_)), fis_))

- `op-iter-act` — forall([k in nn, md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies forall([c in carr(scal(md)), a in vec(md)], op-iter(md, tt, (act(md))(c, a), k) = (act(md))(c, op-iter(md, tt, a, k))))
- `op-iter-add` — forall([k in nn, md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies forall([a in vec(md), b in vec(md)], op-iter(md, tt, (vadd(md))(a, b), k) = (vadd(md))(op-iter(md, tt, a, k), op-iter(md, tt, b, k))))
- `op-iter-compose` — forall([e in nn, md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies forall([w in vec(md), j in nn], op-iter(md, tt, op-iter(md, tt, w, j), e) = op-iter(md, tt, w, j + e)))
- `op-iter-one` — forall([md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies forall([w in vec(md)], op-iter(md, tt, w, 1) = tt(w)))
- `op-iter-shift` — forall([k in nn, md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies forall([w in vec(md)], op-iter(md, tt, tt(w), k) = tt(op-iter(md, tt, w, k))))
- `op-iter-type` — forall([k in nn, md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies forall([w in vec(md)], op-iter(md, tt, w, k) in vec(md)))

- `op-mat-compose` — forall([md, n, u], is-module(md) implies n in nn implies 1 <= n implies u in mat(n, 1, vec(md)) implies generates(md, n, u) implies rel-free(md, n, u) implies forall([tt, ss, rr_], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies is-hom-module(md, md, ss) implies rr_ in fun(vec(md), vec(md)) implies forall([x4z in vec(md)], rr_(x4z) = ss(tt(x4z))) implies op-mat(md, n, u, rr_) = matmul(scal(md), op-mat(md, n, u, tt), op-mat(md, n, u, ss))))
- `op-mat-id` — forall([md, n, u], is-module(md) implies n in nn implies 1 <= n implies u in mat(n, 1, vec(md)) implies generates(md, n, u) implies rel-free(md, n, u) implies forall([rr_ in fun(vec(md), vec(md))], forall([x4z in vec(md)], rr_(x4z) = x4z) implies op-mat(md, n, u, rr_) = identmat(scal(md), n)))
- `op-mat-scal` — forall([md, n, u], is-module(md) implies n in nn implies 1 <= n implies u in mat(n, 1, vec(md)) implies generates(md, n, u) implies rel-free(md, n, u) implies forall([x4c in carr(scal(md)), rr_ in fun(vec(md), vec(md))], forall([x4z in vec(md)], rr_(x4z) = (act(md))(x4c, x4z)) implies op-mat(md, n, u, rr_) = matscale(scal(md), x4c, identmat(scal(md), n))))
- `op-mat-spec` — forall([md, n, u], is-module(md) implies n in nn implies 1 <= n implies u in mat(n, 1, vec(md)) implies generates(md, n, u) implies rel-free(md, n, u) implies forall([tt in fun(vec(md), vec(md))], op-mat(md, n, u, tt) in mat(n, n, carr(scal(md))) and map-seq(tt, n, u) = matact(md, op-mat(md, n, u, tt), u)))
- `op-mat-unique` — forall([md, n, u], is-module(md) implies n in nn implies 1 <= n implies u in mat(n, 1, vec(md)) implies generates(md, n, u) implies rel-free(md, n, u) implies forall([tt in fun(vec(md), vec(md)), am in mat(n, n, carr(scal(md)))], map-seq(tt, n, u) = matact(md, am, u) implies op-mat(md, n, u, tt) = am))
- `op-mul-of` — forall([md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies is-commutative-ring(scal(md)) implies forall([p in carr(poly(scal(md))), q in carr(poly(scal(md)))], (op-mul(md, tt))(op-of(md, tt, p), op-of(md, tt, q)) = op-of(md, tt, (mul(poly(scal(md))))(p, q))))
- `op-neg-of` — forall([md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies is-commutative-ring(scal(md)) implies forall([p in carr(poly(scal(md)))], (op-neg(md, tt))(op-of(md, tt, p)) = op-of(md, tt, (neg(poly(scal(md))))(p))))
- `op-of-apply` — forall([md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies is-commutative-ring(scal(md)) implies forall([p in carr(poly(scal(md))), w in vec(md)], (op-of(md, tt, p))(w) = poly-op(md, tt, p, w)))
- `op-of-in-ops` — forall([md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies is-commutative-ring(scal(md)) implies forall([p in carr(poly(scal(md)))], op-of(md, tt, p) in fun(vec(md), vec(md)) and op-of(md, tt, p) in ops(md, tt)))

- `op-range-membership` — forall([bov_, bow_, bot_, y_], y_ in op-range(bov_, bow_, bot_) iff y_ in vec(bow_) and forsome([box_ in vec(bov_)], y_ = bot_(box_)))

- `op-sqrt-unfold` — forall([kqv_, kqt_], op-sqrt(kqv_, kqt_) == iota(kqs_, is-positive-op(kqv_, kqs_) and bop-comp(kqv_, kqs_, kqs_) = kqt_))
- `op-trace-add` — forall([v], is-hilbert-space(v) implies forall([s_, t_], is-trace-class(v, s_) implies is-trace-class(v, t_) implies op-trace(v, bop-sum(v, v, s_, t_)) = op-trace(v, s_) + op-trace(v, t_)))

- `op-unit-ball-form-bound` — forall([v, t, x, y], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies t in op-unit-ball(v) implies x in vec(v) implies y in vec(v) implies magnitude((ip(v))(t(x), y)) <= ip-norm(v, x) * ip-norm(v, y))

- `open-cone-misses-subspace` — forall([m, t, c], is-tvs(rr-normed-field, m, t) implies c in opens(t) implies is-convex-subset(m, c) implies forall([cnx_ in c, cnr_ in rr], 0 < cnr_ implies (act(m))(cnr_, cnx_) in c) implies forsome([ce_ in vec(m)], not(ce_ in c)) implies forsome([d1_, d2_], d1_ in vec(m) and d2_ in vec(m) and forall([ca_ in rr, cb_ in rr], (vadd(m))((act(m))(ca_, d1_), (act(m))(cb_, d2_)) = vzero(m) implies ca_ = 0 and cb_ = 0)) implies forsome([vs], is-submodule(m, vs) and forsome([vv_ in vs], not(vv_ = vzero(m))) and forall([vx_ in vs], not(vx_ in c))))

- `open-cover-covers-point` — forall([s, f], is-open-cover(s, f) implies forall([p in pts(s)], forsome([u in f], p in u)))
- `open-eapp` — forall([u, ix, h, l], u in expr-set implies ix in nn implies h in nn implies l in tuples(expr-set) implies expr-open(eapp(h, l), ix, u) == eapp(h, maplk(open-fun(u), l, ix)))
- `open-ebind` — forall([u, ix, h, nb, a, b], u in expr-set implies ix in nn implies h in nn implies nb in nn implies a in tuples(expr-set) implies b in expr-set implies expr-open(ebind(h, nb, a, b), ix, u) == ebind(h, nb, maplk(open-fun(u), a, ix), expr-open(b, ix + nb, u)))

- `open-mapping-bounded-inverse` — forall([fld, m1, fam1, m2, fam2, tt, gg], is-nontrivially-valued(fld) implies is-frechet-structure(fld, m1, fam1) implies is-frechet-structure(fld, m2, fam2) implies is-cont-lin(m1, fam1, m2, fam2, tt) implies is-linear-map(m2, m1, gg) implies forall([x in vec(m1)], gg(tt(x)) = x) implies forall([y in vec(m2)], tt(gg(y)) = y) implies is-cont-lin(m2, fam2, m1, fam1, gg))

- `open-mapping-theorem-holomorphic` — forall([u, f], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies is-connected(cc-ms, u) implies forsome([ivx13_ in u, ivy13_ in u], not(f(ivx13_) = f(ivy13_))) implies forall([oo], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), oo) implies oo subset u implies is-open(cc-ms, {ivw14_ in cc: forsome([ivz14_ in oo], f(ivz14_) = ivw14_)})))
- `open-preimage-implies-continuous` — forall([s, t, f], is-metric-space(s) and is-metric-space(t) and f in fun(pts(s), pts(t)) implies forall([v], is-open(t, v) implies is-open(s, preimage(s, f, v))) implies is-continuous(s, t, f))
- `open-stage-coh` — forall([d in nn, u, j, e, ix], j in nn implies e in expr-stage(j) implies ix in nn implies (open-stage(u, j + d))(e, ix) == (open-stage(u, j))(e, ix))

- `open-subgroup-contains-component` — forall([g], is-top-group(g) implies forall([h], is-subgroup(top-group-group(g), h) implies h in opens(top-group-space(g)) implies connected-component(top-group-space(g), iden(top-group-group(g))) subset h))

- `operator-form-in-bounded-forms` — forall([v, t], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies t in op-unit-ball(v) implies vnb-lambda(wph_, cartesian(vec(v), vec(v)), (ip(v))(t(nth(1, wph_)), nth(2, wph_))) in {wkh_ in tprod-pts(cartesian(vec(v), vec(v)), vnb-lambda(bgx_, cartesian(vec(v), vec(v)), metric-top(cc-ms))): forall([wka_ in vec(v), wky_ in vec(v)], magnitude(wkh_([wka_, wky_])) <= ip-norm(v, wka_) * ip-norm(v, wky_)) and forall([wka_ in vec(v), wkb_ in vec(v), wky_ in vec(v)], wkh_([(vadd(v))(wka_, wkb_), wky_]) = wkh_([wka_, wky_]) + wkh_([wkb_, wky_])) and forall([wkk_ in cc, wka_ in vec(v), wky_ in vec(v)], wkh_([(act(v))(wkk_, wka_), wky_]) = wkk_ * wkh_([wka_, wky_])) and forall([wka_ in vec(v), wkb_ in vec(v), wky_ in vec(v)], wkh_([wka_, (vadd(v))(wkb_, wky_)]) = wkh_([wka_, wkb_]) + wkh_([wka_, wky_])) and forall([wkk_ in cc, wka_ in vec(v), wky_ in vec(v)], wkh_([wka_, (act(v))(wkk_, wky_)]) = conjugate(wkk_) * wkh_([wka_, wky_]))})
- `operator-of-form-unique` — forall([v, s1, s2], is-hilbert-space(v) implies s1 in bounded-ops(v, v) implies s2 in bounded-ops(v, v) implies forall([wka_ in vec(v), wky_ in vec(v)], (ip(v))(s1(wka_), wky_) = (ip(v))(s2(wka_), wky_)) implies s1 = s2)
- `opg-ext-apply` — forall([g, al, phi, t], is-group(g) implies al in rr implies 0 < al implies phi in fun(ccint(0, al), carr(g)) implies forall([gsr_ in ccint(0, al), gsu_ in ccint(0, al)], gsr_ + gsu_ <= al implies phi(gsr_ + gsu_) = (opr(g))(phi(gsr_), phi(gsu_))) implies t in rr implies (opg-ext(g, al, phi))(t) = opg-val(g, al, phi, t))
- `opg-ext-extends` — forall([g, al, phi, t], is-group(g) implies al in rr implies 0 < al implies phi in fun(ccint(0, al), carr(g)) implies forall([gsr_ in ccint(0, al), gsu_ in ccint(0, al)], gsr_ + gsu_ <= al implies phi(gsr_ + gsu_) = (opr(g))(phi(gsr_), phi(gsu_))) implies t in ccint(0, al) implies (opg-ext(g, al, phi))(t) = phi(t))
- `opg-ext-fun` — forall([g, al, phi], is-group(g) implies al in rr implies 0 < al implies phi in fun(ccint(0, al), carr(g)) implies forall([gsr_ in ccint(0, al), gsu_ in ccint(0, al)], gsr_ + gsu_ <= al implies phi(gsr_ + gsu_) = (opr(g))(phi(gsr_), phi(gsu_))) implies opg-ext(g, al, phi) in fun(rr, carr(g)))
- `opg-rep-exists` — forall([g, al, phi, t], is-group(g) implies al in rr implies 0 < al implies phi in fun(ccint(0, al), carr(g)) implies forall([gsr_ in ccint(0, al), gsu_ in ccint(0, al)], gsr_ + gsu_ <= al implies phi(gsr_ + gsu_) = (opr(g))(phi(gsr_), phi(gsu_))) implies t in rr implies forsome([y in carr(g)], opg-rep(g, al, phi, t, y)))
- `opg-rep-unique` — forall([g, al, phi, t, y1, y2], is-group(g) implies al in rr implies 0 < al implies phi in fun(ccint(0, al), carr(g)) implies forall([gsr_ in ccint(0, al), gsu_ in ccint(0, al)], gsr_ + gsu_ <= al implies phi(gsr_ + gsu_) = (opr(g))(phi(gsr_), phi(gsu_))) implies t in rr implies opg-rep(g, al, phi, t, y1) implies opg-rep(g, al, phi, t, y2) implies y1 = y2)
- `opg-val-additive` — forall([g, al, phi, a, b], is-group(g) implies al in rr implies 0 < al implies phi in fun(ccint(0, al), carr(g)) implies forall([gsr_ in ccint(0, al), gsu_ in ccint(0, al)], gsr_ + gsu_ <= al implies phi(gsr_ + gsu_) = (opr(g))(phi(gsr_), phi(gsu_))) implies a in rr implies b in rr implies opg-val(g, al, phi, a + b) = (opr(g))(opg-val(g, al, phi, a), opg-val(g, al, phi, b)))
- `opg-val-additive-nonneg` — forall([g, al, phi, a, b], is-group(g) implies al in rr implies 0 < al implies phi in fun(ccint(0, al), carr(g)) implies forall([gsr_ in ccint(0, al), gsu_ in ccint(0, al)], gsr_ + gsu_ <= al implies phi(gsr_ + gsu_) = (opr(g))(phi(gsr_), phi(gsu_))) implies a in rr implies 0 <= a implies b in rr implies 0 <= b implies opg-val(g, al, phi, a + b) = (opr(g))(opg-val(g, al, phi, a), opg-val(g, al, phi, b)))
- `opg-val-continuous` — forall([g], is-top-group(g) implies forall([al, phi], is-group-segment(top-group-space(g), top-group-group(g), al, phi) implies forall([t in rr, w in opens(top-group-space(g))], opg-val(top-group-group(g), al, phi, t) in w implies forsome([d], pos-rr(d) and forall([v in rr], abs(v - t) < d implies opg-val(top-group-group(g), al, phi, v) in w)))))
- `opg-val-continuous-gt` — forall([s, g], is-group-topology(s, g) implies forall([al, phi], is-group-segment(s, g, al, phi) implies forall([t in rr, w in opens(s)], opg-val(g, al, phi, t) in w implies forsome([d], pos-rr(d) and forall([v in rr], abs(v - t) < d implies opg-val(g, al, phi, v) in w)))))
- `opg-val-negative` — forall([g, al, phi, t], is-group(g) implies al in rr implies 0 < al implies phi in fun(ccint(0, al), carr(g)) implies forall([gsr_ in ccint(0, al), gsu_ in ccint(0, al)], gsr_ + gsu_ <= al implies phi(gsr_ + gsu_) = (opr(g))(phi(gsr_), phi(gsu_))) implies t in rr implies t < 0 implies opg-val(g, al, phi, t) = (inv(g))(opg-val(g, al, phi, 0 - t)))
- `opg-val-nonneg` — forall([g, al, phi, n, r, t], is-group(g) implies al in rr implies 0 < al implies phi in fun(ccint(0, al), carr(g)) implies forall([gsr_ in ccint(0, al), gsu_ in ccint(0, al)], gsr_ + gsu_ <= al implies phi(gsr_ + gsu_) = (opr(g))(phi(gsr_), phi(gsu_))) implies n in nn implies r in rr implies 0 <= r implies r < al implies t in rr implies 0 <= t implies t = n * al + r implies opg-val(g, al, phi, t) = (opr(g))(gpow(g, phi(al), n), phi(r)))
- `opg-val-rep` — forall([g, al, phi, t], is-group(g) implies al in rr implies 0 < al implies phi in fun(ccint(0, al), carr(g)) implies forall([gsr_ in ccint(0, al), gsu_ in ccint(0, al)], gsr_ + gsu_ <= al implies phi(gsr_ + gsu_) = (opr(g))(phi(gsr_), phi(gsu_))) implies t in rr implies opg-val(g, al, phi, t) in carr(g) and opg-rep(g, al, phi, t, opg-val(g, al, phi, t)))
- `opg-val-value` — forall([g, al, phi, t, y], is-group(g) implies al in rr implies 0 < al implies phi in fun(ccint(0, al), carr(g)) implies forall([gsr_ in ccint(0, al), gsu_ in ccint(0, al)], gsr_ + gsu_ <= al implies phi(gsr_ + gsu_) = (opr(g))(phi(gsr_), phi(gsu_))) implies t in rr implies y in carr(g) implies opg-rep(g, al, phi, t, y) implies opg-val(g, al, phi, t) = y)
- `opnorm-approx` — forall([v, w, t_, e_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies is-complex-inner-product-space(w) implies t_ in bounded-ops(v, w) implies e_ in rr implies 0 < e_ implies forsome([tqex_ in vec(v)], ip-norm(v, tqex_) <= 1 and opnorm(v, w, t_) - e_ < ip-norm(w, t_(tqex_))))
- `opnorm-approx-seq` — forall([v, t_, k_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies t_ in bounded-ops(v, v) implies 0 < opnorm(v, v, t_) implies k_ in rr implies 0 < k_ implies forsome([tqsg_ in fun(nn, vec(v))], forall([n_ in nn], ip-norm(v, tqsg_(n_)) <= 1 and opnorm(v, v, t_) - (recip(n_ + 1) * recip(n_ + 1)) * k_ < ip-norm(v, t_(tqsg_(n_))) and opnorm(v, v, t_) < 2 * ip-norm(v, t_(tqsg_(n_))))))
- `opnorm-body-cnvs-iff` — forall([v, w, t_, e_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies is-complex-inner-product-space(w) implies t_ in fun(vec(v), vec(w)) implies e_ = 0 or forsome([box_ in vec(v)], not(ip-norm(v, box_) = 0) and e_ = ip-norm(w, t_(box_)) * recip(ip-norm(v, box_))) iff e_ = 0 or forsome([cbx_ in vec(v)], not((vnrm(cips-cnvs(v)))(cbx_) = 0) and e_ = (vnrm(cips-cnvs(w)))(t_(cbx_)) * recip((vnrm(cips-cnvs(v)))(cbx_))))
- `opnorm-bound` — forall([v, w, t_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies is-complex-inner-product-space(w) implies t_ in bounded-ops(v, w) implies forall([x_ in vec(v)], ip-norm(w, t_(x_)) <= opnorm(v, w, t_) * ip-norm(v, x_)))
- `opnorm-cnvs-opnorm` — forall([v, w, t_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies is-complex-inner-product-space(w) implies t_ in fun(vec(v), vec(w)) implies opnorm(v, w, t_) == cnvs-opnorm(cips-cnvs(v), cips-cnvs(w), t_))
- `opnorm-comp-le` — forall([v, s_, t_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies s_ in bounded-ops(v, v) implies t_ in bounded-ops(v, v) implies opnorm(v, v, bop-comp(v, s_, t_)) <= opnorm(v, v, s_) * opnorm(v, v, t_))
- `opnorm-definite` — forall([v, w, t_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies is-complex-inner-product-space(w) implies t_ in bounded-ops(v, w) implies opnorm(v, w, t_) = 0 iff t_ = bop-zero(v, w))

- `polar-bound` — forall([a, b, p, d1, d2, d3, d4], d1 in rr implies d2 in rr implies d3 in rr implies d4 in rr implies 0 <= d1 implies 0 <= d2 implies 0 <= d3 implies 0 <= d4 implies a in rr implies b in rr implies a = d1 - d2 implies b = d3 - d4 implies p in rr implies 0 <= p implies p * p = a * a + b * b implies p <= (d1 + d2) + (d3 + d4))

- `polar-decomposition-exists` — forall([omega, ca, nu], is-complex-measure(omega, ca, nu) implies forsome([tv_], is-finite-measure(omega, ca, tv_) and forall([a_ in ca], tv_(a_) = 0 iff is-complex-null-set(omega, ca, nu, a_)) and forsome([u_], is-complex-measurable-fn(omega, ca, u_) and forall([x_ in omega], magnitude(u_(x_)) = 1) and forall([a_ in ca], nu(a_) = complex-integral(omega, ca, tv_, vnb-lambda(cux_, omega, (indicator(omega, a_))(cux_) * u_(cux_)))))))

- `polar-functions-exist` — forall([omega, ca, re, im], is-sigma-algebra(omega, ca) implies is-real-measurable-fn(omega, ca, re) implies is-real-measurable-fn(omega, ca, im) implies forsome([pp_, ru_, iu_], is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, pp_) and is-real-measurable-fn(omega, ca, pp_) and is-real-measurable-fn(omega, ca, ru_) and is-real-measurable-fn(omega, ca, iu_) and forall([x in omega], 0 <= pp_(x)) and forall([x in omega], pp_(x) * pp_(x) = re(x) * re(x) + im(x) * im(x)) and forall([x in omega], pp_(x) * ru_(x) = re(x)) and forall([x in omega], pp_(x) * iu_(x) = im(x)) and forall([x in omega], ru_(x) * ru_(x) + iu_(x) * iu_(x) = 1)))

- `polar-part-density-im` — forall([omega, ca, rho, mu, h, u, a], is-measure(omega, ca, rho) implies is-measure(omega, ca, mu) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, h) implies forall([rnx_ in omega], h(rnx_) in rr) implies forall([rna_ in ca], mu(rna_) = integral(omega, ca, rho, ptwise-etimes(omega, h, indicator(omega, rna_)))) implies mu(omega) in rr implies is-complex-measurable-fn(omega, ca, u) implies forall([x in omega], magnitude(u(x)) = 1) implies a in ca implies is-integrable(omega, ca, rho, vnb-lambda(ux_, omega, h(ux_) * ((indicator(omega, a))(ux_) * imag-part(u(ux_))))) and rintegral(omega, ca, mu, vnb-lambda(cix_, omega, imag-part((vnb-lambda(cux_, omega, (indicator(omega, a))(cux_) * u(cux_)))(cix_)))) = rintegral(omega, ca, rho, vnb-lambda(ux_, omega, h(ux_) * ((indicator(omega, a))(ux_) * imag-part(u(ux_))))))

- `polar-total-finite` — forall([omega, ca, rho, pp, d1, d2, d3, d4, m1, m2, m3, m4], is-measure(omega, ca, rho) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, pp) implies forall([rnx_ in omega], pp(rnx_) in rr) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, d1) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, d2) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, d3) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, d4) implies forall([rnx_ in omega], d1(rnx_) in rr) implies forall([rnx_ in omega], d2(rnx_) in rr) implies forall([rnx_ in omega], d3(rnx_) in rr) implies forall([rnx_ in omega], d4(rnx_) in rr) implies is-finite-measure(omega, ca, m1) implies is-finite-measure(omega, ca, m2) implies is-finite-measure(omega, ca, m3) implies is-finite-measure(omega, ca, m4) implies forall([rna_ in ca], m1(rna_) = integral(omega, ca, rho, ptwise-etimes(omega, d1, indicator(omega, rna_)))) implies forall([rna_ in ca], m2(rna_) = integral(omega, ca, rho, ptwise-etimes(omega, d2, indicator(omega, rna_)))) implies forall([rna_ in ca], m3(rna_) = integral(omega, ca, rho, ptwise-etimes(omega, d3, indicator(omega, rna_)))) implies forall([rna_ in ca], m4(rna_) = integral(omega, ca, rho, ptwise-etimes(omega, d4, indicator(omega, rna_)))) implies forall([x in omega], pp(x) <= (d1(x) + d2(x)) + (d3(x) + d4(x))) implies integral(omega, ca, rho, ptwise-etimes(omega, pp, indicator(omega, omega))) in rr)

- `poly-eval-add` — forall([a_], is-commutative-ring(a_) implies forall([p_ in carr(poly(a_)), q_ in carr(poly(a_)), t_ in carr(a_)], poly-eval(a_, (add(poly(a_)))(p_, q_), t_) = (add(a_))(poly-eval(a_, p_, t_), poly-eval(a_, q_, t_))))

- `poly-eval-monomial-mul` — forall([a_], is-commutative-ring(a_) implies forall([c_ in carr(a_), e_ in nn, s_ in carr(poly(a_)), t_ in carr(a_)], poly-eval(a_, (mul(poly(a_)))(monomial(a_, c_, e_), s_), t_) = (mul(a_))((mul(a_))(c_, ring-power(a_, t_, e_)), poly-eval(a_, s_, t_))))
- `poly-eval-monomial-mul-partial` — forall([j_ in nn, a_], is-commutative-ring(a_) implies forall([c_ in carr(a_), e_ in nn, s_ in carr(poly(a_)), t_ in carr(a_)], sum-ag(ring-additive-ag(a_), vnb-lambda(gek_, nn, (mul(a_))((monalg-mul(a_, nn-add-monoid, monomial(a_, c_, e_), s_))(gek_), ring-power(a_, t_, gek_))), e_ + j_) = (mul(a_))((mul(a_))(c_, ring-power(a_, t_, e_)), sum-ag(ring-additive-ag(a_), vnb-lambda(gek_, nn, (mul(a_))(s_(gek_), ring-power(a_, t_, gek_))), j_))))
- `poly-eval-mul` — forall([pmr], is-commutative-ring(pmr) implies forall([pmt in carr(pmr), pmp in carr(poly(pmr)), pmq in carr(poly(pmr))], poly-eval(pmr, (mul(poly(pmr)))(pmp, pmq), pmt) = (mul(pmr))(poly-eval(pmr, pmp, pmt), poly-eval(pmr, pmq, pmt))))
- `poly-eval-neg` — forall([a_], is-commutative-ring(a_) implies forall([q_ in carr(poly(a_)), t_ in carr(a_)], poly-eval(a_, (neg(poly(a_)))(q_), t_) = (neg(a_))(poly-eval(a_, q_, t_))))
- `poly-eval-sum-stable` — forall([j_ in nn, a_], is-commutative-ring(a_) implies forall([p_ in carr(poly(a_)), t_ in carr(a_)], sum-ag(ring-additive-ag(a_), vnb-lambda(gek_, nn, (mul(a_))(p_(gek_), ring-power(a_, t_, gek_))), succ(deg(a_, p_) + j_)) = sum-ag(ring-additive-ag(a_), vnb-lambda(gek_, nn, (mul(a_))(p_(gek_), ring-power(a_, t_, gek_))), succ(deg(a_, p_)))))
- `poly-eval-type` — forall([a_], is-commutative-ring(a_) implies forall([p_ in carr(poly(a_)), t_ in carr(a_)], poly-eval(a_, p_, t_) in carr(a_)))
- `poly-eval-x-minus-mul` — forall([a_], is-commutative-ring(a_) implies forall([al_ in carr(a_), s_ in carr(poly(a_)), t_ in carr(a_)], poly-eval(a_, (mul(poly(a_)))(x-minus(a_, al_), s_), t_) = (mul(a_))((add(a_))(t_, (neg(a_))(al_)), poly-eval(a_, s_, t_))))
- `poly-eval-zero` — forall([a_], is-commutative-ring(a_) implies forall([t_ in carr(a_)], poly-eval(a_, zero(poly(a_)), t_) = zero(a_)))
- `poly-fn-add` — forall([kk], is-cc-subring(kk) implies forall([a, f], is-poly-fn-on(kk, a, f) implies forall([g], is-poly-fn-on(kk, a, g) implies is-poly-fn-on(kk, a, vnb-lambda(pfx_, a, f(pfx_) + g(pfx_))))))
- `poly-fn-affine` — forall([kk], is-cc-subring(kk) implies forall([pfbb_, f], is-poly-fn-on(kk, pfbb_, f) implies forall([a], a subset kk implies forall([pfal_ in kk, pfbe_ in kk], forall([pfx_ in a], pfal_ * pfx_ + pfbe_ in pfbb_) implies is-poly-fn-on(kk, a, vnb-lambda(pfx_, a, f(pfal_ * pfx_ + pfbe_)))))))
- `poly-fn-affine-ps` — forall([n in nn, kk], is-cc-subring(kk) implies forall([a], a subset kk implies forall([pfal_ in kk, pfbe_ in kk, pfc_ in fun(nn, kk)], forall([pfk_ in nn], n <= pfk_ implies pfc_(pfk_) = 0) implies is-poly-fn-on(kk, a, vnb-lambda(pfx_, a, cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(pfj_, nn, pfc_(pfj_) * (pfal_ * pfx_ + pfbe_) ^ pfj_), n))))))
- `poly-fn-antiderivable` — forall([n_ in nn, cf, ph_, a, b], cf in fun(nn, rr) implies a in rr and b in rr and a < b implies ph_ in fun(rr, rr) implies forall([x_ in rr], ph_(x_) == series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(k_, nn, cf(k_) * x_ ^ k_), n_)) implies is-antiderivable(ph_, a, b))
- `poly-fn-closed-road-integral` — forall([f], is-poly-fn-on(cc, cc, f) implies forall([pgam, dgam, a, b], is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies pgam(b) = pgam(a) implies line-int(f, pgam, dgam, a, b) = 0))
- `poly-fn-comp` — forall([kk], is-cc-subring(kk) implies forall([pfbb_, f], is-poly-fn-on(kk, pfbb_, f) implies forall([a, g], is-poly-fn-on(kk, a, g) implies forall([pfx_ in a], g(pfx_) in pfbb_) implies is-poly-fn-on(kk, a, vnb-lambda(pfx_, a, f(g(pfx_)))))))
- `poly-fn-comp-ps` — forall([n in nn, kk], is-cc-subring(kk) implies forall([a, g], is-poly-fn-on(kk, a, g) implies forall([pfc_ in fun(nn, kk)], forall([pfk_ in nn], n <= pfk_ implies pfc_(pfk_) = 0) implies is-poly-fn-on(kk, a, vnb-lambda(pfx_, a, cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(pfj_, nn, pfc_(pfj_) * g(pfx_) ^ pfj_), n))))))
- `poly-fn-const` — forall([kk], is-cc-subring(kk) implies forall([a], a subset kk implies forall([pfb_ in kk], is-poly-fn-on(kk, a, vnb-lambda(pfx_, a, pfb_)))))
- `poly-fn-ext` — forall([kk, a, f], is-poly-fn-on(kk, a, f) implies forall([g in fun(a, kk)], forall([pfz_ in a], g(pfz_) = f(pfz_)) implies is-poly-fn-on(kk, a, g)))
- `poly-fn-fta` — forall([f, n in nn], 1 <= n implies is-poly-deg(cc, cc, f, n) implies forsome([z in cc], f(z) = 0))
- `poly-fn-holomorphic` — forall([u], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u) implies forall([f], is-poly-fn-on(cc, u, f) implies holomorphic-on(u, f) and forsome([pfd_], is-poly-fn-on(cc, u, pfd_) and forall([pfw_ in u], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, u, f, pfw_, pfd_(pfw_))))))
- `poly-fn-id` — forall([kk], is-cc-subring(kk) implies forall([a], a subset kk implies is-poly-fn-on(kk, a, vnb-lambda(pfx_, a, pfx_))))
- `poly-fn-lin` — forall([kk], is-cc-subring(kk) implies forall([a, f], is-poly-fn-on(kk, a, f) implies forall([g], is-poly-fn-on(kk, a, g) implies forall([pfal_ in kk, pfbe_ in kk], is-poly-fn-on(kk, a, vnb-lambda(pfx_, a, pfal_ * f(pfx_) + pfbe_ * g(pfx_)))))))
- `poly-fn-mul` — forall([kk], is-cc-subring(kk) implies forall([a, f], is-poly-fn-on(kk, a, f) implies forall([g], is-poly-fn-on(kk, a, g) implies is-poly-fn-on(kk, a, vnb-lambda(pfx_, a, f(pfx_) * g(pfx_))))))
- `poly-fn-mul-ps` — forall([n in nn, kk], is-cc-subring(kk) implies forall([a], a subset kk implies forall([pfc_ in fun(nn, kk)], forall([pfk_ in nn], n <= pfk_ implies pfc_(pfk_) = 0) implies forall([g], is-poly-fn-on(kk, a, g) implies is-poly-fn-on(kk, a, vnb-lambda(pfx_, a, cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(pfj_, nn, pfc_(pfj_) * pfx_ ^ pfj_), n) * g(pfx_)))))))
- `poly-fn-mulz` — forall([kk], is-cc-subring(kk) implies forall([a, f], is-poly-fn-on(kk, a, f) implies is-poly-fn-on(kk, a, vnb-lambda(pfx_, a, pfx_ * f(pfx_)))))
- `poly-fn-restrict` — forall([kk], is-cc-subring(kk) implies forall([a, f], is-poly-fn-on(kk, a, f) implies forall([pfaa_], pfaa_ subset a implies is-poly-fn-on(kk, pfaa_, vnb-lambda(pfx_, pfaa_, f(pfx_))))))
- `poly-fn-scale` — forall([kk], is-cc-subring(kk) implies forall([a, f], is-poly-fn-on(kk, a, f) implies forall([pfal_ in kk], is-poly-fn-on(kk, a, vnb-lambda(pfx_, a, pfal_ * f(pfx_))))))
- `poly-interpolation-exists` — forall([m_ in nn, fk], is-field-ring(fk) implies forall([th_], forall([i_ in interval(1, succ(m_))], th_(i_) in carr(fk)) implies forall([i_ in interval(1, succ(m_)), j_ in interval(1, succ(m_))], th_(i_) = th_(j_) implies i_ = j_) implies forall([v_], forall([i_ in interval(1, succ(m_))], v_(i_) in carr(fk)) implies forsome([gip_ in carr(poly(fk))], deg-bound(fk, gip_, m_) and forall([i_ in interval(1, succ(m_))], poly-eval(fk, gip_, th_(i_)) = v_(i_))))))
- `poly-interpolation-unique` — forall([m_ in nn, fk], is-field-ring(fk) implies forall([th_], forall([i_ in interval(1, succ(m_))], th_(i_) in carr(fk)) implies forall([i_ in interval(1, succ(m_)), j_ in interval(1, succ(m_))], th_(i_) = th_(j_) implies i_ = j_) implies forall([p_ in carr(poly(fk))], deg-bound(fk, p_, m_) implies forall([q_ in carr(poly(fk))], deg-bound(fk, q_, m_) implies forall([i_ in interval(1, succ(m_))], poly-eval(fk, p_, th_(i_)) = poly-eval(fk, q_, th_(i_))) implies p_ = q_))))
- `poly-is-antiderivable` — forall([n in nn, cf in fun(nn, rr), a, b], a in rr and b in rr and a < b implies is-antiderivable(vnb-lambda(x_, rr, series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(k_, nn, cf(k_) * x_ ^ k_), succ(n))), a, b))
- `poly-is-euclidean-domain` — forall([fk], is-field-ring(fk) implies is-euclidean-domain(poly(fk)))
- `poly-is-integral-domain` — forall([a_], is-integral-domain(a_) implies is-integral-domain(poly(a_)))
- `poly-is-pid-and-ufd` — forall([fk], is-field-ring(fk) implies is-pid(poly(fk)) and is-ufd(poly(fk)))
- `poly-is-ring` — forall([a], is-ring(a) implies is-ring(poly(a)))
- `poly-lam-in-fun` — forall([cf in fun(nn, rr), n in nn], vnb-lambda(x, rr, series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(k, nn, cf(k) * x ^ k), n)) in fun(rr, rr))
- `poly-le-unfold` — forall([a_, m_], poly-le(a_, m_) == {gpl_ in carr(poly(a_)): deg-bound(a_, gpl_, m_)})
- `poly-membership` — forall([a_, f_], is-ring(a_) implies f_ in carr(poly(a_)) iff f_ in sqn(carr(a_)) and card(supp(a_, nn-add-monoid, f_)) in nn)
- `poly-monomial-zero` — forall([fr], is-ring(fr) implies forall([e_ in nn], monomial(fr, zero(fr), e_) = zero(poly(fr))))
- `poly-mul-coef-in` — forall([pca, pcs], is-ring(pca) implies zero(pca) in pcs and forall([pcu in pcs, pcv in pcs], (add(pca))(pcu, pcv) in pcs) and forall([pcu in pcs, pcv in pcs], (mul(pca))(pcu, pcv) in pcs) implies forall([pcf in carr(poly(pca))], forall([pcy in nn], pcf(pcy) in pcs) implies forall([pcg in carr(poly(pca))], forall([pcy in nn], pcg(pcy) in pcs) implies forall([pcx in nn], ((mul(poly(pca)))(pcf, pcg))(pcx) in pcs))))
- `poly-mul-deg` — forall([a_], is-integral-domain(a_) implies forall([f_ in carr(poly(a_))], not(f_ = zero(poly(a_))) implies forall([g_ in carr(poly(a_))], not(g_ = zero(poly(a_))) implies not((mul(poly(a_)))(f_, g_) = zero(poly(a_))) and deg(a_, (mul(poly(a_)))(f_, g_)) = deg(a_, f_) + deg(a_, g_))))
- `poly-mul-deg-bound` — forall([a_], is-ring(a_) implies forall([f_ in carr(poly(a_)), g_ in carr(poly(a_)), n_ in nn, d_ in nn], deg-bound(a_, f_, n_) implies deg-bound(a_, g_, d_) implies deg-bound(a_, monalg-mul(a_, nn-add-monoid, f_, g_), n_ + d_)))
- `poly-mul-single-coef` — forall([a_], is-ring(a_) implies forall([f_ in carr(poly(a_)), g_ in carr(poly(a_)), n_ in nn, d_ in nn], forall([i_ in nn], not(i_ = n_) implies f_(i_) = zero(a_)) implies (monalg-mul(a_, nn-add-monoid, f_, g_))(n_ + d_) = (mul(a_))(f_(n_), g_(d_))))
- `poly-mul-single-low` — forall([a_], is-ring(a_) implies forall([f_ in carr(poly(a_)), g_ in carr(poly(a_)), n_ in nn, k_ in nn], forall([i_ in nn], not(i_ = n_) implies f_(i_) = zero(a_)) implies k_ < n_ implies (monalg-mul(a_, nn-add-monoid, f_, g_))(k_) = zero(a_)))
- `poly-mul-top-coef` — forall([a_], is-ring(a_) implies forall([f_ in carr(poly(a_)), g_ in carr(poly(a_)), n_ in nn, d_ in nn], deg-bound(a_, f_, n_) implies deg-bound(a_, g_, d_) implies (monalg-mul(a_, nn-add-monoid, f_, g_))(n_ + d_) = (mul(a_))(f_(n_), g_(d_))))
- `poly-mul-unfold` — forall([a_], is-ring(a_) implies forall([f_ in carr(poly(a_)), g_ in carr(poly(a_))], (mul(poly(a_)))(f_, g_) = monalg-mul(a_, nn-add-monoid, f_, g_)))
- `poly-neg-at` — forall([a_], is-ring(a_) implies forall([f_ in carr(poly(a_)), k_ in nn], ((neg(poly(a_)))(f_))(k_) = (neg(a_))(f_(k_))))
- `poly-neg-deg-bound` — forall([a_], is-commutative-ring(a_) implies forall([f_ in carr(poly(a_)), n_ in nn], deg-bound(a_, f_, n_) implies deg-bound(a_, (neg(poly(a_)))(f_), n_)))
- `poly-neg-monomial` — forall([fr], is-commutative-ring(fr) implies forall([c_ in carr(fr), e_ in nn], (neg(poly(fr)))(monomial(fr, c_, e_)) = monomial(fr, (neg(fr))(c_), e_)))
- `poly-nth-deriv-at-zero` — forall([tck_ in nn, n in nn, cf in fun(nn, rr)], tck_ <= n implies (nth-deriv(vnb-lambda(x, rr, series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(k, nn, cf(k) * x ^ k), succ(n))), tck_))(0) = factorial(tck_) * cf(tck_))
- `poly-nth-deriv-in-fun` — forall([tck_ in nn, n in nn, cf in fun(nn, rr)], nth-deriv(vnb-lambda(x, rr, series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(k, nn, cf(k) * x ^ k), n)), tck_) in fun(rr, rr))
- `poly-one-is-monomial` — forall([a_], is-ring(a_) implies one(poly(a_)) = monomial(a_, one(a_), 0))
- `poly-op-act` — forall([md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies is-commutative-ring(scal(md)) implies forall([p in carr(poly(scal(md))), c in carr(scal(md)), x in vec(md)], poly-op(md, tt, p, (act(md))(c, x)) = (act(md))(c, poly-op(md, tt, p, x))))
- `poly-op-add` — forall([md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies forall([p in carr(poly(scal(md))), x in vec(md), y in vec(md)], poly-op(md, tt, p, (vadd(md))(x, y)) = (vadd(md))(poly-op(md, tt, p, x), poly-op(md, tt, p, y))))
- `poly-op-bound` — forall([md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies forall([p in carr(poly(scal(md))), w in vec(md), n in nn], deg-bound(scal(md), p, n) implies poly-op(md, tt, p, w) = sum-ag(module-vector-ag(md), vnb-lambda(gpok_, nn, (act(md))(p(gpok_), op-iter(md, tt, w, gpok_))), succ(n))))
- `poly-op-commutes` — forall([md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies forall([p in carr(poly(scal(md))), w in vec(md)], poly-op(md, tt, p, tt(w)) = tt(poly-op(md, tt, p, w))))
- `poly-op-iter` — forall([j in nn, md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies forall([p in carr(poly(scal(md))), w in vec(md)], poly-op(md, tt, p, op-iter(md, tt, w, j)) = op-iter(md, tt, poly-op(md, tt, p, w), j)))
- `poly-op-kills-krylov-span` — forall([md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies is-commutative-ring(scal(md)) implies forall([p in carr(poly(scal(md))), v in vec(md)], poly-op(md, tt, p, v) = vzero(md) implies forall([n in nn, c in mat(1, n, carr(scal(md)))], poly-op(md, tt, p, lincomb(md, n, c, krylov(md, tt, v, n))) = vzero(md))))
- `poly-op-monomial` — forall([md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies is-commutative-ring(scal(md)) implies forall([c in carr(scal(md)), e in nn, w in vec(md)], poly-op(md, tt, monomial(scal(md), c, e), w) = (act(md))(c, op-iter(md, tt, w, e))))
- `poly-op-monomial-mul` — forall([md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies is-commutative-ring(scal(md)) implies forall([c in carr(scal(md)), e in nn, s in carr(poly(scal(md))), w in vec(md)], poly-op(md, tt, (mul(poly(scal(md))))(monomial(scal(md), c, e), s), w) = (act(md))(c, op-iter(md, tt, poly-op(md, tt, s, w), e))))
- `poly-op-monomial-mul-partial` — forall([j in nn, md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies is-commutative-ring(scal(md)) implies forall([c in carr(scal(md)), e in nn, s in carr(poly(scal(md))), w in vec(md)], sum-ag(module-vector-ag(md), vnb-lambda(gpok_, nn, (act(md))((monalg-mul(scal(md), nn-add-monoid, monomial(scal(md), c, e), s))(gpok_), op-iter(md, tt, w, gpok_))), e + j) = (act(md))(c, op-iter(md, tt, sum-ag(module-vector-ag(md), vnb-lambda(gpok_, nn, (act(md))(s(gpok_), op-iter(md, tt, w, gpok_))), j), e))))
- `poly-op-mul` — forall([md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies is-commutative-ring(scal(md)) implies forall([p in carr(poly(scal(md))), q in carr(poly(scal(md))), w in vec(md)], poly-op(md, tt, (mul(poly(scal(md))))(p, q), w) = poly-op(md, tt, p, poly-op(md, tt, q, w))))
- `poly-op-mul-bounded` — forall([nb in nn, md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies is-commutative-ring(scal(md)) implies forall([p in carr(poly(scal(md)))], deg-bound(scal(md), p, nb) implies forall([q in carr(poly(scal(md))), w in vec(md)], poly-op(md, tt, (mul(poly(scal(md))))(p, q), w) = poly-op(md, tt, p, poly-op(md, tt, q, w)))))
- `poly-op-one-poly` — forall([md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies is-commutative-ring(scal(md)) implies forall([w in vec(md)], poly-op(md, tt, one(poly(scal(md))), w) = w))
- `poly-op-padd` — forall([md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies is-commutative-ring(scal(md)) implies forall([p in carr(poly(scal(md))), q in carr(poly(scal(md))), w in vec(md)], poly-op(md, tt, (add(poly(scal(md))))(p, q), w) = (vadd(md))(poly-op(md, tt, p, w), poly-op(md, tt, q, w))))
- `poly-op-pneg` — forall([md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies is-commutative-ring(scal(md)) implies forall([p in carr(poly(scal(md))), w in vec(md)], poly-op(md, tt, (neg(poly(scal(md))))(p), w) = (vneg(md))(poly-op(md, tt, p, w))))
- `poly-op-sum-kernel` — forall([n in nn, md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies forall([p in carr(poly(scal(md))), g], forall([gbi_ in ord-segment(n)], g(gbi_) in vec(md)) implies forall([gbi_ in ord-segment(n)], poly-op(md, tt, p, g(gbi_)) = vzero(md)) implies poly-op(md, tt, p, sum-ag(module-vector-ag(md), g, n)) = vzero(md)))
- `poly-op-sum-stable` — forall([j in nn, md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies forall([p in carr(poly(scal(md))), w in vec(md)], sum-ag(module-vector-ag(md), vnb-lambda(gpok_, nn, (act(md))(p(gpok_), op-iter(md, tt, w, gpok_))), succ(deg(scal(md), p) + j)) = sum-ag(module-vector-ag(md), vnb-lambda(gpok_, nn, (act(md))(p(gpok_), op-iter(md, tt, w, gpok_))), succ(deg(scal(md), p)))))
- `poly-op-type` — forall([md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies forall([p in carr(poly(scal(md))), w in vec(md)], poly-op(md, tt, p, w) in vec(md)))
- `poly-op-vneg` — forall([md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies is-commutative-ring(scal(md)) implies forall([p in carr(poly(scal(md))), x in vec(md)], poly-op(md, tt, p, (vneg(md))(x)) = (vneg(md))(poly-op(md, tt, p, x))))
- `poly-op-vzero` — forall([md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies forall([p in carr(poly(scal(md)))], poly-op(md, tt, p, vzero(md)) = vzero(md)))
- `poly-op-zero-poly` — forall([md, tt], is-hom-module(md, md, tt) implies is-commutative-ring(scal(md)) implies forall([w in vec(md)], poly-op(md, tt, zero(poly(scal(md))), w) = vzero(md)))
- `poly-piece-locate` — forall([m in nn, n, tq], n in nn implies tq in fun(nn, rr) implies forall([cgk_ in nn], cgk_ < n implies tq(cgk_) < tq(succ(cgk_))) implies m < n implies forall([th in ccint(tq(0), tq(succ(m)))], forsome([k in nn], k <= m and th in ccint(tq(k), tq(succ(k))))))
