- `positively-oriented-iff` — forall([aoa_, aob_, aoc_], aoa_ in cc implies aob_ in cc implies aoc_ in cc implies not(aoa_ = aob_) implies not(aob_ = aoc_) implies not(aoc_ = aoa_) implies forsome([aov_], aov_ in interior(cc-ms, conv3(aoa_, aob_, aoc_))) implies positively-oriented(aoa_, aob_, aoc_) iff forsome([aou_ in interior(cc-ms, conv3(aoa_, aob_, aoc_))], angle(aob_ - aou_, aoa_ - aou_) < pi and angle(aoc_ - aou_, aob_ - aou_) < pi and angle(aoa_ - aou_, aoc_ - aou_) < pi))
- `post-compose` — forall([a, b, c, u, s, s2, f, h, k], a in set implies b in set implies f in fun(a, b) implies h in fun(b, c) implies k in fun(c, u) implies f in s implies compose(h, f) in s2 implies (vnb-lambda(hmpf_, s, compose(compose(k, h), hmpf_)))(f) = (vnb-lambda(hmpf_, s2, compose(k, hmpf_)))((vnb-lambda(hmpf_, s, compose(h, hmpf_)))(f)))
- `post-id` — forall([a, b, s, f], a in set implies b in set implies f in s implies f in fun(a, b) implies (vnb-lambda(hmpf_, s, compose(id-fun(b), hmpf_)))(f) = f)
- `pow-lam-in-fun` — forall([n in nn], vnb-lambda(x, rr, x ^ n) in fun(rr, rr))
- `pow-sub-holomorphic` — forall([zld_ in nn, zlu_], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), zlu_) implies forall([zlc_ in cc], holomorphic-on(zlu_, vnb-lambda(zlx_, zlu_, (zlx_ - zlc_) ^ zld_))))
- `power-antiderivable` — forall([m_, a, b], m_ in nn implies a in rr and b in rr and a < b implies is-antiderivable(vnb-lambda(x, rr, x ^ m_), a, b))
- `power-big-union-closed` — forall([a_, fam_], a_ in set implies fam_ subset power(a_) implies big-union(u_, fam_, u_) in power(a_))
- `power-closed-at` — forall([n in nn, x in rr], x ^ n in rr)
- `power-complement-closed` — forall([a_, b_], a_ in set implies complement-in(a_, b_) in power(a_))
- `power-complement-in-member` — forall([omega, a, b in power(omega)], complement-in(b, a) in power(omega))
- `power-empty-in` — forall([a_], empty-set in power(a_))
- `power-fun-union-closed` — forall([a_, f_ in fun(nn, power(a_))], big-union(n_, nn, f_(n_)) in power(a_))
- `power-insert-cover` — forall([x in set, k], k in set and not(k in x) implies power(union(x, pair(k, k))) = union(power(x), image(vnb-lambda(s, power(x), union(s, pair(k, k))), power(x))))
- `power-insert-disjoint` — forall([x in set, k], k in set and not(k in x) implies intersection(power(x), image(vnb-lambda(s, power(x), union(s, pair(k, k))), power(x))) = empty-set)
- `power-insert-injective` — forall([x in set, k_ in set], not(k_ in x) implies vnb-lambda(s, power(x), union(s, pair(k_, k_))) in injection(power(x), power(union(x, pair(k_, k_)))))
- `power-inter-closed` — forall([a_, u_, v_], u_ in power(a_) implies v_ in power(a_) implies intersection(u_, v_) in power(a_))
- `power-lin-diff-on-rhp` — forall([c6tk_ in nn, c6tc_ in cc, c6ta_ in {gmu_ in cc: 0 < real-part(gmu_)}], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, {gmu_ in cc: 0 < real-part(gmu_)}, vnb-lambda(c6tw_, {gmu_ in cc: 0 < real-part(gmu_)}, (1 - c6tw_ * c6tc_) ^ succ(c6tk_)), c6ta_, (succ(c6tk_) * (1 - c6ta_ * c6tc_) ^ c6tk_) * -c6tc_))
- `power-lin-holomorphic-rhp` — forall([c6tk_ in nn, c6tc_ in cc], holomorphic-on({gmu_ in cc: 0 < real-part(gmu_)}, vnb-lambda(c6tw_, {gmu_ in cc: 0 < real-part(gmu_)}, (1 - c6tw_ * c6tc_) ^ c6tk_)))
- `power-mem-in` — forall([a_, b_, z_], b_ in power(a_) implies z_ in b_ implies z_ in a_)
- `power-mem-intro` — forall([a_, b_ in set], forall([z_ in b_], z_ in a_) implies b_ in power(a_))
- `power-mem-sethood` — forall([a_, b_ in power(a_)], b_ in set)
- `power-of-empty` — power(empty-set) = pair(empty-set, empty-set)
- `power-real-closed` — forall([x in rr, n in nn], x ^ n in rr)
- `power-series-coefficient-bound` — forall([pcq_, a, r, m], pcq_ in fun(nn, cc) implies a in cc implies r in rr implies 0 < r implies r < cps-radius(pcq_) implies m in rr implies forall([y in cc], magnitude(y - a) = r implies magnitude(cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, pcq_(cpsk_) * (y - a) ^ cpsk_))) <= m) implies forall([k in nn], magnitude(pcq_(k)) <= m * recip(r) ^ k))
- `power-small-threshold` — forall([r in rr], 0 <= r and r < 1 implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([cap in nn], forall([k in nn], cap <= k implies r ^ k <= eps))))
- `power-sub-succ-continuous` — forall([b in rr, itk_ in nn, ity_ in rr], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, vnb-lambda(z, rr, (b - z) ^ succ(itk_)), ity_))
- `power-sub-succ-has-deriv` — forall([b in rr, itk_ in nn, itx_ in rr], has-deriv-at(vnb-lambda(z, rr, (b - z) ^ succ(itk_)), itx_, (succ(itk_) * (b - itx_) ^ itk_) * -1))
- `power-tends-to-zero` — forall([r], r in rr and abs(r) < 1 implies converges-to(rr-ms, vnb-lambda(n, nn, r ^ n), 0))
- `power-two-pos` — forall([k in nn], 0 < 2 ^ k)
- `power-whole-in` — forall([a_ in set], a_ in power(a_))
- `power-zero-base` — forall([n in nn], 0 ^ succ(n) = 0)
- `powers-card` — forall([g], is-group(g) implies forall([x in carr(g), d], is-element-order(g, x, d) implies {pwy_ in carr(g): forsome([pwk_ in zz], pwy_ = group-zpow(g, x, pwk_))} in set and card({pwy_ in carr(g): forsome([pwk_ in zz], pwy_ = group-zpow(g, x, pwk_))}) = d))
- `powers-subgroup` — forall([g], is-group(g) implies forall([x in carr(g)], is-subgroup(g, {pwy_ in carr(g): forsome([pwk_ in zz], pwy_ = group-zpow(g, x, pwk_))})))
- `powers-union-contains` — forall([g, v], is-group(g) implies v subset carr(g) implies v subset powers-union(g, v))
- `powers-union-elim` — forall([g, v, z in powers-union(g, v)], forsome([k in nn], z in set-power(g, v, k)))
- `powers-union-iden` — forall([g, v], is-group(g) implies iden(g) in powers-union(g, v))
- `powers-union-in-component` — forall([s, g], is-group-topology(s, g) implies forall([v in opens(s)], iden(g) in v implies is-connected-t(s, v) implies powers-union(g, v) subset connected-component(s, iden(g))))
- `powers-union-intro` — forall([g, v, k, z], k in nn implies z in set-power(g, v, k) implies z in powers-union(g, v))
- `powers-union-inv` — forall([k in nn, g, v], is-group(g) implies v subset carr(g) implies forall([p in v], (inv(g))(p) in v) implies forall([y in set-power(g, v, k)], (inv(g))(y) in powers-union(g, v)))
- `powers-union-is-set` — forall([g, v], is-group(g) implies powers-union(g, v) in set)
- `powers-union-open` — forall([s, g], is-group-topology(s, g) implies forall([v in opens(s)], iden(g) in v implies powers-union(g, v) in opens(s)))
- `powers-union-prod` — forall([m in nn, g, v], is-group(g) implies v subset carr(g) implies forall([x in powers-union(g, v), y in set-power(g, v, m)], (opr(g))(x, y) in powers-union(g, v)))
- `powers-union-right-mult` — forall([g, v, z, y], is-group(g) implies v subset carr(g) implies z in powers-union(g, v) implies y in v implies (opr(g))(z, y) in powers-union(g, v))
- `powers-union-sub-carr` — forall([g, v], is-group(g) implies v subset carr(g) implies powers-union(g, v) subset carr(g))
- `powers-union-subgroup` — forall([g, v], is-group(g) implies v subset carr(g) implies forall([p in v], (inv(g))(p) in v) implies is-subgroup(g, powers-union(g, v)))
- `powers-union-unfold` — forall([g, v], powers-union(g, v) == big-union(puk_, nn, set-power(g, v, puk_)))
- `pprod-cauchy-bound` — forall([c6p_ in nn, c6n_ in nn, c6a_ in fun(nn, cc), c6b_ in rr], forall([c6i_ in nn], series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, magnitude(c6a_(c6k_))), c6i_) <= c6b_) implies magnitude(pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, 1 + c6a_(c6k_)), c6n_ + c6p_) - pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, 1 + c6a_(c6k_)), c6n_)) <= (r-exp(c6b_) * r-exp(c6b_)) * (series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, magnitude(c6a_(c6k_))), c6n_ + c6p_) - series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, magnitude(c6a_(c6k_))), c6n_)))
- `pprod-dec` — forall([c6p_ in nn, c6n_ in nn, c6f_ in fun(nn, rr)], forall([c6i_ in nn], 0 < c6f_(c6i_)) implies forall([c6i_ in nn], c6f_(c6i_) <= 1) implies pprod(c6f_, c6n_ + c6p_) <= pprod(c6f_, c6n_))
- `pprod-diff-le` — forall([c6p_ in nn, c6n_ in nn, c6a_ in fun(nn, cc)], magnitude(pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, 1 + c6a_(c6k_)), c6n_ + c6p_) - pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, 1 + c6a_(c6k_)), c6n_)) <= pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, 1 + magnitude(c6a_(c6k_))), c6n_ + c6p_) - pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, 1 + magnitude(c6a_(c6k_))), c6n_))
- `pprod-exp-bounds` — forall([c6n_ in nn, c6r_ in fun(nn, rr)], forall([c6i_ in nn], 0 <= c6r_(c6i_)) implies 1 + series-partial-sum(c6r_, c6n_) <= pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, 1 + c6r_(c6k_)), c6n_) and pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, 1 + c6r_(c6k_)), c6n_) <= r-exp(series-partial-sum(c6r_, c6n_)))
- `pprod-exp-harmonic` — forall([egm_ in nn, egz_ in cc], pprod(vnb-lambda(eek_, nn, cc-exp(-(egz_ * recip(succ(eek_))))), egm_) = cc-exp(-(egz_ * series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(egj_, nn, recip(succ(egj_))), egm_))))
- `pprod-in-cc` — forall([c6n_ in nn, c6f_ in fun(nn, cc)], pprod(c6f_, c6n_) in cc)
- `pprod-in-rr` — forall([c6n_ in nn, c6f_ in fun(nn, rr)], pprod(c6f_, c6n_) in rr)
- `pprod-lower` — forall([c6n_ in nn, c6a_ in fun(nn, cc)], forall([c6i_ in nn], magnitude(c6a_(c6i_)) <= num(1/2)) implies r-exp(num(-2) * series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, magnitude(c6a_(c6k_))), c6n_)) <= magnitude(pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, 1 + c6a_(c6k_)), c6n_)))
- `pprod-mag-le` — forall([c6n_ in nn, c6a_ in fun(nn, cc)], magnitude(pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, 1 + c6a_(c6k_)), c6n_)) <= pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, 1 + magnitude(c6a_(c6k_))), c6n_))
- `pprod-magnitude` — forall([c6n_ in nn, c6f_ in fun(nn, cc)], magnitude(pprod(c6f_, c6n_)) = pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, magnitude(c6f_(c6k_))), c6n_))
- `pprod-nonzero` — forall([c6n_ in nn, c6f_ in fun(nn, cc)], forall([c6j_ in nn], c6j_ < c6n_ implies not(c6f_(c6j_) = 0)) implies not(pprod(c6f_, c6n_) = 0))
- `pprod-omr-ratio` — forall([c6p_ in nn, c6n_ in nn, c6r_ in fun(nn, rr)], forall([c6i_ in nn], 0 <= c6r_(c6i_)) implies forall([c6i_ in nn], c6r_(c6i_) < 1) implies forall([c6i_ in nn], c6n_ <= c6i_ implies c6r_(c6i_) <= num(1/2)) implies pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, 1 - c6r_(c6k_)), c6n_) * r-exp(num(-2) * (series-partial-sum(c6r_, c6n_ + c6p_) - series-partial-sum(c6r_, c6n_))) <= pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, 1 - c6r_(c6k_)), c6n_ + c6p_))
- `pprod-one-plus-le` — forall([c6n_ in nn, c6a_ in fun(nn, cc)], magnitude(pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, 1 + c6a_(c6k_)), c6n_) - 1) <= pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, 1 + magnitude(c6a_(c6k_))), c6n_) - 1)
- `pprod-opr-omr-le` — forall([c6n_ in nn, c6r_ in fun(nn, rr)], forall([c6i_ in nn], 0 <= c6r_(c6i_)) implies forall([c6i_ in nn], c6r_(c6i_) <= 1) implies 0 <= pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, 1 + c6r_(c6k_)), c6n_) * pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, 1 - c6r_(c6k_)), c6n_) and pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, 1 + c6r_(c6k_)), c6n_) * pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, 1 - c6r_(c6k_)), c6n_) <= 1)
- `pprod-pos` — forall([c6n_ in nn, c6f_ in fun(nn, rr)], forall([c6i_ in nn], 0 < c6f_(c6i_)) implies 0 < pprod(c6f_, c6n_))
- `pprod-qq-nonzero` — forall([c6tk_ in nn, c6tz_ in cc], 0 < real-part(c6tz_) implies not(pprod(vnb-lambda(egq_, nn, 1 + c6tz_ * recip(succ(egq_))), c6tk_) = 0))
- `pprod-qq-shift` — forall([c6tk_ in nn, c6tz_ in cc], succ(c6tk_) * pprod(vnb-lambda(egq_, nn, 1 + c6tz_ * recip(succ(egq_))), succ(c6tk_)) = (c6tz_ + 1) * pprod(vnb-lambda(egq_, nn, 1 + (c6tz_ + 1) * recip(succ(egq_))), c6tk_))
- `pprod-ratio-le` — forall([c6p_ in nn, c6n_ in nn, c6r_ in fun(nn, rr)], forall([c6i_ in nn], 0 <= c6r_(c6i_)) implies pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, 1 + c6r_(c6k_)), c6n_ + c6p_) <= pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, 1 + c6r_(c6k_)), c6n_) * r-exp(series-partial-sum(c6r_, c6n_ + c6p_) - series-partial-sum(c6r_, c6n_)))
- `pprod-small-converges` — forall([c6a_ in fun(nn, cc)], forall([c6i_ in nn], magnitude(c6a_(c6i_)) <= num(1/2)) implies series-converges(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, magnitude(c6a_(c6k_)))) implies forsome([c6z_ in cc], not(c6z_ = 0) and converges-to(cc-ms, vnb-lambda(c6n_, nn, pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, 1 + c6a_(c6k_)), c6n_)), c6z_)))
- `pprod-split` — forall([c6p_ in nn, c6n_ in nn, c6f_ in fun(nn, cc)], pprod(c6f_, c6n_ + c6p_) = pprod(c6f_, c6n_) * pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, c6f_(c6n_ + c6k_)), c6p_))
- `pprod-zero-factor` — forall([c6n_ in nn, c6f_ in fun(nn, cc), c6j_ in nn], c6j_ < c6n_ implies c6f_(c6j_) = 0 implies pprod(c6f_, c6n_) = 0)
- `pps-agree-below` — forall([c6n_ in nn, c6f_ in fun(nn, cc), c6g_ in fun(nn, cc)], forall([c6j_ in nn], c6j_ < c6n_ implies c6f_(c6j_) = c6g_(c6j_)) implies pprod(c6f_, c6n_) = pprod(c6g_, c6n_))
- `pps-delta` — forall([c6n_ in nn, c6s_ in nn, c6c_ in cc], (c6s_ < c6n_ implies pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, if(c6k_ = c6s_, c6c_, 1)), c6n_) = c6c_) and (c6n_ <= c6s_ implies pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, if(c6k_ = c6s_, c6c_, 1)), c6n_) = 1))
- `pps-mask` — forall([c6m_ in nn, c6n_ in nn, c6a_ in fun(nn, cc), c6g_ in fun(nn, nn)], forall([c6u_ in nn, c6v_ in nn], c6g_(c6u_) = c6g_(c6v_) implies c6u_ = c6v_) implies forall([c6u_ in nn], c6u_ < c6m_ implies c6g_(c6u_) < c6n_) implies pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, c6a_(c6g_(c6k_))), c6m_) = pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, if(forsome([c6t_ in nn], c6t_ < c6m_ and c6g_(c6t_) = c6k_), c6a_(c6k_), 1)), c6n_))
- `pps-mul` — forall([c6n_ in nn, c6f_ in fun(nn, cc), c6g_ in fun(nn, cc)], pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, c6f_(c6k_) * c6g_(c6k_)), c6n_) = pprod(c6f_, c6n_) * pprod(c6g_, c6n_))
- `pps-trunc` — forall([c6p_ in nn, c6n_ in nn, c6a_ in fun(nn, cc)], pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, if(c6k_ < c6n_, c6a_(c6k_), 1)), c6n_ + c6p_) = pprod(c6a_, c6n_))
- `ppx-continuous` — forall([c6n_ in nn, c6u_], c6u_ subset cc implies forall([c6f_ in fun(nn, fun(c6u_, cc))], forall([c6i_ in nn], c6f_(c6i_) in cc-cont-fns(c6u_)) implies vnb-lambda(c6x_, c6u_, pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, 1 + (c6f_(c6k_))(c6x_)), c6n_)) in cc-cont-fns(c6u_)))
- `ppx-holomorphic` — forall([c6n_ in nn, c6u_], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), c6u_) implies forall([c6f_ in fun(nn, fun(c6u_, cc))], forall([c6i_ in nn], holomorphic-on(c6u_, c6f_(c6i_))) implies holomorphic-on(c6u_, vnb-lambda(c6x_, c6u_, pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, 1 + (c6f_(c6k_))(c6x_)), c6n_)))))
- `ppx-log-deriv` — forall([c6n_ in nn, c6u_], is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), c6u_) implies forall([c6f_ in fun(nn, fun(c6u_, cc))], forall([c6i_ in nn], holomorphic-on(c6u_, c6f_(c6i_))) implies forall([c6z_ in c6u_], forall([c6q_ in nn], not(1 + (c6f_(c6q_))(c6z_) = 0)) implies deriv-on(cc-normed-field, c6u_, vnb-lambda(c6x_, c6u_, pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, 1 + (c6f_(c6k_))(c6x_)), c6n_)), c6z_) = pprod(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, 1 + (c6f_(c6k_))(c6z_)), c6n_) * cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, deriv-on(cc-normed-field, c6u_, vnb-lambda(c6x_, c6u_, 1 + (c6f_(c6k_))(c6x_)), c6z_) * recip(1 + (c6f_(c6k_))(c6z_))), c6n_))))
- `pq-add` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies add(qq-padic(p)) = vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(qq, qq), x_ + y_))
- `pq-carr` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies carr(qq-padic(p)) = qq)
- `pq-fnrm` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies fnrm(qq-padic(p)) = padic-abs(p))
- `pq-mul` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies mul(qq-padic(p)) = vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(qq, qq), x_ * y_))
- `pq-neg` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies neg(qq-padic(p)) = vnb-lambda(x_, qq, -x_))
- `pq-one` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies one(qq-padic(p)) = 1)
- `pq-zero` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies zero(qq-padic(p)) = 0)
- `pre-compose` — forall([a, b, c, u, s, s2, f, h, k], a in set implies b in set implies k in fun(a, b) implies h in fun(b, c) implies f in fun(c, u) implies f in s implies compose(f, h) in s2 implies (vnb-lambda(hmpf_, s, compose(hmpf_, compose(h, k))))(f) = (vnb-lambda(hmpf_, s2, compose(hmpf_, k)))((vnb-lambda(hmpf_, s, compose(hmpf_, h)))(f)))
- `pre-id` — forall([a, b, s, f], a in set implies f in s implies f in fun(a, b) implies (vnb-lambda(hmpf_, s, compose(hmpf_, id-fun(a))))(f) = f)
- `prec-strict-unfold` — forall([spa, nd, ed], prec-strict(spa, nd, ed) == {ssp_ in cartesian(nd, nd): forall([ssq_ in power(cartesian(nd, nd))], is-prec-closed(spa, nd, ed, ssq_) implies ssp_ in ssq_)})
- `precedes-antisym` — forall([c, x, y], is-bundle(c) implies [x, y] in precedes(c) implies [y, x] in precedes(c) implies x = y)
- `precedes-elim` — forall([c, x, y], [x, y] in precedes(c) implies [x, y] in precedes-strict(c) or x = y and x in bnodes(c))
- `precedes-intro-strict` — forall([c, x, y], is-bundle(c) implies [x, y] in precedes-strict(c) implies [x, y] in precedes(c))
- `precedes-partial-order` — forall([c], is-bundle(c) implies is-partial-order(bnodes(c), precedes(c)))
- `precedes-refl` — forall([c, x in bnodes(c)], [x, x] in precedes(c))
- `precedes-set` — forall([c], is-bundle(c) implies precedes(c) in set)
- `precedes-strict-irreflexive` — forall([c, x], is-bundle(c) implies not([x, x] in precedes-strict(c)))
- `precedes-strict-trans` — forall([c, x, y, z], is-bundle(c) implies [x, y] in precedes-strict(c) implies [y, z] in precedes-strict(c) implies [x, z] in precedes-strict(c))
- `precedes-strict-unfold` — forall([c], precedes-strict(c) == prec-strict(bspace(c), bnodes(c), bsend(c)))
- `precedes-trans` — forall([c, x, y, z], is-bundle(c) implies [x, y] in precedes(c) implies [y, z] in precedes(c) implies [x, z] in precedes(c))
- `precedes-unfold` — forall([c], precedes(c) == union(precedes-strict(c), {ssp_ in cartesian(bnodes(c), bnodes(c)): nth(1, ssp_) = nth(2, ssp_)}))
- `pred-code-nn` — forall([k], pred-code(k) implies k in nn)

- `prefix-dist-large` — forall([sx_, a, xs, ys], a in fun(sx_, rr) implies forall([w in sx_], 1 < a(w)) implies xs in fun(nn, sx_) implies ys in fun(nn, sx_) implies forall([k in nn], not(xs(k) = ys(k)) implies recip(prefix-prod(a, ys, k)) <= prefix-dist(a, xs, ys)))
- `prefix-dist-nonneg` — forall([sx_, a, xs, ys], a in fun(sx_, rr) implies forall([w in sx_], 1 < a(w)) implies xs in fun(nn, sx_) implies ys in fun(nn, sx_) implies prefix-dist(a, xs, ys) in rr and 0 <= prefix-dist(a, xs, ys))
- `prefix-dist-self` — forall([a, xs], prefix-dist(a, xs, xs) = 0)
- `prefix-dist-small` — forall([sx_, a, xs, ys], a in fun(sx_, rr) implies forall([w in sx_], 1 < a(w)) implies xs in fun(nn, sx_) implies ys in fun(nn, sx_) implies forall([n in nn], forall([j in nn], j < n implies xs(j) = ys(j)) implies prefix-dist(a, xs, ys) <= recip(prefix-prod(a, ys, n))))
- `prefix-dist-sym` — forall([sx_, a, xs, ys], a in fun(sx_, rr) implies forall([w in sx_], 1 < a(w)) implies xs in fun(nn, sx_) implies ys in fun(nn, sx_) implies prefix-dist(a, xs, ys) = prefix-dist(a, ys, xs))
- `prefix-dist-ultra` — forall([sx_, a, xs, ys, zs], a in fun(sx_, rr) implies forall([w in sx_], 1 < a(w)) implies xs in fun(nn, sx_) implies ys in fun(nn, sx_) implies zs in fun(nn, sx_) implies prefix-dist(a, xs, ys) <= max(prefix-dist(a, xs, zs), prefix-dist(a, zs, ys)))
- `prefix-dist-value` — forall([sx_, a, xs, ys], a in fun(sx_, rr) implies forall([w in sx_], 1 < a(w)) implies xs in fun(nn, sx_) implies ys in fun(nn, sx_) implies not(xs = ys) implies prefix-dist(a, xs, ys) = recip(prefix-prod(a, xs, agree-length(xs, ys))) and recip(prefix-prod(a, xs, agree-length(xs, ys))) in rr and 0 < recip(prefix-prod(a, xs, agree-length(xs, ys))))
- `prefix-eq-agree` — forall([z in fun(nn, nn), w in fun(nn, nn), n in nn], restrict(w, ord-segment(n)) = restrict(z, ord-segment(n)) implies forall([k in nn], k < n implies w(k) = z(k)))
- `prefix-eq-intro` — forall([z in fun(nn, nn), w in fun(nn, nn), n in nn], forall([k in nn], k < n implies w(k) = z(k)) implies restrict(w, ord-segment(n)) = restrict(z, ord-segment(n)))
- `prefix-eq-le` — forall([z in fun(nn, nn), w in fun(nn, nn), n in nn, m in nn], m <= n implies restrict(w, ord-segment(n)) = restrict(z, ord-segment(n)) implies restrict(w, ord-segment(m)) = restrict(z, ord-segment(m)))
- `prefix-eventually-agrees` — forall([n in nn, sx_, zs, u], zs in fun(nn, fun(nn, sx_)) implies u in fun(nn, sx_) implies forall([ck_ in nn], forsome([cn_ in nn], forall([ci_ in nn], cn_ <= ci_ implies (zs(ci_))(ck_) = u(ck_)))) implies forsome([pn_ in nn], forall([pi_ in nn], pn_ <= pi_ implies forall([pj_ in nn], pj_ < n implies (zs(pi_))(pj_) = u(pj_)))))
- `prefix-in-nstar` — forall([z in fun(nn, nn), n in nn], restrict(z, ord-segment(n)) in fun(ord-segment(n), nn) and restrict(z, ord-segment(n)) in nstar)
- `prefix-prod-agree-ind` — forall([n in nn, sx_, a, xs, ys], a in fun(sx_, rr) implies forall([w in sx_], 1 < a(w)) implies xs in fun(nn, sx_) implies ys in fun(nn, sx_) implies forall([j in nn], j < n implies xs(j) = ys(j)) implies prefix-prod(a, xs, n) = prefix-prod(a, ys, n))
- `prefix-prod-ge-one` — forall([sx_, a, xs], a in fun(sx_, rr) implies forall([w in sx_], 1 < a(w)) implies xs in fun(nn, sx_) implies forall([n in nn], prefix-prod(a, xs, n) in rr and 1 <= prefix-prod(a, xs, n)))
- `prefix-prod-ge-one-ind` — forall([n in nn, sx_, a, xs], a in fun(sx_, rr) implies forall([w in sx_], 1 < a(w)) implies xs in fun(nn, sx_) implies prefix-prod(a, xs, n) in rr and 1 <= prefix-prod(a, xs, n))
- `prefix-prod-mono` — forall([sx_, a, xs], a in fun(sx_, rr) implies forall([w in sx_], 1 < a(w)) implies xs in fun(nn, sx_) implies forall([m in nn, n in nn], m <= n implies prefix-prod(a, xs, m) <= prefix-prod(a, xs, n)))
- `preimage-complement` — forall([s, t, f, u], is-metric-space(s) and is-metric-space(t) and f in fun(pts(s), pts(t)) implies preimage(s, f, complement-in(pts(t), u)) = complement-in(pts(s), preimage(s, f, u)))

- `preimage-subspace-open` — forall([s, t, fqf_], is-continuous(s, t, fqf_) implies forall([bqb_], bqb_ subset pts(t) implies forall([zqp_ in pts(s)], fqf_(zqp_) in bqb_) implies forall([wqu_], is-open(subspace-ms(t, bqb_), wqu_) implies is-open(s, preimage(s, fqf_, wqu_)))))
- `prime-decomposition` — forall([q], is-prime-nat(q) implies forall([n in nn], 1 <= n implies forsome([qda_ in nn, qdm_ in nn], 1 <= qdm_ and n = q ^ qda_ * qdm_ and not(zz-divides(q, qdm_)))))
- `prime-decomposition-bounded` — forall([k in nn, q], is-prime-nat(q) implies forall([n in nn], 1 <= n implies n <= k implies forsome([qda_ in nn, qdm_ in nn], 1 <= qdm_ and n = q ^ qda_ * qdm_ and not(zz-divides(q, qdm_)))))
- `prime-divides-binomial` — forall([p], is-prime-nat(p) implies forall([i in nn], 0 < i implies i < p implies zz-divides(p, choose(p, i))))

- `prime-divisor-bounded` — forall([nb_ in nn, s, dfn], is-degree-function(s, dfn) implies forall([a in carr(s)], dfn(a) < nb_ implies not(a = zero(s)) implies not(is-unit(s, a)) implies forsome([p], is-prime-element(s, p) and forsome([d in carr(s)], a = (mul(s))(p, d)))))
- `prime-factorization-exists` — forall([a in nn], 1 <= a implies forsome([ntk_ in nn, ntp_], forall([nti_ in interval(1, ntk_)], is-prime-nat(ntp_(nti_))) and a = prod-ring(zz-ring, ntp_, interval(1, ntk_))))
- `prime-factorization-unique` — forall([k in nn, p], forall([nti_ in interval(1, k)], is-prime-nat(p(nti_))) implies forall([m in nn, q], forall([nti_ in interval(1, m)], is-prime-nat(q(nti_))) implies prod-ring(zz-ring, p, interval(1, k)) = prod-ring(zz-ring, q, interval(1, m)) implies k = m and forsome([nts_ in bijection(interval(1, k), interval(1, m))], forall([nti_ in interval(1, k)], q(nts_(nti_)) = p(nti_)))))
- `prime-nat-associated-equal` — forall([p], is-prime-nat(p) implies forall([q], is-prime-nat(q) implies associated(zz-ring, p, q) implies p = q))
- `prime-nat-divides-prime` — forall([q], is-prime-nat(q) implies forall([p], is-prime-nat(p) implies zz-divides(q, p) implies q = p))

- `prime-set-multiples-count` — forall([n in nn], 1 <= n implies forall([ff in set], card(ff) in nn implies forall([ntp_ in ff], is-prime-nat(ntp_)) implies forall([ntp_ in ff], zz-divides(ntp_, n)) implies prod-ring(zz-ring, vnb-lambda(nzp_, zz, nzp_), ff) * card({iex_ in interval(1, n): forall([iek_ in ff], iex_ in (vnb-lambda(nzf_, nn, {nzm_ in zz: zz-divides(nzf_, nzm_)}))(iek_))}) = n))
- `prime-set-product` — forall([ff in set], card(ff) in nn implies forall([ntp_ in ff], is-prime-nat(ntp_)) implies prod-ring(zz-ring, vnb-lambda(nzp_, zz, nzp_), ff) in nn and 1 <= prod-ring(zz-ring, vnb-lambda(nzp_, zz, nzp_), ff) and forall([ntp_ in ff], zz-divides(ntp_, prod-ring(zz-ring, vnb-lambda(nzp_, zz, nzp_), ff))) and forall([ntq_ in nn], is-prime-nat(ntq_) implies zz-divides(ntq_, prod-ring(zz-ring, vnb-lambda(nzp_, zz, nzp_), ff)) implies ntq_ in ff) and forall([ntk_ in zz], forall([ntp_ in ff], zz-divides(ntp_, ntk_)) implies zz-divides(prod-ring(zz-ring, vnb-lambda(nzp_, zz, nzp_), ff), ntk_)))
- `prime-set-recip-product` — forall([ff in set], card(ff) in nn implies forall([ntp_ in ff], is-prime-nat(ntp_)) implies prod-ring(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field), vnb-lambda(nza_, nn, -recip(nza_)), ff) = (-1) ^ card(ff) * recip(prod-ring(zz-ring, vnb-lambda(nzp_, zz, nzp_), ff)))

- `primitive-family-deriv-at` — forall([a in rr, b in rr], a < b implies forall([gfam in fun(nn, fun(ccint(a, b), rr)), ffam in fun(nn, fun(ccint(a, b), rr)), pufc_ in fun(rr, rr), put_ in ooint(a, b), pulv_ in rr], forall([puk_ in nn], is-primitive(gfam(puk_), ffam(puk_), a, b)) implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([pun_ in nn], forall([puk_ in nn, pul_ in nn], pun_ <= puk_ implies pun_ <= pul_ implies forall([pux_ in ccint(a, b)], abs((ffam(puk_))(pux_) - (ffam(pul_))(pux_)) <= eps)))) implies forall([pux_ in ccint(a, b)], converges-to(rr-ms, vnb-lambda(puk_, nn, (gfam(puk_))(pux_)), pufc_(pux_))) implies forall([puk_ in nn], has-deriv-at(gfam(puk_), put_, (ffam(puk_))(put_))) implies converges-to(rr-ms, vnb-lambda(puk_, nn, (ffam(puk_))(put_)), pulv_) implies is-diff-at(pufc_, put_, pulv_)))
- `primitive-family-limit` — forall([a in rr, b in rr], a < b implies forall([gfam in fun(nn, fun(ccint(a, b), rr)), ffam in fun(nn, fun(ccint(a, b), rr))], forall([puk_ in nn], is-primitive(gfam(puk_), ffam(puk_), a, b)) implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([pun_ in nn], forall([puk_ in nn, pul_ in nn], pun_ <= puk_ implies pun_ <= pul_ implies forall([pux_ in ccint(a, b)], abs((ffam(puk_))(pux_) - (ffam(pul_))(pux_)) <= eps)))) implies forall([puk_ in nn], (gfam(puk_))(a) = 0) implies forsome([pufc_ in fun(rr, rr)], forall([pux_ in ccint(a, b)], converges-to(rr-ms, vnb-lambda(puk_, nn, (gfam(puk_))(pux_)), pufc_(pux_))) and forall([put_ in rr], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, pufc_, put_)))))
- `primitive-family-normalised-choice` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, rhpff_], forall([rhpk_ in nn], forsome([rhpg_], is-primitive(rhpg_, rhpff_(rhpk_), a, b))) implies forsome([rhpgf_ in fun(nn, fun(ccint(a, b), rr))], forall([rhpk_ in nn], is-primitive(rhpgf_(rhpk_), rhpff_(rhpk_), a, b) and (rhpgf_(rhpk_))(a) = 0)))

- `primitive-of-constant-piece` — forall([u in rr, v in rr], u < v implies forall([f in fun(rr, rr), cv in rr, k in rr], forall([t_], t_ in rr and u < t_ and t_ < v implies f(t_) = cv) implies is-primitive(vnb-lambda(pgs_, ccint(u, v), k + cv * (pgs_ - u)), restrict(f, ccint(u, v)), u, v)))
- `primitive-pair-lipschitz` — forall([a, b, pug1_, puf1_, pug2_, puf2_, pum_ in rr], is-primitive(pug1_, puf1_, a, b) implies is-primitive(pug2_, puf2_, a, b) implies forall([pux_ in ccint(a, b)], abs(puf1_(pux_) - puf2_(pux_)) <= pum_) implies forall([pux_ in ccint(a, b), puy_ in ccint(a, b)], pux_ < puy_ implies abs(pug1_(puy_) - pug2_(puy_) - (pug1_(pux_) - pug2_(pux_))) <= pum_ * (puy_ - pux_)))

- `primitive-root-coprime` — forall([n in nn], 1 <= n implies forall([j in zz], cc-exp(((2 * pi) * 1i) * (j * recip(n))) in primitive-roots(n) implies zz-coprime(j, n)))

- `principal-part-integral` — forall([ppa_, u0, pgam, dgam, a, b], ppa_ in fun(nn, cc) implies u0 in cc implies is-road(pgam, dgam, a, b) implies trace(pgam, a, b) subset difference(cc, singleton(u0)) implies pgam(b) = pgam(a) implies forall([ppn_ in nn], 1 <= ppn_ implies recip((2 * pi) * 1i) * line-int(vnb-lambda(ppw_, difference(cc, singleton(u0)), cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(ppj_, nn, ppa_(succ(ppj_)) * recip(ppw_ - u0) ^ succ(ppj_)), ppn_)), pgam, dgam, a, b) = ppa_(1) * winding(pgam, dgam, a, b, u0)))

- `principal-sequence-exists` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = zz-ring implies forall([n, u, sm], n in nn implies u in mat(n, 1, vec(md)) implies generates(md, n, u) implies rel-free(md, n, u) implies is-submodule(md, sm) implies forsome([es, dm], is-principal-sequence(md, n, sm, es, dm))))

- `prop-6-14-forward` — forall([c6u_], is-open(cc-ms, c6u_) implies forall([c6f_ in fun(nn, fun(c6u_, cc)), c6n_ in nn], is-normally-convergent(c6f_, cc-exhaust(c6u_, c6n_)) implies forsome([c6m_ in nn], forall([c6q_ in nn], c6m_ <= c6q_ implies forall([c6w_ in cc-exhaust(c6u_, c6n_)], not(imag-part(1 + (c6f_(c6q_))(c6w_)) = 0 and real-part(1 + (c6f_(c6q_))(c6w_)) <= 0))) and is-normally-convergent(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, vnb-lambda(c6x_, cc-exhaust(c6u_, c6n_), cc-log(1 + (c6f_(c6m_ + c6k_))(c6x_)))), cc-exhaust(c6u_, c6n_)))))
- `prop-6-17` — forall([c6u_], is-open(cc-ms, c6u_) implies forall([c6f_ in fun(nn, fun(c6u_, cc))], forall([c6i_ in nn], holomorphic-on(c6u_, c6f_(c6i_))) implies prod-normal-on-compacta(c6u_, c6f_) implies forall([c6z_ in c6u_], not((prod-fun(c6u_, c6f_))(c6z_) = 0) implies cc-series-converges-to(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, deriv-on(cc-normed-field, c6u_, vnb-lambda(c6x_, c6u_, 1 + (c6f_(c6k_))(c6x_)), c6z_) * recip(1 + (c6f_(c6k_))(c6z_))), deriv-on(cc-normed-field, c6u_, prod-fun(c6u_, c6f_), c6z_) * recip((prod-fun(c6u_, c6f_))(c6z_))))))
- `prop-6-22` — forall([c6a_ in fun(nn, cc)], forall([c6q_ in nn], not(c6a_(c6q_) = 0)) implies forall([c6r_ in rr], forsome([c6m_ in nn], forall([c6q_ in nn], c6m_ <= c6q_ implies c6r_ <= magnitude(c6a_(c6q_))))) implies forall([c6t_ in nn], forall([c6r_ in rr], 0 <= c6r_ implies series-converges(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, (c6r_ * recip(magnitude(c6a_(c6k_)))) ^ succ((vnb-lambda(c6tk_, nn, c6t_))(c6k_)) * recip(succ((vnb-lambda(c6tk_, nn, c6t_))(c6k_)))))) implies forall([c6f_], holomorphic-on(cc, c6f_) implies forsome([c6w_ in cc], not(c6f_(c6w_) = 0)) implies forall([c6m_ in nn, c6g_, c6h_], holomorphic-on(cc, c6g_) implies holomorphic-on(cc, c6h_) implies forall([c6z_ in cc], c6f_(c6z_) = (c6z_ ^ c6m_ * cc-exp(c6g_(c6z_))) * (prod-fun(cc, vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, vnb-lambda(c6x_, cc, (1 - c6x_ * recip(c6a_(c6k_))) * cc-exp(cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(clhk_, nn, recip-star(clhk_) * (c6x_ * recip(c6a_(c6k_))) ^ clhk_), succ((vnb-lambda(c6tk_, nn, c6t_))(c6k_)))) - 1))))(c6z_)) implies forall([c6z_ in cc], c6f_(c6z_) = (c6z_ ^ c6m_ * cc-exp(c6h_(c6z_))) * (prod-fun(cc, vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, vnb-lambda(c6x_, cc, (1 - c6x_ * recip(c6a_(c6k_))) * cc-exp(cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(clhk_, nn, recip-star(clhk_) * (c6x_ * recip(c6a_(c6k_))) ^ clhk_), succ((vnb-lambda(c6tk_, nn, c6t_))(c6k_)))) - 1))))(c6z_)) implies forall([c6p_ in cc, c6r_ in cc], c6g_(c6p_) - c6h_(c6p_) = c6g_(c6r_) - c6h_(c6r_))))))
- `prop-6-8` — forall([c6a_ in fun(nn, cc)], series-converges(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, magnitude(c6a_(c6k_)))) iff forsome([c6m_ in nn], forall([c6q_ in nn], c6m_ <= c6q_ implies not(imag-part(1 + c6a_(c6q_)) = 0 and real-part(1 + c6a_(c6q_)) <= 0)) and series-converges(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, magnitude(cc-log(1 + c6a_(c6m_ + c6k_)))))))
- `prop-6-8-backward` — forall([c6m_ in nn, c6a_ in fun(nn, cc)], forall([c6q_ in nn], c6m_ <= c6q_ implies not(imag-part(1 + c6a_(c6q_)) = 0 and real-part(1 + c6a_(c6q_)) <= 0)) implies series-converges(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, magnitude(cc-log(1 + c6a_(c6m_ + c6k_))))) implies series-converges(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, magnitude(c6a_(c6k_)))))
- `prop-6-8-forward` — forall([c6m_ in nn, c6a_ in fun(nn, cc)], series-converges(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, magnitude(c6a_(c6k_)))) implies forall([c6q_ in nn], c6m_ <= c6q_ implies magnitude(c6a_(c6q_)) <= num(1/10)) implies series-converges(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, magnitude(cc-log(1 + c6a_(c6m_ + c6k_))))))
- `proper-subset-witness` — forall([a, b], a subset b implies not(a = b) implies forsome([x_ in b], not(x_ in a)))
- `proposition-6-28` — holomorphic-on(cc, recip-gamma) and forall([egn_ in nn], has-zero-of-order(cc, recip-gamma, -egn_, 1)) and forall([egw_ in cc], forall([egn_ in nn], not(egw_ = -egn_)) implies not(recip-gamma(egw_) = 0))
- `proposition-6-28-gamma` — forall([egn_ in nn], is-pole(gamma-product, -egn_, 1)) and forall([egw_ in {egu_ in cc: forall([egn_ in nn], not(egu_ = -egn_))}], not(gamma-product(egw_) = 0))
- `proposition-6-29` — forall([c6tz_ in cc], 0 < real-part(c6tz_) implies gamma-function(c6tz_) = recip(recip-gamma(c6tz_)))
- `ps-abs-term` — forall([coef in fun(nn, rr), x in rr, n in nn], abs(coef(n) * x ^ n) = abs(coef(n)) * abs(x) ^ n)
- `ps-absolute-implies-convergent` — forall([coef in fun(nn, rr), x], x in rr and ps-absolutely-converges-at(coef, x) implies ps-converges-at(coef, x))
- `ps-converges-as-series` — forall([coef in fun(nn, rr), x in rr], ps-converges-at(coef, x) iff series-converges(vnb-lambda(n, nn, coef(n) * x ^ n)))
- `ps-in-box` — forall([spa, nd, ed, x, y], [x, y] in prec-strict(spa, nd, ed) implies x in nd and y in nd)
- `ps-last-step` — forall([spa, nd, ed], nd in set implies ed in power(cartesian(nd, nd)) implies forall([x, y], [x, y] in prec-strict(spa, nd, ed) implies forsome([z], ([z, y] in ed or z in nd and same-strand-before(spa, z, y)) and (z = x or [x, z] in prec-strict(spa, nd, ed)))))
- `ps-least` — forall([spa, nd, ed, r in power(cartesian(nd, nd))], is-prec-closed(spa, nd, ed, r) implies forall([x, y], [x, y] in prec-strict(spa, nd, ed) implies [x, y] in r))
- `ps-partial-sum-as-series` — forall([coef in fun(nn, rr), x in rr, k in nn], ps-partial-sum(coef, x, k) = series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(n, nn, coef(n) * x ^ n), k))
- `ps-send` — forall([spa, nd, ed, x, y], ed in power(cartesian(nd, nd)) implies [x, y] in ed implies [x, y] in prec-strict(spa, nd, ed))
- `ps-ssb` — forall([spa, nd, ed, x, y], x in nd implies y in nd implies same-strand-before(spa, x, y) implies [x, y] in prec-strict(spa, nd, ed))
- `ps-trans` — forall([spa, nd, ed, x, y, z], [x, y] in prec-strict(spa, nd, ed) implies [y, z] in prec-strict(spa, nd, ed) implies [x, z] in prec-strict(spa, nd, ed))
- `psd-form-hermitian` — forall([md, fq], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-psd-form(md, fq) implies is-hermitian-form(md, fq))
- `psd-form-neg-left` — forall([md, fq, x_, y_], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-psd-form(md, fq) implies x_ in vec(md) implies y_ in vec(md) implies fq((vneg(md))(x_), y_) = -fq(x_, y_))
- `psd-form-neg-right` — forall([md, fq, x_, y_], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-psd-form(md, fq) implies x_ in vec(md) implies y_ in vec(md) implies fq(x_, (vneg(md))(y_)) = -fq(x_, y_))
- `psd-form-nonneg` — forall([md, fq, x_], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-psd-form(md, fq) implies x_ in vec(md) implies 0 <= fq(x_, x_))
- `psd-form-null-orth` — forall([md, fq, n_, y_], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-psd-form(md, fq) implies n_ in vec(md) implies fq(n_, n_) = 0 implies y_ in vec(md) implies fq(n_, y_) = 0)
- `psd-form-null-right` — forall([md, fq, n_, y_], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-psd-form(md, fq) implies n_ in vec(md) implies fq(n_, n_) = 0 implies y_ in vec(md) implies fq(y_, n_) = 0)
- `psd-form-real` — forall([md, fq, x_], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-psd-form(md, fq) implies x_ in vec(md) implies fq(x_, x_) in rr)
- `psd-form-zero` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([fq], is-psd-form(md, fq) implies fq(vzero(md), vzero(md)) = 0))
- `psd-form-zero-left` — forall([md, fq, y_], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-psd-form(md, fq) implies y_ in vec(md) implies fq(vzero(md), y_) = 0)
- `pseudometric-pos` — forall([dst, crr], is-pseudometric(dst, crr) implies forall([u in crr, v in crr], 0 <= dst(u, v)))
- `pseudometric-self-zero` — forall([dst, crr], is-pseudometric(dst, crr) implies forall([u in crr], dst(u, u) = 0))
- `pseudometric-sym` — forall([dst, crr], is-pseudometric(dst, crr) implies forall([u in crr, v in crr], dst(u, v) = dst(v, u)))
- `pseudometric-triangle` — forall([dst, crr], is-pseudometric(dst, crr) implies forall([u in crr, v in crr, w in crr], dst(u, w) <= dst(u, v) + dst(v, w)))
- `pt-box-membership` — forall([t, v, c, e, z], z in pt-box(t, v, c, e) iff z in cartesian(pts(t), rr) and nth(1, z) in v and abs(nth(2, z) - c) < e)
- `pt-box-mono` — forall([t, v1, v2, c, e1, e2], is-top-space(t) implies v1 subset v2 implies c in rr implies e1 in rr implies e2 in rr implies e1 <= e2 implies pt-box(t, v1, c, e1) subset pt-box(t, v2, c, e2))
- `pt-box-open` — forall([t, v, c, e], is-top-space(t) implies v in opens(t) implies c in rr implies pos-rr(e) implies pt-box(t, v, c, e) in opens(prod-top(t)))
- `pt-box-unfold` — forall([t, v, c, e], pt-box(t, v, c, e) == {ptz_ in cartesian(pts(t), rr): nth(1, ptz_) in v and abs(nth(2, ptz_) - c) < e})
- `pt-open-empty` — forall([t], is-top-space(t) implies is-pt-open(t, empty-set))
- `pt-open-inter` — forall([t, u, v], is-top-space(t) implies is-pt-open(t, u) implies is-pt-open(t, v) implies is-pt-open(t, intersection(u, v)))
- `pt-open-union` — forall([t, fam], is-top-space(t) implies forall([tow_ in fam], is-pt-open(t, tow_)) implies is-pt-open(t, big-union(u, fam, u)))
- `pt-open-whole` — forall([t], is-top-space(t) implies is-pt-open(t, cartesian(pts(t), rr)))
- `pt-set-dist-ge-elim` — forall([m], is-metric-space(m) implies forall([x, es, r], x in pts(m) implies es subset pts(m) implies r in rr-pos-star implies r <= pt-set-dist(m, x, es) implies forall([mzz_ in es], r <= (dist(m))(x, mzz_))))
- `pt-set-dist-ge-intro` — forall([m, x, es, r in rr-pos-star], forall([mzz_ in es], r <= (dist(m))(x, mzz_)) implies r <= pt-set-dist(m, x, es))
- `pt-set-dist-le` — forall([m], is-metric-space(m) implies forall([es], es subset pts(m) implies forall([x in pts(m), z in es], pt-set-dist(m, x, es) <= (dist(m))(x, z))))
- `pt-set-dist-lipschitz` — forall([m], is-metric-space(m) implies forall([es], es subset pts(m) implies forall([z in es, x in pts(m), y in pts(m)], pt-set-dist(m, x, es) <= (dist(m))(x, y) + pt-set-dist(m, y, es))))
- `pt-set-dist-open-pos` — forall([m, u], is-open(m, u) implies forall([x in u], forsome([r], pos-rr(r) and r <= pt-set-dist(m, x, complement-in(pts(m), u)))))
- `pt-set-dist-real` — forall([m], is-metric-space(m) implies forall([es], es subset pts(m) implies forall([z in es, x in pts(m)], pt-set-dist(m, x, es) in rr and 0 <= pt-set-dist(m, x, es))))
- `pt-set-dist-unfold` — forall([m, x, es], pt-set-dist(m, x, es) == einf({mov_ in rr-pos-star: forsome([moz_ in es], mov_ = (dist(m))(x, moz_))}))
- `pts-left-cosets-unfold` — forall([s, g, h], pts-left-cosets(s, g, h) == {lcu_ in power(pts(s)): forsome([lcx_ in carr(g)], lcu_ = {lcz_ in pts(s): (opr(g))((inv(g))(lcx_), lcz_) in h})})
- `ptwise-cauchy-compact-equicont-unif` — forall([s, fam], is-compact(s) implies fam in fun(nn, fun(pts(s), rr)) implies is-equicontinuous(s, rr-ms, fam) implies is-ptwise-cauchy(s, fam) implies is-unif-cauchy(s, fam))
- `ptwise-conv-iff-converges-to` — forall([s, t, fam, g], is-metric-space(s) implies is-metric-space(t) implies fam in fun(nn, fun(pts(s), pts(t))) implies g in fun(pts(s), pts(t)) implies converges-ptwise-to(s, t, fam, g) iff forall([x in pts(s)], converges-to(t, vnb-lambda(k, nn, (fam(k))(x)), g(x))))
- `ptwise-eplus-value` — forall([omega, f, g, x in omega], f(x) in rr-pos-star implies g(x) in rr-pos-star implies (ptwise-eplus(omega, f, g))(x) = eplus(f(x), g(x)))
- `ptwise-eplus-value-q` — forall([omega, g1, g2, x in omega], (ptwise-eplus(omega, g1, g2))(x) == eplus(g1(x), g2(x)))
- `ptwise-epow-value` — forall([omega, f in fun(omega, rr-pos-star), p_ in rr], 0 < p_ implies forall([x in omega], (ptwise-epow(omega, f, p_))(x) = epow(f(x), p_)))
- `ptwise-etimes-sup` — forall([omega, h, cf], omega in set implies h in fun(omega, rr-pos-star) implies cf in fun(nn, fun(omega, rr-pos-star)) implies forall([n_ in nn], ptwise-le(omega, cf(n_), cf(succ(n_)))) implies ptwise-etimes(omega, h, ptwise-sup(omega, cf)) = ptwise-sup(omega, vnb-lambda(mrgk_, nn, vnb-lambda(x_, omega, etimes(h(x_), (cf(mrgk_))(x_))))))
- `ptwise-etimes-value` — forall([omega, f, g, x in omega], f(x) in rr-pos-star implies g(x) in rr-pos-star implies (ptwise-etimes(omega, f, g))(x) = etimes(f(x), g(x)))
- `ptwise-etimes-value-q` — forall([omega, g1, g2, x in omega], (ptwise-etimes(omega, g1, g2))(x) == etimes(g1(x), g2(x)))
- `ptwise-liminf-apply` — forall([omega, cf, x in omega], (ptwise-liminf(omega, cf))(x) == eliminf(vnb-lambda(n_, nn, (cf(n_))(x))))
- `ptwise-limit-function` — forall([s, t, fam], is-metric-space(s) implies is-metric-space(t) implies fam in fun(nn, fun(pts(s), pts(t))) implies forall([x in pts(s)], forsome([y in pts(t)], converges-to(t, vnb-lambda(k, nn, (fam(k))(x)), y))) implies forsome([g], converges-ptwise-to(s, t, fam, g)))
- `ptwise-limit-in-isometry-group` — forall([s, fam, g], is-compact(s) implies fam in fun(nn, isometry-group(s)) implies converges-ptwise-to(s, s, fam, g) implies g in isometry-group(s))
- `ptwise-limits-equicontinuous` — forall([t, ee], is-top-space(t) implies is-equicontinuous-t(t, ee) implies is-equicontinuous-t(t, ptwise-net-limits(t, ee)))
- `ptwise-neg-part-scale` — forall([p, g], p in rr implies g in rr implies 0 <= p implies etimes(p, if(0 <= g, 0, -g)) = if(0 <= p * g, 0, -(p * g)))
- `ptwise-net-limits-unfold` — forall([t, ee], ptwise-net-limits(t, ee) == {pwf_ in fun(pts(t), rr): forsome([pwd_, pwp_], pwd_ in directed-set and is-directed-set(pwd_) and pwp_ in fun(pts(pwd_), ee) and forall([pwx_ in pts(t)], net-converges-to(metric-top(rr-ms), pwd_, vnb-lambda(pwl_, pts(pwd_), (pwp_(pwl_))(pwx_)), pwf_(pwx_))))})
- `ptwise-pos-part-scale` — forall([p, g], p in rr implies g in rr implies 0 <= p implies etimes(p, if(0 <= g, g, 0)) = if(0 <= p * g, p * g, 0))
- `ptwise-scale-measurable` — forall([omega, ca, g, k], is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, g) implies k in rr implies 0 <= k implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, ptwise-scale(omega, k, g)))
- `ptwise-scale-value` — forall([omega, c_, f, x in omega], c_ in rr-pos-star implies f(x) in rr-pos-star implies (ptwise-scale(omega, c_, f))(x) = etimes(c_, f(x)))
- `ptwise-scale-value-q` — forall([omega, k, g, x in omega], (ptwise-scale(omega, k, g))(x) == etimes(k, g(x)))
- `ptwise-subseq-converges` — forall([s, g, phi, p, b], converges-to(s, b, p) implies strictly-mono-nn(phi) implies g in fun(nn, pts(s)) implies forall([n_ in nn], b(n_) = g(phi(n_))) implies converges-to(s, subseq(g, phi), p))
- `ptwise-sup-apply` — forall([omega, cf, x in omega], (ptwise-sup(omega, cf))(x) == esup(image(vnb-lambda(n_, nn, (cf(n_))(x)), nn)))
- `pullback-converges-to` — forall([mt, ss, jj, sq, a], is-metric-space(mt) implies ss in set implies jj in fun(ss, pts(mt)) implies forall([pbx_ in ss, pby_ in ss], jj(pbx_) = jj(pby_) implies pbx_ = pby_) implies sq in fun(nn, ss) implies a in ss implies converges-to(pullback-ms(mt, ss, jj), sq, a) iff converges-to(mt, compose(jj, sq), jj(a)))
- `pullback-dist` — forall([mt, ss, jj, u, v], ss in set implies u in ss implies v in ss implies (dist(pullback-ms(mt, ss, jj)))(u, v) == (dist(mt))(jj(u), jj(v)))
- `pullback-dist-slot` — forall([mt, ss, jj], ss in set implies dist(pullback-ms(mt, ss, jj)) == vnb-lambda([pbu_, pbv_], cartesian(ss, ss), (dist(mt))(jj(pbu_), jj(pbv_))))
- `pullback-is-metric-space` — forall([mt, ss, jj], is-metric-space(mt) implies ss in set implies jj in fun(ss, pts(mt)) implies forall([pbx_ in ss, pby_ in ss], jj(pbx_) = jj(pby_) implies pbx_ = pby_) implies is-metric-space(pullback-ms(mt, ss, jj)))
- `pullback-measure-at` — forall([omega, cb, omega2, f, nu], is-measure(omega2, cb, nu) implies f in fun(omega, omega2) implies forall([mpsy_ in omega2], forsome([mpsx_ in omega], f(mpsx_) = mpsy_)) implies forall([a in pullback-sigma(omega, cb, f)], image(f, a) in cb and (pullback-measure(omega, cb, f, nu))(a) = nu(image(f, a))))
- `pullback-measure-exists-unique` — forall([omega, cb, omega2, f, nu], is-measure(omega2, cb, nu) implies f in fun(omega, omega2) implies forall([mpsy_ in omega2], forsome([mpsx_ in omega], f(mpsx_) = mpsy_)) implies is-measure(omega, pullback-sigma(omega, cb, f), pullback-measure(omega, cb, f, nu)) and forall([b in cb], (pullback-measure(omega, cb, f, nu))({mpx_ in omega: f(mpx_) in b}) = nu(b)) and forall([mu], is-measure(omega, pullback-sigma(omega, cb, f), mu) implies forall([b in cb], mu({mpx_ in omega: f(mpx_) in b}) = nu(b)) implies mu = pullback-measure(omega, cb, f, nu)))
- `pullback-measure-is-measure` — forall([omega, cb, omega2, f, nu], is-measure(omega2, cb, nu) implies f in fun(omega, omega2) implies forall([mpsy_ in omega2], forsome([mpsx_ in omega], f(mpsx_) = mpsy_)) implies is-measure(omega, pullback-sigma(omega, cb, f), pullback-measure(omega, cb, f, nu)))
- `pullback-measure-type` — forall([omega, cb, omega2, f, nu], is-measure(omega2, cb, nu) implies f in fun(omega, omega2) implies forall([mpsy_ in omega2], forsome([mpsx_ in omega], f(mpsx_) = mpsy_)) implies pullback-measure(omega, cb, f, nu) in fun(pullback-sigma(omega, cb, f), rr-pos-star))
- `pullback-measure-unfold` — forall([omega, cb, f, nu], pullback-measure(omega, cb, f, nu) == vnb-lambda(mpm_, pullback-sigma(omega, cb, f), nu(image(f, mpm_))))
- `pullback-measure-unique` — forall([omega, cb, omega2, f, nu], is-measure(omega2, cb, nu) implies f in fun(omega, omega2) implies forall([mpsy_ in omega2], forsome([mpsx_ in omega], f(mpsx_) = mpsy_)) implies forall([mu], is-measure(omega, pullback-sigma(omega, cb, f), mu) implies forall([b in cb], mu({mpx_ in omega: f(mpx_) in b}) = nu(b)) implies mu = pullback-measure(omega, cb, f, nu)))
- `pullback-measure-value` — forall([omega, cb, omega2, f, nu], is-measure(omega2, cb, nu) implies f in fun(omega, omega2) implies forall([mpsy_ in omega2], forsome([mpsx_ in omega], f(mpsx_) = mpsy_)) implies forall([b in cb], (pullback-measure(omega, cb, f, nu))({mpx_ in omega: f(mpx_) in b}) = nu(b)))
- `pullback-pts` — forall([mt, ss, jj], ss in set implies pts(pullback-ms(mt, ss, jj)) == ss)
- `pullback-sigma-algebra` — forall([omega, cb, omega2, f], is-sigma-algebra(omega2, cb) implies f in fun(omega, omega2) implies is-sigma-algebra(omega, pullback-sigma(omega, cb, f)) and is-measurable-map(omega, pullback-sigma(omega, cb, f), omega2, cb, f) and forall([mpcc], is-sigma-algebra(omega, mpcc) implies is-measurable-map(omega, mpcc, omega2, cb, f) implies pullback-sigma(omega, cb, f) subset mpcc))
- `pullback-sigma-is-sigma-algebra` — forall([omega, cb, omega2, f], is-sigma-algebra(omega2, cb) implies f in fun(omega, omega2) implies is-sigma-algebra(omega, pullback-sigma(omega, cb, f)))
- `pullback-sigma-measurable` — forall([omega, cb, omega2, f], is-sigma-algebra(omega2, cb) implies f in fun(omega, omega2) implies is-measurable-map(omega, pullback-sigma(omega, cb, f), omega2, cb, f))
- `pullback-sigma-membership` — forall([omega, cb, f, a], a in pullback-sigma(omega, cb, f) iff a in power(omega) and forsome([mpb_ in cb], a = {mpx_ in omega: f(mpx_) in mpb_}))
- `pullback-sigma-smallest` — forall([omega, cb, omega2, f], is-sigma-algebra(omega2, cb) implies f in fun(omega, omega2) implies forall([mpcc], is-sigma-algebra(omega, mpcc) implies is-measurable-map(omega, mpcc, omega2, cb, f) implies pullback-sigma(omega, cb, f) subset mpcc))
- `pullback-sigma-unfold` — forall([omega, cb, f], pullback-sigma(omega, cb, f) == {mpa_ in power(omega): forsome([mpb_ in cb], mpa_ = {mpx_ in omega: f(mpx_) in mpb_})})
- `pure-state-exists` — forall([a], is-unital-involutive-banach-algebra(a) implies forsome([g4kz_], g4kz_ in states(a)) implies forsome([g4kp_], is-pure-state(a, g4kp_)))
- `pure-state-extreme` — forall([a], is-unital-involutive-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([f], is-pure-state(a, f) implies forall([g in states(a), h in states(a), r in rr], 0 < r implies r < 1 implies forall([g4ty_ in vec(a)], f(g4ty_) = r * g(g4ty_) + (1 - r) * h(g4ty_)) implies forall([x in vec(a)], g(x) = f(x) and h(x) = f(x)))))
- `pure-state-iff-extreme` — forall([a], is-unital-involutive-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([f], is-pure-state(a, f) iff is-extreme-state(a, f)))
- `pure-state-is-extreme` — forall([a], is-unital-involutive-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([f], is-pure-state(a, f) implies is-extreme-state(a, f)))
- `pv-act-fun` — forall([m], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies pv-act(m) in fun(cartesian(carr(scal(m)), cartesian(vec(m), rr)), cartesian(vec(m), rr)))
- `pv-act-value` — forall([m], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies forall([rx_, px_], rx_ in rr implies px_ in cartesian(vec(m), rr) implies (pv-act(m))(rx_, px_) = [(act(m))(rx_, nth(1, px_)), rx_ * nth(2, px_)]))
- `pv-vadd-fun` — forall([m], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies pv-vadd(m) in fun(cartesian(cartesian(vec(m), rr), cartesian(vec(m), rr)), cartesian(vec(m), rr)))
- `pv-vadd-value` — forall([m], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies forall([px_, qx_], px_ in cartesian(vec(m), rr) implies qx_ in cartesian(vec(m), rr) implies (pv-vadd(m))(px_, qx_) = [(vadd(m))(nth(1, px_), nth(1, qx_)), nth(2, px_) + nth(2, qx_)]))
- `pv-vneg-fun` — forall([m], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies pv-vneg(m) in fun(cartesian(vec(m), rr), cartesian(vec(m), rr)))
- `pv-vneg-value` — forall([m], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies forall([px_ in cartesian(vec(m), rr)], (pv-vneg(m))(px_) = [(vneg(m))(nth(1, px_)), -nth(2, px_)]))
- `pw-affine-antiderivative` — forall([a in rr, b in rr], a < b implies forall([pac_ in rr, pam_ in rr, pwf_, pphi_], pwf_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) implies pphi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pwf_(pay_) == pac_ + pam_ * pay_) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pphi_(pay_) == pam_) implies is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b)))
- `pw-antiderivative-differ-by-constant` — forall([pwf_, paw_, pphi_, a, b], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies is-primitive(paw_, pphi_, a, b) implies forall([pbs_ in ccint(a, b)], pwf_(pbs_) = paw_(pbs_) + pwf_(a) - paw_(a)))
- `pw-antiderivative-differ-by-some-constant` — forall([pwf_, paw_, pphi_, a, b], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies is-primitive(paw_, pphi_, a, b) implies forsome([pbc_ in rr], forall([pbs_ in ccint(a, b)], pwf_(pbs_) = paw_(pbs_) + pbc_)))
- `pw-antiderivative-endpoint-difference` — forall([pwf_, paw_, pphi_, a, b], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies is-primitive(paw_, pphi_, a, b) implies pwf_(b) - pwf_(a) = paw_(b) - paw_(a))
- `pw-antiderivative-integrand-congruence` — forall([pwf_, pphi_, ppsi_, a, b], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies ppsi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pphi_(pay_) == ppsi_(pay_)) implies is-primitive(pwf_, ppsi_, a, b))
- `pw-antiderivative-linear` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, pcc_ in rr, pdd_ in rr, pwf_, paw_, pphi_, ppsi_], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies is-primitive(paw_, ppsi_, a, b) implies forall([pauh_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr), pchi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr)], forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pauh_(pay_) == pcc_ * pwf_(pay_) + pdd_ * paw_(pay_)) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pchi_(pay_) == pcc_ * pphi_(pay_) + pdd_ * ppsi_(pay_)) implies is-primitive(pauh_, pchi_, a, b) and pw-int(pchi_, a, b) = pcc_ * pw-int(pphi_, a, b) + pdd_ * pw-int(ppsi_, a, b)))
- `pw-antiderivative-one-piece` — forall([a in rr, b in rr], a < b implies forall([pwf_, pphi_], pwf_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) implies pphi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) implies is-continuous-on(pwf_, ccint(a, b)) implies forall([pat_ in ooint(a, b)], has-deriv-at(pwf_, pat_, pphi_(pat_))) implies is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b)))
- `pw-antiderivative-real-mul` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, pwf_, pphi_, pcc_ in rr], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies forall([pauh_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr), pchi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr)], forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pauh_(pay_) == pcc_ * pwf_(pay_)) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pchi_(pay_) == pcc_ * pphi_(pay_)) implies is-primitive(pauh_, pchi_, a, b) and pw-int(pchi_, a, b) = pcc_ * pw-int(pphi_, a, b)))
- `pw-antiderivative-reflect` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, pwf_, pphi_], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies forall([prg_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr), prk_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr)], forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], prg_(pay_) == pwf_(a + b - pay_)) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], prk_(pay_) == -1 * pphi_(a + b - pay_)) implies is-primitive(prg_, prk_, a, b)))
- `pw-antiderivative-restrict` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, pcv_ in rr, pdv_ in rr, pwf_, pphi_], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies a <= pcv_ implies pcv_ < pdv_ implies pdv_ <= b implies is-primitive(restrict(pwf_, ccint(pcv_, pdv_)), restrict(pphi_, ccint(pcv_, pdv_)), pcv_, pdv_))
- `pw-antiderivative-sum` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, pwf_, paw_, pphi_, ppsi_], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies is-primitive(paw_, ppsi_, a, b) implies forall([pauh_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr), pchi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr)], forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pauh_(pay_) == pwf_(pay_) + paw_(pay_)) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pchi_(pay_) == pphi_(pay_) + ppsi_(pay_)) implies is-primitive(pauh_, pchi_, a, b) and pw-int(pchi_, a, b) = pw-int(pphi_, a, b) + pw-int(ppsi_, a, b)))
- `pw-antiderivative-value-in-rr` — forall([pwf_, pphi_, a, b], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pwf_(pay_) in rr))
- `pw-continuous-endpoints` — forall([pphi_, a, b], is-pw-continuous-on(pphi_, a, b) implies a in rr and b in rr and a < b)
- `pw-continuous-in-fun` — forall([pphi_, a, b], is-pw-continuous-on(pphi_, a, b) implies pphi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr))
- `pw-continuous-one-piece` — forall([a in rr, b in rr], a < b implies forall([pphi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr)], is-continuous-on(pphi_, ccint(a, b)) implies is-pw-continuous-on(pphi_, a, b)))
- `pw-continuous-reflect` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, pphi_, prc_ in rr, prq_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr)], is-pw-continuous-on(pphi_, a, b) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], prq_(pay_) == prc_ * pphi_(a + b - pay_)) implies is-pw-continuous-on(prq_, a, b))
- `pw-int-abs-bound` — forall([pwf_, pphi_, paw_, pabs_, a, b], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies is-primitive(paw_, pabs_, a, b) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pabs_(pay_) == abs(pphi_(pay_))) implies abs(pw-int(pphi_, a, b)) <= pw-int(pabs_, a, b))
- `pw-int-adjacent` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, pcv_ in ooint(a, b), pwf_, pphi_], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies pw-int(pphi_, a, b) = pw-int(restrict(pphi_, ccint(a, pcv_)), a, pcv_) + pw-int(restrict(pphi_, ccint(pcv_, b)), pcv_, b))
- `pw-int-affine-subst` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, lrpc_ in rr, lrpd_ in rr, lrpl_ in rr, lrpm_ in rr], 0 < lrpl_ implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpc_ = a implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpd_ = b implies lrpc_ < lrpd_ implies forall([pwf_, pphi_], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies forall([lrph_ in fun(ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_), rr), lrps_ in fun(ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_), rr)], forall([lrpz_ in ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_)], lrph_(lrpz_) == pwf_(lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpz_)) implies forall([lrpz_ in ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_)], lrps_(lrpz_) == lrpl_ * pphi_(lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpz_)) implies is-primitive(lrph_, lrps_, lrpc_, lrpd_) and pw-int(lrps_, lrpc_, lrpd_) = pw-int(pphi_, a, b))))
- `pw-int-congruence` — forall([pwf_, pphi_, ppsi_, a, b], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies ppsi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pphi_(pay_) == ppsi_(pay_)) implies pw-int(pphi_, a, b) = pw-int(ppsi_, a, b))
- `pw-int-const` — forall([a in rr, b in rr], a < b implies forall([pac_ in rr, pphi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr)], forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pphi_(pay_) == pac_) implies pw-int(pphi_, a, b) = pac_ * (b - a)))
- `pw-int-in-rr` — forall([pwf_, pphi_, a, b], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies pw-int(pphi_, a, b) in rr)
- `pw-int-interior-congruence` — forall([pwf_, pphi_, ppsi_, a, b], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies ppsi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) implies forall([pay_ in ooint(a, b)], pphi_(pay_) == ppsi_(pay_)) implies pw-int(pphi_, a, b) = pw-int(ppsi_, a, b))
- `pw-int-monotone` — forall([pwf_, pphi_, paw_, ppsi_, a, b], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies is-primitive(paw_, ppsi_, a, b) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pphi_(pay_) <= ppsi_(pay_)) implies pw-int(pphi_, a, b) <= pw-int(ppsi_, a, b))
- `pw-int-nonneg` — forall([pwf_, pphi_, a, b], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], 0 <= pphi_(pay_)) implies 0 <= pw-int(pphi_, a, b))
- `pw-int-nonneg-zero` — forall([cmzf_, cmzh_, cmza_, cmzb_], is-primitive(cmzf_, cmzh_, cmza_, cmzb_) implies is-continuous-on(cmzh_, ccint(cmza_, cmzb_)) implies forall([cmzt_ in ccint(cmza_, cmzb_)], 0 <= cmzh_(cmzt_)) implies pw-int(cmzh_, cmza_, cmzb_) = 0 implies forall([cmzt_ in ccint(cmza_, cmzb_)], cmzh_(cmzt_) = 0))
- `pw-int-reflect` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, pwf_, pphi_], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies forall([prh_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr), prs_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr)], forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], prh_(pay_) == -1 * pwf_(a + b - pay_)) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], prs_(pay_) == pphi_(a + b - pay_)) implies is-primitive(prh_, prs_, a, b) and pw-int(prs_, a, b) = pw-int(pphi_, a, b)))
- `pw-int-value` — forall([pwf_, pphi_, a, b], is-primitive(pwf_, pphi_, a, b) implies pw-int(pphi_, a, b) = pwf_(b) - pwf_(a))
- `pw-lt-ne` — forall([pcu_ in rr, pcv_ in rr], pcu_ < pcv_ implies not(pcu_ = pcv_) and not(pcv_ = pcu_))
- `pw-nondecreasing-on-interval` — forall([a in rr, b in rr], a < b implies forall([h in fun(ccint(a, b), rr)], is-continuous-on(h, ccint(a, b)) implies forall([pas_ in set], card(pas_) in nn implies forall([pat_ in ooint(a, b)], not(pat_ in pas_) implies forsome([pal_], has-deriv-at(h, pat_, pal_) and 0 <= pal_)) implies h(a) <= h(b))))
- `pw-not-in-insert` — forall([pcy_ in set, pcw_, pct_], not(pct_ in pcw_) implies not(pct_ = pcy_) implies not(pct_ in union(pcw_, pair(pcy_, pcy_))))
- `pw-restrict-continuous-on` — forall([a in rr, b in rr], a < b implies forall([f, pwf_], f in fun(rr, rr) implies forall([pay_ in rr], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, pay_)) implies pwf_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], pwf_(pay_) == f(pay_)) implies is-continuous-on(pwf_, ccint(a, b))))
- `pw-step-identity` — forall([c, u, v], c in rr implies u in rr implies v in rr implies (c + 1) * (u * v) = 1 * (u * v) + u * (c * v))
- `pw-zero-deriv-off-finite-set` — forall([pas_ in set], card(pas_) in nn implies forall([pah_ in fun(rr, rr)], forall([pax_ in rr], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, pah_, pax_)) implies forall([pau_ in rr, pav_ in rr], pau_ < pav_ implies forall([pat_ in ooint(pau_, pav_)], not(pat_ in pas_) implies is-diff-at(pah_, pat_, 0)) implies pah_(pau_) = pah_(pav_))))
- `pw-zero-deriv-total` — forall([pah_ in fun(rr, rr)], forall([pax_ in rr], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, pah_, pax_)) implies forall([pau_ in rr, pav_ in rr], pau_ < pav_ implies forall([pat_ in ooint(pau_, pav_)], is-diff-at(pah_, pat_, 0)) implies pah_(pau_) = pah_(pav_)))
- `pz-abs-mul` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies forall([x in qq, y in qq], (padic-abs(p))(x * y) = (padic-abs(p))(x) * (padic-abs(p))(y)))
- `pz-abs-nonneg` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies forall([x in qq], 0 <= (padic-abs(p))(x)))
- `pz-abs-rel` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies forall([x in qq], padic-rel(p, x, (padic-abs(p))(x))))
- `pz-abs-triangle` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies forall([x in qq, y in qq], (padic-abs(p))(x + y) <= (padic-abs(p))(x) + (padic-abs(p))(y)))
- `pz-abs-type` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies padic-abs(p) in fun(qq, rr))
- `pz-abs-ultra` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies forall([x in qq, y in qq], (padic-abs(p))(x + y) <= max((padic-abs(p))(x), (padic-abs(p))(y))))
- `pz-abs-value` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies forall([x in qq, v], padic-rel(p, x, v) implies (padic-abs(p))(x) = v))
- `pz-abs-zero` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies forall([x in qq], (padic-abs(p))(x) = 0 iff x = 0))
- `pz-dvd-add` — forall([d, a, b], zz-divides(d, a) implies zz-divides(d, b) implies zz-divides(d, a + b))
- `pz-dvd-bound` — forall([d, n], zz-divides(d, n) implies not(n = 0) implies abs(d) <= abs(n))
- `pz-dvd-mul` — forall([d, n], zz-divides(d, n) implies forall([c in zz], zz-divides(d, c * n)))
- `pz-dvd-neg` — forall([d, n], zz-divides(d, n) implies zz-divides(d, -n))
- `pz-dvd-refl` — forall([d in zz], zz-divides(d, d))
- `pz-dvd-zero` — forall([d in zz], zz-divides(d, 0))
- `pz-euclid` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies forall([a in zz, b in zz], zz-divides(p, a * b) implies zz-divides(p, a) or zz-divides(p, b)))
- `pz-ord-exists` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies forall([n in zz], not(n = 0) implies forsome([k in nn], zz-ord-is(p, n, k))))
- `pz-ord-mult` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies forall([a in zz, b in zz, i in nn, j in nn], zz-ord-is(p, a, i) implies zz-ord-is(p, b, j) implies zz-ord-is(p, a * b, i + j)))
- `pz-ord-one` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies zz-ord-is(p, 1, 0))
- `pz-ord-p` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies zz-ord-is(p, p, 1))
- `pz-ord-sum` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies forall([a in zz, b in zz, i in nn, j in nn, s in nn], zz-ord-is(p, a, i) implies zz-ord-is(p, b, j) implies zz-ord-is(p, a + b, s) implies forall([m in nn], m <= i implies m <= j implies m <= s)))
- `pz-ord-unique` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies forall([n, i in nn, j in nn], zz-ord-is(p, n, i) implies zz-ord-is(p, n, j) implies i = j))
- `pz-power-dvd` — forall([p in zz, k in nn, j in nn], k <= j implies zz-divides(p ^ k, p ^ j))
- `pz-power-ge` — forall([p in zz], 2 <= p implies forall([cn in nn], cn + 1 <= p ^ cn))
- `pz-power-ge-ind` — forall([cn in nn, p in zz], 2 <= p implies cn + 1 <= p ^ cn)
- `pz-power-in-zz` — forall([p in zz, cn in nn], p ^ cn in zz)
- `pz-power-in-zz-ind` — forall([cn in nn, p in zz], p ^ cn in zz)
- `pz-rel-exists` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies forall([x in qq], forsome([cpw_], padic-rel(p, x, cpw_))))
- `pz-rel-intro` — forall([p, x in qq], not(x = 0) implies forall([a in zz, b in zz], not(b = 0) implies x * b = a implies forall([i in nn, j in nn], zz-ord-is(p, a, i) implies zz-ord-is(p, b, j) implies forall([v in rr], v * 2 ^ i = 2 ^ j implies padic-rel(p, x, v)))))
- `pz-rel-iota` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies forall([x in qq], padic-rel(p, x, iota(cpv_, cpv_ in rr and padic-rel(p, x, cpv_)))))
- `pz-rel-mul` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies forall([x in qq, y in qq, v, w], padic-rel(p, x, v) implies padic-rel(p, y, w) implies padic-rel(p, x * y, v * w)))
- `pz-rel-pos` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies forall([x in qq, v], padic-rel(p, x, v) implies 0 <= v and (not(x = 0) implies 0 < v)))
- `pz-rel-rep` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies forall([z in qq, u], padic-rel(p, z, u) implies not(z = 0) implies forall([cn in zz, cd in zz], not(cd = 0) implies z * cd = cn implies forall([s in nn, tt in nn], zz-ord-is(p, cn, s) implies zz-ord-is(p, cd, tt) implies u * 2 ^ s = 2 ^ tt))))
- `pz-rel-ultra` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies forall([x in qq, y in qq, v, w, u], padic-rel(p, x, v) implies padic-rel(p, y, w) implies padic-rel(p, x + y, u) implies u <= max(v, w)))
- `pz-rel-unique` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies forall([x in qq, v, w], padic-rel(p, x, v) implies padic-rel(p, x, w) implies v = w))
- `pz-rel-zero` — forall([p], padic-rel(p, 0, 0))
- `pz-rr-cancel-pos` — forall([cra in rr, crb in rr, crc in rr], 0 < crc implies cra * crc = crb * crc implies cra = crb)

- `qmod-rel-in` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([sm], is-submodule(md, sm) implies forall([a_, b_], a_ in vec(md) implies b_ in vec(md) implies (vadd(md))(a_, (vneg(md))(b_)) in sm implies [a_, b_] in qmod-rel(md, sm))))

- `qmod-rel-unfold` — forall([md, sm], qmod-rel(md, sm) == {qmp_ in cartesian(vec(md), vec(md)): (vadd(md))(nth(1, qmp_), (vneg(md))(nth(2, qmp_))) in sm})
- `qmod-related-in` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([sm], is-submodule(md, sm) implies forall([a_, b_], a_ in vec(md) implies b_ in vec(md) implies (vadd(md))(a_, (vneg(md))(b_)) in sm implies related(qmod-setoid(md, sm), a_, b_))))
- `qmod-related-out` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([sm], is-submodule(md, sm) implies forall([a_, b_], related(qmod-setoid(md, sm), a_, b_) implies (vadd(md))(a_, (vneg(md))(b_)) in sm)))

- `qmod-ro-scal` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([sm], is-submodule(md, sm) implies scal(quotient-module(md, sm)) == scal(md)))
- `qmod-ro-vadd` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([sm], is-submodule(md, sm) implies vadd(quotient-module(md, sm)) == qmod-vadd(md, sm)))
- `qmod-ro-vec` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([sm], is-submodule(md, sm) implies vec(quotient-module(md, sm)) == quotient(qmod-setoid(md, sm))))
- `qmod-ro-vneg` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([sm], is-submodule(md, sm) implies vneg(quotient-module(md, sm)) == qmod-vneg(md, sm)))

- `qmod-scale-computes` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([sm], is-submodule(md, sm) implies forall([r_, a_], r_ in carr(scal(md)) implies a_ in vec(md) implies (qmod-scale(md, sm, r_))(class(qmod-setoid(md, sm), a_)) = class(qmod-setoid(md, sm), (act(md))(r_, a_)))))
- `qmod-scale-fun` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([sm], is-submodule(md, sm) implies forall([r_ in carr(scal(md))], qmod-scale(md, sm, r_) in fun(quotient(qmod-setoid(md, sm)), quotient(qmod-setoid(md, sm))))))

- `qmod-vadd-fun` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([sm], is-submodule(md, sm) implies vadd(quotient-module(md, sm)) in fun(cartesian(vec(quotient-module(md, sm)), vec(quotient-module(md, sm))), vec(quotient-module(md, sm)))))
- `qmod-vadd-fun0` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([sm], is-submodule(md, sm) implies qmod-vadd(md, sm) in fun(cartesian(quotient(qmod-setoid(md, sm)), quotient(qmod-setoid(md, sm))), quotient(qmod-setoid(md, sm)))))
- `qmod-vec-set` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([sm], is-submodule(md, sm) implies vec(quotient-module(md, sm)) in set))
- `qmod-vneg-computes` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([sm], is-submodule(md, sm) implies forall([a_ in vec(md)], (vneg(quotient-module(md, sm)))(class(qmod-setoid(md, sm), a_)) = class(qmod-setoid(md, sm), (vneg(md))(a_)))))
- `qmod-vneg-fun` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([sm], is-submodule(md, sm) implies vneg(quotient-module(md, sm)) in fun(vec(quotient-module(md, sm)), vec(quotient-module(md, sm)))))
- `qmod-vneg-fun0` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([sm], is-submodule(md, sm) implies qmod-vneg(md, sm) in fun(quotient(qmod-setoid(md, sm)), quotient(qmod-setoid(md, sm)))))

- `qn-ultra` — forall([vf in fun(qq, rr)], is-nv-field(qq-nv(vf)) implies forall([x in qq, y in qq], vf(x + y) <= max(vf(x), vf(y))))

- `qna-lvm-fun` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([ii], is-two-sided-ideal(a, ii) implies vnb-lambda([bqnx_, bqny_], cartesian(vec(a), vec(a)), class(qmod-setoid(uba-as-module(a), ii), (vmul(a))(bqnx_, bqny_))) in fun(cartesian(pts(qmod-setoid(uba-as-module(a), ii)), pts(qmod-setoid(uba-as-module(a), ii))), quotient(qmod-setoid(uba-as-module(a), ii)))))

- `qna-ro-scal` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([ii], is-two-sided-ideal(a, ii) implies scal(quotient-na(a, ii)) == scal(quotient-module(uba-as-module(a), ii))))

- `qna-ro-vnrm` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([ii], is-two-sided-ideal(a, ii) implies vnrm(quotient-na(a, ii)) == qna-vnrm(a, ii)))
- `qna-ro-vzero` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([ii], is-two-sided-ideal(a, ii) implies vzero(quotient-na(a, ii)) == vzero(quotient-module(uba-as-module(a), ii))))
- `qna-vmul-act-left` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([ii], is-two-sided-ideal(a, ii) implies forall([lam in cc, c in quotient(qmod-setoid(uba-as-module(a), ii)), d in quotient(qmod-setoid(uba-as-module(a), ii))], (qna-vmul(a, ii))((act(quotient-module(uba-as-module(a), ii)))(lam, c), d) = (act(quotient-module(uba-as-module(a), ii)))(lam, (qna-vmul(a, ii))(c, d)))))

- `qna-vmul-act-right` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([ii], is-two-sided-ideal(a, ii) implies forall([lam in cc, c in quotient(qmod-setoid(uba-as-module(a), ii)), d in quotient(qmod-setoid(uba-as-module(a), ii))], (qna-vmul(a, ii))(c, (act(quotient-module(uba-as-module(a), ii)))(lam, d)) = (act(quotient-module(uba-as-module(a), ii)))(lam, (qna-vmul(a, ii))(c, d)))))
- `qna-vmul-act-right-na` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([ii], is-two-sided-ideal(a, ii) implies forall([r_ in carr(scal(quotient-module(uba-as-module(a), ii))), x_ in vec(quotient-module(uba-as-module(a), ii)), y_ in vec(quotient-module(uba-as-module(a), ii))], (qna-vmul(a, ii))(x_, (act(quotient-module(uba-as-module(a), ii)))(r_, y_)) = (act(quotient-module(uba-as-module(a), ii)))(r_, (qna-vmul(a, ii))(x_, y_)))))
- `qna-vmul-assoc` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([ii], is-two-sided-ideal(a, ii) implies forall([c in quotient(qmod-setoid(uba-as-module(a), ii)), d in quotient(qmod-setoid(uba-as-module(a), ii)), e in quotient(qmod-setoid(uba-as-module(a), ii))], (qna-vmul(a, ii))((qna-vmul(a, ii))(c, d), e) = (qna-vmul(a, ii))(c, (qna-vmul(a, ii))(d, e)))))
- `qna-vmul-assoc-na` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([ii], is-two-sided-ideal(a, ii) implies is-associative(qna-vmul(a, ii), vec(quotient-module(uba-as-module(a), ii)))))
- `qna-vmul-computes` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([ii], is-two-sided-ideal(a, ii) implies forall([x in vec(a), y in vec(a)], (qna-vmul(a, ii))(class(qmod-setoid(uba-as-module(a), ii), x), class(qmod-setoid(uba-as-module(a), ii), y)) = class(qmod-setoid(uba-as-module(a), ii), (vmul(a))(x, y)))))

- `qna-vmul-dist-right` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([ii], is-two-sided-ideal(a, ii) implies forall([c in quotient(qmod-setoid(uba-as-module(a), ii)), d in quotient(qmod-setoid(uba-as-module(a), ii)), e in quotient(qmod-setoid(uba-as-module(a), ii))], (qna-vmul(a, ii))((vadd(quotient-module(uba-as-module(a), ii)))(c, d), e) = (vadd(quotient-module(uba-as-module(a), ii)))((qna-vmul(a, ii))(c, e), (qna-vmul(a, ii))(d, e)))))
- `qna-vmul-dist-right-na` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([ii], is-two-sided-ideal(a, ii) implies forall([x_ in vec(quotient-module(uba-as-module(a), ii)), y_ in vec(quotient-module(uba-as-module(a), ii)), z_ in vec(quotient-module(uba-as-module(a), ii))], (qna-vmul(a, ii))((vadd(quotient-module(uba-as-module(a), ii)))(x_, y_), z_) = (vadd(quotient-module(uba-as-module(a), ii)))((qna-vmul(a, ii))(x_, z_), (qna-vmul(a, ii))(y_, z_)))))
- `qna-vmul-fun` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([ii], is-two-sided-ideal(a, ii) implies qna-vmul(a, ii) in fun(cartesian(quotient(qmod-setoid(uba-as-module(a), ii)), quotient(qmod-setoid(uba-as-module(a), ii))), quotient(qmod-setoid(uba-as-module(a), ii)))))
- `qna-vnrm-apply` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([ii], is-two-sided-ideal(a, ii) implies forall([c in quotient(qmod-setoid(uba-as-module(a), ii))], (qna-vnrm(a, ii))(c) = coset-norm(a, ii, c))))
- `qna-vnrm-definite` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([ii], is-two-sided-ideal(a, ii) implies is-closed(ba-metric-space(a), ii) implies forall([x_ in vec(quotient-module(uba-as-module(a), ii))], (qna-vnrm(a, ii))(x_) = 0 iff x_ = vzero(quotient-module(uba-as-module(a), ii)))))
- `qna-vnrm-fun` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([ii], is-two-sided-ideal(a, ii) implies qna-vnrm(a, ii) in fun(quotient(qmod-setoid(uba-as-module(a), ii)), rr)))
- `qna-vnrm-homog` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([ii], is-two-sided-ideal(a, ii) implies forall([r_ in carr(scal(quotient-module(uba-as-module(a), ii))), x_ in vec(quotient-module(uba-as-module(a), ii))], (qna-vnrm(a, ii))((act(quotient-module(uba-as-module(a), ii)))(r_, x_)) = magnitude(r_) * (qna-vnrm(a, ii))(x_))))
- `qna-vnrm-nonneg` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([ii], is-two-sided-ideal(a, ii) implies forall([x_ in vec(quotient-module(uba-as-module(a), ii))], 0 <= (qna-vnrm(a, ii))(x_))))
- `qna-vnrm-submult` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([ii], is-two-sided-ideal(a, ii) implies forall([x_ in vec(quotient-module(uba-as-module(a), ii)), y_ in vec(quotient-module(uba-as-module(a), ii))], (qna-vnrm(a, ii))((qna-vmul(a, ii))(x_, y_)) <= (qna-vnrm(a, ii))(x_) * (qna-vnrm(a, ii))(y_))))
- `qna-vnrm-triangle` — forall([a], is-unital-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([ii], is-two-sided-ideal(a, ii) implies forall([x_ in vec(quotient-module(uba-as-module(a), ii)), y_ in vec(quotient-module(uba-as-module(a), ii))], (qna-vnrm(a, ii))((vadd(quotient-module(uba-as-module(a), ii)))(x_, y_)) <= (qna-vnrm(a, ii))(x_) + (qna-vnrm(a, ii))(y_))))
- `qo-abs-p` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies (padic-abs(p))(p) * 2 = 1)
- `qo-abs-power` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies forall([x in carr(qp-field(p))], not(x = zero(qp-field(p))) implies forsome([m in zz], (qp-abs(p))(x) = rpow-star(2, m))))
- `qo-all-units` — forall([vf in fun(qq, rr)], is-nv-field(qq-nv(vf)) implies not(forsome([n in nn], 0 < n and vf(n) < 1)) implies forall([m in zz], not(m = 0) implies vf(m) = 1))
- `qo-int-halves` — forall([k in zz], max(k, 0) in nn and max(-k, 0) in nn and max(k, 0) + -max(-k, 0) = k)
- `qo-int-mult` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies forall([u], is-add-subgroup(qp-field(p), u) implies forall([x in u, n in zz], (mul(qp-field(p)))((embed(nf-metric-space(qq-padic(p))))(n), x) in u)))
- `qo-int-mult-nn` — forall([n in nn, p], zz-prime(p) implies forall([u], is-add-subgroup(qp-field(p), u) implies forall([x in u], (mul(qp-field(p)))((embed(nf-metric-space(qq-padic(p))))(n), x) in u)))
- `qo-int-small-iff` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies forall([n in zz], (padic-abs(p))(n) < 1 iff zz-divides(p, n)))
- `qo-int-value` — forall([vf in fun(qq, rr)], is-nv-field(qq-nv(vf)) implies forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies vf(p) < 1 implies forall([n in zz, i in nn], zz-ord-is(p, n, i) implies vf(n) = vf(p) ^ i)))
- `qo-le-one` — forall([vf in fun(qq, rr)], is-nv-field(qq-nv(vf)) implies forall([m in zz], vf(m) <= 1))
- `qo-le-one-nn` — forall([n in nn, vf in fun(qq, rr)], is-nv-field(qq-nv(vf)) implies vf(n) <= 1)
- `qo-one` — forall([vf in fun(qq, rr)], is-nv-field(qq-nv(vf)) implies vf(1) = 1)
- `qo-open-subgroup-module` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies forall([u], is-add-subgroup(qp-field(p), u) implies is-open(nf-metric-space(qp-field(p)), u) implies is-nv-module(qp-field(p), zp(p), u)))
- `qo-ord-value` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies forall([x in carr(qp-field(p)), m in rr], (qp-abs(p))(x) = rpow-star(2, m) implies (qp-ord(p))(x) = -m))
- `qo-power` — forall([k in nn, vf in fun(qq, rr)], is-nv-field(qq-nv(vf)) implies forall([p in zz], vf(p ^ k) = vf(p) ^ k))
- `qo-power-one` — forall([x in rr], x ^ 1 = x)
- `qo-ppos-abs` — forall([p], zz-prime(p) implies forall([k in nn], (embed(nf-metric-space(qq-padic(p))))(p ^ k) in carr(qp-field(p)) and not((embed(nf-metric-space(qq-padic(p))))(p ^ k) = zero(qp-field(p))) and (qp-abs(p))((embed(nf-metric-space(qq-padic(p))))(p ^ k)) = rpow-star(2, -k)))
