- `real-riesz-representation` — forall([v, f], is-real-hilbert-space(v) implies f in fun(vec(v), rr) implies forall([x_ in vec(v), y_ in vec(v)], f((vadd(v))(x_, y_)) = f(x_) + f(y_)) implies forall([r_ in rr, x_ in vec(v)], f((act(v))(r_, x_)) = r_ * f(x_)) implies is-continuous(sip-metric-space(v), rr-ms, f) implies forsome([rze_ in vec(v)], forall([rzx_ in vec(v)], f(rzx_) = (rip(v))(rzx_, rze_))))
- `real-scale-re-im` — forall([anc_, anw_], anc_ in rr implies anw_ in cc implies imag-part(anc_ * anw_) = anc_ * imag-part(anw_) and real-part(anc_ * anw_) = anc_ * real-part(anw_))
- `real-valued-measurable-fn-real` — forall([omega, ca, u], is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, u) implies forall([x_ in omega], u(x_) in rr) implies is-real-measurable-fn(omega, ca, u))
- `realification-convex` — forall([m], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies forall([mr], is-module(mr) implies scal(mr) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies vec(mr) = vec(m) implies vadd(mr) = vadd(m) implies vzero(mr) = vzero(m) implies vneg(mr) = vneg(m) implies forall([r_ in rr, x_ in vec(m)], (act(mr))(r_, x_) = (act(m))(r_, x_)) implies forall([c], is-convex-subset(m, c) implies is-convex-subset(mr, c))))
- `realification-seminorm-family` — forall([m], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies forall([mr], is-module(mr) implies scal(mr) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies vec(mr) = vec(m) implies vadd(mr) = vadd(m) implies vzero(mr) = vzero(m) implies vneg(mr) = vneg(m) implies forall([r_ in rr, x_ in vec(m)], (act(mr))(r_, x_) = (act(m))(r_, x_)) implies forall([ix, pf], is-seminorm-family-on(cc-normed-field, m, ix, pf) implies is-seminorm-family-on(rr-normed-field, mr, ix, pf))))
- `realification-seminorm-top` — forall([m], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies forall([mr], is-module(mr) implies scal(mr) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies vec(mr) = vec(m) implies vadd(mr) = vadd(m) implies vzero(mr) = vzero(m) implies vneg(mr) = vneg(m) implies forall([r_ in rr, x_ in vec(m)], (act(mr))(r_, x_) = (act(m))(r_, x_)) implies forall([ix, pf], seminorm-top(mr, ix, pf) == seminorm-top(m, ix, pf))))
- `rearrangement-abs` — forall([c6a_ in fun(nn, cc), c6g_ in fun(nn, nn)], forall([c6u_ in nn, c6v_ in nn], c6g_(c6u_) = c6g_(c6v_) implies c6u_ = c6v_) implies series-converges(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, magnitude(c6a_(c6k_)))) implies series-converges(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, magnitude(c6a_(c6g_(c6k_))))))
- `rearrangement-value` — forall([c6a_ in fun(nn, cc), c6g_ in fun(nn, nn)], forall([c6u_ in nn, c6v_ in nn], c6g_(c6u_) = c6g_(c6v_) implies c6u_ = c6v_) implies forall([c6w_ in nn], forsome([c6t_ in nn], c6g_(c6t_) = c6w_)) implies series-converges(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, magnitude(c6a_(c6k_)))) implies cc-series-converges-to(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, c6a_(c6g_(c6k_))), cc-series-limit(c6a_)))
- `recip-algebraic` — forall([n in nn, kk, c, b], is-subfield-of-cc(kk) implies c in fun(nn, kk) implies forall([pfk_ in nn], succ(n) <= pfk_ implies c(pfk_) = 0) implies c(n) = 1 implies b in cc implies not(b = 0) implies cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(pfj_, nn, c(pfj_) * b ^ pfj_), succ(n)) = 0 implies is-algebraic-over(kk, recip(b)))
- `recip-compare` — forall([a, t], a in rr implies t in rr implies 0 < t implies a < recip(t) iff a * t < 1)
- `recip-continuous-at` — forall([h, p], h in fun(rr, rr) implies forall([x in rr], not(h(x) = 0)) implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, h, p) implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, vnb-lambda(x, rr, recip(h(x))), p))
- `recip-factorial-in-rr` — forall([n in nn], recip(factorial(n)) in rr)
- `recip-gamma-nonzero-rhp` — forall([c6sw_ in cc], 0 < real-part(c6sw_) implies not(recip-gamma(c6sw_) = 0))
- `recip-lam-in-fun` — forall([h in fun(rr, rr)], forall([x in rr], not(h(x) = 0)) implies vnb-lambda(x, rr, recip(h(x))) in fun(rr, rr))
- `recip-near` — forall([c in rr], 0 < c implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([delta], pos-rr(delta) and forall([v in rr], abs(c - v) <= delta implies 0 < v and abs(recip(c) - recip(v)) <= eps))))
- `recip-power-two-halves` — forall([k in nn], recip(2 ^ k) = 2 * recip(2 * 2 ^ k))
- `recip-square-step` — forall([egn_ in nn], (recip(succ(egn_)) * recip(succ(egn_))) * num(1/2) <= recip(succ(egn_)) - recip(succ(succ(egn_))) and 0 <= recip(succ(egn_)) - recip(succ(succ(egn_))))
- `recip-square-telescope` — forall([egn_ in nn, egr_ in rr], series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(egq_, nn, (egr_ * egr_) * (recip(succ(egq_)) - recip(succ(succ(egq_))))), egn_) + (egr_ * egr_) * recip(succ(egn_)) = egr_ * egr_)
- `recip-star-antiderivable-pos` — forall([a, b], a in rr implies b in rr implies 0 < a implies a < b implies is-antiderivable(vnb-lambda(z_, rr, recip-star(z_)), a, b))
- `recip-star-continuous-at` — forall([c in rr], not(c = 0) implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, vnb-lambda(z_, rr, recip-star(z_)), c))
- `recip-star-continuous-on-ccint` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, x_ in rr], 0 < a implies x_ in ccint(a, b) implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, vnb-lambda(z_, rr, recip-star(z_)), x_))
- `recip-star-in-rr` — forall([u_ in rr], recip-star(u_) in rr)
- `recip-star-int-additive` — forall([u, v, w], u in rr implies v in rr implies w in rr implies 0 < u implies 0 < v implies 0 < w implies c-int-or(vnb-lambda(z_, rr, recip-star(z_)), u, w) = c-int-or(vnb-lambda(z_, rr, recip-star(z_)), u, v) + c-int-or(vnb-lambda(z_, rr, recip-star(z_)), v, w))
- `recip-star-inverse` — forall([u_ in rr], not(u_ = 0) implies u_ * recip-star(u_) = 1)
- `recip-star-lam-in-fun` — vnb-lambda(z_, rr, recip-star(z_)) in fun(rr, rr)
- `recip-star-le-one` — forall([c6k_ in nn], recip-star(c6k_) <= 1)
- `recip-star-nn-nonneg` — forall([cpsk_ in nn], 0 <= recip-star(cpsk_))
- `recip-star-nn-pos` — forall([cpsk_ in nn], 1 <= cpsk_ implies 0 < recip-star(cpsk_))
- `recip-star-scale` — forall([lam, u], lam in rr implies u in rr implies not(lam = 0) implies recip-star(lam * u) * lam = recip-star(u))
- `recip-star-value` — forall([u_ in rr], not(u_ = 0) implies recip-star(u_) = recip(u_))
- `recip-star-zero` — recip-star(0) = 0
- `recip-succ-cancel` — forall([m in nn, c in rr, v in rr], c * v = (succ(m) * (recip(succ(m)) * c)) * v)
- `recip-succ-small` — forall([d], pos-rr(d) implies forsome([n_ in nn], forall([m_ in nn], n_ <= m_ implies recip(m_ + 1) <= d)))
- `rect-cont-intro` — forall([a, b, f, chx_], a in rr implies b in rr implies a < b implies f in fun(cartesian(ccint(0, 1), ccint(a, b)), cc) implies chx_ in cartesian(ccint(0, 1), ccint(a, b)) implies forall([che_], pos-rr(che_) implies forsome([chd_], pos-rr(chd_) and forall([chy_ in cartesian(ccint(0, 1), ccint(a, b))], abs(nth(1, chx_) - nth(1, chy_)) <= chd_ implies abs(nth(2, chx_) - nth(2, chy_)) <= chd_ implies magnitude(f(chx_) - f(chy_)) <= che_))) implies is-continuous-at(product2-ms(subspace-ms(rr-ms, ccint(0, 1)), subspace-ms(rr-ms, ccint(a, b))), cc-ms, f, chx_))
- `rect-dist` — forall([a, b, chy_, chz_], a in rr implies b in rr implies chy_ in cartesian(ccint(0, 1), ccint(a, b)) implies chz_ in cartesian(ccint(0, 1), ccint(a, b)) implies (dist(product2-ms(subspace-ms(rr-ms, ccint(0, 1)), subspace-ms(rr-ms, ccint(a, b)))))(chy_, chz_) == max(abs(nth(1, chy_) - nth(1, chz_)), abs(nth(2, chy_) - nth(2, chz_))))
- `rect-unif` — forall([a, b, f], a in rr implies b in rr implies a < b implies f in fun(cartesian(ccint(0, 1), ccint(a, b)), cc) implies forall([chx_ in cartesian(ccint(0, 1), ccint(a, b))], is-continuous-at(product2-ms(subspace-ms(rr-ms, ccint(0, 1)), subspace-ms(rr-ms, ccint(a, b))), cc-ms, f, chx_)) implies forall([che_], pos-rr(che_) implies forsome([chd_], pos-rr(chd_) and forall([chy_ in cartesian(ccint(0, 1), ccint(a, b)), chz_ in cartesian(ccint(0, 1), ccint(a, b))], abs(nth(1, chy_) - nth(1, chz_)) <= chd_ implies abs(nth(2, chy_) - nth(2, chz_)) <= chd_ implies magnitude(f(chy_) - f(chz_)) <= che_))))
- `rectangle-in-product-sigma` — forall([xs, ca, ys, cb, aa, bb], is-sigma-algebra(xs, ca) implies is-sigma-algebra(ys, cb) implies aa in ca implies bb in cb implies cartesian(aa, bb) in product-sigma(xs, ca, ys, cb))
- `rectangle-in-rectangles` — forall([xs, ca, ys, cb, aa, bb], is-sigma-algebra(xs, ca) implies is-sigma-algebra(ys, cb) implies aa in ca implies bb in cb implies cartesian(aa, bb) in rectangles(xs, ca, ys, cb))
- `rectangles-membership` — forall([xs, ca, ys, cb, r_], r_ in rectangles(xs, ca, ys, cb) iff r_ in power(cartesian(xs, ys)) and forsome([rca_ in ca, rcb_ in cb], r_ = cartesian(rca_, rcb_)))
- `rectangles-pi-system` — forall([xs, ca, ys, cb], is-sigma-algebra(xs, ca) implies is-sigma-algebra(ys, cb) implies is-pi-system(rectangles(xs, ca, ys, cb)))

- `reflect-continuous-at-sub` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, f, prc_ in rr, prq_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr)], forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], prq_(pay_) == prc_ * f(a + b - pay_)) implies forall([prt_ in ccint(a, b)], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(rr-ms, ccint(a, b)), rr-ms, f, a + b - prt_) implies is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(rr-ms, ccint(a, b)), rr-ms, prq_, prt_)))
- `reflect-continuous-on` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, f, prc_ in rr, prq_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr)], is-continuous-on(f, ccint(a, b)) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], prq_(pay_) == prc_ * f(a + b - pay_)) implies is-continuous-on(prq_, ccint(a, b)))
- `reflect-image-countable` — forall([a, b], a in rr implies b in rr implies forall([prd_], is-countable(prd_) implies prd_ subset ccint(a, b) implies is-countable(image(vnb-lambda(prx_, ccint(a, b), a + b - prx_), prd_)) and image(vnb-lambda(prx_, ccint(a, b), a + b - prx_), prd_) subset ccint(a, b)))
- `reflect-image-finite` — forall([a, b], a in rr implies b in rr implies forall([prd_ in set], card(prd_) in nn implies prd_ subset ccint(a, b) implies image(vnb-lambda(prx_, ccint(a, b), a + b - prx_), prd_) in set and card(image(vnb-lambda(prx_, ccint(a, b), a + b - prx_), prd_)) in nn and image(vnb-lambda(prx_, ccint(a, b), a + b - prx_), prd_) subset ccint(a, b)))
- `reflect-not-in-image` — forall([a, b], a in rr implies b in rr implies forall([prd_], prd_ subset ccint(a, b) implies forall([prt_ in ccint(a, b)], not(prt_ in image(vnb-lambda(prx_, ccint(a, b), a + b - prx_), prd_)) implies not(a + b - prt_ in prd_))))
- `reflection-holomorphic` — forall([rxa_, rxh_], holomorphic-on(rxa_, rxh_) implies holomorphic-on(conj-set(rxa_), vnb-lambda(rxw_, conj-set(rxa_), conjugate(rxh_(conjugate(rxw_))))))
- `regular-iff-separable-support` — forall([s], is-complete(s) implies forall([mu], is-measure(pts(s), borel-sets(s), mu) implies mu(pts(s)) = 1 implies is-regular-measure(s, mu) iff forsome([e in borel-sets(s)], is-separable(subspace-ms(s, e)) and mu(e) = 1)))
- `regular-iff-tight` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([mu], is-measure(pts(s), borel-sets(s), mu) implies mu(pts(s)) in rr implies is-regular-measure(s, mu) iff mu(pts(s)) = esup({rgv_ in rr-pos-star: forsome([rgk_ in power(pts(s))], rgk_ subset pts(s) and is-compact(subspace-ms(s, rgk_)) and rgv_ = mu(rgk_))})))
- `regulated-extend-const-is-regulated-on` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, f in fun(ccint(a, b), rr)], is-regulated(extend-const(f, a, b), a, b) implies is-regulated-on(f, a, b))

- `regulated-on-glue` — forall([a in rr, c in rr, b in rr], a < c implies c < b implies forall([f1, f2, f], is-regulated-on(f1, a, c) implies is-regulated-on(f2, c, b) implies f in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) implies forall([t in ccint(a, c)], t < c implies f(t) == f1(t)) implies forall([t in ccint(c, b)], c < t implies f(t) == f2(t)) implies is-regulated-on(f, a, b)))
- `regulated-on-has-primitive` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, f], is-regulated-on(f, a, b) implies forsome([g], is-primitive(g, f, a, b)))
- `regulated-on-iff-step-limit` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, f], a < b implies f in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) implies is-regulated-on(f, a, b) iff forsome([fam in fun(nn, fun(rr, rr))], forall([k in nn], is-step-fn(fam(k), a, b)) and is-unif-limit-on(fam, extend-const(f, a, b), a, b)))
- `regulated-on-is-step-limit` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, f], is-regulated-on(f, a, b) implies forsome([fam in fun(nn, fun(rr, rr))], forall([k in nn], is-step-fn(fam(k), a, b)) and is-unif-limit-on(fam, extend-const(f, a, b), a, b)))
- `regulated-on-left-window` — forall([rswa_, rswb_, rswf_, rswg_, rswe_, rswt_], is-regulated-on(rswf_, rswa_, rswb_) implies rswg_ in fun(rr, rr) implies forall([rswz_ in ccint(rswa_, rswb_)], rswg_(rswz_) = rswf_(rswz_)) implies pos-rr(rswe_) implies rswt_ in ccint(rswa_, rswb_) implies forsome([rsld_ in rr], 0 < rsld_ and forsome([rsll_ in rr], forall([rsls_ in rr], rswa_ <= rsls_ implies rswt_ - rsld_ < rsls_ implies rsls_ < rswt_ implies abs(rswg_(rsls_) - rsll_) <= rswe_))))
- `regulated-on-magnitude` — forall([f, g, lih_, a, b], is-regulated-on(f, a, b) implies is-regulated-on(g, a, b) implies lih_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) implies forall([liz_ in ccint(a, b)], lih_(liz_) == magnitude(f(liz_) + g(liz_) * 1i)) implies is-regulated-on(lih_, a, b))
- `regulated-on-mul` — forall([f, g, rgh_, a, b], is-regulated-on(f, a, b) implies is-regulated-on(g, a, b) implies rgh_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) implies forall([rgz_ in ccint(a, b)], rgh_(rgz_) == f(rgz_) * g(rgz_)) implies is-regulated-on(rgh_, a, b))
- `regulated-on-reflect` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, f, prc_ in rr, prq_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr)], is-regulated-on(f, a, b) implies forall([pay_ in ccint(a, b)], prq_(pay_) == prc_ * f(a + b - pay_)) implies is-regulated-on(prq_, a, b))
- `regulated-on-restrict` — forall([f, a, b, rqc_, rqd_, g], is-regulated-on(f, a, b) implies rqc_ in rr implies rqd_ in rr implies a <= rqc_ implies rqc_ < rqd_ implies rqd_ <= b implies g in fun(ccint(rqc_, rqd_), rr) implies forall([rqz_ in ccint(rqc_, rqd_)], g(rqz_) = f(rqz_)) implies is-regulated-on(g, rqc_, rqd_))
- `regulated-on-right-window` — forall([rswa_, rswb_, rswf_, rswg_, rswe_, rswt_], is-regulated-on(rswf_, rswa_, rswb_) implies rswg_ in fun(rr, rr) implies forall([rswz_ in ccint(rswa_, rswb_)], rswg_(rswz_) = rswf_(rswz_)) implies pos-rr(rswe_) implies rswt_ in ccint(rswa_, rswb_) implies forsome([rsrd_ in rr], 0 < rsrd_ and forsome([rsrl_ in rr], forall([rsrs_ in rr], rswt_ < rsrs_ implies rsrs_ < rswt_ + rsrd_ implies rsrs_ <= rswb_ implies abs(rswg_(rsrs_) - rsrl_) <= rswe_))))
- `regulated-on-scalar` — forall([f, rgh_, a, b, rgc_ in rr], is-regulated-on(f, a, b) implies rgh_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) implies forall([rgz_ in ccint(a, b)], rgh_(rgz_) == rgc_ * f(rgz_)) implies is-regulated-on(rgh_, a, b))
- `regulated-on-step-approx` — forall([rswa_, rswb_, rswf_], is-regulated-on(rswf_, rswa_, rswb_) implies forall([rswe_], pos-rr(rswe_) implies forsome([rsth_ in fun(rr, rr)], is-step-fn(rsth_, rswa_, rswb_) and forall([rsqz_ in ccint(rswa_, rswb_)], abs((extend-const(rswf_, rswa_, rswb_))(rsqz_) - rsth_(rsqz_)) <= rswe_))))
- `regulated-on-step-approx-creep` — forall([rswa_, rswb_, rswf_, rswg_, rswe_], is-regulated-on(rswf_, rswa_, rswb_) implies rswg_ in fun(rr, rr) implies forall([rswz_ in ccint(rswa_, rswb_)], rswg_(rswz_) = rswf_(rswz_)) implies pos-rr(rswe_) implies forsome([rsqn_ in nn, rsqp_ in fun(nn, rr), rsqh_ in fun(rr, rr)], rsqp_(0) = rswa_ and rsqp_(rsqn_) = rswb_ and forall([rsi_, rsj_], rsi_ in interval(0, rsqn_) and rsj_ in interval(0, rsqn_) and rsi_ < rsj_ implies rsqp_(rsi_) < rsqp_(rsj_)) and forall([rspi_], rspi_ in interval(0, rsqn_) and rspi_ < rsqn_ implies forsome([rspc_ in rr], forall([rspt_], rspt_ in rr and rsqp_(rspi_) < rspt_ and rspt_ < rsqp_(succ(rspi_)) implies rsqh_(rspt_) = rspc_))) and forall([rsqz_ in ccint(rswa_, rswb_)], abs(rswg_(rsqz_) - rsqh_(rsqz_)) <= rswe_)))
- `regulated-on-sub` — forall([f, g, rgh_, a, b], is-regulated-on(f, a, b) implies is-regulated-on(g, a, b) implies rgh_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) implies forall([rgz_ in ccint(a, b)], rgh_(rgz_) == f(rgz_) - g(rgz_)) implies is-regulated-on(rgh_, a, b))
- `regulated-on-sum` — forall([f, g, rgh_, a, b], is-regulated-on(f, a, b) implies is-regulated-on(g, a, b) implies rgh_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) implies forall([rgz_ in ccint(a, b)], rgh_(rgz_) == f(rgz_) + g(rgz_)) implies is-regulated-on(rgh_, a, b))
- `rel-free-lincomb-cancel` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([n, cr, dr, xs], cr in mat(1, n, carr(scal(md))) implies dr in mat(1, n, carr(scal(md))) implies xs in mat(n, 1, vec(md)) implies rel-free(md, n, xs) implies lincomb(md, n, cr, xs) = lincomb(md, n, dr, xs) implies forall([j_ in interval(1, n)], entry(cr, 1, j_) = entry(dr, 1, j_))))
- `rel-free-matact-cancel` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([m, n, xs, pm, qm], xs in mat(n, 1, vec(md)) implies pm in mat(m, n, carr(scal(md))) implies qm in mat(m, n, carr(scal(md))) implies rel-free(md, n, xs) implies matact(md, pm, xs) = matact(md, qm, xs) implies pm = qm))

- `ring-pow-form-add-r` — forall([r, n, a, x, y, z], is-commutative-ring(r) implies n in nn implies 1 <= n implies a in mat(n, n, carr(r)) implies x in vec(ring-pow(r, n)) implies y in vec(ring-pow(r, n)) implies z in vec(ring-pow(r, n)) implies entry(matmul(r, ring-row(r, n, z), matmul(r, a, transpose(ring-row(r, n, (vadd(ring-pow(r, n)))(x, y)), 1, n))), 1, 1) = (add(r))(entry(matmul(r, ring-row(r, n, z), matmul(r, a, transpose(ring-row(r, n, x), 1, n))), 1, 1), entry(matmul(r, ring-row(r, n, z), matmul(r, a, transpose(ring-row(r, n, y), 1, n))), 1, 1)))
- `ring-pow-form-type` — forall([r, n, a, u, v], is-commutative-ring(r) implies n in nn implies 1 <= n implies a in mat(n, n, carr(r)) implies u in vec(ring-pow(r, n)) implies v in vec(ring-pow(r, n)) implies entry(matmul(r, ring-row(r, n, u), matmul(r, a, transpose(ring-row(r, n, v), 1, n))), 1, 1) in carr(r))
- `ring-pow-is-module` — forall([r, n], is-ring(r) implies n in nn implies is-module(ring-pow(r, n)))
- `ring-pow-lincomb-at` — forall([r, n, c, i], is-ring(r) implies n in nn implies c in mat(1, n, carr(r)) implies i in interval(1, n) implies (lincomb(ring-pow(r, n), n, c, ring-units(r, n)))(i) = entry(c, 1, i))
- `ring-pow-matrix-form-bilinear` — forall([r, n, a], is-commutative-ring(r) implies n in nn implies 1 <= n implies a in mat(n, n, carr(r)) implies forall([rpfx_ in vec(ring-pow(r, n)), rpfy_ in vec(ring-pow(r, n)), rpfw_ in vec(ring-pow(r, n))], entry(matmul(r, ring-row(r, n, (vadd(ring-pow(r, n)))(rpfx_, rpfy_)), matmul(r, a, transpose(ring-row(r, n, rpfw_), 1, n))), 1, 1) = (add(r))(entry(matmul(r, ring-row(r, n, rpfx_), matmul(r, a, transpose(ring-row(r, n, rpfw_), 1, n))), 1, 1), entry(matmul(r, ring-row(r, n, rpfy_), matmul(r, a, transpose(ring-row(r, n, rpfw_), 1, n))), 1, 1)) and entry(matmul(r, ring-row(r, n, rpfw_), matmul(r, a, transpose(ring-row(r, n, (vadd(ring-pow(r, n)))(rpfx_, rpfy_)), 1, n))), 1, 1) = (add(r))(entry(matmul(r, ring-row(r, n, rpfw_), matmul(r, a, transpose(ring-row(r, n, rpfx_), 1, n))), 1, 1), entry(matmul(r, ring-row(r, n, rpfw_), matmul(r, a, transpose(ring-row(r, n, rpfy_), 1, n))), 1, 1))) and forall([rpfa_ in carr(r), rpfx_ in vec(ring-pow(r, n)), rpfy_ in vec(ring-pow(r, n))], entry(matmul(r, ring-row(r, n, (act(ring-pow(r, n)))(rpfa_, rpfx_)), matmul(r, a, transpose(ring-row(r, n, rpfy_), 1, n))), 1, 1) = (mul(r))(rpfa_, entry(matmul(r, ring-row(r, n, rpfx_), matmul(r, a, transpose(ring-row(r, n, rpfy_), 1, n))), 1, 1)) and entry(matmul(r, ring-row(r, n, rpfx_), matmul(r, a, transpose(ring-row(r, n, (act(ring-pow(r, n)))(rpfa_, rpfy_)), 1, n))), 1, 1) = (mul(r))(rpfa_, entry(matmul(r, ring-row(r, n, rpfx_), matmul(r, a, transpose(ring-row(r, n, rpfy_), 1, n))), 1, 1))))
- `ring-pow-row-lincomb` — forall([r, n, x], is-ring(r) implies n in nn implies x in vec(ring-pow(r, n)) implies lincomb(ring-pow(r, n), n, ring-row(r, n, x), ring-units(r, n)) = x)
- `ring-pow-scal` — forall([r, n], is-ring(r) implies n in nn implies scal(ring-pow(r, n)) = r)
- `ring-pow-unfold` — forall([r, n], ring-pow(r, n) == direct-sum(r, n, vnb-lambda(rqpi_, interval(1, n), ring-as-module(r))))
- `ring-pow-vadd-at` — forall([r, n, x, y, i], is-ring(r) implies n in nn implies x in vec(ring-pow(r, n)) implies y in vec(ring-pow(r, n)) implies i in interval(1, n) implies ((vadd(ring-pow(r, n)))(x, y))(i) = (add(r))(x(i), y(i)))
- `ring-pow-vec-in` — forall([r, n, x], is-ring(r) implies n in nn implies x in fun(interval(1, n), carr(r)) implies x in vec(ring-pow(r, n)))
- `ring-pow-vec-out` — forall([r, n, x, i], is-ring(r) implies n in nn implies x in vec(ring-pow(r, n)) implies i in interval(1, n) implies x(i) in carr(r))
- `ring-pow-vzero-at` — forall([r, n, i], is-ring(r) implies n in nn implies i in interval(1, n) implies (vzero(ring-pow(r, n)))(i) = zero(r))
- `ring-power-add` — forall([r], is-commutative-ring(r) implies forall([x in carr(r), j in nn, k in nn], ring-power(r, x, j + k) = (mul(r))(ring-power(r, x, j), ring-power(r, x, k))))
- `ring-power-add-ind` — forall([k in nn, r], is-commutative-ring(r) implies forall([x in carr(r), j in nn], ring-power(r, x, j + k) = (mul(r))(ring-power(r, x, j), ring-power(r, x, k))))
- `ring-power-mult` — forall([r], is-commutative-ring(r) implies forall([x in carr(r), y in carr(r), n in nn], ring-power(r, (mul(r))(x, y), n) = (mul(r))(ring-power(r, x, n), ring-power(r, y, n))))
- `ring-power-mult-ind` — forall([n in nn, r], is-commutative-ring(r) implies forall([x in carr(r), y in carr(r)], ring-power(r, (mul(r))(x, y), n) = (mul(r))(ring-power(r, x, n), ring-power(r, y, n))))
- `ring-power-nilpotent-zero` — forall([n in nn, r], is-integral-domain(r) implies forall([a in carr(r)], ring-power(r, a, succ(n)) = zero(r) implies a = zero(r)))
- `ring-power-of-one` — forall([n_ in nn, r], is-commutative-ring(r) implies ring-power(r, one(r), n_) = one(r))
- `ring-power-one` — forall([r], is-commutative-ring(r) implies forall([x in carr(r)], ring-power(r, x, 1) = x))
- `ring-power-succ` — forall([r], is-commutative-ring(r) implies forall([x in carr(r), n in nn], ring-power(r, x, succ(n)) = (mul(r))(ring-power(r, x, n), x)))
- `ring-power-succ-left` — forall([r], is-commutative-ring(r) implies forall([x in carr(r), n in nn], ring-power(r, x, succ(n)) = (mul(r))(x, ring-power(r, x, n))))
- `ring-power-type` — forall([r], is-commutative-ring(r) implies forall([x in carr(r), n in nn], ring-power(r, x, n) in carr(r)))
- `ring-power-zero` — forall([r], is-ring(r) implies forall([x], ring-power(r, x, 0) == one(r)))
- `ring-prod-is-ring` — forall([x], is-ring(x) implies forall([y], is-ring(y) implies is-ring(ring-prod(x, y))))
- `ring-prod-n-is-ring` — forall([f, n in nn], forall([i in nn], is-ring(f(i))) implies is-ring(ring-prod-n(f, n)))
- `ring-prod-n-is-ring-ind` — forall([n in nn, f], forall([i in nn], is-ring(f(i))) implies is-ring(ring-prod-n(f, n)))
- `ring-row-act` — forall([r, n, a, x], is-ring(r) implies n in nn implies a in carr(r) implies x in vec(ring-pow(r, n)) implies ring-row(r, n, (act(ring-pow(r, n)))(a, x)) = matscale(r, a, ring-row(r, n, x)))
- `ring-row-entry` — forall([r, n, x, i], is-ring(r) implies n in nn implies x in vec(ring-pow(r, n)) implies i in interval(1, n) implies entry(ring-row(r, n, x), 1, i) = x(i))
- `ring-row-type` — forall([r, n, x], is-ring(r) implies n in nn implies x in vec(ring-pow(r, n)) implies ring-row(r, n, x) in mat(1, n, carr(r)))
- `ring-row-vadd` — forall([r, n, x, y], is-ring(r) implies n in nn implies x in vec(ring-pow(r, n)) implies y in vec(ring-pow(r, n)) implies ring-row(r, n, (vadd(ring-pow(r, n)))(x, y)) = matadd(r, ring-row(r, n, x), ring-row(r, n, y)))
- `ring-scalar-zz-nn` — forall([k in nn, rng], is-commutative-ring(rng) implies forall([r in carr(rng), a in carr(rng)], (mul(rng))(r, zz-act(ring-additive-ag(rng), k, a)) = zz-act(ring-additive-ag(rng), k, (mul(rng))(r, a))))
- `ring-unit-at` — forall([r, n, k, i], is-ring(r) implies n in nn implies i in interval(1, n) implies (vnb-lambda(rqut_, interval(1, n), entry(unitrow(r, n, k), 1, rqut_)))(i) = entry(unitrow(r, n, k), 1, i))
- `ring-unit-vec` — forall([r, n, k], is-ring(r) implies n in nn implies vnb-lambda(rqut_, interval(1, n), entry(unitrow(r, n, k), 1, rqut_)) in vec(ring-pow(r, n)))
- `ring-units-entry` — forall([r, n, k], is-ring(r) implies n in nn implies k in interval(1, n) implies entry(ring-units(r, n), k, 1) = vnb-lambda(rqut_, interval(1, n), entry(unitrow(r, n, k), 1, rqut_)))
- `ring-units-generate` — forall([r, n], is-ring(r) implies n in nn implies generates(ring-pow(r, n), n, ring-units(r, n)))
- `ring-units-rel-free` — forall([r, n], is-ring(r) implies n in nn implies rel-free(ring-pow(r, n), n, ring-units(r, n)))
- `ring-units-type` — forall([r, n], is-ring(r) implies n in nn implies ring-units(r, n) in mat(n, 1, vec(ring-pow(r, n))))
- `ringoid-as-ring-functorial` — forall([a, b, f], is-hom-ringoid(a, b, f) implies is-hom-ring(ringoid-as-ring(a), ringoid-as-ring(b), f))
- `ringoid-as-ring-is-ring` — forall([r], is-ringoid(r) implies is-ring(ringoid-as-ring(r)))
- `ringoid-diff-telescope` — forall([r, a, b, c], is-ringoid(r) implies a in carr(r) implies b in carr(r) implies c in carr(r) implies (add(r))((add(r))(a, (neg(r))(b)), (add(r))(b, (neg(r))(c))) = (add(r))(a, (neg(r))(c)))
- `ringoid-neg-diff` — forall([r, a, b], is-ringoid(r) implies a in carr(r) implies b in carr(r) implies (neg(r))((add(r))(a, (neg(r))(b))) = (add(r))(b, (neg(r))(a)))
- `ringoid-quotient-is-ring` — forall([r], is-ringoid(r) implies is-ring(ringoid-quotient-ring(r)))
- `ringoid-rel-is-equivalence` — forall([r], is-ringoid(r) implies is-equivalence(ringoid-rel(r), carr(r)))
- `ringoid-setoid-is-setoid` — forall([r], is-ringoid(r) implies is-setoid(ringoid-setoid(r)))
- `rintegral-abs-le` — forall([omega, ca, mu, f], is-measure(omega, ca, mu) implies is-integrable(omega, ca, mu, f) implies abs(rintegral(omega, ca, mu, f)) <= integral(omega, ca, mu, abs-fn(omega, f)))
- `rintegral-add` — forall([omega, ca, mu, f, g], is-measure(omega, ca, mu) implies is-integrable(omega, ca, mu, f) implies is-integrable(omega, ca, mu, g) implies is-integrable(omega, ca, mu, vnb-lambda(sx_, omega, f(sx_) + g(sx_))) and rintegral(omega, ca, mu, vnb-lambda(sx_, omega, f(sx_) + g(sx_))) = rintegral(omega, ca, mu, f) + rintegral(omega, ca, mu, g))
- `rintegral-ae-eq` — forall([omega, ca, mu, f, g, ns], is-measure(omega, ca, mu) implies is-integrable(omega, ca, mu, f) implies is-real-measurable-fn(omega, ca, g) implies is-null-set(omega, ca, mu, ns) implies forall([x in omega], not(x in ns) implies f(x) = g(x)) implies is-integrable(omega, ca, mu, g) and rintegral(omega, ca, mu, g) = rintegral(omega, ca, mu, f))
- `rintegral-congruence` — forall([omega, ca, mu, f, g], f in fun(omega, rr) implies g in fun(omega, rr) implies forall([x in omega], f(x) = g(x)) implies rintegral(omega, ca, mu, f) == rintegral(omega, ca, mu, g))
- `rintegral-decomposition` — forall([omega, ca, mu, f, h1, h2], is-measure(omega, ca, mu) implies f in fun(omega, rr) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, h1) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, h2) implies forall([x in omega], h1(x) in rr) implies forall([x in omega], h2(x) in rr) implies forall([x in omega], f(x) = h1(x) - h2(x)) implies integral(omega, ca, mu, h1) in rr implies integral(omega, ca, mu, h2) in rr implies is-integrable(omega, ca, mu, f) and rintegral(omega, ca, mu, f) = integral(omega, ca, mu, h1) - integral(omega, ca, mu, h2))
- `rintegral-density` — forall([omega, ca, rho, pp, g, f], is-measure(omega, ca, rho) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, pp) implies forall([x in omega], pp(x) in rr) implies is-real-measurable-fn(omega, ca, g) implies f in fun(omega, rr) implies forall([x in omega], f(x) = pp(x) * g(x)) implies is-integrable(omega, ca, rho, f) implies rintegral(omega, ca, vnb-lambda(dma_, ca, integral(omega, ca, rho, ptwise-etimes(omega, pp, indicator(omega, dma_)))), g) = rintegral(omega, ca, rho, f))
- `rintegral-density-hyp` — forall([omega, ca, rho, mu, h, g, f], is-measure(omega, ca, rho) implies is-measure(omega, ca, mu) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, h) implies forall([rnx_ in omega], h(rnx_) in rr) implies forall([rna_ in ca], mu(rna_) = integral(omega, ca, rho, ptwise-etimes(omega, h, indicator(omega, rna_)))) implies is-real-measurable-fn(omega, ca, g) implies f in fun(omega, rr) implies forall([x in omega], f(x) = h(x) * g(x)) implies is-integrable(omega, ca, rho, f) implies rintegral(omega, ca, mu, g) = rintegral(omega, ca, rho, f))
- `rintegral-diff-density` — forall([omega, ca, rho, d1, d2, m1, m2, c], is-measure(omega, ca, rho) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, d1) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, d2) implies forall([rnx_ in omega], d1(rnx_) in rr) implies forall([rnx_ in omega], d2(rnx_) in rr) implies is-finite-measure(omega, ca, m1) implies is-finite-measure(omega, ca, m2) implies forall([rna_ in ca], m1(rna_) = integral(omega, ca, rho, ptwise-etimes(omega, d1, indicator(omega, rna_)))) implies forall([rna_ in ca], m2(rna_) = integral(omega, ca, rho, ptwise-etimes(omega, d2, indicator(omega, rna_)))) implies c in ca implies is-integrable(omega, ca, rho, vnb-lambda(hx_, omega, (indicator(omega, c))(hx_) * (d1(hx_) - d2(hx_)))) and rintegral(omega, ca, rho, vnb-lambda(hx_, omega, (indicator(omega, c))(hx_) * (d1(hx_) - d2(hx_)))) = m1(c) - m2(c))
- `rintegral-in-rr` — forall([omega, ca, mu, f in fun(omega, rr)], is-integrable(omega, ca, mu, f) implies rintegral(omega, ca, mu, f) in rr)
- `rintegral-mono-off-null` — forall([omega, ca, mu, f, g, ns], is-measure(omega, ca, mu) implies is-integrable(omega, ca, mu, f) implies is-integrable(omega, ca, mu, g) implies is-null-set(omega, ca, mu, ns) implies forall([x in omega], not(x in ns) implies f(x) <= g(x)) implies rintegral(omega, ca, mu, f) <= rintegral(omega, ca, mu, g))
- `rintegral-monotone` — forall([omega, ca, mu, f, g], is-measure(omega, ca, mu) implies is-integrable(omega, ca, mu, f) implies is-integrable(omega, ca, mu, g) implies forall([x in omega], f(x) <= g(x)) implies rintegral(omega, ca, mu, f) <= rintegral(omega, ca, mu, g))
- `rintegral-nonneg-on-sets-null` — forall([omega, ca, mu, f], is-measure(omega, ca, mu) implies is-integrable(omega, ca, mu, f) implies forall([aa in ca], 0 <= rintegral(omega, ca, mu, vnb-lambda(rx_, omega, f(rx_) * (indicator(omega, aa))(rx_)))) implies is-null-set(omega, ca, mu, {nx_ in omega: f(nx_) < 0}))
- `rintegral-null-support` — forall([omega, ca, mu, b, g], is-measure(omega, ca, mu) implies b in ca implies mu(b) = 0 implies is-real-measurable-fn(omega, ca, g) implies rintegral(omega, ca, mu, vnb-lambda(cix_, omega, (indicator(omega, b))(cix_) * g(cix_))) = 0)
- `rintegral-of-nonneg` — forall([omega, ca, mu, f], is-measure(omega, ca, mu) implies is-integrable(omega, ca, mu, f) implies forall([x in omega], 0 <= f(x)) implies is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, f) and rintegral(omega, ca, mu, f) = integral(omega, ca, mu, f))
- `rintegral-restrict` — forall([omega, ca, mu, f, aa], is-measure(omega, ca, mu) implies is-integrable(omega, ca, mu, f) implies aa in ca implies is-integrable(omega, ca, mu, vnb-lambda(rx_, omega, f(rx_) * (indicator(omega, aa))(rx_))) and rintegral(omega, ca, mu, vnb-lambda(rx_, omega, f(rx_) * (indicator(omega, aa))(rx_))) = integral(omega, ca, mu, ptwise-etimes(omega, pos-part(omega, f), indicator(omega, aa))) - integral(omega, ca, mu, ptwise-etimes(omega, neg-part(omega, f), indicator(omega, aa))))
- `rintegral-scale` — forall([omega, ca, mu, f, c], is-measure(omega, ca, mu) implies is-integrable(omega, ca, mu, f) implies c in rr implies is-integrable(omega, ca, mu, vnb-lambda(sx_, omega, c * f(sx_))) and rintegral(omega, ca, mu, vnb-lambda(sx_, omega, c * f(sx_))) = c * rintegral(omega, ca, mu, f))
- `rintegral-unfold` — forall([omega, ca, mu, f], rintegral(omega, ca, mu, f) == integral(omega, ca, mu, pos-part(omega, f)) - integral(omega, ca, mu, neg-part(omega, f)))
- `rintegral-zero-fn` — forall([omega, ca, mu], is-measure(omega, ca, mu) implies rintegral(omega, ca, mu, vnb-lambda(cx_, omega, 0)) = 0)
- `rintegral-zero-on-sets-null` — forall([omega, ca, rho, f], is-measure(omega, ca, rho) implies is-integrable(omega, ca, rho, f) implies forall([bb_ in ca], rintegral(omega, ca, rho, vnb-lambda(rx_, omega, f(rx_) * (indicator(omega, bb_))(rx_))) = 0) implies is-null-set(omega, ca, rho, {nzx_ in omega: not(f(nzx_) = 0)}))
- `rko2-cauchy-setoid-length` — forall([m], is-metric-space(m) implies length(cauchy-setoid(m)) = 2)
- `rko2-cauchy-setoid-rel` — forall([m], is-metric-space(m) implies rel(cauchy-setoid(m)) == crel(m))
- `rko2-class-eq-null` — forall([m, p_, q_], is-metric-space(m) implies p_ in cseq(m) implies q_ in cseq(m) implies class(cauchy-setoid(m), p_) = class(cauchy-setoid(m), q_) implies converges-to(rr-ms, dist-seq(m, p_, q_), 0))
- `rko2-completion-dist` — forall([m], is-metric-space(m) implies dist(completion(m)) == completion-dist(m))
- `rko2-const-equiv-converges` — forall([m, u_, f_], is-metric-space(m) implies u_ in pts(m) implies f_ in fun(nn, pts(m)) implies converges-to(rr-ms, dist-seq(m, embed-seq(m, u_), f_), 0) implies converges-to(m, f_, u_))
- `rko2-const-seq-converges` — forall([m, u_], is-metric-space(m) implies u_ in pts(m) implies converges-to(m, embed-seq(m, u_), u_))
- `rko2-crel-elim` — forall([m, p_, q_], [p_, q_] in crel(m) implies cseq-equiv(m, p_, q_))
- `rko2-crel-intro` — forall([m, p_, q_], p_ in cseq(m) implies q_ in cseq(m) implies cseq-equiv(m, p_, q_) implies [p_, q_] in crel(m))
- `rko2-crel-is-set` — forall([m], is-metric-space(m) implies crel(m) in set)
- `rko2-crel-unfold` — forall([m], crel(m) == {p_ in cartesian(cseq(m), cseq(m)): cseq-equiv(m, nth(1, p_), nth(2, p_))})
- `rko2-cseq-in-fun` — forall([m, f_ in cseq(m)], f_ in fun(nn, pts(m)))
- `rko2-cseq-unfold` — forall([m], cseq(m) == {f_ in fun(nn, pts(m)): is-cauchy-seq(m, f_)})
- `rko2-dist-converges` — forall([m], is-metric-space(m) implies forall([f_, g_, a_, b_], f_ in fun(nn, pts(m)) implies g_ in fun(nn, pts(m)) implies a_ in pts(m) implies b_ in pts(m) implies converges-to(m, f_, a_) implies converges-to(m, g_, b_) implies converges-to(rr-ms, dist-seq(m, f_, g_), (dist(m))(a_, b_))))
- `rko2-dist-seq-at` — forall([m, f_, g_, n_ in nn], (dist-seq(m, f_, g_))(n_) == (dist(m))(f_(n_), g_(n_)))
- `rko2-dist-seq-type` — forall([m, f_, g_], is-metric-space(m) implies f_ in fun(nn, pts(m)) implies g_ in fun(nn, pts(m)) implies dist-seq(m, f_, g_) in fun(nn, rr))

- `segment-complement` — forall([g, al, phi, r], is-group(g) implies al in rr implies 0 < al implies phi in fun(ccint(0, al), carr(g)) implies forall([gsr_ in ccint(0, al), gsu_ in ccint(0, al)], gsr_ + gsu_ <= al implies phi(gsr_ + gsu_) = (opr(g))(phi(gsr_), phi(gsu_))) implies r in rr implies 0 <= r implies r <= al implies (opr(g))(phi(r), phi(al - r)) = phi(al) and (opr(g))(phi(al - r), phi(r)) = phi(al))
- `segment-int-abs-bound` — forall([u, f], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([pz0_ in cc, pzw_ in cc], trace(vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pz0_ + psx_ * pzw_), 0, 1) subset u implies forall([lrpn_ in rr], forall([lrpy_ in trace(vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pz0_ + psx_ * pzw_), 0, 1)], magnitude(f(lrpy_)) <= lrpn_) implies magnitude(line-int(f, vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pz0_ + psx_ * pzw_), vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pzw_), 0, 1)) <= magnitude(pzw_) * lrpn_)))
- `segment-int-reverse` — forall([u, f], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([pz0_ in cc, pzw_ in cc], trace(vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pz0_ + psx_ * pzw_), 0, 1) subset u implies line-int(f, vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), (pz0_ + pzw_) + psx_ * (-1 * pzw_)), vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), -1 * pzw_), 0, 1) = -1 * line-int(f, vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pz0_ + psx_ * pzw_), vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pzw_), 0, 1)))
- `segment-int-split` — forall([u, f], u subset cc implies f in fun(u, cc) implies forall([rgy_ in u], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), u), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), f, rgy_)) implies forall([pz0_ in cc, pzw_ in cc, lrpt_ in ooint(0, 1)], trace(vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pz0_ + psx_ * pzw_), 0, 1) subset u implies line-int(f, vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pz0_ + psx_ * pzw_), vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pzw_), 0, 1) = line-int(f, vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pz0_ + psx_ * (lrpt_ * pzw_)), vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), lrpt_ * pzw_), 0, 1) + line-int(f, vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), (pz0_ + lrpt_ * pzw_) + psx_ * ((1 - lrpt_) * pzw_)), vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), (1 - lrpt_) * pzw_), 0, 1)))
- `segment-interval-bijection` — forall([n_ in nn], vnb-lambda(gsk_, ord-segment(n_), succ(gsk_)) in bijection(ord-segment(n_), interval(1, n_)))
- `segment-is-road` — forall([pz0_, pzw_], pz0_ in cc implies pzw_ in cc implies is-road(vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pz0_ + psx_ * pzw_), vnb-lambda(psx_, ccint(0, 1), pzw_), 0, 1))
- `segment-overflow` — forall([g, al, phi, r1, r2], is-group(g) implies al in rr implies 0 < al implies phi in fun(ccint(0, al), carr(g)) implies forall([gsr_ in ccint(0, al), gsu_ in ccint(0, al)], gsr_ + gsu_ <= al implies phi(gsr_ + gsu_) = (opr(g))(phi(gsr_), phi(gsu_))) implies r1 in rr implies 0 <= r1 implies r1 <= al implies r2 in rr implies 0 <= r2 implies r2 <= al implies al <= r1 + r2 implies (opr(g))(phi(r1), phi(r2)) = (opr(g))(phi(al), phi(r1 + r2 - al)))
- `segment-primitive-diff` — forall([u, f, prim], holomorphic-on(u, f) implies prim in fun(u, cc) implies forall([sdz_ in u], forsome([sdr_], pos-rr(sdr_) and ball(cc-ms, sdz_, sdr_) subset u and forall([sdy_ in ball(cc-ms, sdz_, sdr_)], prim(sdy_) = prim(sdz_) + seg-int(f, sdz_, sdy_)))) implies forall([sdw_ in u], is-diff-on(cc-normed-field, u, prim, sdw_, f(sdw_))))
- `self-adjoint-iff-cayley-unitary` — forall([v, gg], is-hilbert-space(v) implies gg subset cartesian(vec(v), vec(v)) implies is-self-adjoint-graph(v, gg) iff is-unitary-graph(v, cayley-graph(v, gg)))
- `self-adjoint-normal` — forall([b], is-unital-involutive-banach-algebra(b) implies forall([x in vec(b)], (vstar(b))(x) = x implies is-normal-el(b, x)))
- `self-adjoint-of-cayley-unitary` — forall([v, gg], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies gg subset cartesian(vec(v), vec(v)) implies is-unitary-graph(v, cayley-graph(v, gg)) implies is-self-adjoint-graph(v, gg))
- `self-adjoint-of-real-form` — forall([v], is-hilbert-space(v) implies forall([t_ in bounded-ops(v, v)], forall([tdx_ in vec(v)], (ip(v))(t_(tdx_), tdx_) in rr) implies is-self-adjoint-op(v, t_)))
- `self-adjoint-op-adjoint-eq` — forall([v], is-hilbert-space(v) implies forall([t_], is-self-adjoint-op(v, t_) implies op-adjoint(v, v, t_) = t_))
- `self-adjoint-op-of-tau` — forall([v], is-hilbert-space(v) implies forall([s_], is-trace-class(v, s_) implies is-self-adjoint-functional(v, tau-op(v, s_)) implies is-self-adjoint-op(v, s_)))
- `self-similar-dimension` — forall([x in set], card(x) in nn implies 2 <= card(x) implies forall([a in fun(x, rr)], forall([w in x], 1 < a(w)) implies forsome([l in rr], 0 < l and finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), vnb-lambda(w, x, rpow-star(a(w), -l)), x) = 1 and forall([l2 in rr], 0 < l2 implies finsum(commutative-ring-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), vnb-lambda(w, x, rpow-star(a(w), -l2)), x) = 1 implies l2 = l))))
- `semigroup-assoc` — forall([s], is-semigroup(s) implies forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s), c in carr(s)], (opr(s))((opr(s))(a, b), c) = (opr(s))(a, (opr(s))(b, c))))
- `seminorm-extension` — forall([m, s, p, q], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies is-submodule(m, s) implies is-seminorm-on(m, s, p) implies is-seminorm(rr-normed-field, m, q) implies forall([dmx_ in s], p(dmx_) <= q(dmx_)) implies is-seminorm(rr-normed-field, m, seminorm-ext(m, s, p, q)) and extends-on(s, seminorm-ext(m, s, p, q), p) and forall([y in vec(m)], (seminorm-ext(m, s, p, q))(y) <= q(y)))
- `seminorm-top-is-tvs` — forall([fld, m, ix, pf], is-seminorm-family-on(fld, m, ix, pf) implies is-tvs(fld, m, seminorm-top(m, ix, pf)))
- `seminorm-top-locally-convex` — forall([m, ix, pf], is-seminorm-family-on(rr-normed-field, m, ix, pf) implies is-locally-convex-tvs(m, seminorm-top(m, ix, pf)))
- `sends-to-dirs` — forall([spa, x, y], sends-to(spa, x, y) implies is-sent(spa, x) and is-received(spa, y) and node-content(spa, x) = node-content(spa, y))

- `sep-congruence-ptwise-eq` — forall([a, p, q], forall([scx_ in a], scx_ in p iff scx_ in q) implies {scx_ in a: scx_ in p} = {scx_ in a: scx_ in q})

- `sep-forall-family-in-sigma` — forall([omega, ca, g], is-sigma-algebra(omega, ca) implies g in fun(nn, ca) implies {mfx_ in omega: forall([mfk_ in nn], mfx_ in g(mfk_))} in ca)
- `separable-countably-separated` — forall([ysp], is-separable(ysp) implies is-countably-separated(pts(ysp), borel-sets(ysp)))
- `separable-hilbert-countable-basis` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies is-separable(ip-metric-space(v)) implies forsome([ix, e], is-orthonormal-basis(v, ix, e) and is-countable(ix)))
- `separable-of-full-subspace` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies is-separable(subspace-ms(s, pts(s))) implies is-separable(s))

- `separating-commutant-cyclic` — forall([v, s, xi], is-hilbert-space(v) implies is-star-op-algebra(v, s) implies is-separating-for(v, commutant(v, s), xi) implies is-cyclic-for(v, s, xi))

- `seq-act-at` — forall([md, fq, a_, f, n_], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-inner-product-form(md, fq) implies a_ in cc implies f in fun(nn, vec(md)) implies n_ in nn implies (seq-act(md, a_, f))(n_) = (act(md))(a_, f(n_)))

- `seq-block-step` — forall([s, h in fun(nn, pts(s))], forall([phi], strictly-mono-nn(phi) implies forsome([psi], strictly-mono-nn(psi) and forsome([p in pts(s)], converges-to(s, subseq(subseq(h, phi), psi), p)))) implies forall([jb in inf-subsets(nn)], forsome([b_ in inf-subsets(nn)], b_ subset jb and forsome([p in pts(s)], converges-along(s, h, b_, p)))))
- `seq-carrier-intro` — forall([sx_ in set, es_ in fun(nn, sx_)], es_ in product-carrier(vnb-lambda(sqk_, nn, discrete-ms(sx_))))
- `seq-closed-implies-closed` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([a], a subset pts(s) implies forall([f in fun(nn, a), l], converges-to(s, f, l) implies l in a) implies is-closed(s, a)))

- `seq-converges-iff-net` — forall([s, f, l], is-metric-space(s) implies f in fun(nn, pts(s)) implies l in pts(s) implies converges-to(s, f, l) iff net-converges-to(metric-top(s), nn-directed, f, l))

- `seq-form-cauchy` — forall([md, fq, f, g], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-inner-product-form(md, fq) implies f in form-cseq(md, fq) implies g in form-cseq(md, fq) implies is-cauchy-seq(cc-ms, seq-form(fq, f, g)))
- `seq-form-type` — forall([md, fq, f, g], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-inner-product-form(md, fq) implies f in fun(nn, vec(md)) implies g in fun(nn, vec(md)) implies seq-form(fq, f, g) in fun(nn, cc))
- `seq-head-act` — forall([m, n, r, x], m in nn implies n in nn implies m = n + n implies r in carr(zz-ring) implies x in vec(zz-pow(m)) implies seq-head(n, (act(zz-pow(m)))(r, x)) = (act(zz-pow(n)))(r, seq-head(n, x)))
- `seq-head-at` — forall([m, n, z, i], m in nn implies n in nn implies m = n + n implies z in vec(zz-pow(m)) implies i in interval(1, n) implies (seq-head(n, z))(i) = z(i))
- `seq-head-join` — forall([m, n, hd, tl], m in nn implies n in nn implies m = n + n implies hd in vec(zz-pow(n)) implies tl in vec(zz-pow(n)) implies seq-head(n, seq-join(m, n, hd, tl)) = hd)
- `seq-head-vadd` — forall([m, n, x, y], m in nn implies n in nn implies m = n + n implies x in vec(zz-pow(m)) implies y in vec(zz-pow(m)) implies seq-head(n, (vadd(zz-pow(m)))(x, y)) = (vadd(zz-pow(n)))(seq-head(n, x), seq-head(n, y)))
- `seq-head-vec` — forall([m, n, z], m in nn implies n in nn implies m = n + n implies z in vec(zz-pow(m)) implies seq-head(n, z) in vec(zz-pow(n)))
- `seq-head-vneg` — forall([m, n, x], m in nn implies n in nn implies m = n + n implies x in vec(zz-pow(m)) implies seq-head(n, (vneg(zz-pow(m)))(x)) = (vneg(zz-pow(n)))(seq-head(n, x)))
- `seq-head-vzero` — forall([m, n], m in nn implies n in nn implies m = n + n implies seq-head(n, vzero(zz-pow(m))) = vzero(zz-pow(n)))

- `seq-join-ext` — forall([m, n, z], m in nn implies n in nn implies m = n + n implies z in vec(zz-pow(m)) implies seq-join(m, n, seq-head(n, z), seq-shift(n, z)) = z)
- `seq-join-hi` — forall([m, n, hd, tl, j], m in nn implies n in nn implies m = n + n implies hd in vec(zz-pow(n)) implies tl in vec(zz-pow(n)) implies j in interval(1, m) implies not(j <= n) implies (seq-join(m, n, hd, tl))(j) = tl(nn-minus(j, n)))

- `seq-join-vec` — forall([m, n, hd, tl], m in nn implies n in nn implies m = n + n implies hd in vec(zz-pow(n)) implies tl in vec(zz-pow(n)) implies seq-join(m, n, hd, tl) in vec(zz-pow(m)))

- `seq-map-at` — forall([dd, ee, tq, f, n_], tq in fun(dd, ee) implies f in fun(nn, dd) implies n_ in nn implies (seq-map(tq, f))(n_) = tq(f(n_)))
- `seq-map-cauchy` — forall([mq, tq, bq], is-metric-space(mq) implies tq in fun(pts(mq), pts(mq)) implies bq in rr implies 0 <= bq implies forall([g4u_ in pts(mq), g4w_ in pts(mq)], (dist(mq))(tq(g4u_), tq(g4w_)) <= bq * (dist(mq))(g4u_, g4w_)) implies forall([f], is-cauchy-seq(mq, f) implies is-cauchy-seq(mq, seq-map(tq, f))))
- `seq-map-equiv` — forall([mq, tq, bq], is-metric-space(mq) implies tq in fun(pts(mq), pts(mq)) implies bq in rr implies 0 <= bq implies forall([g4u_ in pts(mq), g4w_ in pts(mq)], (dist(mq))(tq(g4u_), tq(g4w_)) <= bq * (dist(mq))(g4u_, g4w_)) implies forall([f, g], f in fun(nn, pts(mq)) implies g in fun(nn, pts(mq)) implies cseq-equiv(mq, f, g) implies cseq-equiv(mq, seq-map(tq, f), seq-map(tq, g))))

- `seq-shift-at` — forall([m, n, z, i], m in nn implies n in nn implies m = n + n implies z in vec(zz-pow(m)) implies i in interval(1, n) implies (seq-shift(n, z))(i) = z(n + i))
- `seq-shift-join` — forall([m, n, hd, tl], m in nn implies n in nn implies m = n + n implies hd in vec(zz-pow(n)) implies tl in vec(zz-pow(n)) implies seq-shift(n, seq-join(m, n, hd, tl)) = tl)
- `seq-shift-vadd` — forall([m, n, x, y], m in nn implies n in nn implies m = n + n implies x in vec(zz-pow(m)) implies y in vec(zz-pow(m)) implies seq-shift(n, (vadd(zz-pow(m)))(x, y)) = (vadd(zz-pow(n)))(seq-shift(n, x), seq-shift(n, y)))

- `seq-shift-vneg` — forall([m, n, x], m in nn implies n in nn implies m = n + n implies x in vec(zz-pow(m)) implies seq-shift(n, (vneg(zz-pow(m)))(x)) = (vneg(zz-pow(n)))(seq-shift(n, x)))
- `seq-shift-vzero` — forall([m, n], m in nn implies n in nn implies m = n + n implies seq-shift(n, vzero(zz-pow(m))) = vzero(zz-pow(n)))
- `seq-space-converges-iff` — forall([sx_ in set, zs in fun(nn, fun(nn, sx_)), u in fun(nn, sx_)], converges-to(seq-space-ms(sx_), zs, u) iff forall([ck_ in nn], forsome([cn_ in nn], forall([ci_ in nn], cn_ <= ci_ implies (zs(ci_))(ck_) = u(ck_)))))
- `seq-split-ext` — forall([m, n, v, w], m in nn implies n in nn implies m = n + n implies v in vec(zz-pow(m)) implies w in vec(zz-pow(m)) implies seq-head(n, v) = seq-head(n, w) implies seq-shift(n, v) = seq-shift(n, w) implies v = w)
- `seq-tail-facts` — forall([z in fun(nn, nn)], seq-tail(z) in fun(nn, nn) and forall([j in nn], (seq-tail(z))(j) = z(succ(j))))
- `seq-unproj` — forall([v in fun(nn, fun(nn, nn))], forsome([z in fun(nn, nn)], forall([k in nn], seq-proj(k, z) = v(k))))
- `seq-vadd-at` — forall([md, fq, f, g, n_], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-inner-product-form(md, fq) implies f in fun(nn, vec(md)) implies g in fun(nn, vec(md)) implies n_ in nn implies (seq-vadd(md, f, g))(n_) = (vadd(md))(f(n_), g(n_)))
- `seq-vadd-cauchy` — forall([md, fq, f, g], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-inner-product-form(md, fq) implies is-cauchy-seq(form-ms(md, fq), f) implies is-cauchy-seq(form-ms(md, fq), g) implies is-cauchy-seq(form-ms(md, fq), seq-vadd(md, f, g)))
- `seq-vadd-type` — forall([md, fq, f, g], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-inner-product-form(md, fq) implies f in fun(nn, vec(md)) implies g in fun(nn, vec(md)) implies seq-vadd(md, f, g) in fun(nn, vec(md)))
- `seq-vneg-at` — forall([md, fq, f, n_], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-inner-product-form(md, fq) implies f in fun(nn, vec(md)) implies n_ in nn implies (seq-vneg(md, f))(n_) = (vneg(md))(f(n_)))
- `seq-vneg-cauchy` — forall([md, fq, f], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-inner-product-form(md, fq) implies is-cauchy-seq(form-ms(md, fq), f) implies is-cauchy-seq(form-ms(md, fq), seq-vneg(md, f)))
- `seq-vneg-type` — forall([md, fq, f], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-inner-product-form(md, fq) implies f in fun(nn, vec(md)) implies seq-vneg(md, f) in fun(nn, vec(md)))
- `seq-weight-summable` — summable-weight(vnb-lambda(sqk_, nn, (/)(1, 2 ^ sqk_)))
- `seq-weight-value` — forall([k in nn], (vnb-lambda(sqk_, nn, (/)(1, 2 ^ sqk_)))(k) = recip(2 ^ k) and recip(2 ^ k) in rr and 0 < recip(2 ^ k) and recip(2 ^ k) = 2 * (vnb-lambda(n, nn, (/)(1, 2 ^ (n + 1))))(k))
- `seq-zero-at` — forall([md, fq, n_], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-inner-product-form(md, fq) implies n_ in nn implies (seq-zero(md))(n_) = vzero(md))
- `seq-zero-cauchy` — forall([md, fq], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-inner-product-form(md, fq) implies is-cauchy-seq(form-ms(md, fq), seq-zero(md)))
- `seq-zero-embed` — forall([md, fq], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-inner-product-form(md, fq) implies seq-zero(md) == embed-seq(form-ms(md, fq), vzero(md)))
- `seq-zero-type` — forall([md, fq], is-module(md) implies scal(md) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies is-inner-product-form(md, fq) implies seq-zero(md) in fun(nn, vec(md)))
- `seqs-differ-somewhere` — forall([sx_, xs, ys], xs in fun(nn, sx_) implies ys in fun(nn, sx_) implies not(xs = ys) implies forsome([dk_ in nn], not(xs(dk_) = ys(dk_))))
- `sequential-implies-continuous-at` — forall([s, t, f, a], is-metric-space(s) implies is-metric-space(t) implies f in fun(pts(s), pts(t)) implies a in pts(s) implies forall([sq in sqn(pts(s))], converges-to(s, sq, a) implies converges-to(t, compose(f, sq), f(a))) implies is-continuous-at(s, t, f, a))
- `series-abs-converges` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr)], forall([j in nn], g(j) = abs(f(j))) implies series-converges(g) implies series-converges(f))
- `series-abs-triangle` — forall([k in nn, f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr)], forall([j in nn], g(j) = abs(f(j))) implies abs(series-partial-sum(f, k)) <= series-partial-sum(g, k))
- `series-abs-triangle-block` — forall([d in nn, m in nn, f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr)], forall([j in nn], g(j) = abs(f(j))) implies abs(series-partial-sum(f, m + d) - series-partial-sum(f, m)) <= series-partial-sum(g, m + d) - series-partial-sum(g, m))
- `series-abs-triangle-le` — forall([k in nn, m in nn, f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr)], forall([j in nn], g(j) = abs(f(j))) implies m <= k implies abs(series-partial-sum(f, k) - series-partial-sum(f, m)) <= series-partial-sum(g, k) - series-partial-sum(g, m))
- `series-block-le` — forall([k in nn, n_ in nn, f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr)], forall([i_ in nn], 0 <= f(i_) and f(i_) <= g(i_)) implies n_ <= k implies series-partial-sum(f, k) - series-partial-sum(f, n_) <= series-partial-sum(g, k) - series-partial-sum(g, n_))
- `series-bounded-converges` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpsk_ in nn], 0 <= f(cpsk_)) implies forall([cpsb_ in rr], forall([cpsk_ in nn], series-partial-sum(f, cpsk_) <= cpsb_) implies series-converges(f)))
- `series-cauchy-criterion` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], series-converges(f) implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([bnd in nn], forall([m in nn, n_ in nn], bnd <= m and m <= n_ implies abs(series-partial-sum(f, n_) - series-partial-sum(f, m)) <= eps))))
- `series-converges-sum` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr), h in fun(nn, rr)], forall([i_ in nn], 0 <= f(i_)) implies forall([i_ in nn], 0 <= g(i_)) implies forall([i_ in nn], h(i_) = f(i_) + g(i_)) implies series-converges(f) implies series-converges(g) implies series-converges(h))
- `series-converges-to-add` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr), h in fun(nn, rr), lv in rr, mv in rr], forall([i_ in nn], h(i_) = f(i_) + g(i_)) implies series-converges-to(f, lv) implies series-converges-to(g, mv) implies series-converges-to(h, lv + mv))
- `series-converges-to-converges` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr), lv in rr], series-converges-to(f, lv) implies series-converges(f))
- `series-dominated-partial-bound` — forall([cpdk_ in nn, f in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpdj_ in nn], 0 <= f(cpdj_)) implies forall([g in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpdj_ in nn], 0 <= g(cpdj_)) implies forall([cpdn_ in nn], forall([cpdj_ in nn], cpdn_ <= cpdj_ implies f(cpdj_) <= g(cpdj_)) implies series-partial-sum(f, cpdk_) <= series-partial-sum(f, cpdn_) + series-partial-sum(g, cpdk_))))
- `series-eventually-dominated-converges` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpdj_ in nn], 0 <= f(cpdj_)) implies forall([g in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpdj_ in nn], 0 <= g(cpdj_)) implies forall([cpdn_ in nn], forall([cpdj_ in nn], cpdn_ <= cpdj_ implies f(cpdj_) <= g(cpdj_)) implies series-converges(g) implies series-converges(f))))
- `series-eventually-geometric-converges` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpsk_ in nn], 0 <= f(cpsk_)) implies forall([cpsq_ in rr], 0 <= cpsq_ implies cpsq_ < 1 implies forall([cpsc_ in rr], 0 <= cpsc_ implies forall([cpsn_ in nn], forall([cpsk_ in nn], cpsn_ <= cpsk_ implies f(cpsk_) <= cpsc_ * cpsq_ ^ cpsk_) implies series-converges(f)))))
- `series-frequently-large-diverges` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr), cpsc_ in rr], 0 < cpsc_ implies forall([cpsn_ in nn], forsome([cpsk_ in nn], cpsn_ <= cpsk_ and cpsc_ <= f(cpsk_))) implies not(series-converges(f)))
- `series-head-null` — forall([n_ in nn, u], forall([j_ in nn], u(j_) in fun(nn, rr)) implies forall([i_ in nn], converges-to(rr-ms, vnb-lambda(j_, nn, (u(j_))(i_)), 0)) implies forall([hd in fun(nn, rr)], forall([j_ in nn], hd(j_) = series-partial-sum(u(j_), n_)) implies converges-to(rr-ms, hd, 0)))
- `series-limit-add` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr), h in fun(nn, rr)], forall([i_ in nn], h(i_) = f(i_) + g(i_)) implies series-converges(f) implies series-converges(g) implies series-limit(h) = series-limit(f) + series-limit(g))
- `series-limit-converges-to` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], series-converges(f) implies series-converges-to(f, series-limit(f)))
- `series-limit-in-rr` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], series-converges(f) implies series-limit(f) in rr)
- `series-limit-iota` — forall([f], iota(l, l in rr and series-converges-to(f, l)) == series-limit(f))
- `series-limit-le` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr), lv in rr, mv in rr], forall([n_ in nn], f(n_) <= g(n_)) implies series-converges-to(f, lv) implies series-converges-to(g, mv) implies lv <= mv)
- `series-nonneg-zero-sum` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], forall([n_ in nn], 0 <= f(n_)) implies series-converges-to(f, 0) implies forall([n_ in nn], f(n_) = 0))
- `series-partial-sum-abs-le` — forall([k in nn, f in fun(nn, rr)], abs(series-partial-sum(f, k)) <= series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(n_, nn, abs(f(n_))), k))
- `series-partial-sum-add` — forall([k in nn, f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr), h in fun(nn, rr)], forall([i_ in nn], h(i_) = f(i_) + g(i_)) implies series-partial-sum(h, k) = series-partial-sum(f, k) + series-partial-sum(g, k))
- `series-partial-sum-add-ptwise` — forall([n_ in nn, f_, g_, h_], forall([k_ in nn], f_(k_) in rr) implies forall([k_ in nn], g_(k_) in rr) implies forall([k_ in nn], h_(k_) = f_(k_) + g_(k_)) implies series-partial-sum(h_, n_) = series-partial-sum(f_, n_) + series-partial-sum(g_, n_))
- `series-partial-sum-agree-below` — forall([n in nn, tcu_, tcg_], forall([tck_ in nn], tck_ < n implies tcg_(tck_) in rr) implies forall([tck_ in nn], tck_ < n implies tcu_(tck_) = tcg_(tck_)) implies series-partial-sum(tcu_, n) = series-partial-sum(tcg_, n))
- `series-partial-sum-antiderivable` — forall([n_ in nn, s_, ph_, a, b], a in rr and b in rr and a < b implies ph_ in fun(rr, rr) implies forall([j_ in nn], is-antiderivable(s_(j_), a, b)) implies forall([x_ in rr], ph_(x_) == series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(j_, nn, (s_(j_))(x_)), n_)) implies is-antiderivable(ph_, a, b))
- `series-partial-sum-bounded` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], forall([i_ in nn], 0 <= f(i_)) implies series-converges(f) implies forsome([bnd in rr], forall([kx in nn], series-partial-sum(f, kx) <= bnd)))
- `series-partial-sum-in-rr` — forall([k in nn, f in fun(nn, rr)], series-partial-sum(f, k) in rr)
- `series-partial-sum-in-rr-below` — forall([itn_ in nn, itf_], forall([itk_ in nn], itk_ < itn_ implies itf_(itk_) in rr) implies series-partial-sum(itf_, itn_) in rr)
- `series-partial-sum-in-rr-ptwise` — forall([n_ in nn, f_], forall([k_ in nn], f_(k_) in rr) implies series-partial-sum(f_, n_) in rr)
- `series-partial-sum-is-ring-sum` — forall([n_ in nn, f_], series-partial-sum(f_, n_) == sum(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field), f_, n_))
- `series-partial-sum-le-termwise` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr)], forall([n_ in nn], f(n_) <= g(n_)) implies forall([k in nn], series-partial-sum(f, k) <= series-partial-sum(g, k)))
- `series-partial-sum-le-termwise-ptwise` — forall([n_ in nn, f_, g_], forall([k_ in nn], f_(k_) in rr) implies forall([k_ in nn], g_(k_) in rr) implies forall([k_ in nn], f_(k_) <= g_(k_)) implies series-partial-sum(f_, n_) <= series-partial-sum(g_, n_))
- `series-partial-sum-mono` — forall([k in nn, m in nn, f in fun(nn, rr)], forall([i_ in nn], 0 <= f(i_)) implies m <= k implies series-partial-sum(f, m) <= series-partial-sum(f, k))
- `series-partial-sum-monotone-nonneg` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], forall([n_ in nn], 0 <= f(n_)) implies forall([k in nn], series-partial-sum(f, k) <= series-partial-sum(f, succ(k))))
- `series-partial-sum-nonneg` — forall([k in nn, f in fun(nn, rr)], forall([i_ in nn], 0 <= f(i_)) implies 0 <= series-partial-sum(f, k))
- `series-partial-sum-scale-ptwise` — forall([n_ in nn, c_, f_, h_], c_ in rr implies forall([k_ in nn], f_(k_) in rr) implies forall([k_ in nn], h_(k_) = c_ * f_(k_)) implies series-partial-sum(h_, n_) = c_ * series-partial-sum(f_, n_))
- `series-partial-sum-seq-apply` — forall([f, j in nn], (vnb-lambda(k, nn, series-partial-sum(f, k)))(j) == series-partial-sum(f, j))
- `series-partial-sum-seq-in-fun` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], vnb-lambda(k, nn, series-partial-sum(f, k)) in fun(nn, rr))
- `series-partial-sum-shift` — forall([n in nn, tcu_ in fun(nn, rr)], series-partial-sum(tcu_, succ(n)) = tcu_(0) + series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(tci_, nn, tcu_(succ(tci_))), n))
- `series-partial-sum-succ` — forall([f, k in nn], series-partial-sum(f, k) in rr implies f(k) in rr implies series-partial-sum(f, succ(k)) == series-partial-sum(f, k) + f(k))
- `series-partial-sum-unfold` — forall([f, k], series-partial-sum(f, k) == sum-ag(normed-field-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), f, k))
- `series-partial-sum-weighted-expansion` — forall([n_ in nn, x_, y_, g_, w_, p_, q_, s_], x_ in rr implies y_ in rr implies forall([k_ in zz], g_(k_) in rr) implies forall([k_ in zz], w_(k_) in rr) implies forall([k_ in nn], q_(k_) in rr) implies forall([k_ in nn], s_(k_) in rr) implies forall([k_ in nn], p_(k_) = w_(k_) * (x_ * g_(k_ - 1) + y_ * g_(k_))) implies forall([k_ in nn], q_(k_) = w_(succ(k_)) * g_(k_)) implies forall([k_ in nn], s_(k_) = w_(k_) * g_(k_)) implies series-partial-sum(p_, succ(n_)) = x_ * (w_(0) * g_(0 - 1) + series-partial-sum(q_, n_)) + y_ * (series-partial-sum(s_, n_) + w_(n_) * g_(n_)))
- `series-partial-sum-zero` — forall([f], series-partial-sum(f, 0) == 0)
- `series-partial-sum-zero-seq` — forall([k_ in nn], series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(n_, nn, 0), k_) = 0)
- `series-scale-converges` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpsk_ in nn], 0 <= f(cpsk_)) implies forall([cpsc_ in rr], 0 <= cpsc_ implies forall([h in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpsk_ in nn], h(cpsk_) = cpsc_ * f(cpsk_)) implies series-converges(f) implies series-converges(h))))
- `series-shift-abs-converges` — forall([c6m_ in nn, c6a_ in fun(nn, cc)], series-converges(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, magnitude(c6a_(c6k_)))) implies series-converges(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, magnitude(c6a_(c6m_ + c6k_)))))
- `series-shift-converges-iff` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpdj_ in nn], 0 <= f(cpdj_)) implies forall([g in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpdj_ in nn], g(cpdj_) = f(succ(cpdj_))) implies series-converges(f) iff series-converges(g)))
- `series-shift-partial-sum` — forall([cpdk_ in nn, f in fun(nn, rr), g in fun(nn, rr)], forall([cpdj_ in nn], g(cpdj_) = f(succ(cpdj_))) implies series-partial-sum(f, succ(cpdk_)) = f(0) + series-partial-sum(g, cpdk_))
- `series-tail-small` — forall([g in fun(nn, rr)], series-converges(g) implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([bnd in nn], forall([k in nn], bnd <= k implies series-partial-sum(g, k) - series-partial-sum(g, bnd) <= eps))))
- `series-term-le-sum` — forall([f in fun(nn, rr)], forall([n_ in nn], 0 <= f(n_)) implies forall([lm_], series-converges-to(f, lm_) implies forall([n_ in nn], f(n_) <= lm_)))
- `series-unshift-abs-converges` — forall([c6m_ in nn, c6a_ in fun(nn, cc)], series-converges(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, magnitude(c6a_(c6m_ + c6k_)))) implies series-converges(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, magnitude(c6a_(c6k_)))))
- `ses-add-left` — forall([v], is-complex-semi-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([sqf], is-sesquilinear-form(v, sqf) implies forall([x_ in vec(v), y_ in vec(v), z_ in vec(v)], sqf((vadd(v))(x_, y_), z_) = sqf(x_, z_) + sqf(y_, z_))))
- `ses-add-right` — forall([v], is-complex-semi-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([sqf], is-sesquilinear-form(v, sqf) implies forall([sx_ in vec(v), sy_ in vec(v), sz_ in vec(v)], sqf(sx_, (vadd(v))(sy_, sz_)) = sqf(sx_, sy_) + sqf(sx_, sz_))))
- `ses-conj-sym` — forall([v], is-complex-semi-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([sqf], is-sesquilinear-form(v, sqf) implies forall([x_ in vec(v), y_ in vec(v)], sqf(y_, x_) = conjugate(sqf(x_, y_)))))
- `ses-expand` — forall([v], is-complex-semi-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([sqf], is-sesquilinear-form(v, sqf) implies forall([sc_ in cc, sx_ in vec(v), sy_ in vec(v)], sqf((vadd(v))(sx_, (cact(v))(sc_, sy_)), (vadd(v))(sx_, (cact(v))(sc_, sy_))) = ((sqf(sx_, sx_) + conjugate(sc_) * sqf(sx_, sy_)) + sc_ * sqf(sy_, sx_)) + (sc_ * conjugate(sc_)) * sqf(sy_, sy_))))
- `ses-homog-left` — forall([v], is-complex-semi-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([sqf], is-sesquilinear-form(v, sqf) implies forall([a_ in cc, x_ in vec(v), y_ in vec(v)], sqf((cact(v))(a_, x_), y_) = a_ * sqf(x_, y_))))
- `ses-homog-right` — forall([v], is-complex-semi-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([sqf], is-sesquilinear-form(v, sqf) implies forall([sk_ in cc, sx_ in vec(v), sy_ in vec(v)], sqf(sx_, (cact(v))(sk_, sy_)) = conjugate(sk_) * sqf(sx_, sy_))))
- `ses-polarization` — forall([v], is-complex-semi-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([sqf], is-sesquilinear-form(v, sqf) implies forall([sx_ in vec(v), sy_ in vec(v)], 4 * sqf(sx_, sy_) = sqf((vadd(v))(sx_, sy_), (vadd(v))(sx_, sy_)) - sqf((vadd(v))(sx_, (vneg(v))(sy_)), (vadd(v))(sx_, (vneg(v))(sy_))) + 1i * sqf((vadd(v))(sx_, (cact(v))(1i, sy_)), (vadd(v))(sx_, (cact(v))(1i, sy_))) - 1i * sqf((vadd(v))(sx_, (vneg(v))((cact(v))(1i, sy_))), (vadd(v))(sx_, (vneg(v))((cact(v))(1i, sy_)))))))
- `ses-type` — forall([v], is-complex-semi-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([sqf], is-sesquilinear-form(v, sqf) implies forall([sx_ in vec(v), sy_ in vec(v)], sqf(sx_, sy_) in cc)))
- `sesq-riesz-bounded` — forall([v, bf_, c_, r_], is-hilbert-space(v) implies bf_ in fun(vec(v), fun(vec(v), cc)) implies forall([bsa_ in vec(v), bsb_ in vec(v), bsy_ in vec(v)], (bf_((vadd(v))(bsa_, bsb_)))(bsy_) = (bf_(bsa_))(bsy_) + (bf_(bsb_))(bsy_)) implies forall([bsk_ in cc, bsa_ in vec(v), bsy_ in vec(v)], (bf_((act(v))(bsk_, bsa_)))(bsy_) = bsk_ * (bf_(bsa_))(bsy_)) implies c_ in rr implies 0 <= c_ implies forall([bsa_ in vec(v), bsy_ in vec(v)], magnitude((bf_(bsa_))(bsy_)) <= c_ * (ip-norm(v, bsa_) * ip-norm(v, bsy_))) implies forall([bsa_ in vec(v), bsb_ in vec(v), bsy_ in vec(v)], (bf_(bsa_))((vadd(v))(bsb_, bsy_)) = (bf_(bsa_))(bsb_) + (bf_(bsa_))(bsy_)) implies forall([bsk_ in cc, bsa_ in vec(v), bsy_ in vec(v)], (bf_(bsa_))((act(v))(bsk_, bsy_)) = conjugate(bsk_) * (bf_(bsa_))(bsy_)) implies r_ in fun(vec(v), vec(v)) implies forall([bsy_ in vec(v), bsx_ in vec(v)], (bf_(bsx_))(bsy_) = (ip(v))(bsx_, r_(bsy_))) implies r_ in bounded-ops(v, v))
