- `sn-cont-of-single-bound-sub` — forall([fld, m1, ix1, pf1, m2, ix2, pf2, tt], is-seminorm-family-on(fld, m1, ix1, pf1) implies is-seminorm-family-on(fld, m2, ix2, pf2) implies tt in fun(vec(m1), vec(m2)) implies forall([sba_ in vec(m1), sbb_ in vec(m1)], tt((vadd(m1))(sba_, (vneg(m1))(sbb_))) = (vadd(m2))(tt(sba_), (vneg(m2))(tt(sbb_)))) implies forall([otj_ in ix2], forsome([oti_ in ix1, otc_ in rr], 0 <= otc_ and forall([otx_ in vec(m1)], (pf2(otj_))(tt(otx_)) <= otc_ * (pf1(oti_))(otx_)))) implies is-hom-top-space(seminorm-top(m1, ix1, pf1), seminorm-top(m2, ix2, pf2), tt))
- `sn-finite-bound` — forall([fld, m, ix, pf, x], is-seminorm-family-on(fld, m, ix, pf) implies x in vec(m) implies forall([ff in set], card(ff) in nn implies ff subset ix implies forsome([bm_ in rr], 0 <= bm_ and forall([sni_ in ff], (pf(sni_))(x) <= bm_))))
- `sn-oball-center` — forall([fld, m, ix, pf, ff, x, r], is-seminorm-family-on(fld, m, ix, pf) implies ff subset ix implies x in vec(m) implies pos-rr(r) implies x in sn-oball(m, pf, ff, x, r))
- `sn-oball-convex` — forall([m, ix, pf, ff, x, r], is-seminorm-family-on(rr-normed-field, m, ix, pf) implies ff subset ix implies x in vec(m) implies r in rr implies is-convex-subset(m, sn-oball(m, pf, ff, x, r)))
- `sn-oball-in-ball` — forall([fld, m, ix, pf, ff, x, r], is-seminorm-family-on(fld, m, ix, pf) implies ff subset ix implies x in vec(m) implies r in rr implies sn-oball(m, pf, ff, x, r) subset sn-ball(m, pf, ff, x, r))
- `sn-oball-membership` — forall([m, pf, ff, x, r, y], y in sn-oball(m, pf, ff, x, r) iff y in vec(m) and forsome([snoe_], pos-rr(snoe_) and forall([sni_ in ff], (pf(sni_))((vadd(m))(y, (vneg(m))(x))) + snoe_ <= r)))
- `sn-oball-open` — forall([fld, m, ix, pf, ff, x, r], is-seminorm-family-on(fld, m, ix, pf) implies ff in set implies card(ff) in nn implies ff subset ix implies x in vec(m) implies r in rr implies is-sn-open(m, ix, pf, sn-oball(m, pf, ff, x, r)))
- `sn-oball-unfold` — forall([m, pf, ff, x, r], sn-oball(m, pf, ff, x, r) == {snoy_ in vec(m): forsome([snoe_ in rr], pos-rr(snoe_) and forall([sni_ in ff], (pf(sni_))((vadd(m))(snoy_, (vneg(m))(x))) + snoe_ <= r))})
- `sn-open-empty` — forall([m, ix, pf], is-module(m) implies is-sn-open(m, ix, pf, empty-set))
- `sn-open-inter` — forall([fld, m, ix, pf, u, v], is-seminorm-family-on(fld, m, ix, pf) implies is-sn-open(m, ix, pf, u) implies is-sn-open(m, ix, pf, v) implies is-sn-open(m, ix, pf, intersection(u, v)))
- `sn-open-union` — forall([m, ix, pf, fam], is-module(m) implies forall([tow_ in fam], is-sn-open(m, ix, pf, tow_)) implies is-sn-open(m, ix, pf, big-union(u, fam, u)))
- `sn-open-whole` — forall([m, ix, pf], is-module(m) implies is-sn-open(m, ix, pf, vec(m)))
- `snd-iter-shift` — forall([k in nn, m in nn], snd-iter(m, succ(k)) = snd-iter(nnsnd(m), k))
- `snd-iter-type` — forall([k in nn, m in nn], snd-iter(m, k) in nn)
- `snoc-col-last` — forall([w, n, v, x], n in nn implies w in mat(n, 1, x) implies v in x implies entry(snoc-col(w, n, v), succ(n), 1) = v)
- `snoc-col-type` — forall([x, n, w, v], n in nn implies w in mat(n, 1, x) implies v in x implies snoc-col(w, n, v) in mat(succ(n), 1, x))
- `snoc-row-last` — forall([c, n, r, x], n in nn implies c in mat(1, n, x) implies r in x implies entry(snoc-row(c, n, r), 1, succ(n)) = r)
- `snoc-row-type` — forall([x, n, c, r], n in nn implies c in mat(1, n, x) implies r in x implies snoc-row(c, n, r) in mat(1, succ(n), x))
- `snowflake-dist` — forall([s, e], is-metric-space(s) implies e in rr implies 0 <= e implies forall([u in pts(s), v in pts(s)], (dist(snowflake(s, e)))(u, v) == rpow-star((dist(s))(u, v), e)))
- `snowflake-dist-fun` — forall([s, e], is-metric-space(s) implies e in rr implies 0 <= e implies dist(snowflake(s, e)) == vnb-lambda([snfu_, snfv_], cartesian(pts(s), pts(s)), rpow-star((dist(s))(snfu_, snfv_), e)))
- `snowflake-is-metric-space` — forall([s, e], is-metric-space(s) implies e in rr implies 0 < e implies e <= 1 implies is-metric-space(snowflake(s, e)))
- `snowflake-lam-type` — forall([s, e], is-metric-space(s) implies e in rr implies 0 <= e implies vnb-lambda([snfu_, snfv_], cartesian(pts(s), pts(s)), rpow-star((dist(s))(snfu_, snfv_), e)) in fun(cartesian(pts(s), pts(s)), rr))
- `snowflake-pts` — forall([s, e], is-metric-space(s) implies e in rr implies 0 <= e implies pts(snowflake(s, e)) == pts(s))
- `sntop-add-continuous` — forall([fld, m, ix, pf], is-seminorm-family-on(fld, m, ix, pf) implies forall([tvx_, tvy_, tvu_], tvx_ in vec(m) implies tvy_ in vec(m) implies tvu_ in opens(seminorm-top(m, ix, pf)) implies (vadd(m))(tvx_, tvy_) in tvu_ implies forsome([tvv_ in opens(seminorm-top(m, ix, pf))], tvx_ in tvv_ and forsome([tvw_ in opens(seminorm-top(m, ix, pf))], tvy_ in tvw_ and forall([tva_ in tvv_, tvb_ in tvw_], (vadd(m))(tva_, tvb_) in tvu_)))))
- `sntop-hausdorff` — forall([fld, m, ix, pf], is-seminorm-family-on(fld, m, ix, pf) implies is-hausdorff(seminorm-top(m, ix, pf)))
- `sntop-hom-of-local` — forall([fld, m, ix, pf, z, g], is-seminorm-family-on(fld, m, ix, pf) implies is-top-space(z) implies g in fun(pts(z), vec(m)) implies forall([slq_ in pts(z), slf_ in set], card(slf_) in nn implies slf_ subset ix implies forall([sle_], pos-rr(sle_) implies forsome([slw_ in opens(z)], slq_ in slw_ and forall([slp_ in slw_, sli_ in slf_], (pf(sli_))((vadd(m))(g(slp_), (vneg(m))(g(slq_)))) <= sle_)))) implies is-hom-top-space(z, seminorm-top(m, ix, pf), g))
- `sntop-is-top-space` — forall([fld, m, ix, pf], is-seminorm-family-on(fld, m, ix, pf) implies is-top-space(seminorm-top(m, ix, pf)))
- `sntop-oball-open` — forall([fld, m, ix, pf, ff, x, r], is-seminorm-family-on(fld, m, ix, pf) implies ff in set implies card(ff) in nn implies ff subset ix implies x in vec(m) implies r in rr implies sn-oball(m, pf, ff, x, r) in opens(seminorm-top(m, ix, pf)))
- `sntop-open-basic` — forall([fld, m, ix, pf, u, x], is-seminorm-family-on(fld, m, ix, pf) implies u in opens(seminorm-top(m, ix, pf)) implies x in u implies forsome([snf_ in set], card(snf_) in nn and snf_ subset ix and forsome([sne_], pos-rr(sne_) and sn-ball(m, pf, snf_, x, sne_) subset u)))
- `sntop-opens` — forall([m, ix, pf], vec(m) in set implies opens(seminorm-top(m, ix, pf)) == {snu_ in power(vec(m)): is-sn-open(m, ix, pf, snu_)})
- `sntop-pts` — forall([m, ix, pf], vec(m) in set implies pts(seminorm-top(m, ix, pf)) == vec(m))
- `sntop-scal-continuous` — forall([fld, m, ix, pf], is-seminorm-family-on(fld, m, ix, pf) implies forall([tvr_, tvx_, tvu_], tvr_ in carr(scal(m)) implies tvx_ in vec(m) implies tvu_ in opens(seminorm-top(m, ix, pf)) implies (act(m))(tvr_, tvx_) in tvu_ implies forsome([tvd_], pos-rr(tvd_) and forsome([tvw_ in opens(seminorm-top(m, ix, pf))], tvx_ in tvw_ and forall([tvs_ in carr(scal(m))], (fnrm(fld))((add(scal(m)))(tvs_, (neg(scal(m)))(tvr_))) < tvd_ implies forall([tva_ in tvw_], (act(m))(tvs_, tva_) in tvu_))))))
- `sot-closure-in-bicommutant` — forall([v, s], is-hilbert-space(v) implies s subset bounded-ops(v, v) implies top-closure(sot(v), s) subset bicommutant(v, s))
- `sot-is-tvs` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies is-tvs(cc-normed-field, bh-module(v), sot(v)))
- `sot-pf-apply` — forall([v, x_, t_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies x_ in vec(v) implies t_ in bounded-ops(v, v) implies ((sot-pf(v))(x_))(t_) = ip-norm(v, t_(x_)))
- `sot-pf-type` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies sot-pf(v) in fun(vec(v), fun(bounded-ops(v, v), rr)))
- `sot-seminorm` — forall([v, x_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies x_ in vec(v) implies is-seminorm(cc-normed-field, bh-module(v), (sot-pf(v))(x_)))
- `sot-seminorm-family` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies is-seminorm-family-on(cc-normed-field, bh-module(v), vec(v), sot-pf(v)))
- `sot-separating` — forall([v, t_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies t_ in bounded-ops(v, v) implies forall([otx_ in vec(v)], ((sot-pf(v))(otx_))(t_) = 0) implies t_ = bop-zero(v, v))
- `sot-to-wot-continuous` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies is-hom-top-space(sot(v), wot(v), id-fun(bounded-ops(v, v))))
- `sot-unfold` — forall([v], sot(v) == seminorm-top(bh-module(v), vec(v), sot-pf(v)))
- `souslin-baire-image` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([e], is-souslin(s, e) implies forsome([f], is-baire-continuous(s, f) and image(f, fun(nn, nn)) = e)))
- `souslin-closed-family` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([e], is-souslin(s, e) implies forsome([t in fun(nstar, power(pts(s)))], forall([p in nstar], is-closed(s, t(p))) and souslin-set(s, t) = e)))
- `souslin-closed-graph-closed` — forall([s], is-polish(s) implies forall([sv in fun(nstar, power(pts(s)))], forall([p in nstar], is-closed(s, sv(p))) implies is-closed(product2-ms(s, baire-ms), {m38w_ in cartesian(pts(s), pts(baire-ms)): forall([m38n_ in nn], nth(1, m38w_) in sv(restrict(nth(2, m38w_), ord-segment(m38n_))))})))
- `souslin-complement-borel` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([e], e subset pts(s) implies (forsome([mbx_], mbx_ in e) implies is-souslin(s, e)) implies (forsome([mbx_], mbx_ in complement-in(pts(s), e)) implies is-souslin(s, complement-in(pts(s), e))) implies e in borel-sets(s)))
- `souslin-continuous-image` — forall([s, t, phi], is-continuous(s, t, phi) implies forall([e], is-souslin(s, e) implies is-souslin(t, image(phi, e))))
- `souslin-countable-intersection` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([e in fun(nn, power(pts(s)))], forall([k in nn], is-souslin(s, e(k))) implies forsome([x], x in {mxp_ in pts(s): forall([mxk_ in nn], mxp_ in e(mxk_))}) implies is-souslin(s, {mxp_ in pts(s): forall([mxk_ in nn], mxp_ in e(mxk_))})))
- `souslin-countable-union` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([e in fun(nn, power(pts(s)))], forall([k in nn], is-souslin(s, e(k))) implies is-souslin(s, big-union(mxk_, nn, e(mxk_)))))
- `souslin-disjoint-envelopes` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([fs in fun(nn, power(pts(s)))], forall([k in nn], forsome([mbx_], mbx_ in fs(k)) implies is-souslin(s, fs(k))) implies forall([k in nn, l in nn], not(k = l) implies forall([x in fs(k)], not(x in fs(l)))) implies forsome([ee in fun(nn, borel-sets(s))], forall([k in nn], fs(k) subset ee(k)) and forall([k in nn, l in nn], not(k = l) implies forall([x in ee(k)], not(x in ee(l)))))))
- `souslin-family-choice` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([e in fun(nn, power(pts(s)))], forall([k in nn], is-souslin(s, e(k))) implies forsome([g in fun(nn, fun(fun(nn, nn), pts(s)))], forall([k in nn], is-baire-continuous(s, g(k)) and image(g(k), fun(nn, nn)) = e(k)))))
- `souslin-iff-baire-image` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([e], is-souslin(s, e) iff forsome([f], is-baire-continuous(s, f) and image(f, fun(nn, nn)) = e)))
- `souslin-iff-closed-family` — forall([s], is-polish(s) implies forall([e], is-souslin(s, e) iff forsome([x], x in e) and forsome([t in fun(nstar, power(pts(s)))], forall([p in nstar], is-closed(s, t(p))) and souslin-set(s, t) = e)))
- `souslin-iff-polish-image` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([e], e subset pts(s) implies is-souslin(s, e) iff forsome([t], is-complete(t) and is-separable(t) and forsome([h], is-continuous(t, subspace-ms(s, e), h) and image(h, pts(t)) = e))))
- `souslin-or-empty-co-union` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([f in fun(nn, power(pts(s)))], forall([k in nn], forsome([mbx_], mbx_ in complement-in(pts(s), f(k))) implies is-souslin(s, complement-in(pts(s), f(k)))) implies forsome([mbx_], mbx_ in complement-in(pts(s), big-union(n_, nn, f(n_)))) implies is-souslin(s, complement-in(pts(s), big-union(n_, nn, f(n_))))))
- `souslin-or-empty-separation` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([a], a subset pts(s) implies forall([b], b subset pts(s) implies (forsome([mbx_], mbx_ in a) implies is-souslin(s, a)) implies (forsome([mbx_], mbx_ in b) implies is-souslin(s, b)) implies forall([x in a], not(x in b)) implies borel-separated(s, a, b))))
- `souslin-or-empty-union` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([f in fun(nn, power(pts(s)))], forall([k in nn], forsome([mbx_], mbx_ in f(k)) implies is-souslin(s, f(k))) implies forsome([mbx_], mbx_ in big-union(n_, nn, f(n_))) implies is-souslin(s, big-union(n_, nn, f(n_)))))
- `souslin-polish-image` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([e], is-souslin(s, e) implies forsome([t], is-complete(t) and is-separable(t) and forsome([h], is-continuous(t, subspace-ms(s, e), h) and image(h, pts(t)) = e))))
- `souslin-separation` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([a], is-souslin(s, a) implies forall([b], is-souslin(s, b) implies forall([x in a], not(x in b)) implies borel-separated(s, a, b))))
- `souslin-set-unfold` — forall([s, sv], souslin-set(s, sv) == {sxp_ in pts(s): forsome([sxz_ in fun(nn, nn)], forall([sxn_ in nn], sxp_ in sv(restrict(sxz_, ord-segment(sxn_)))))})
- `souslin-theorem` — forall([s], is-polish(s) implies forall([e], e subset pts(s) implies e in borel-sets(s) iff (forsome([mbx_], mbx_ in e) implies is-souslin(s, e)) and (forsome([mbx_], mbx_ in complement-in(pts(s), e)) implies is-souslin(s, complement-in(pts(s), e)))))
- `span-add-one-has-v-nvs` — forall([m, t, v], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies is-submodule(m, t) implies v in vec(m) implies v in span-add-one(m, t, v))
- `span-add-one-membership` — forall([m, s, v, w_], w_ in span-add-one(m, s, v) iff w_ in vec(m) and forsome([y_ in s, r_ in rr], w_ = (vadd(m))(y_, (act(m))(r_, v))))
- `span-add-one-submodule` — forall([m, t, v], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies is-submodule(m, t) implies v in vec(m) implies is-submodule(m, span-add-one(m, t, v)))
- `span-add-one-superset-nvs` — forall([m, t, v], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies is-submodule(m, t) implies v in vec(m) implies t subset span-add-one(m, t, v))
- `span-add-one-unfold` — forall([m, s, v], span-add-one(m, s, v) == {y_ in vec(m): forsome([x_ in s, r_ in rr], y_ = (vadd(m))(x_, (act(m))(r_, v)))})
- `span-is-submodule` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([n, u in mat(n, 1, vec(md))], is-submodule(md, span(md, n, u))))
- `span2-add-coeffs` — forall([m, eta, xi, r1, s1, r2, s2], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies eta in vec(m) implies xi in vec(m) implies r1 in rr implies s1 in rr implies r2 in rr implies s2 in rr implies (vadd(m))((vadd(m))((act(m))(r1, eta), (act(m))(s1, xi)), (vadd(m))((act(m))(r2, eta), (act(m))(s2, xi))) = (vadd(m))((act(m))(r1 + r2, eta), (act(m))(s1 + s2, xi)))
- `span2-scale-coeffs` — forall([m, eta, xi, c, r, s], is-normed-vector-space(m) implies eta in vec(m) implies xi in vec(m) implies c in rr implies r in rr implies s in rr implies (act(m))(c, (vadd(m))((act(m))(r, eta), (act(m))(s, xi))) = (vadd(m))((act(m))(c * r, eta), (act(m))(c * s, xi)))
- `span2-unfold` — forall([m, eta, xi], span2(m, eta, xi) == {s2v_ in vec(m): forsome([s2r_ in rr, s2s_ in rr], s2v_ = (vadd(m))((act(m))(s2r_, eta), (act(m))(s2s_, xi)))})
- `spans-coeff-matrix` — forall([md], is-module(md) implies forall([n, m, xs, ys, sm], xs in mat(n, 1, vec(md)) implies ys in mat(m, 1, vec(md)) implies (n = 0 implies m = 0) implies spans(md, n, xs, sm) implies forall([j_ in interval(1, m)], entry(ys, j_, 1) in sm) implies forsome([cm in mat(m, n, carr(scal(md)))], ys = matact(md, cm, xs))))
- `spans-fg-base` — forall([md], is-module(md) and is-euclidean-ring(scal(md)) implies forall([u in mat(0, 1, vec(md)), bm in power(vec(md))], is-submodule(md, bm) implies spans(md, 0, u, bm) implies forall([sm in power(vec(md))], is-submodule(md, sm) implies sm subset bm implies forsome([k], (k in nn and k <= 0) and forsome([w in mat(k, 1, vec(md))], spans(md, k, w, sm))))))
- `spans-fg-step` — forall([md], is-module(md) and is-euclidean-ring(scal(md)) implies forall([n in nn], forall([u in mat(n, 1, vec(md)), bm in power(vec(md))], is-submodule(md, bm) implies spans(md, n, u, bm) implies forall([sm in power(vec(md))], is-submodule(md, sm) implies sm subset bm implies forsome([k], (k in nn and k <= n) and forsome([w in mat(k, 1, vec(md))], spans(md, k, w, sm))))) implies forall([u in mat(succ(n), 1, vec(md)), bm in power(vec(md))], is-submodule(md, bm) implies spans(md, succ(n), u, bm) implies forall([sm in power(vec(md))], is-submodule(md, sm) implies sm subset bm implies forsome([k], (k in nn and k <= succ(n)) and forsome([w in mat(k, 1, vec(md))], spans(md, k, w, sm)))))))

- `subsequence-capture` — forall([s in inf-subsets(nn)], forsome([f in fun(nn, s)], forall([m in nn, n in nn], m < n implies f(m) < f(n))))
- `subsequence-principle` — forall([s, f, l], is-metric-space(s) implies f in fun(nn, pts(s)) implies l in pts(s) implies forall([phi], strictly-mono-nn(phi) implies forsome([psi], strictly-mono-nn(psi) and converges-to(s, subseq(subseq(f, phi), psi), l))) implies converges-to(s, f, l))
- `subset-bicommutant` — forall([v, s], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies s subset bounded-ops(v, v) implies s subset bicommutant(v, s))
- `subset-card-eq` — forall([sa, sb in set], card(sb) in nn implies sa subset sb implies card(sb) <= card(sa) implies sa = sb)
- `subset-mem-fwd` — forall([a, b, x], a subset b implies x in a implies x in b)
- `subset-of-empty-is-empty` — forall([w_ in set], forall([z_ in w_], z_ in empty-set) implies w_ = empty-set)
- `subset-refl` — forall([a_], a_ subset a_)
- `subset-rr-in-power-rr` — forall([es], es subset rr implies es in power(rr))
- `subset-trans` — forall([a, b, c], a subset b implies b subset c implies a subset c)
- `subspace-ball` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([a], a subset pts(s) implies forall([c in a, r], ball(subspace-ms(s, a), c, r) = intersection(ball(s, c, r), a))))
- `subspace-ball-membership` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([a], a subset pts(s) implies forall([c in a, r, y], y in ball(subspace-ms(s, a), c, r) iff y in ball(s, c, r) and y in a)))
- `subspace-closed-ball-eq` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([uu], uu subset pts(s) implies forall([ca in uu, ra], closed-ball(s, ca, ra) subset uu implies closed-ball(subspace-ms(s, uu), ca, ra) = closed-ball(s, ca, ra))))
- `subspace-complete` — forall([s], is-complete(s) implies forall([a], is-closed(s, a) implies is-complete(subspace-ms(s, a))))
- `subspace-converges-to` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([a], a subset pts(s) implies forall([g in fun(nn, a), l in a], converges-to(subspace-ms(s, a), g, l) iff converges-to(s, g, l))))
- `subspace-diam` — forall([m, ys, a], is-metric-space(m) implies ys subset pts(m) implies a subset ys implies diam(subspace-ms(m, ys), a) = diam(m, a))
- `subspace-dist` — forall([s, a in set, u_, v_], u_ in a implies v_ in a implies (dist(subspace-ms(s, a)))(u_, v_) == (dist(s))(u_, v_))
- `subspace-dist-slot` — forall([s, a in set], dist(subspace-ms(s, a)) == vnb-lambda([sbu_, sbv_], cartesian(a, a), (dist(s))(sbu_, sbv_)))
- `subspace-inclusion-continuous` — forall([t, a], is-top-space(t) implies a subset pts(t) implies is-hom-top-space(subspace-top(t, a), t, vnb-lambda(b6q_, a, b6q_)))
- `subspace-is-cauchy-seq` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([a], a subset pts(s) implies forall([f in fun(nn, a)], is-cauchy-seq(subspace-ms(s, a), f) iff is-cauchy-seq(s, f))))
- `subspace-is-metric-space` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([a], a subset pts(s) implies is-metric-space(subspace-ms(s, a))))
- `subspace-of-subspace` — forall([t, a, bb], is-top-space(t) implies a subset pts(t) implies bb subset a implies subspace-top(subspace-top(t, a), bb) == subspace-top(t, bb))
- `subspace-open-is-trace` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([a], a subset pts(s) implies forall([vs_], is-open(subspace-ms(s, a), vs_) implies forsome([us_], is-open(s, us_) and vs_ = intersection(us_, a)))))
- `subspace-open-trace` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([a], a subset pts(s) implies forall([u], is-open(s, u) implies is-open(subspace-ms(s, a), intersection(u, a)))))
- `subspace-pts` — forall([s, a in set], pts(subspace-ms(s, a)) == a)
- `subspace-restrict-continuous-at` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies forall([icu_], icu_ subset pts(s) implies forall([icv_], icv_ subset icu_ implies forall([ict_], is-metric-space(ict_) implies forall([f, icz_ in icv_], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(s, icu_), ict_, f, icz_) implies is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(s, icv_), ict_, restrict(f, icv_), icz_))))))
- `subspace-top-is-top-space` — forall([t, a], is-top-space(t) implies a subset pts(t) implies is-top-space(subspace-top(t, a)))
- `subspace-top-of-metric-top` — forall([mt, a], is-metric-space(mt) implies a subset pts(mt) implies subspace-top(metric-top(mt), a) == metric-top(subspace-ms(mt, a)))
- `subspace-top-opens` — forall([t, a in set], opens(subspace-top(t, a)) == {stw_ in power(a): forsome([stu_ in opens(t)], stw_ = intersection(stu_, a))})
- `subspace-top-pts` — forall([t, a in set], pts(subspace-top(t, a)) == a)
- `subspace-top-unfold` — forall([t, a], subspace-top(t, a) == [a, {stw_ in power(a): forsome([stu_ in opens(t)], stw_ = intersection(stu_, a))}])
- `subspace-ultrametric` — forall([s], is-ultrametric(s) implies forall([a in set], a subset pts(s) implies is-ultrametric(subspace-ms(s, a))))
- `subspace-whole` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) implies pts(subspace-ms(s, pts(s))) == pts(s) and forall([u_, v_], u_ in pts(s) implies v_ in pts(s) implies (dist(subspace-ms(s, pts(s))))(u_, v_) == (dist(s))(u_, v_)))
- `subsqn-preserves-sqn` — forall([a, f, y], f in sqn(a) implies subsqn(y, f) implies y in sqn(a))
- `subst-app2` — forall([m, u, h, a, b], u in expr-set implies h in nn implies a in expr-set implies b in expr-set implies expr-subst(eapp(h, [a, b]), m, u) = eapp(h, [expr-subst(a, m, u), expr-subst(b, m, u)]))
- `subst-bind1` — forall([m, u, h, nb, a, b], u in expr-set implies h in nn implies nb in nn implies a in expr-set implies b in expr-set implies expr-subst(ebind(h, nb, [a], b), m, u) = ebind(h, nb, [expr-subst(a, m, u)], expr-subst(b, m, u)))
- `subst-eapp` — forall([m, u, h, l], u in expr-set implies h in nn implies l in tuples(expr-set) implies expr-subst(eapp(h, l), m, u) == eapp(h, mapl(subst-fun(m, u), l)))
- `subst-ebind` — forall([m, u, h, nb, a, b], u in expr-set implies h in nn implies nb in nn implies a in tuples(expr-set) implies b in expr-set implies expr-subst(ebind(h, nb, a, b), m, u) == ebind(h, nb, mapl(subst-fun(m, u), a), expr-subst(b, m, u)))
- `subst-ebvar` — forall([m, u, k], u in expr-set implies k in nn implies expr-subst(ebvar(k), m, u) == ebvar(k))
- `subst-econst` — forall([m, u, c], u in expr-set implies c in nn implies expr-subst(econst(c), m, u) == econst(c))
- `subst-efvar-hit` — forall([m, u in expr-set], m in nn implies expr-subst(efvar(m), m, u) == u)
- `subst-efvar-miss` — forall([m, u, n], u in expr-set implies n in nn implies not(n = m) implies expr-subst(efvar(n), m, u) == efvar(n))
- `subst-fresh` — forall([m, u in expr-set, e in expr-set], not(m in expr-fv(e)) implies expr-subst(e, m, u) = e)
- `subst-fun-unfold` — forall([m, u], subst-fun(m, u) == vnb-lambda(mxw_, expr-set, expr-subst(mxw_, m, u)))
- `subst-hole-l` — forall([z, s, c, h], z in nn implies s in expr-set implies c in expr-set implies h in nn implies not(z in expr-fv(c)) implies expr-subst(eapp(h, [efvar(z), c]), z, s) = eapp(h, [s, c]))
- `subst-hole-list` — forall([z, h, l, lz, l2, i], z in nn implies h in nn implies l in tuples(expr-set) implies lz in tuples(expr-set) implies l2 in tuples(expr-set) implies length(lz) = length(l) implies length(l2) = length(l) implies i in nn implies 1 <= i implies i <= length(l) implies nth(i, lz) = efvar(z) implies forall([mrj_ in nn], 1 <= mrj_ implies mrj_ <= length(l) implies not(mrj_ = i) implies nth(mrj_, lz) = nth(mrj_, l)) implies forall([mrj_ in nn], 1 <= mrj_ implies mrj_ <= length(l) implies not(mrj_ = i) implies nth(mrj_, l2) = nth(mrj_, l)) implies not(z in expr-fv(eapp(h, l))) implies expr-subst(eapp(h, lz), z, nth(i, l2)) = eapp(h, l2))
- `subst-hole-r` — forall([z, s, c, h], z in nn implies s in expr-set implies c in expr-set implies h in nn implies not(z in expr-fv(c)) implies expr-subst(eapp(h, [c, efvar(z)]), z, s) = eapp(h, [c, s]))
- `subst-in-expr` — forall([m, u in expr-set, e in expr-set], expr-subst(e, m, u) in expr-set)
- `subst-open-commute` — forall([n, u, v], u in expr-set implies v in expr-set implies expr-lc(v) implies forall([e in expr-set, ix in nn], expr-subst(expr-open(e, ix, u), n, v) = expr-open(expr-subst(e, n, v), ix, expr-subst(u, n, v))))
- `subst-open-name` — forall([y, e, v], y in nn implies e in expr-set implies v in expr-set implies expr-lc(v) implies not(y in expr-fv(e)) implies expr-subst(expr-open(e, 0, efvar(y)), y, v) = expr-open(e, 0, v))
- `subst-stage-coh` — forall([d in nn, m, u, j, e], j in nn implies e in expr-stage(j) implies (subst-stage(m, u, j + d))(e) == (subst-stage(m, u, j))(e))
- `subst-stage-fun` — forall([n in nn, m, u in expr-set], subst-stage(m, u, n) in fun(expr-stage(n), expr-set))
- `subst-stage-step` — forall([m, u, k, e], k in nn implies e in expr-stage(k) implies (subst-stage(m, u, succ(k)))(e) == (subst-stage(m, u, k))(e))
- `subterm-antisym` — forall([t, k], is-token-set(t) implies k in set implies forall([a, b], is-subterm(t, k, a, b) implies is-subterm(t, k, b, a) implies a = b))
- `subterm-cases` — forall([t, k], t in set implies k in set implies forall([a, b], is-subterm(t, k, a, b) implies a = b or forsome([l in tuples(msg-set(t, k))], b = lst(l) and forsome([i in nn], 1 <= i and i <= length(l) and is-subterm(t, k, a, nth(i, l)))) or forsome([g in msg-set(t, k), y in k], b = encr(g, y) and is-subterm(t, k, a, g))))
- `subterm-component` — forall([t, k, a, l, i], l in tuples(msg-set(t, k)) implies i in nn implies 1 <= i implies i <= length(l) implies is-subterm(t, k, a, nth(i, l)) implies is-subterm(t, k, a, lst(l)))
- `subterm-encr` — forall([t, k, a, g, y], g in msg-set(t, k) implies y in k implies is-subterm(t, k, a, g) implies is-subterm(t, k, a, encr(g, y)))
- `subterm-encr-other-key` — forall([t, k], t in set implies k in set implies forall([h, h2, y, y2], h in msg-set(t, k) implies h2 in msg-set(t, k) implies y in k implies y2 in k implies not(y = y2) implies is-subterm(t, k, encr(h2, y2), encr(h, y)) implies is-subterm(t, k, encr(h2, y2), h)))
- `subterm-in-msgs` — forall([t, k, a, b], is-subterm(t, k, a, b) implies a in msg-set(t, k) and b in msg-set(t, k))
- `subterm-least` — forall([t, k, r in power(cartesian(msg-set(t, k), msg-set(t, k)))], is-subterm-closed(t, k, r) implies forall([a, b], is-subterm(t, k, a, b) implies [a, b] in r))
- `subterm-of-encr` — forall([t, k], t in set implies k in set implies forall([a, g, y], g in msg-set(t, k) implies y in k implies is-subterm(t, k, a, encr(g, y)) implies a = encr(g, y) or is-subterm(t, k, a, g)))
- `subterm-of-flat-encr-list` — forall([t, k, d, w, l, ky], is-token-set(t) implies k in set implies forall([x in d], x in t) implies l in tuples(d) implies ky in k implies is-subterm(t, k, w, encr(lst(l), ky)) implies w = encr(lst(l), ky) or w = lst(l) or w in d)
- `subterm-of-flat-encr-token` — forall([t, k, d, w, x, ky], is-token-set(t) implies k in set implies forall([z in d], z in t) implies x in d implies ky in k implies is-subterm(t, k, w, encr(x, ky)) implies w = encr(x, ky) or w in d)
- `subterm-of-flat-list` — forall([t, k, d, w, l], is-token-set(t) implies k in set implies forall([x in d], x in t) implies l in tuples(d) implies is-subterm(t, k, w, lst(l)) implies w = lst(l) or w in d)
- `subterm-of-list` — forall([t, k], t in set implies k in set implies forall([a, l in tuples(msg-set(t, k))], is-subterm(t, k, a, lst(l)) implies a = lst(l) or forsome([i in nn], 1 <= i and i <= length(l) and is-subterm(t, k, a, nth(i, l)))))
- `subterm-of-token` — forall([t, k], is-token-set(t) implies k in set implies forall([a, tk in t], is-subterm(t, k, a, tk) implies a = tk))
- `subterm-rank` — forall([t, k], is-token-set(t) implies k in set implies forall([a, b], is-subterm(t, k, a, b) implies a = b or succ(msg-rank(t, k, a)) <= msg-rank(t, k, b)))
- `subterm-refl` — forall([t, k, a in msg-set(t, k)], is-subterm(t, k, a, a))
- `subterm-rel-unfold` — forall([t, k], subterm-rel(t, k) == {p_ in cartesian(msg-set(t, k), msg-set(t, k)): forall([q_ in power(cartesian(msg-set(t, k), msg-set(t, k)))], is-subterm-closed(t, k, q_) implies p_ in q_)})
- `subterm-trans` — forall([t, k], t in set implies k in set implies forall([a, b, c], is-subterm(t, k, a, b) implies is-subterm(t, k, b, c) implies is-subterm(t, k, a, c)))
- `succ-in-interval` — forall([q in nn, z in interval(1, q)], succ(z) in interval(1, succ(q)))
- `succ-nn-minus-1` — forall([i in nn], 1 <= i implies succ(nn-minus(i, 1)) = i)
- `succ-nn-ord` — forall([n in nn], succ(n) = succ_ord(n))  _[warrant: informal]_
- `succ-not-one` — forall([q, z in interval(1, q)], not(succ(z) = 1))
- `sum-ag-act-collect-ind` — forall([n in nn, md], is-module(md) implies forall([x in vec(md), gc_, gv_], forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], gc_(i_) in carr(scal(md))) implies forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], gv_(i_) == (act(md))(gc_(i_), x)) implies sum-ag(module-vector-ag(md), gv_, n) = (act(md))(sum-ag(ring-additive-ag(scal(md)), gc_, n), x)))
- `sum-ag-act-ind` — forall([n in nn, md], is-module(md) implies forall([r in carr(scal(md)), ga_, gb_], forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], ga_(i_) in carr(module-vector-ag(md))) implies forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], gb_(i_) == (act(md))(r, ga_(i_))) implies sum-ag(module-vector-ag(md), gb_, n) = (act(md))(r, sum-ag(module-vector-ag(md), ga_, n))))
- `sum-ag-add-ind` — forall([n in nn, ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([ga_, gb_, gc_], forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], ga_(i_) in carr(ag)) implies forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], gb_(i_) in carr(ag)) implies forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], gc_(i_) == (opr(ag))(ga_(i_), gb_(i_))) implies sum-ag(ag, gc_, n) = (opr(ag))(sum-ag(ag, ga_, n), sum-ag(ag, gb_, n))))
- `sum-ag-all-id-ind` — forall([n in nn, ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([g_], forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], g_(i_) = iden(ag)) implies sum-ag(ag, g_, n) = iden(ag)))
- `sum-ag-as-reduce` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([f in fun(nn, carr(ag)), n], n in nn and 1 <= n implies sum-ag(ag, f, n) = reduce(opr(ag), f, n)))
- `sum-ag-as-reduce-ind` — forall([k in nn, ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([f in fun(nn, carr(ag))], sum-ag(ag, f, succ(k)) = reduce(opr(ag), f, succ(k))))
- `sum-ag-cc-in-cc` — forall([k in nn, f in fun(nn, cc)], sum-ag(normed-field-additive-ag(cc-normed-field), f, k) in cc)
- `sum-ag-comm-monoid-add-ind` — forall([n in nn, m], is-comm-monoid(m) implies forall([ga_, gb_, gc_], forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], ga_(i_) in carr(m)) implies forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], gb_(i_) in carr(m)) implies forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], gc_(i_) == (opr(m))(ga_(i_), gb_(i_))) implies sum-ag(m, gc_, n) = (opr(m))(sum-ag(m, ga_, n), sum-ag(m, gb_, n))))
- `sum-ag-comm-monoid-type-ind` — forall([n in nn, m], is-comm-monoid(m) implies forall([f in fun(nn, carr(m))], sum-ag(m, f, n) in carr(m)))
- `sum-ag-comm-monoid-type-ptwise` — forall([n in nn, m], is-comm-monoid(m) implies forall([g_], forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], g_(i_) in carr(m)) implies sum-ag(m, g_, n) in carr(m)))
- `sum-ag-fubini-ind` — forall([m in nn, ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([n in nn, ff_, gg_, rs_, cs_], forall([i_ in ord-segment(m), j_ in ord-segment(n)], (ff_(i_))(j_) in carr(ag)) implies forall([i_ in ord-segment(m), j_ in ord-segment(n)], (gg_(j_))(i_) == (ff_(i_))(j_)) implies forall([i_ in ord-segment(m)], rs_(i_) == sum-ag(ag, ff_(i_), n)) implies cs_ in fun(ord-segment(n), carr(ag)) implies forall([j_ in ord-segment(n)], cs_(j_) == sum-ag(ag, gg_(j_), m)) implies forall([fbi_ in ord-segment(m)], rs_(fbi_) in carr(ag)) implies forall([fbj_ in ord-segment(n)], cs_(fbj_) in carr(ag)) implies sum-ag(ag, rs_, m) = sum-ag(ag, cs_, n)))
- `sum-ag-in-subset-ind` — forall([n in nn, ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([sm], iden(ag) in sm implies forall([x_ in sm, y_ in sm], (opr(ag))(x_, y_) in sm) implies forall([g_], forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], g_(i_) in sm) implies sum-ag(ag, g_, n) in sm)))
- `sum-ag-permutation-invariance` — forall([n in nn, ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([g in fun(nn, carr(ag)), h in fun(nn, carr(ag)), phi in bijection(ord-segment(n), ord-segment(n))], forall([i in ord-segment(n)], h(i) = g(phi(i))) implies sum-ag(ag, g, n) = sum-ag(ag, h, n)))  _[warrant: informal]_
- `sum-ag-permutation-invariance-laws` — forall([n in nn, s], iden(s) in carr(s) implies forall([a_ in carr(s), b_ in carr(s)], (opr(s))(a_, b_) in carr(s)) implies forall([a_ in carr(s), b_ in carr(s), c_ in carr(s)], (opr(s))((opr(s))(a_, b_), c_) = (opr(s))(a_, (opr(s))(b_, c_))) implies forall([a_ in carr(s), b_ in carr(s)], (opr(s))(a_, b_) = (opr(s))(b_, a_)) implies forall([g in fun(nn, carr(s)), h in fun(nn, carr(s)), phi in bijection(ord-segment(n), ord-segment(n))], forall([i in ord-segment(n)], h(i) = g(phi(i))) implies sum-ag(s, g, n) = sum-ag(s, h, n)))
- `sum-ag-replace-entry-laws` — forall([n in nn, s], iden(s) in carr(s) implies forall([a_ in carr(s), b_ in carr(s)], (opr(s))(a_, b_) in carr(s)) implies forall([a_ in carr(s), b_ in carr(s), c_ in carr(s)], (opr(s))((opr(s))(a_, b_), c_) = (opr(s))(a_, (opr(s))(b_, c_))) implies forall([a_ in carr(s), b_ in carr(s)], (opr(s))(a_, b_) = (opr(s))(b_, a_)) implies forall([g in fun(nn, carr(s)), gp in fun(nn, carr(s)), k in ord-segment(n)], forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], not(i_ = k) implies g(i_) == gp(i_)) implies (opr(s))(sum-ag(s, g, n), gp(k)) = (opr(s))(sum-ag(s, gp, n), g(k))))
- `sum-ag-ring-left-ind` — forall([n in nn, rng], is-ring(rng) implies forall([r in carr(rng), ga_, gb_], forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], ga_(i_) in carr(rng)) implies forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], gb_(i_) == (mul(rng))(r, ga_(i_))) implies sum-ag(ring-additive-ag(rng), gb_, n) = (mul(rng))(r, sum-ag(ring-additive-ag(rng), ga_, n))))
- `sum-ag-ring-right-ind` — forall([n in nn, rng], is-ring(rng) implies forall([r in carr(rng), ga_, gb_], forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], ga_(i_) in carr(rng)) implies forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], gb_(i_) == (mul(rng))(ga_(i_), r)) implies sum-ag(ring-additive-ag(rng), gb_, n) = (mul(rng))(sum-ag(ring-additive-ag(rng), ga_, n), r)))
- `sum-ag-rr-in-rr` — forall([k in nn, f in fun(nn, rr)], sum-ag(normed-field-additive-ag(rr-normed-field), f, k) in rr)
- `sum-ag-segment-congruence` — forall([n in nn, ag, g, h], forall([i in ord-segment(n)], g(i) == h(i)) implies sum-ag(ag, g, n) == sum-ag(ag, h, n))
- `sum-ag-single-ind` — forall([n in nn, ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([g_, p_ in ord-segment(n)], g_(p_) in carr(ag) implies forall([i_ in ord-segment(n)], not(i_ = p_) implies g_(i_) = iden(ag)) implies sum-ag(ag, g_, n) = g_(p_)))
- `sum-ag-singleton` — forall([ag], is-abelian-group(ag) implies forall([f in fun(nn, carr(ag))], sum-ag(ag, f, 1) = f(0)))

- `sxt-set-elim` — forall([m, s, p, q, y, t in seminorm-ext-set(m, s, p, q, y)], t in rr and forsome([sev_ in s, sew_ in vec(m)], y = (vadd(m))(sev_, sew_) and t = p(sev_) + q(sew_)))
- `sxt-set-glb` — forall([m, s, p, q, z], is-module(m) implies scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field) implies is-submodule(m, s) implies is-seminorm-on(m, s, p) implies is-seminorm(rr-normed-field, m, q) implies forall([dmx_ in s], p(dmx_) <= q(dmx_)) implies z in vec(m) implies inf(seminorm-ext-set(m, s, p, q, z)) in rr and forall([lbw_ in seminorm-ext-set(m, s, p, q, z)], inf(seminorm-ext-set(m, s, p, q, z)) <= lbw_) and forall([lbb_ in rr], forall([lbw_ in seminorm-ext-set(m, s, p, q, z)], lbb_ <= lbw_) implies lbb_ <= inf(seminorm-ext-set(m, s, p, q, z))))

- `taylor-coefficient-formula` — forall([cf in fun(nn, cc), cpdr_ in rr], 0 < cpdr_ implies cpdr_ < cps-radius(cf) implies forall([ndlk_ in nn], cf(ndlk_) = (nth-deriv-on(cc-normed-field, ball(cc-ms, 0, cpdr_), vnb-lambda(cpdz_, ball(cc-ms, 0, cpdr_), cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, cf(cpsk_) * cpdz_ ^ cpsk_))), ndlk_))(0) * recip(factorial(ndlk_))))

- `taylor-coefficients-at` — forall([algf_, algu_], algf_ in fun(algu_, cc) implies forall([algc_ in fun(nn, cc), alga_ in cc, algr_ in rr], 0 < algr_ implies algr_ < cps-radius(algc_) implies ball(cc-ms, alga_, algr_) subset algu_ implies forall([algz_ in ball(cc-ms, alga_, algr_)], algf_(algz_) = cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(cpsk_, nn, algc_(cpsk_) * (algz_ - alga_) ^ cpsk_))) implies forall([algk_ in nn], (nth-deriv-on(cc-normed-field, ball(cc-ms, alga_, algr_), restrict(algf_, ball(cc-ms, alga_, algr_)), algk_))(alga_) = factorial(algk_) * algc_(algk_))))

- `taylor-exact-polynomial` — forall([tcm_ in nn, cf in fun(nn, rr), a in rr, h in rr], (vnb-lambda(x, rr, series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(k, nn, cf(k) * x ^ k), succ(tcm_))))(a + h) = series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(tci_, nn, ((nth-deriv(vnb-lambda(x, rr, series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(k, nn, cf(k) * x ^ k), succ(tcm_))), tci_))(a) * h ^ tci_) * recip(factorial(tci_))), succ(tcm_)))
- `taylor-factor-fn-continuous` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, tcf_, tcm_ in nn], a <= b implies is-continuous-on(tcf_(0), ccint(a, b)) implies forall([tck_ in nn], tck_ < succ(tcm_) implies (tcf_(tck_))(a) in rr) implies forall([tcp_ in rr], a < tcp_ implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, vnb-lambda(tcs_, rr, (((extend-const(tcf_(0), a, b))(tcs_) - taylor-sum(tcf_, succ(tcm_), tcs_, a)) * factorial(succ(tcm_))) * recip-star((tcs_ - a) ^ succ(tcm_))), tcp_)))

- `taylor-factor-value` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, tcf_, tcm_ in nn], forall([tck_ in nn], tck_ <= succ(tcm_) implies tcf_(tck_) in fun(ccint(a, b), rr)) implies forall([tck_ in nn], tck_ < succ(tcm_) implies is-continuous-on(tcf_(tck_), ccint(a, b))) implies forall([tck_ in nn], tck_ < succ(tcm_) implies forall([tcx_ in ooint(a, b)], has-deriv-at(tcf_(tck_), tcx_, (tcf_(succ(tck_)))(tcx_)))) implies forall([tct_ in rr], a < tct_ implies tct_ <= b implies forsome([tcxi_ in ooint(a, tct_)], (taylor-rem(tcf_, succ(tcm_), a, tct_) * factorial(succ(tcm_))) * recip((tct_ - a) ^ succ(tcm_)) = (tcf_(succ(tcm_)))(tcxi_))))
- `taylor-family-continuous` — forall([itd_, itn_, a, b], is-taylor-family(itd_, itn_, a, b) implies forall([itk_ in nn], itk_ < itn_ implies is-continuous-on(itd_(itk_), ccint(a, b))))
- `taylor-family-deriv` — forall([itd_, itn_, a, b], is-taylor-family(itd_, itn_, a, b) implies forall([itk_ in nn], itk_ < itn_ implies forall([itx_ in ooint(a, b)], has-deriv-at(itd_(itk_), itx_, (itd_(succ(itk_)))(itx_)))))

- `taylor-family-left-in-rr` — forall([itd_, itn_, a, b], is-taylor-family(itd_, itn_, a, b) implies a in rr)

- `theorem-6-20` — forall([c6a_ in fun(nn, cc)], forall([c6q_ in nn], not(c6a_(c6q_) = 0)) implies forall([c6r_ in rr], forsome([c6m_ in nn], forall([c6q_ in nn], c6m_ <= c6q_ implies c6r_ <= magnitude(c6a_(c6q_))))) implies forall([c6u_ in fun(nn, nn)], forall([c6r_ in rr], 0 <= c6r_ implies series-converges(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, (c6r_ * recip(magnitude(c6a_(c6k_)))) ^ succ(c6u_(c6k_)) * recip(succ(c6u_(c6k_)))))) implies prod-normal-on-compacta(cc, vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, vnb-lambda(c6x_, cc, (1 - c6x_ * recip(c6a_(c6k_))) * cc-exp(cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(clhk_, nn, recip-star(clhk_) * (c6x_ * recip(c6a_(c6k_))) ^ clhk_), succ(c6u_(c6k_)))) - 1))) and holomorphic-on(cc, prod-fun(cc, vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, vnb-lambda(c6x_, cc, (1 - c6x_ * recip(c6a_(c6k_))) * cc-exp(cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(clhk_, nn, recip-star(clhk_) * (c6x_ * recip(c6a_(c6k_))) ^ clhk_), succ(c6u_(c6k_)))) - 1)))) and forall([c6z_ in cc], (prod-fun(cc, vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, vnb-lambda(c6x_, cc, (1 - c6x_ * recip(c6a_(c6k_))) * cc-exp(cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(clhk_, nn, recip-star(clhk_) * (c6x_ * recip(c6a_(c6k_))) ^ clhk_), succ(c6u_(c6k_)))) - 1))))(c6z_) = 0 iff forsome([c6q_ in nn], c6z_ = c6a_(c6q_)))))
- `theorem-6-20-family` — forall([c6a_ in fun(nn, cc)], forall([c6q_ in nn], not(c6a_(c6q_) = 0)) implies forall([c6r_ in rr], forsome([c6m_ in nn], forall([c6q_ in nn], c6m_ <= c6q_ implies c6r_ <= magnitude(c6a_(c6q_))))) implies forall([c6u_ in fun(nn, nn)], forall([c6r_ in rr], 0 <= c6r_ implies series-converges(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, (c6r_ * recip(magnitude(c6a_(c6k_)))) ^ succ(c6u_(c6k_)) * recip(succ(c6u_(c6k_)))))) implies forall([c6f_ in fun(nn, fun(cc, cc))], forall([c6k_ in nn, c6x_ in cc], (c6f_(c6k_))(c6x_) = (1 - c6x_ * recip(c6a_(c6k_))) * cc-exp(cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(clhk_, nn, recip-star(clhk_) * (c6x_ * recip(c6a_(c6k_))) ^ clhk_), succ(c6u_(c6k_)))) - 1) implies prod-normal-on-compacta(cc, c6f_) and holomorphic-on(cc, prod-fun(cc, c6f_)) and forall([c6z_ in cc], (prod-fun(cc, c6f_))(c6z_) = 0 iff forsome([c6q_ in nn], c6z_ = c6a_(c6q_))))))
- `theorem-6-20-multiplicity` — forall([c6a_ in fun(nn, cc)], forall([c6q_ in nn], not(c6a_(c6q_) = 0)) implies forall([c6r_ in rr], forsome([c6m_ in nn], forall([c6q_ in nn], c6m_ <= c6q_ implies c6r_ <= magnitude(c6a_(c6q_))))) implies forall([c6u_ in fun(nn, nn)], forall([c6r_ in rr], 0 <= c6r_ implies series-converges(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, (c6r_ * recip(magnitude(c6a_(c6k_)))) ^ succ(c6u_(c6k_)) * recip(succ(c6u_(c6k_)))))) implies forall([c6f_ in fun(nn, fun(cc, cc))], forall([c6k_ in nn, c6x_ in cc], (c6f_(c6k_))(c6x_) = (1 - c6x_ * recip(c6a_(c6k_))) * cc-exp(cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(clhk_, nn, recip-star(clhk_) * (c6x_ * recip(c6a_(c6k_))) ^ clhk_), succ(c6u_(c6k_)))) - 1) implies forall([c6z_ in cc, c6n_ in nn], forall([c6q_ in nn], c6n_ <= c6q_ implies not(c6a_(c6q_) = c6z_)) implies has-zero-of-order(cc, prod-fun(cc, c6f_), c6z_, count-hits(c6a_, c6z_, c6n_))))))
- `theorem-6-20-multiplicity-fam` — forall([c6a_ in fun(nn, cc)], forall([c6q_ in nn], not(c6a_(c6q_) = 0)) implies forall([c6r_ in rr], forsome([c6m_ in nn], forall([c6q_ in nn], c6m_ <= c6q_ implies c6r_ <= magnitude(c6a_(c6q_))))) implies forall([c6u_ in fun(nn, nn)], forall([c6r_ in rr], 0 <= c6r_ implies series-converges(vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, (c6r_ * recip(magnitude(c6a_(c6k_)))) ^ succ(c6u_(c6k_)) * recip(succ(c6u_(c6k_)))))) implies forall([c6z_ in cc, c6n_ in nn], forall([c6q_ in nn], c6n_ <= c6q_ implies not(c6a_(c6q_) = c6z_)) implies has-zero-of-order(cc, prod-fun(cc, vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, vnb-lambda(c6x_, cc, (1 - c6x_ * recip(c6a_(c6k_))) * cc-exp(cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(clhk_, nn, recip-star(clhk_) * (c6x_ * recip(c6a_(c6k_))) ^ clhk_), succ(c6u_(c6k_)))) - 1))), c6z_, count-hits(c6a_, c6z_, c6n_)))))

- `three-strand-node` — forall([spa, n, d1, d2, d3], n in nodes(spa) implies (strand-map(spa))(nth(2, n)) = [d1, d2, d3] implies nth(1, n) = 1 and node-content(spa, n) == nth(2, d1) and node-dir(spa, n) == nth(1, d1) or nth(1, n) = 2 and node-content(spa, n) == nth(2, d2) and node-dir(spa, n) == nth(1, d2) or nth(1, n) = 3 and node-content(spa, n) == nth(2, d3) and node-dir(spa, n) == nth(1, d3))

- `top-dual-mem` — forall([m, t, z], z in top-dual(m, t) iff z in fun(vec(m), rr) and is-linear-functional(m, z) and is-hom-top-space(t, seminorm-top(normed-vector-space-as-module(rr-nvs), pair(0, 0), vnb-lambda(nvk_, pair(0, 0), vnrm(rr-nvs))), z))

- `trace-affine-reparam` — forall([a in rr, b in rr, lrpc_ in rr, lrpd_ in rr, lrpl_ in rr, lrpm_ in rr], 0 < lrpl_ implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpc_ = a implies lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpd_ = b implies forall([pgam, lrpr_], pgam in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) implies lrpr_ in fun(ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_), cc) implies forall([lrpz_ in ccint(lrpc_, lrpd_)], lrpr_(lrpz_) == pgam(lrpm_ + lrpl_ * lrpz_)) implies trace(lrpr_, lrpc_, lrpd_) subset trace(pgam, a, b) and trace(pgam, a, b) subset trace(lrpr_, lrpc_, lrpd_)))

- `trace-class-comp-right` — forall([v], is-hilbert-space(v) implies forall([s_, t_], s_ in bounded-ops(v, v) implies is-trace-class(v, t_) implies is-trace-class(v, bop-comp(v, t_, s_))))

- `trace-pairing-nondeg-left` — forall([v], is-hilbert-space(v) implies forall([t_], is-trace-class(v, t_) implies forall([s_ in bounded-ops(v, v)], op-trace(v, bop-comp(v, s_, t_)) = 0) implies forall([x_ in vec(v)], t_(x_) = vzero(v))))
- `trace-pairing-nondeg-right` — forall([v], is-hilbert-space(v) implies forall([s_ in bounded-ops(v, v)], forall([t_], is-trace-class(v, t_) implies op-trace(v, bop-comp(v, s_, t_)) = 0) implies forall([x_ in vec(v)], s_(x_) = vzero(v))))

- `tri-child-geom-1` — forall([goux_ in cc, gouy_ in cc, gouz_ in cc], (magnitude(cc-mid(goux_, gouy_) - goux_) + magnitude(cc-mid(goux_, gouz_) - cc-mid(goux_, gouy_))) + magnitude(goux_ - cc-mid(goux_, gouz_)) = num(1/2) * ((magnitude(gouy_ - goux_) + magnitude(gouz_ - gouy_)) + magnitude(goux_ - gouz_)) and magnitude(goux_ - goux_) <= (magnitude(gouy_ - goux_) + magnitude(gouz_ - gouy_)) + magnitude(goux_ - gouz_))

- `tvs-local-bound-of-one-sided` — forall([m, t, f, n], is-tvs(rr-normed-field, m, t) implies is-linear-functional(m, f) implies n in opens(t) implies vzero(m) in n implies forall([osw_ in n], f(osw_) <= 1) implies forall([eps in rr], 0 < eps implies forsome([bw_ in opens(t)], vzero(m) in bw_ and forall([bwz_ in bw_], abs(f(bwz_)) <= eps))))
- `tvs-open-zero-absorbing` — forall([m, t, w], is-tvs(rr-normed-field, m, t) implies w in opens(t) implies vzero(m) in w implies is-absorbing-subset(m, w))
- `tvs-scal-cont-rr` — forall([m, t, r, x, u], is-tvs(rr-normed-field, m, t) implies r in rr implies x in vec(m) implies u in opens(t) implies (act(m))(r, x) in u implies forsome([tsd_], pos-rr(tsd_) and forsome([tsw_ in opens(t)], x in tsw_ and forall([tss_ in rr], abs(tss_ - r) < tsd_ implies forall([tsa_ in tsw_], (act(m))(tss_, tsa_) in u)))))
- `tvs-shift-open` — forall([m, t, a, x0], is-tvs(rr-normed-field, m, t) implies a in opens(t) implies x0 in vec(m) implies {shy_ in vec(m): (vadd(m))(shy_, x0) in a} in opens(t))
- `tvs-sub-continuous` — forall([m, t, x, y, u], is-tvs(rr-normed-field, m, t) implies x in vec(m) implies y in vec(m) implies u in opens(t) implies (vadd(m))(x, (vneg(m))(y)) in u implies forsome([tsv_ in opens(t)], x in tsv_ and forsome([tsw_ in opens(t)], y in tsw_ and forall([tsp_ in tsv_, tsq_ in tsw_], (vadd(m))(tsp_, (vneg(m))(tsq_)) in u))))
- `tvs-translate-open` — forall([m, t, w, x0], is-tvs(rr-normed-field, m, t) implies w in opens(t) implies x0 in vec(m) implies {trx_ in vec(m): (vadd(m))(trx_, (act(m))(-1, x0)) in w} in opens(t))

- `tychonoff` — forall([ix, tf], is-top-family(ix, tf) implies forall([tpi_ in ix], is-compact-t(tf(tpi_))) implies is-compact-t(tproduct-top(ix, tf)))
- `tychonoff-factor-point` — forall([ix, tf, mm, i], is-top-family(ix, tf) implies forall([tpi_ in ix], is-compact-t(tf(tpi_))) implies mm subset opens(tproduct-top(ix, tf)) implies not(has-finite-subcover(tproduct-top(ix, tf), mm)) implies i in ix implies forsome([tpe_ in pts(tf(i))], forall([tpv5_ in opens(tf(i))], tprod-box(ix, tf, pair([i, tpv5_], [i, tpv5_])) in mm implies not(tpe_ in tpv5_))))
- `uba-as-cba-functorial` — forall([a, b, f], is-hom-unital-banach-algebra(a, b, f) implies is-hom-complex-banach-algebra(uba-as-cba(a), uba-as-cba(b), f))

- `ultra-ball-closed` — forall([s], is-ultrametric(s) implies forall([a, r], a in pts(s) implies r in rr implies 0 < r implies is-closed(s, ball(s, a, r))))

- `unif-cauchy-cont-implies-uniform-limit` — forall([s, fam in fun(nn, fun(pts(s), rr))], forall([k in nn], is-continuous(s, rr-ms, fam(k))) implies is-unif-cauchy(s, fam) implies forsome([g in fun(pts(s), rr)], is-continuous(s, rr-ms, g) and converges-uniformly(s, fam, g)))
- `unif-cauchy-has-uniform-limit` — forall([s, fam in fun(nn, fun(pts(s), rr))], is-unif-cauchy(s, fam) implies forsome([g in fun(pts(s), rr)], converges-uniformly(s, fam, g)))

- `uniform-cauchy-limit` — forall([g in fun(nn, fun(rr, rr)), s_], forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([n_ in nn], forall([k_ in nn, l_ in nn], n_ <= k_ implies n_ <= l_ implies forall([x_ in rr], x_ in s_ implies abs((g(k_))(x_) - (g(l_))(x_)) <= eps)))) implies forsome([h in fun(rr, rr)], forall([x_ in rr], x_ in s_ implies converges-to(rr-ms, vnb-lambda(k_, nn, (g(k_))(x_)), h(x_))) and forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([n_ in nn], forall([k_ in nn], n_ <= k_ implies forall([x_ in rr], x_ in s_ implies abs(h(x_) - (g(k_))(x_)) <= eps))))))
- `uniform-conv-implies-ptwise` — forall([s, t, fam, g], converges-uniformly-to(s, t, fam, g) implies converges-ptwise-to(s, t, fam, g))

- `uniform-limit-continuous-at` — forall([fam in fun(nn, fun(rr, rr)), g in fun(rr, rr), t_ in rr, rho in rr], 0 < rho implies forall([k in nn], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, fam(k), t_)) implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([cp_ in nn], forall([k in nn], cp_ <= k implies forall([x_ in rr], abs(x_ - t_) <= rho implies abs(g(x_) - (fam(k))(x_)) <= eps)))) implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, g, t_))
- `uniform-limit-continuous-on-ccint` — forall([a, b, dfam, psi], dfam in fun(nn, fun(ccint(a, b), rr)) implies psi in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) implies forall([k in nn], is-continuous-on(dfam(k), ccint(a, b))) implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([n in nn], forall([k in nn], n <= k implies forall([x in ccint(a, b)], abs(psi(x) - (dfam(k))(x)) <= eps)))) implies is-continuous-on(psi, ccint(a, b)))

- `uniform-witness-diff-at` — forall([gfam in fun(nn, fun(rr, rr)), wfam in fun(nn, fun(rr, rr)), fc in fun(rr, rr), lv in rr, a in rr, b in rr, t_ in rr, rho in rr], 0 < rho implies forall([y_ in rr], abs(y_ - t_) <= rho implies y_ in ccint(a, b)) implies t_ in ccint(a, b) implies forall([k_ in nn], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, wfam(k_), t_)) implies forall([k_ in nn, y_ in rr], y_ in ccint(a, b) implies (gfam(k_))(y_) - (gfam(k_))(t_) = (wfam(k_))(y_) * (y_ - t_)) implies forall([y_ in rr], y_ in ccint(a, b) implies converges-to(rr-ms, vnb-lambda(k_, nn, (gfam(k_))(y_)), fc(y_))) implies forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([n_ in nn], forall([k_ in nn, l_ in nn], n_ <= k_ implies n_ <= l_ implies forall([x_ in rr], x_ in ccint(a, b) implies abs((wfam(k_))(x_) - (wfam(l_))(x_)) <= eps)))) implies converges-to(rr-ms, vnb-lambda(k_, nn, (wfam(k_))(t_)), lv) implies is-diff-at(fc, t_, lv))
- `uniformly-continuous-arrow-is-continuous-arrow` — forall([a, b, f], is-uniformly-continuous-arrow(a, b, f) implies is-continuous-arrow(a, b, f))
- `uniformly-continuous-extension-from-dense` — forall([s, t, a, f], is-complete(t) implies is-dense(s, a) implies is-uniformly-continuous(subspace-ms(s, a), t, f) implies forsome([g], is-uniformly-continuous(s, t, g) and extends-on(a, g, f) and forall([h], is-uniformly-continuous(s, t, h) implies extends-on(a, h, f) implies h = g)))

- `union-as-disjoint` — forall([a_, b_], union(a_, b_) = union(a_, complement-in(b_, a_)))

- `unit-disc-intro` — forall([u in cc], magnitude(u) < 1 implies u in ball(cc-ms, 0, 1))
- `unit-grid-approx` — forall([dl, k, t], dl in rr implies pos-rr(dl) implies k in nn implies 1 < k * dl + dl implies t in rr implies 0 <= t implies t <= 1 implies forsome([i in ord-segment(succ(k))], i * dl in rr and i * dl <= t and t < i * dl + dl))
- `unit-interval-clopen` — forall([ctp_, ctq_], forall([ctv_ in ccint(0, 1)], ctv_ in ctp_ or ctv_ in ctq_) implies forall([ctv_ in ccint(0, 1)], not(ctv_ in ctp_ and ctv_ in ctq_)) implies forall([cts_ in ccint(0, 1)], cts_ in ctp_ implies forsome([ctd_], pos-rr(ctd_) and forall([ctu_ in ccint(0, 1)], abs(ctu_ - cts_) < ctd_ implies ctu_ in ctp_))) implies forall([cts_ in ccint(0, 1)], cts_ in ctq_ implies forsome([ctd_], pos-rr(ctd_) and forall([ctu_ in ccint(0, 1)], abs(ctu_ - cts_) < ctd_ implies ctu_ in ctq_))) implies 0 in ctp_ implies forall([ctt_ in ccint(0, 1)], ctt_ in ctp_))
- `unit-interval-connected` — is-connected(rr-ms, ccint(0, 1))
- `unit-interval-mul` — forall([anp_ in rr, anq_ in rr], 0 <= anp_ implies anp_ <= 1 implies 0 <= anq_ implies anq_ <= 1 implies 0 <= anp_ * anq_ and anp_ * anq_ <= 1)

- `unitary-graph-preserves-ip` — forall([v, uu, c_, d_, e_, f_], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies is-unitary-graph(v, uu) implies c_ in vec(v) implies d_ in vec(v) implies e_ in vec(v) implies f_ in vec(v) implies [c_, d_] in uu implies [e_, f_] in uu implies (ip(v))(c_, e_) = (ip(v))(d_, f_))
- `unitization-act-add` — forall([a], is-complex-normed-algebra(a) implies forall([kuc_ in cc, kud_ in cc, kuu_ in unit-vec(a)], (unit-act(a))(kuc_ + kud_, kuu_) = (unit-vadd(a))((unit-act(a))(kuc_, kuu_), (unit-act(a))(kud_, kuu_))))
- `unitization-act-mul` — forall([a], is-complex-normed-algebra(a) implies forall([kuc_ in cc, kud_ in cc, kuu_ in unit-vec(a)], (unit-act(a))(kuc_ * kud_, kuu_) = (unit-act(a))(kuc_, (unit-act(a))(kud_, kuu_))))

- `unitization-act-vadd` — forall([a], is-complex-normed-algebra(a) implies forall([kuc_ in cc, kuu_ in unit-vec(a), kuv_ in unit-vec(a)], (unit-act(a))(kuc_, (unit-vadd(a))(kuu_, kuv_)) = (unit-vadd(a))((unit-act(a))(kuc_, kuu_), (unit-act(a))(kuc_, kuv_))))

- `unitization-norm-homog` — forall([a], is-complex-normed-algebra(a) implies forall([c in cc, l in cc, x in vec(a)], (unit-vnrm(a))((unit-act(a))(c, [l, x])) = magnitude(c) * (unit-vnrm(a))([l, x])))

- `unitization-norm-triangle` — forall([a], is-complex-normed-algebra(a) implies forall([l in cc, x in vec(a), r in cc, y in vec(a)], (unit-vnrm(a))((unit-vadd(a))([l, x], [r, y])) <= (unit-vnrm(a))([l, x]) + (unit-vnrm(a))([r, y])))

- `unitization-star-act` — forall([a], is-nu-involutive-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([kuc_ in cc, kuu_ in unit-vec(a)], (unit-istar(a))((unit-act(a))(kuc_, kuu_)) = (unit-act(a))(conjugate(kuc_), (unit-istar(a))(kuu_))))
- `unitization-star-isometric` — forall([a], is-nu-involutive-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([kuu_ in unit-vec(a)], (unit-vnrm(a))((unit-istar(a))(kuu_)) = (unit-vnrm(a))(kuu_)))
- `unitization-star-mul` — forall([a], is-nu-involutive-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([kuu_ in unit-vec(a), kuv_ in unit-vec(a)], (unit-istar(a))((unit-vmul(a))(kuu_, kuv_)) = (unit-vmul(a))((unit-istar(a))(kuv_), (unit-istar(a))(kuu_))))
- `unitization-star-star` — forall([a], is-nu-involutive-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([kuu_ in unit-vec(a)], (unit-istar(a))((unit-istar(a))(kuu_)) = kuu_))
- `unitization-star-vadd` — forall([a], is-nu-involutive-banach-algebra(a) implies forall([kuu_ in unit-vec(a), kuv_ in unit-vec(a)], (unit-istar(a))((unit-vadd(a))(kuu_, kuv_)) = (unit-vadd(a))((unit-istar(a))(kuu_), (unit-istar(a))(kuv_))))
- `unitization-unfold` — forall([a], unitization(a) == [normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field), unit-vec(a), unit-vadd(a), [0, vzero(a)], unit-vneg(a), unit-act(a), unit-vnrm(a), unit-vmul(a), [1, vzero(a)]])

- `unitization-unit-right` — forall([a], is-complex-normed-algebra(a) implies forall([u in unit-vec(a)], (unit-vmul(a))(u, [1, vzero(a)]) = u))
- `unitization-vadd-assoc` — forall([a], is-complex-normed-algebra(a) implies forall([kuu_ in unit-vec(a), kuv_ in unit-vec(a), kuw_ in unit-vec(a)], (unit-vadd(a))((unit-vadd(a))(kuu_, kuv_), kuw_) = (unit-vadd(a))(kuu_, (unit-vadd(a))(kuv_, kuw_))))
- `unitization-vadd-comm` — forall([a], is-complex-normed-algebra(a) implies forall([kuu_ in unit-vec(a), kuv_ in unit-vec(a)], (unit-vadd(a))(kuu_, kuv_) = (unit-vadd(a))(kuv_, kuu_)))

- `unitization-vadd-neg-right` — forall([a], is-complex-normed-algebra(a) implies forall([kuu_ in unit-vec(a)], (unit-vadd(a))(kuu_, (unit-vneg(a))(kuu_)) = [0, vzero(a)]))
- `unitization-vadd-zero-left` — forall([a], is-complex-normed-algebra(a) implies forall([kuu_ in unit-vec(a)], (unit-vadd(a))([0, vzero(a)], kuu_) = kuu_))
- `unitization-vadd-zero-right` — forall([a], is-complex-normed-algebra(a) implies forall([kuu_ in unit-vec(a)], (unit-vadd(a))(kuu_, [0, vzero(a)]) = kuu_))
- `unitization-vmul-act-left` — forall([a], is-complex-normed-algebra(a) implies forall([kuc_ in cc, kuu_ in unit-vec(a), kuv_ in unit-vec(a)], (unit-vmul(a))((unit-act(a))(kuc_, kuu_), kuv_) = (unit-act(a))(kuc_, (unit-vmul(a))(kuu_, kuv_))))

- `unitization-vmul-assoc` — forall([a], is-complex-normed-algebra(a) implies forall([kuu_ in unit-vec(a), kuv_ in unit-vec(a), kuw_ in unit-vec(a)], (unit-vmul(a))((unit-vmul(a))(kuu_, kuv_), kuw_) = (unit-vmul(a))(kuu_, (unit-vmul(a))(kuv_, kuw_))))
- `unitization-vmul-dist-left` — forall([a], is-complex-normed-algebra(a) implies forall([kuu_ in unit-vec(a), kuv_ in unit-vec(a), kuw_ in unit-vec(a)], (unit-vmul(a))(kuu_, (unit-vadd(a))(kuv_, kuw_)) = (unit-vadd(a))((unit-vmul(a))(kuu_, kuv_), (unit-vmul(a))(kuu_, kuw_))))
- `unitization-vmul-dist-right` — forall([a], is-complex-normed-algebra(a) implies forall([kuu_ in unit-vec(a), kuv_ in unit-vec(a), kuw_ in unit-vec(a)], (unit-vmul(a))((unit-vadd(a))(kuu_, kuv_), kuw_) = (unit-vadd(a))((unit-vmul(a))(kuu_, kuw_), (unit-vmul(a))(kuv_, kuw_))))
- `unitization-vnrm-definite` — forall([a], is-complex-normed-algebra(a) implies forall([kqu_ in unit-vec(a)], (unit-vnrm(a))(kqu_) = 0 iff kqu_ = [0, vzero(a)]))
- `unitization-vnrm-homog` — forall([a], is-complex-normed-algebra(a) implies forall([kqc_ in cc, kqu_ in unit-vec(a)], (unit-vnrm(a))((unit-act(a))(kqc_, kqu_)) = magnitude(kqc_) * (unit-vnrm(a))(kqu_)))

- `unitization-vnrm-submult` — forall([a], is-complex-normed-algebra(a) implies forall([kqu_ in unit-vec(a), kqv_ in unit-vec(a)], (unit-vnrm(a))((unit-vmul(a))(kqu_, kqv_)) <= (unit-vnrm(a))(kqu_) * (unit-vnrm(a))(kqv_)))
- `unitization-vnrm-triangle` — forall([a], is-complex-normed-algebra(a) implies forall([kqu_ in unit-vec(a), kqv_ in unit-vec(a)], (unit-vnrm(a))((unit-vadd(a))(kqu_, kqv_)) <= (unit-vnrm(a))(kqu_) + (unit-vnrm(a))(kqv_)))
- `unitrow-entries-defined` — forall([a, n, i], is-ring(a) implies n in nn implies forall([i_ in interval(1, 1), j_ in interval(1, n)], (vnb-lambda([rw, cl], cartesian(interval(1, 1), interval(1, n)), if(cl = i, one(a), zero(a))))(i_, j_) in set))
- `unitrow-entry-at` — forall([a, n, i], is-ring(a) implies n in nn implies i in interval(1, n) implies entry(unitrow(a, n, i), 1, i) = one(a))
- `unitrow-entry-off` — forall([a, n, i, j], is-ring(a) implies n in nn implies i in interval(1, n) implies j in interval(1, n) implies not(j = i) implies entry(unitrow(a, n, i), 1, j) = zero(a))
- `unitrow-matmul-entry` — forall([a, m, n, pm, ri, cj], is-ring(a) implies pm in mat(m, n, carr(a)) implies ri in interval(1, m) implies cj in interval(1, n) implies entry(matmul(a, unitrow(a, m, ri), pm), 1, cj) = entry(pm, ri, cj))
- `unitrow-type` — forall([a], is-ring(a) implies forall([n, i], n in nn implies unitrow(a, n, i) in mat(1, n, carr(a))))
- `unity-roots-at-most-d` — forall([fk], is-field-ring(fk) implies forall([d_ in nn], 1 <= d_ implies forall([m_ in nn, al_], forall([i_ in interval(1, m_)], al_(i_) in carr(fk) and ring-power(fk, al_(i_), d_) = one(fk)) implies forall([i_ in interval(1, m_), j_ in interval(1, m_)], al_(i_) = al_(j_) implies i_ = j_) implies m_ <= d_)))
- `upd-facts` — forall([w in fun(nn, nn), n in nn, m in nn], upd(w, n, m) in fun(nn, nn) and forall([j in nn], j < n implies (upd(w, n, m))(j) = w(j)) and forall([j in nn], not(j < n) implies (upd(w, n, m))(j) = m))
- `upper-half-plane-membership` — forall([z], z in upper-half-plane iff z in cc and 0 < imag-part(z))
- `upper-triangular-entry` — forall([a, n, d], is-upper-triangular(a, n, d) implies forall([i in interval(1, n), j in interval(1, n)], j < i implies entry(d, i, j) = zero(a)))
- `ury-apx-bounds` — forall([n in nn, t, x], is-compact-t(t) implies is-hausdorff(t) implies forall([c in cu-pairs(t)], 0 <= (ury-apx(t, x, n))(c) and (ury-apx(t, x, n))(c) <= 1))
- `ury-apx-le-of-sub` — forall([t, x], is-compact-t(t) implies is-hausdorff(t) implies forall([c1 in cu-pairs(t), c2 in cu-pairs(t)], nth(2, c1) subset nth(1, c2) implies forall([m in nn, k in nn], (ury-apx(t, x, k))(c2) <= (ury-apx(t, x, m))(c1))))
- `ury-apx-mid` — forall([n in nn, t, x], is-compact-t(t) implies is-hausdorff(t) implies forall([c in cu-pairs(t)], (ury-apx(t, x, n))(ury-r(t, c)) <= (ury-apx(t, x, n))(c) and (ury-apx(t, x, n))(c) <= (ury-apx(t, x, n))(ury-l(t, c))))
- `ury-apx-mono` — forall([n in nn, t, x], is-compact-t(t) implies is-hausdorff(t) implies forall([c in cu-pairs(t)], (ury-apx(t, x, n))(c) <= (ury-apx(t, x, succ(n)))(c)))
- `ury-apx-mono-add` — forall([d in nn, t, x], is-compact-t(t) implies is-hausdorff(t) implies forall([c in cu-pairs(t), k in nn], (ury-apx(t, x, k))(c) <= (ury-apx(t, x, k + d))(c)))
- `ury-apx-off-u` — forall([n in nn, t, x], is-compact-t(t) implies is-hausdorff(t) implies forall([c in cu-pairs(t)], not(x in nth(2, c)) implies (ury-apx(t, x, n))(c) = 1))
- `ury-apx-on-c` — forall([n in nn, t, x], is-compact-t(t) implies is-hausdorff(t) implies forall([c in cu-pairs(t)], x in nth(1, c) implies (ury-apx(t, x, n))(c) = 0))
- `ury-apx-succ-val` — forall([n in nn, t, x, c], is-compact-t(t) implies is-hausdorff(t) implies c in cu-pairs(t) implies (ury-apx(t, x, succ(n)))(c) = num(1/2) * ((ury-apx(t, x, n))(ury-l(t, c)) + (ury-apx(t, x, n))(ury-r(t, c))))
- `ury-apx-type` — forall([n in nn, t, x], is-compact-t(t) implies is-hausdorff(t) implies ury-apx(t, x, n) in fun(cu-pairs(t), rr))
- `ury-apx-zero-in` — forall([t, x, c], is-compact-t(t) implies is-hausdorff(t) implies c in cu-pairs(t) implies x in nth(2, c) implies (ury-apx(t, x, 0))(c) = 0)
- `ury-apx-zero-out` — forall([t, x, c], is-compact-t(t) implies is-hausdorff(t) implies c in cu-pairs(t) implies not(x in nth(2, c)) implies (ury-apx(t, x, 0))(c) = 1)
- `ury-cu-intro` — forall([t, a, u], is-top-space(t) implies is-top-closed(t, a) implies u in opens(t) implies a subset u implies [a, u] in cu-pairs(t))
- `ury-cu-parts` — forall([t, c in cu-pairs(t)], is-top-closed(t, nth(1, c)) and nth(2, c) in opens(t) and nth(1, c) subset nth(2, c) and c = [nth(1, c), nth(2, c)])
- `ury-cu-set` — forall([t], is-top-space(t) implies cu-pairs(t) in set)
- `ury-cu-unfold` — forall([t], cu-pairs(t) == {ucw_ in cartesian(power(pts(t)), opens(t)): is-top-closed(t, nth(1, ucw_)) and nth(1, ucw_) subset nth(2, ucw_)})
- `ury-k-spec` — forall([t, c], is-compact-t(t) implies is-hausdorff(t) implies c in cu-pairs(t) implies ury-k(t, c) in power(pts(t)) and is-top-closed(t, ury-k(t, c)) and ury-v(t, c) subset ury-k(t, c) and ury-k(t, c) subset nth(2, c))
- `ury-l-in` — forall([t, c], is-compact-t(t) implies is-hausdorff(t) implies c in cu-pairs(t) implies ury-l(t, c) in cu-pairs(t))
- `ury-lim-least` — forall([t, x], is-compact-t(t) implies is-hausdorff(t) implies forall([c in cu-pairs(t), b in rr], forall([ulq_ in nn], (ury-apx(t, x, ulq_))(c) <= b) implies ury-lim(t, c, x) <= b))
- `ury-lim-mid` — forall([t, x], is-compact-t(t) implies is-hausdorff(t) implies forall([c in cu-pairs(t)], ury-lim(t, c, x) = num(1/2) * (ury-lim(t, ury-l(t, c), x) + ury-lim(t, ury-r(t, c), x))))
- `ury-lim-off-u` — forall([t, x], is-compact-t(t) implies is-hausdorff(t) implies forall([c in cu-pairs(t)], not(x in nth(2, c)) implies ury-lim(t, c, x) = 1))
- `ury-lim-on-c` — forall([t, x], is-compact-t(t) implies is-hausdorff(t) implies forall([c in cu-pairs(t)], x in nth(1, c) implies ury-lim(t, c, x) = 0))

- `zz-pow-pad-span-iff` — forall([m, n, f, z], m in nn implies n in nn implies m = n + n implies f in fun(interval(1, n), zz) implies z in vec(zz-pow(m)) implies z in span(zz-pow(m), m, matact(zz-pow(m), diag-mat(m, pad-ones(m, n, f)), zz-units(m))) iff seq-shift(n, z) in span(zz-pow(n), n, matact(zz-pow(n), diag-mat(n, f), zz-units(n))))
- `zz-pow-row-lincomb` — forall([n, x], n in nn implies x in vec(zz-pow(n)) implies lincomb(zz-pow(n), n, zz-row(n, x), zz-units(n)) = x)
- `zz-pow-row-lincomb-via-ring-pow` — forall([n, x], n in nn implies x in vec(zz-pow(n)) implies lincomb(zz-pow(n), n, zz-row(n, x), zz-units(n)) = x)
- `zz-pow-scal` — forall([n in nn], scal(zz-pow(n)) = zz-ring)
- `zz-pow-scal-via-ring-pow` — forall([n in nn], scal(zz-pow(n)) = zz-ring)
- `zz-pow-unfold` — forall([n], zz-pow(n) == direct-sum(zz-ring, n, vnb-lambda(zpi_, interval(1, n), ring-as-module(zz-ring))))
- `zz-pow-unfold-via-ring-pow` — forall([n], zz-pow(n) == direct-sum(zz-ring, n, vnb-lambda(zpi_, interval(1, n), ring-as-module(zz-ring))))
- `zz-pow-vadd-at` — forall([n, x, y, i], n in nn implies x in vec(zz-pow(n)) implies y in vec(zz-pow(n)) implies i in interval(1, n) implies ((vadd(zz-pow(n)))(x, y))(i) = (add(zz-ring))(x(i), y(i)))
- `zz-pow-vec-in` — forall([n, x], n in nn implies x in fun(interval(1, n), zz) implies x in vec(zz-pow(n)))
- `zz-pow-vec-in-via-ring-pow` — forall([n, x], n in nn implies x in fun(interval(1, n), zz) implies x in vec(zz-pow(n)))
- `zz-pow-vec-out` — forall([n, x, i], n in nn implies x in vec(zz-pow(n)) implies i in interval(1, n) implies x(i) in zz)
- `zz-pow-vec-out-via-ring-pow` — forall([n, x, i], n in nn implies x in vec(zz-pow(n)) implies i in interval(1, n) implies x(i) in zz)
- `zz-pow-vneg-at` — forall([n, x, i], n in nn implies x in vec(zz-pow(n)) implies i in interval(1, n) implies ((vneg(zz-pow(n)))(x))(i) = (neg(zz-ring))(x(i)))
- `zz-pow-vzero-at` — forall([n, i], n in nn implies i in interval(1, n) implies (vzero(zz-pow(n)))(i) = zero(zz-ring))
- `zz-pow-vzero-at-via-ring-pow` — forall([n, i], n in nn implies i in interval(1, n) implies (vzero(zz-pow(n)))(i) = zero(zz-ring))
- `zz-prime-abs-prime-nat` — forall([p], is-prime-element(zz-ring, p) implies is-prime-nat(abs(p)))
- `zz-prime-factor-exists` — forall([d in zz], not(d = 0) implies not(d = 1) implies not(d = -1) implies forsome([ntp_], is-prime-nat(ntp_) and zz-divides(ntp_, d)))
- `zz-principal-ideal-in` — forall([b, x, t], b in zz implies x in zz implies t in zz implies x = t * b implies x in principal-ideal(zz-ring, b))
- `zz-principal-ideal-out` — forall([b, x], b in zz implies x in principal-ideal(zz-ring, b) implies x in zz and forsome([t in zz], x = t * b))
- `zz-prod-abs` — forall([n in nn, q], forall([ntq_ in interval(1, n)], q(ntq_) in zz) implies prod-ring(zz-ring, vnb-lambda(nti_, nn, abs(q(nti_))), interval(1, n)) = abs(prod-ring(zz-ring, q, interval(1, n))))
- `zz-residue-in` — forall([m, k], m in nn implies 1 <= m implies k in zz implies zz-residue(k, m) in interval(1, m) and zz-divides(m, k - zz-residue(k, m)))
- `zz-residue-unique` — forall([m, k, r], m in nn implies 1 <= m implies k in zz implies r in interval(1, m) implies zz-divides(m, k - r) implies r = zz-residue(k, m))
- `zz-restrict-injective` — forall([kq_], is-ring(kq_) implies forall([a6s], a6s subset zz implies forall([fq_ in fun(zz, carr(kq_)), gq_ in fun(zz, carr(kq_))], forall([a6j in zz], not(a6j in a6s) implies fq_(a6j) = zero(kq_)) implies forall([a6j in zz], not(a6j in a6s) implies gq_(a6j) = zero(kq_)) implies vnb-lambda(a6i, a6s, fq_(a6i)) = vnb-lambda(a6i, a6s, gq_(a6i)) implies fq_ = gq_)))
- `zz-restrict-type` — forall([kq_], is-ring(kq_) implies forall([a6s], a6s subset zz implies forall([fq_ in fun(zz, carr(kq_))], vnb-lambda(a6i, a6s, fq_(a6i)) in fun(a6s, carr(kq_)))))
- `zz-ring-add-is-add` — forall([u, v], u in zz implies v in zz implies (add(zz-ring))(u, v) = u + v)
- `zz-ring-add-neg` — forall([x, y], x in zz implies y in zz implies (add(zz-ring))(x, (neg(zz-ring))(y)) = x + -y)
- `zz-ring-divides-iff` — forall([p in zz, x in zz], divides(zz-ring, p, x) iff zz-divides(p, x))
- `zz-ring-mul-is-mul` — forall([t, b], t in zz implies b in zz implies (mul(zz-ring))(t, b) = t * b)
- `zz-ring-neg-is-neg` — forall([u in zz], (neg(zz-ring))(u) = -u)
- `zz-row-entry` — forall([n, x, i], n in nn implies x in vec(zz-pow(n)) implies i in interval(1, n) implies entry(zz-row(n, x), 1, i) = x(i))
- `zz-row-entry-via-ring-pow` — forall([n, x, i], n in nn implies x in vec(zz-pow(n)) implies i in interval(1, n) implies entry(zz-row(n, x), 1, i) = x(i))
- `zz-row-is-ring-row` — forall([n, x], zz-row(n, x) == ring-row(zz-ring, n, x))
- `zz-row-type` — forall([n, x], n in nn implies x in vec(zz-pow(n)) implies zz-row(n, x) in mat(1, n, carr(zz-ring)))
- `zz-row-type-via-ring-pow` — forall([n, x], n in nn implies x in vec(zz-pow(n)) implies zz-row(n, x) in mat(1, n, carr(zz-ring)))
- `zz-small-multiple-zero` — forall([m, x], m in zz implies x in zz implies 1 <= m implies zz-divides(m, x) implies x < m implies -m < x implies x = 0)
- `zz-sub-in-zz` — forall([u_, v_], u_ in zz implies v_ in zz implies u_ - v_ in zz)
- `zz-trichotomy` — forall([a_ in zz], a_ < 0 or a_ = 0 or 0 < a_)
- `zz-unit-at` — forall([n, k, i], n in nn implies i in interval(1, n) implies (vnb-lambda(zut_, interval(1, n), entry(unitrow(zz-ring, n, k), 1, zut_)))(i) = entry(unitrow(zz-ring, n, k), 1, i))
- `zz-unit-at-via-ring-pow` — forall([n, k, i], n in nn implies i in interval(1, n) implies (vnb-lambda(zut_, interval(1, n), entry(unitrow(zz-ring, n, k), 1, zut_)))(i) = entry(unitrow(zz-ring, n, k), 1, i))
- `zz-unit-neg` — forall([x in zz], is-unit(zz-ring, x) implies is-unit(zz-ring, -x))
- `zz-unit-vec` — forall([n, k], n in nn implies vnb-lambda(zut_, interval(1, n), entry(unitrow(zz-ring, n, k), 1, zut_)) in vec(zz-pow(n)))
- `zz-unit-vec-via-ring-pow` — forall([n, k], n in nn implies vnb-lambda(zut_, interval(1, n), entry(unitrow(zz-ring, n, k), 1, zut_)) in vec(zz-pow(n)))
- `zz-units-entry` — forall([n, k], n in nn implies k in interval(1, n) implies entry(zz-units(n), k, 1) = vnb-lambda(zut_, interval(1, n), entry(unitrow(zz-ring, n, k), 1, zut_)))
- `zz-units-entry-via-ring-pow` — forall([n, k], n in nn implies k in interval(1, n) implies entry(zz-units(n), k, 1) = vnb-lambda(zut_, interval(1, n), entry(unitrow(zz-ring, n, k), 1, zut_)))
- `zz-units-generate` — forall([n in nn], generates(zz-pow(n), n, zz-units(n)))
- `zz-units-generate-via-ring-pow` — forall([n in nn], generates(zz-pow(n), n, zz-units(n)))
- `zz-units-is-ring-units` — forall([n], zz-units(n) == ring-units(zz-ring, n))
- `zz-units-rel-free` — forall([n in nn], rel-free(zz-pow(n), n, zz-units(n)))
- `zz-units-rel-free-via-ring-pow` — forall([n in nn], rel-free(zz-pow(n), n, zz-units(n)))
- `zz-units-type` — forall([n in nn], zz-units(n) in mat(n, 1, vec(zz-pow(n))))
- `zz-units-type-via-ring-pow` — forall([n in nn], zz-units(n) in mat(n, 1, vec(zz-pow(n))))

## Proof Support Set

Results we accept without a machine proof in VNB.  Logically treated as theorems.


## Stated without proof

Not proved in VNB; split by *origin*.  "Axiom" is reserved for the first group — it is NOT the umbrella for this section.

### Axioms — the fixed VNB base

The foundational axioms of VNB set theory (make-vnb-base-theory core + theorem-library/axioms).  Fixed, though not finite (separation/replacement are schemas).  Everything else rests on these.

> **The axioms below are NOT the whole trusted base.**  The set- & class-formation *schemas* (separation `{x∈A|p}`, comprehension `{x|p}`, indexed union `⋃_{z∈A}body`) carry a formula schema in their body and so live in the proof checker as primitive inference rules, not as formulas in this table.  They are stated, with their premises and conclusions, in `KERNEL-RULES.md`.  The trusted base is these axioms **plus** the kernel rules.

- `app-graph` — forall([fn_, arg_], fn_(arg_) == iota(val_, [arg_, val_] in fn_))
- `burali-forti` — not(ord in set)
- `cartesian-set-iff` — forall([a, b], cartesian(a, b) in set iff a in set and b in set)
- `cc-add-assoc` — forall([a, b, c], a in cc and b in cc and c in cc implies (a + b) + c = a + (b + c))
- `cc-add-closed` — forall([a, b], a in cc and b in cc implies a + b in cc)
- `cc-add-comm` — forall([a, b], a in cc and b in cc implies a + b = b + a)
- `cc-add-zero` — forall([a in cc], a + 0 = a)
- `cc-conjugate-add` — forall([a, b], a in cc and b in cc implies conjugate(a + b) = conjugate(a) + conjugate(b))
- `cc-conjugate-closed` — forall([a in cc], conjugate(a) in cc)
- `cc-conjugate-fixes-rr` — forall([a in rr], conjugate(a) = a)  _[warrant: reference]_
- `cc-conjugate-i` — conjugate(1i) = -1i  _[warrant: reference]_
- `cc-conjugate-involution` — forall([a in cc], conjugate(conjugate(a)) = a)
- `cc-conjugate-mul` — forall([a, b], a in cc and b in cc implies conjugate(a * b) = conjugate(a) * conjugate(b))
- `cc-distributive` — forall([a, b, c], a in cc and b in cc and c in cc implies a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c)
- `cc-generated-by-rr` — forall([z in cc], forsome([x in rr, y in rr], z = x + y * 1i))  _[warrant: reference]_
- `cc-i-in` — 1i in cc  _[warrant: reference]_
- `cc-i-squared` — 1i * 1i = num(-1)  _[warrant: reference]_
- `cc-inf-in-set` — cc-inf in set
- `cc-inf-not-in-cc` — not(cc-inf in cc)
- `cc-is-set` — cc in set
- `cc-mul-assoc` — forall([a, b, c], a in cc and b in cc and c in cc implies (a * b) * c = a * (b * c))
- `cc-mul-closed` — forall([a, b], a in cc and b in cc implies a * b in cc)
- `cc-mul-comm` — forall([a, b], a in cc and b in cc implies a * b = b * a)
- `cc-neg-closed` — forall([a in cc], -a in cc)
- `cc-neg-inverse` — forall([a in cc], a + -a = 0)
- `cc-one-in` — 1 in cc
- `cc-one-mul` — forall([a in cc], 1 * a = a)
- `cc-recip-closed` — forall([a], a in cc and not(a = 0) implies recip(a) in cc)
- `cc-recip-inverse` — forall([a], a in cc and not(a = 0) implies a * recip(a) = 1)
- `cc-self-conj-nonneg` — forall([a in cc], a * conjugate(a) in rr and 0 <= a * conjugate(a))
- `cc-self-conj-real` — forall([a in cc], a * conjugate(a) in rr)
- `cc-zero-in` — 0 in cc
- `choice-axiom` — forall([a], forsome([x], x in a) implies choice(a) in a)
- `class-extensionality` — forall([a, b], forall([x], x in a iff x in b) implies a = b)
- `complement-in-membership` — forall([a, b, x], x in complement-in(a, b) iff x in a and not(x in b))
- `complement-in-set-closure` — forall([a, b], a in set implies complement-in(a, b) in set)
- `dom-fun-membership` — forall([a, f in fun(a), x], x in dom(f) iff x in a)
- `dom-membership` — forall([f, x], x in dom(f) iff x in set and f(x) in set)
- `dom-of-fun` — forall([a, f], f in fun(a) and a in set implies dom(f) in set and dom(f) = a)
