- `equality-symmetry` — forall([a, b], a = b implies b = a)
- `equality-transitivity` — forall([a, b, c], a = b and b = c implies a = c)
- `extensionality` — forall([a, b], a in set and b in set implies a = b iff forall([x], x in a iff x in b))
- `fun-apply-type` — forall([f, a, b, x], f in fun(a, b) and x in a implies f(x) in b)
- `fun-codomain-iff` — forall([a, b, f], f in fun(a, b) iff f in fun(a) and forall([x in a], f(x) in b))
- `fun-domain-apply-def` — forall([a, f, x], f in fun(a) implies f(x) = f(x) iff x in a)
- `fun-domain-elements-are-sets` — forall([a, f], f in fun(a) and a in set implies f in set)
- `fun-domain-extensionality` — forall([a, f, g], f in fun(a) implies g in fun(a) implies forall([x in a], f(x) = g(x)) implies f = g)
- `fun-elements-are-sets` — forall([a, b, f], f in fun(a, b) and a in set implies f in set)
- `fun-no-junk` — forall([a, f in fun(a), z], z in f iff forsome([x, y], z = [x, y] and x in a and f(x) = y))
- `fun-set-iff` — forall([a, b], fun(a, b) in set iff a in set and b in set)
- `image-set` — forall([phi, s in set], image(phi, s) in set)
- `intersection-decompose` — forall([x, as], x in intersection(restvar(as)) iff splice(and, e, as, x in e))
- `intersection-membership` — forall([a, b, x], x in intersection(a, b) iff x in a and x in b)
- `intersection-set-closure` — forall([a, b], a in set or b in set implies intersection(a, b) in set)
- `is-fun-def` — forall([f], is-fun(f) iff forsome([a in set], f in fun(a)))
- `length-in-nn` — forall([a, l in tuples(a)], length(l) in nn)
- `length-of-empty` — length([]) = 0
- `limit-ord-is-sup` — forall([lambda], limit-ord(lambda) implies sup-ord(ord-segment(lambda)) = lambda)
- `list-sethood` — forall([a, l], a in set and l in tuples(a) implies l in set)
- `make-set-empty` — {} = empty-set
- `make-set-membership` — forall([x, l], x in make-set(l) iff x in set and forsome([i in nn], 1 <= i and i <= length(l) and nth(i, l) = x))
- `make-set-sethood` — forall([a, l], l in tuples(a) and a in set implies make-set(l) in set)
- `membership-implies-sethood` — forall([a, b], a in b implies a in set)
- `neg-inf-lower-bound` — forall([x in rr-star], neg-inf <= x)
- `nn-add-assoc` — forall([a, b, c], a in nn and b in nn and c in nn implies (a + b) + c = a + (b + c))
- `nn-add-closed` — forall([a, b], a in nn and b in nn implies a + b in nn)
- `nn-add-comm` — forall([a, b], a in nn and b in nn implies a + b = b + a)
- `nn-add-zero` — forall([a in nn], a + 0 = a)
- `nn-distributive` — forall([a, b, c], a in nn and b in nn and c in nn implies a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c)
- `nn-induction` — forall([c], 0 in c and forall([n], n in nn and n in c implies succ(n) in c) implies forall([n in nn], n in c))
- `nn-is-set` — nn in set
- `nn-mul-assoc` — forall([a, b, c], a in nn and b in nn and c in nn implies (a * b) * c = a * (b * c))
- `nn-mul-closed` — forall([a, b], a in nn and b in nn implies a * b in nn)
- `nn-mul-comm` — forall([a, b], a in nn and b in nn implies a * b = b * a)
- `nn-not-a-list` — forall([n in nn], not(n in tuples(set)))
- `nn-one-mul` — forall([a in nn], 1 * a = a)
- `nn-subset-ord` — forall([n in nn], n in ord)
- `nn-subset-zz` — forall([n in nn], n in zz)
- `nn-succ-closed` — forall([n in nn], succ(n) in nn)
- `nn-zero-in` — 0 in nn
- `nth-in-range` — forall([a, i, l], i in nn and l in tuples(a) and 1 <= i and i <= length(l) implies nth(i, l) in a)
- `ord-le-antisymm` — forall([alpha, beta], ord-le(alpha, beta) and ord-le(beta, alpha) implies alpha = beta)
- `ord-le-closure` — forall([alpha, beta], ord-le(alpha, beta) implies alpha in ord and beta in ord)
- `ord-le-nn-compat` — forall([m, n], m in nn and n in nn implies ord-le(m, n) iff m <= n)
- `ord-le-refl` — forall([alpha in ord], ord-le(alpha, alpha))
- `ord-le-total` — forall([alpha, beta], alpha in ord and beta in ord implies ord-le(alpha, beta) or ord-le(beta, alpha))
- `ord-le-trans` — forall([alpha, beta, gamma], ord-le(alpha, beta) and ord-le(beta, gamma) implies ord-le(alpha, gamma))
- `ord-segment-is-set` — forall([alpha in ord], ord-segment(alpha) in set)
- `ord-segment-limit` — forall([lambda], limit-ord(lambda) implies forall([x], ord-lt(x, lambda) implies forsome([beta], ord-lt(x, beta) and ord-lt(beta, lambda))))
- `ord-segment-membership` — forall([alpha, x], alpha in ord implies x in ord-segment(alpha) iff ord-lt(x, alpha))
- `ord-segment-succ` — forall([alpha in ord, x], x in ord-segment(succ_ord(alpha)) iff x in ord-segment(alpha) or x = alpha)
- `ord-segment-zero` — ord-segment(0) = empty-set
- `ord-succ-above` — forall([alpha in ord], ord-lt(alpha, succ_ord(alpha)))
- `ord-succ-immediate` — forall([alpha, beta], alpha in ord and beta in ord and ord-lt(alpha, beta) implies ord-le(succ_ord(alpha), beta))
- `ord-succ-in` — forall([alpha in ord], succ_ord(alpha) in ord)
- `ord-succ-injective` — forall([alpha, beta], alpha in ord and beta in ord and succ_ord(alpha) = succ_ord(beta) implies alpha = beta)
- `ord-succ-nn` — forall([n in nn], succ_ord(n) = succ(n))
- `ord-zero-least` — forall([alpha in ord], ord-le(0, alpha))
- `pairing` — forall([a, b], a in set and b in set implies pair(a, b) in set)
- `pairing-membership` — forall([a, b], a in set and b in set implies forall([x], x in pair(a, b) iff x = a or x = b))
- `partial-fun-binary-membership` — forall([a, c, f], f in partial-fun(a, c) iff forsome([b in power(a)], f in fun(b, c)))
- `partial-fun-binary-sethood` — forall([a, c], a in set and c in set implies partial-fun(a, c) in set)
- `partial-fun-membership` — forall([a, f], f in partial-fun(a) iff forsome([b in power(a)], f in fun(b)))
- `pos-inf-upper-bound` — forall([x in rr-star], x <= pos-inf)
- `power-neg` — forall([x, n], x in cc and n in nn and not(x = 0) implies x ^ (-n) = recip(x ^ n))
- `power-set` — forall([a in set], power(a) in set)
- `power-set-membership` — forall([a, x], x in power(a) iff x in set and forall([z in x], z in a))
- `power-succ` — forall([x, n], x in cc and n in nn implies x ^ succ(n) = x * x ^ n)
- `power-typing-nonneg` — forall([x, n], x in cc and n in nn implies x ^ n in cc)
- `power-zero` — forall([x in cc], x ^ 0 = 1)
- `qq-add-assoc` — forall([a, b, c], a in qq and b in qq and c in qq implies (a + b) + c = a + (b + c))
- `qq-add-closed` — forall([a, b], a in qq and b in qq implies a + b in qq)
- `qq-add-comm` — forall([a, b], a in qq and b in qq implies a + b = b + a)
- `qq-add-zero` — forall([a in qq], a + 0 = a)
- `qq-distributive` — forall([a, b, c], a in qq and b in qq and c in qq implies a * (b + c) = a * b + a * c)
- `qq-is-fraction` — forall([q in qq], forsome([a in zz, b in zz], not(b = 0) and q = a * recip(b)))
- `qq-is-set` — qq in set
- `qq-mul-assoc` — forall([a, b, c], a in qq and b in qq and c in qq implies (a * b) * c = a * (b * c))
- `qq-mul-closed` — forall([a, b], a in qq and b in qq implies a * b in qq)
- `qq-mul-comm` — forall([a, b], a in qq and b in qq implies a * b = b * a)
- `qq-neg-closed` — forall([a in qq], -a in qq)
- `qq-neg-inverse` — forall([a in qq], a + -a = 0)
- `qq-one-in` — 1 in qq
- `qq-one-mul` — forall([a in qq], 1 * a = a)
- `qq-recip-closed` — forall([a], a in qq and not(a = 0) implies recip(a) in qq)
- `qq-recip-inverse` — forall([a], a in qq and not(a = 0) implies a * recip(a) = 1)
- `qq-subset-rr` — forall([n in qq], n in rr)
- `qq-zero-in` — 0 in qq

- `adm-def-pred-hyp` — forall([mdt_], adm-def-pred-hyp(mdt_) iff forall([mdhs_, mdc_], def-pred-hyp(mdt_, mdhs_, mdc_) implies hyps-in(mdhs_, derivable(mdt_)) implies mdc_ in derivable(mdt_)))

- `adm-def-strict-arg` — forall([mdt_], adm-def-strict-arg(mdt_) iff forall([mdhs_, mdc_], def-strict-arg(mdt_, mdhs_, mdc_) implies hyps-in(mdhs_, derivable(mdt_)) implies mdc_ in derivable(mdt_)))

- `adm-def-strict-hyp` — forall([mdt_], adm-def-strict-hyp(mdt_) iff forall([mdhs_, mdc_], def-strict-hyp(mdt_, mdhs_, mdc_) implies hyps-in(mdhs_, derivable(mdt_)) implies mdc_ in derivable(mdt_)))

- `adm-def-strict-in-r` — forall([mdt_], adm-def-strict-in-r(mdt_) iff forall([mdhs_, mdc_], def-strict-in-r(mdt_, mdhs_, mdc_) implies hyps-in(mdhs_, derivable(mdt_)) implies mdc_ in derivable(mdt_)))
- `adm-def-strict-pred` — forall([mdt_], adm-def-strict-pred(mdt_) iff forall([mdhs_, mdc_], def-strict-pred(mdt_, mdhs_, mdc_) implies hyps-in(mdhs_, derivable(mdt_)) implies mdc_ in derivable(mdt_)))
- `adm-def-struct-hyp` — forall([mdt_], adm-def-struct-hyp(mdt_) iff forall([mdhs_, mdc_], def-struct-hyp(mdt_, mdhs_, mdc_) implies hyps-in(mdhs_, derivable(mdt_)) implies mdc_ in derivable(mdt_)))
- `ag-cancel-right-ring-additive-ag` — forall([r], is-ring(r) implies forall([a in carr(r), b in carr(r), c in carr(r)], (add(r))(a, c) = (add(r))(b, c) implies a = b))
- `ag-cancel-right-ring-additive-ag-uba-as-ring` — forall([r], is-unital-banach-algebra(r) implies forall([a in vec(r), b in vec(r), c in vec(r)], (vadd(r))(a, c) = (vadd(r))(b, c) implies a = b))

- `ale` — forall([gnva_, gnvx_, gnvy_], ale(gnva_, gnvx_, gnvy_) iff (vadd(gnva_))(gnvy_, (vneg(gnva_))(gnvx_)) in pos-cone(gnva_))
- `all-confined` — forall([mnbb_], all-confined(mnbb_) iff forsome([mnbqx_, mnbqy_, mnbqd_, mnbqc_], mnbqx_ in expr-set and mnbqy_ in expr-set and mnbqd_ in nn and mnbqc_ in expr-set and [enc-imp(mnbqx_, mnbqy_), mnbqd_] in all-spine(mnbb_) and enc-in(ebvar(mnbqd_), mnbqc_) in conj-reach(mnbqx_)))
- `all-spine-closed` — forall([mnbw_], all-spine-closed(mnbw_) iff forall([mnbce_ in mnbw_, mnbcf_ in cartesian(expr-set, nn)], all-spine-step(mnbce_, mnbcf_) implies mnbcf_ in mnbw_))
- `all-spine-step` — forall([mnbu_, mnbt_], all-spine-step(mnbu_, mnbt_) iff forsome([mnbsc_, mnbsd_], mnbsc_ in expr-set and mnbsd_ in nn and mnbu_ = [enc-all(mnbsc_), mnbsd_] and mnbt_ = [mnbsc_, mnbsd_ + 1]) or forsome([mnbsx_, mnbsy_, mnbse_], mnbsx_ in expr-set and mnbsy_ in expr-set and mnbse_ in nn and mnbu_ = [enc-imp(mnbsx_, mnbsy_), mnbse_] and mnbt_ = [mnbsy_, mnbse_]))
- `app-ar-ok` — forall([mch_, mcn_], app-ar-ok(mch_, mcn_) iff 10 <= mch_ or mch_ <= 1 and mcn_ = 0 or mch_ = 2 and mcn_ = 1 or 3 <= mch_ and mcn_ = 2)
- `apply-tupling-2` — forall([f, a, b], f(a, b) == f([a, b]))
- `apply-tupling-3` — forall([f, a, b, c], f(a, b, c) == f([a, b, c]))
- `associated` — forall([gss_, gsa_, gsb_], associated(gss_, gsa_, gsb_) iff gsa_ in carr(gss_) and gsb_ in carr(gss_) and forsome([gsw_], is-unit(gss_, gsw_) and gsb_ = (mul(gss_))(gsw_, gsa_)))
- `ax-class-ext-def` — ax-class-ext == enc-all(enc-all(enc-imp(enc-all(enc-iff(enc-in(ebvar(0), ebvar(2)), enc-in(ebvar(0), ebvar(1)))), enc-eq(ebvar(1), ebvar(0)))))
- `ax-fun-app-def` — ax-fun-app == enc-all(enc-all(enc-all(enc-imp(enc-in(ebvar(1), enc-fun1(ebvar(2))), enc-iff(enc-eq(enc-apply(ebvar(1), ebvar(0)), enc-apply(ebvar(1), ebvar(0))), enc-in(ebvar(0), ebvar(2)))))))
- `ax-len-nn-def` — ax-len-nn == enc-all(enc-all(enc-imp(enc-in(ebvar(0), enc-tuples(ebvar(1))), enc-in(enc-length(ebvar(0)), enc-nnc))))
- `ax-limit-iff-def` — ax-limit-iff == enc-all(enc-iff(enc-limit(ebvar(0)), enc-and(enc-in(ebvar(0), enc-ordc), enc-and(enc-not(enc-eq(ebvar(0), enc-num(0))), enc-not(enc-ex(enc-and(enc-in(ebvar(0), enc-ordc), enc-eq(ebvar(1), enc-succo(ebvar(0))))))))))
- `ax-mem-set-def` — ax-mem-set == enc-all(enc-all(enc-imp(enc-in(ebvar(1), ebvar(0)), enc-in(ebvar(1), enc-setc))))
- `ax-nn-ind-def` — ax-nn-ind == enc-all(enc-imp(enc-and(enc-in(enc-num(0), ebvar(0)), enc-all(enc-imp(enc-and(enc-in(ebvar(0), enc-nnc), enc-in(ebvar(0), ebvar(1))), enc-in(enc-succ(ebvar(0)), ebvar(1))))), enc-all(enc-imp(enc-in(ebvar(0), enc-nnc), enc-in(ebvar(0), ebvar(1))))))
- `ax-ord-succ-above-def` — ax-ord-succ-above == enc-all(enc-imp(enc-in(ebvar(0), enc-ordc), enc-ordlt(ebvar(0), enc-succo(ebvar(0)))))
- `ax-succ-nn-def` — ax-succ-nn == enc-all(enc-imp(enc-in(ebvar(0), enc-nnc), enc-in(enc-succ(ebvar(0)), enc-nnc)))
- `ax-tfi-def` — ax-tfi == enc-all(enc-imp(enc-all(enc-imp(enc-and(enc-in(ebvar(0), enc-ordc), enc-all(enc-imp(enc-ordlt(ebvar(0), ebvar(1)), enc-in(ebvar(0), ebvar(2))))), enc-in(ebvar(0), ebvar(1)))), enc-all(enc-imp(enc-in(ebvar(0), enc-ordc), enc-in(ebvar(0), ebvar(1))))))
- `ax-zero-nn-def` — ax-zero-nn == enc-in(enc-num(0), enc-nnc)
- `baire-ms-def` — baire-ms == ultra-seq-ms(nn, vnb-lambda(bwk_, nn, 2))
- `banach-alaoglu-separable-metrizable-cnvs-as-nvs` — forall([r], is-complex-normed-vector-space(r) implies is-separable(nvs-metric-space(cnvs-as-nvs(r))) implies is-metrizable-top-space(subspace-top(dual-weak-star-top(cnvs-as-nvs(r)), dual-unit-ball(cnvs-as-nvs(r)))) and is-compact-t(subspace-top(dual-weak-star-top(cnvs-as-nvs(r)), dual-unit-ball(cnvs-as-nvs(r)))))
- `bidual-norm-sublinear-view-cnvs-as-nvs` — forall([r], is-complex-normed-vector-space(r) implies is-sublinear(normed-vector-space-as-module(cnvs-as-nvs(r)), vnrm(r)))
- `bidual-view-scal-cnvs-as-nvs` — forall([r], is-complex-normed-vector-space(r) implies scal(normed-vector-space-as-module(cnvs-as-nvs(r))) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(rr-normed-field))
- `bijection-membership-iff` — forall([x, y, phi], phi in bijection(x, y) iff phi in fun(x, y) and forall([a in x, b in x], phi(a) = phi(b) implies a = b) and forall([w in y], forsome([z in x], phi(z) = w)))
- `binary-divide-def` — forall([a, b], (/)(a, b) == a * recip(b))
- `binary-minus-def` — forall([a, b], a - b == a + -b)
- `bind-sig` — forall([mch_, mcnb_, mcn_], bind-sig(mch_, mcnb_, mcn_) iff 20 <= mch_ and mch_ <= 21 and mcnb_ = 1 and mcn_ = 0 or (mch_ = 22 or mch_ = 24 or mch_ = 26) and mcnb_ = 1 and mcn_ = 1 or (mch_ = 23 or mch_ = 25) and mcnb_ = 1 and mcn_ = 0 or mch_ = 27 and mcnb_ = 0 and mcn_ = 2)
- `binneg-apply` — forall([x], binneg(x) == -x)
- `binplus-apply` — forall([x, y], binplus(x, y) == x + y)
- `bintimes-apply` — forall([x, y], bintimes(x, y) == x * y)
- `border-identity-uba-as-ring` — forall([r], is-unital-banach-algebra(r) implies forall([p in nn], border(uba-as-ring(r), vone(r), identmat(uba-as-ring(r), p), p, p) = identmat(uba-as-ring(r), succ(p))))

- `border-is-diagonal-uba-as-ring` — forall([r], is-unital-banach-algebra(r) implies forall([b, e, p, q], p in nn implies q in nn implies is-diagonal(uba-as-ring(r), p, q, e) implies b in vec(r) implies e in mat(p, q, vec(r)) implies is-diagonal(uba-as-ring(r), succ(p), succ(q), border(uba-as-ring(r), b, e, p, q))))
- `border-is-diagonal-uba-as-ring-uiba-as-uba` — forall([r], is-unital-involutive-banach-algebra(r) implies forall([b, e, p, q], p in nn implies q in nn implies is-diagonal(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), p, q, e) implies b in vec(r) implies e in mat(p, q, vec(r)) implies is-diagonal(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), succ(p), succ(q), border(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), b, e, p, q))))
- `border-mult-uba-as-ring` — forall([r], is-unital-banach-algebra(r) implies forall([p, q, r_70, x, y, b, d], p in nn implies q in nn implies r_70 in nn implies x in mat(p, q, vec(r)) implies y in mat(q, r_70, vec(r)) implies b in vec(r) implies d in vec(r) implies (q = 0 implies p = 0 or r_70 = 0) implies matmul(uba-as-ring(r), border(uba-as-ring(r), b, x, p, q), border(uba-as-ring(r), d, y, q, r_70)) = border(uba-as-ring(r), (vmul(r))(b, d), matmul(uba-as-ring(r), x, y), p, r_70)))
- `border-mult-uba-as-ring-uiba-as-uba` — forall([r], is-unital-involutive-banach-algebra(r) implies forall([p, q, r_70, x, y, b, d], p in nn implies q in nn implies r_70 in nn implies x in mat(p, q, vec(r)) implies y in mat(q, r_70, vec(r)) implies b in vec(r) implies d in vec(r) implies (q = 0 implies p = 0 or r_70 = 0) implies matmul(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), border(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), b, x, p, q), border(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), d, y, q, r_70)) = border(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), (vmul(r))(b, d), matmul(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), x, y), p, r_70)))
- `border-scale-row-uba-as-ring` — forall([r], is-unital-banach-algebra(r) implies forall([p, q, b, sc, e], p in nn implies q in nn implies b in vec(r) implies sc in vec(r) implies e in mat(p, q, vec(r)) implies matmul(uba-as-ring(r), elem-h(uba-as-ring(r), succ(p), sc, 1), border(uba-as-ring(r), b, e, p, q)) = border(uba-as-ring(r), (vmul(r))(sc, b), e, p, q)))
- `border-scale-row-uba-as-ring-uiba-as-uba` — forall([r], is-unital-involutive-banach-algebra(r) implies forall([p, q, b, sc, e], p in nn implies q in nn implies b in vec(r) implies sc in vec(r) implies e in mat(p, q, vec(r)) implies matmul(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), elem-h(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), succ(p), sc, 1), border(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), b, e, p, q)) = border(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), (vmul(r))(sc, b), e, p, q)))
- `border-staircase-uba-as-ring` — forall([r], is-unital-banach-algebra(r) implies forall([b, w, p, q, kp], p in nn implies q in nn implies kp in nn implies b in vec(r) implies not(b = vzero(r)) implies smith-staircase(uba-as-ring(r), p, q, w, kp) implies w in mat(p, q, vec(r)) implies smith-staircase(uba-as-ring(r), succ(p), succ(q), border(uba-as-ring(r), b, w, p, q), succ(kp))))
- `border-staircase-uba-as-ring-uiba-as-uba` — forall([r], is-unital-involutive-banach-algebra(r) implies forall([b, w, p, q, kp], p in nn implies q in nn implies kp in nn implies b in vec(r) implies not(b = vzero(r)) implies smith-staircase(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), p, q, w, kp) implies w in mat(p, q, vec(r)) implies smith-staircase(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), succ(p), succ(q), border(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), b, w, p, q), succ(kp))))
- `bordered-eq-border-uba-as-ring` — forall([r], is-unital-banach-algebra(r) implies forall([p, q, c], p in nn implies q in nn implies c in mat(succ(p), succ(q), vec(r)) implies forall([j in interval(1, succ(q))], not(j = 1) implies entry(c, 1, j) = vzero(r)) implies forall([i in interval(1, succ(p))], not(i = 1) implies entry(c, i, 1) = vzero(r)) implies c = border(uba-as-ring(r), entry(c, 1, 1), submat(c, p, q), p, q)))
- `bordered-eq-border-uba-as-ring-uiba-as-uba` — forall([r], is-unital-involutive-banach-algebra(r) implies forall([p, q, c], p in nn implies q in nn implies c in mat(succ(p), succ(q), vec(r)) implies forall([j in interval(1, succ(q))], not(j = 1) implies entry(c, 1, j) = vzero(r)) implies forall([i in interval(1, succ(p))], not(i = 1) implies entry(c, i, 1) = vzero(r)) implies c = border(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), entry(c, 1, 1), submat(c, p, q), p, q)))
- `bordering-uba-as-ring` — forall([r], is-unital-banach-algebra(r) implies forall([p, q, b, w, g, e], p in nn implies q in nn implies b in vec(r) implies w in mat(p, q, vec(r)) implies g in mat(succ(p), succ(q), vec(r)) implies g = border(uba-as-ring(r), b, w, p, q) implies mat-equiv(uba-as-ring(r), p, q, w, e) implies mat-equiv(uba-as-ring(r), succ(p), succ(q), g, border(uba-as-ring(r), b, e, p, q))))
- `bordering-uba-as-ring-uiba-as-uba` — forall([r], is-unital-involutive-banach-algebra(r) implies forall([p, q, b, w, g, e], p in nn implies q in nn implies b in vec(r) implies w in mat(p, q, vec(r)) implies g in mat(succ(p), succ(q), vec(r)) implies g = border(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), b, w, p, q) implies mat-equiv(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), p, q, w, e) implies mat-equiv(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), succ(p), succ(q), g, border(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), b, e, p, q))))
- `borel-separated` — forall([s, a, b], borel-separated(s, a, b) iff forsome([bsc_ in borel-sets(s)], a subset bsc_ and forall([bsx_ in b], not(bsx_ in bsc_))))
- `bundle-class` — forall([s], s in bundle iff is-bundle(s))
- `c-metric-space-class` — forall([s], s in c-metric-space iff is-c-metric-space(s))
- `cantor-ms-def` — cantor-ms == product-metric(vnb-lambda(ctk_, nn, rm-two-ms))
- `caratheodory-sets-membership` — forall([omega, mu, es_], es_ in caratheodory-sets(omega, mu) iff es_ in power(omega) and is-caratheodory-measurable(omega, mu, es_))
- `cayley-def` — cayley == lft(1, -1i, 1, 1i)
- `cc-coords-def` — cc-coords == vnb-lambda(zv_, cc, [real-part(zv_), imag-part(zv_)])
- `cc-hat-def` — cc-hat == union(cc, singleton(cc-inf))
- `cc-hat-opens-def` — cc-hat-opens == {uh_ in power(cc-hat): uh_ subset cc and is-open(cc-ms, uh_) or forsome([kh_ in power(cc)], kh_ subset cc and is-compact(subspace-ms(cc-ms, kh_)) and uh_ = difference(cc-hat, kh_))}
- `cc-hat-top-def` — cc-hat-top = [cc-hat, cc-hat-opens]
- `cc-hat-top@opens` — opens(cc-hat-top) == cc-hat-opens
- `cc-hat-top@pts` — pts(cc-hat-top) == cc-hat
- `cc-hol-bounded` — forall([u, a], cc-hol-bounded(u, a) iff a subset cc-hol-fns(u) and forall([chn_ in nn], forsome([chm_ in rr], forall([chf_ in a, chz_ in cc-exhaust(u, chn_)], magnitude(chf_(chz_)) <= chm_))))
- `cc-matrices-def` — cc-matrices == {cmq_ in mat(2, 2, rr): forsome([cma_ in rr, cmb_ in rr], cmq_ = cc-matrix-of(cma_, cmb_))}
- `cc-matrix-rep-def` — cc-matrix-rep == vnb-lambda(cmz_, cc, cc-matrix-of(real-part(cmz_), imag-part(cmz_)))
- `cc-ms-def` — cc-ms = [cc, vnb-lambda([x, y], cartesian(cc, cc), magnitude(x - y))]
- `cc-ms@dist` — dist(cc-ms) == vnb-lambda([x, y], cartesian(cc, cc), magnitude(x - y))
- `cc-ms@pts` — pts(cc-ms) == cc
- `cc-nag-def` — cc-nag = [cc, vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(cc, cc), x_ + y_), 0, vnb-lambda(x_, cc, -x_), vnb-lambda(x_, cc, magnitude(x_))]
- `cc-nag@carr` — carr(cc-nag) == cc
- `cc-nag@iden` — iden(cc-nag) == 0
- `cc-nag@inv` — inv(cc-nag) == vnb-lambda(x_, cc, -x_)
- `cc-nag@nrm` — nrm(cc-nag) == vnb-lambda(x_, cc, magnitude(x_))
- `cc-nag@opr` — opr(cc-nag) == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(cc, cc), x_ + y_)
- `cc-normed-field-def` — cc-normed-field = [cc, vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(cc, cc), x_ + y_), vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(cc, cc), x_ * y_), vnb-lambda(x_, cc, -x_), 0, 1, vnb-lambda(x_, cc, magnitude(x_))]
- `cc-normed-field@add` — add(cc-normed-field) == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(cc, cc), x_ + y_)
- `cc-normed-field@carr` — carr(cc-normed-field) == cc
- `cc-normed-field@fnrm` — fnrm(cc-normed-field) == vnb-lambda(x_, cc, magnitude(x_))
- `cc-normed-field@mul` — mul(cc-normed-field) == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(cc, cc), x_ * y_)
- `cc-normed-field@neg` — neg(cc-normed-field) == vnb-lambda(x_, cc, -x_)
- `cc-normed-field@one` — one(cc-normed-field) == 1
- `cc-normed-field@zero` — zero(cc-normed-field) == 0

- `cc-sn-module-def` — cc-sn-module == ring-as-module(normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field))

- `cc-sn-top-def` — cc-sn-top == seminorm-top(cc-sn-module, pair(0, 0), cc-sn-pf)
- `cc2-sphere-def` — cc2-sphere == {hsw_ in cartesian(cc, cc): magnitude(nth(1, hsw_)) * magnitude(nth(1, hsw_)) + magnitude(nth(2, hsw_)) * magnitude(nth(2, hsw_)) = 1}

- `char-converges` — forall([c5k_, c5s_, c5c_], char-converges(c5k_, c5s_, c5c_) iff forall([c5e_], c5e_ subset carr(c5k_) implies is-compact(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(c5k_), c5e_)) implies forall([c5p_], pos-rr(c5p_) implies forsome([c5n_ in nn], forall([c5m_ in nn], c5n_ <= c5m_ implies forall([c5x_ in c5e_], magnitude((c5s_(c5m_))(c5x_) - c5c_(c5x_)) < c5p_))))))
- `char-mat-entry-uba-as-ring` — forall([r], is-unital-banach-algebra(r) implies forall([nv_ in nn, am_ in mat(nv_, nv_, vec(r))], char-mat(uba-as-ring(r), am_, nv_) in mat(nv_, nv_, carr(poly(uba-as-ring(r)))) and forall([i_ in interval(1, nv_), j_ in interval(1, nv_)], entry(char-mat(uba-as-ring(r), am_, nv_), i_, j_) = (add(poly(uba-as-ring(r))))(if(i_ = j_, monomial(uba-as-ring(r), vone(r), 1), zero(poly(uba-as-ring(r)))), (neg(poly(uba-as-ring(r))))(monomial(uba-as-ring(r), entry(am_, i_, j_), 0))))))

- `cips-act-type` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([a_ in cc, x_ in vec(v)], (act(v))(a_, x_) in vec(v)))
- `cips-ip-add-left` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in vec(v), y_ in vec(v), z_ in vec(v)], (ip(v))((vadd(v))(x_, y_), z_) = (ip(v))(x_, z_) + (ip(v))(y_, z_)))
- `cips-ip-conj-sym` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in vec(v), y_ in vec(v)], (ip(v))(y_, x_) = conjugate((ip(v))(x_, y_))))
- `cips-ip-definite` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in vec(v)], (ip(v))(x_, x_) = 0 iff x_ = vzero(v)))
- `cips-ip-homog-left` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([a_ in cc, x_ in vec(v), y_ in vec(v)], (ip(v))((act(v))(a_, x_), y_) = a_ * (ip(v))(x_, y_)))
- `cips-ip-self-nonneg` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in vec(v)], 0 <= (ip(v))(x_, x_)))
- `cips-ip-self-real` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in vec(v)], (ip(v))(x_, x_) in rr))
- `cips-ip-type` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in vec(v), y_ in vec(v)], (ip(v))(x_, y_) in cc))
- `cips-ip-zero-vector` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in vec(v)], (ip(v))(x_, x_) = 0 implies x_ = vzero(v)))
- `cips-scal-carrier` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies carr(scal(v)) = cc)
- `cips-vadd-type` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in vec(v), y_ in vec(v)], (vadd(v))(x_, y_) in vec(v)))
- `cips-vadd-vzero` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x_ in vec(v)], (vadd(v))(vzero(v), x_) = x_))
- `cips-vzero-in` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies vzero(v) in vec(v))
- `classmin-transport-uba-as-ring` — forall([r], is-unital-banach-algebra(r) implies forall([m, n, p, q], p in mat(m, n, vec(r)) implies mat-equiv(uba-as-ring(r), m, n, p, q) implies entry(q, 1, 1) = entry(p, 1, 1) implies forall([c], mat-equiv(uba-as-ring(r), m, n, p, c) implies forall([ii, jj], ii in interval(1, m) implies jj in interval(1, n) implies not(entry(c, ii, jj) = vzero(r)) implies (gauge(uba-as-ring(r)))(entry(p, 1, 1)) <= (gauge(uba-as-ring(r)))(entry(c, ii, jj)))) implies forall([c], mat-equiv(uba-as-ring(r), m, n, q, c) implies forall([ii, jj], ii in interval(1, m) implies jj in interval(1, n) implies not(entry(c, ii, jj) = vzero(r)) implies (gauge(uba-as-ring(r)))(entry(q, 1, 1)) <= (gauge(uba-as-ring(r)))(entry(c, ii, jj))))))
- `classmin-transport-uba-as-ring-uiba-as-uba` — forall([r], is-unital-involutive-banach-algebra(r) implies forall([m, n, p, q], p in mat(m, n, vec(r)) implies mat-equiv(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), m, n, p, q) implies entry(q, 1, 1) = entry(p, 1, 1) implies forall([c], mat-equiv(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), m, n, p, c) implies forall([ii, jj], ii in interval(1, m) implies jj in interval(1, n) implies not(entry(c, ii, jj) = vzero(r)) implies (gauge(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r))))(entry(p, 1, 1)) <= (gauge(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r))))(entry(c, ii, jj)))) implies forall([c], mat-equiv(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), m, n, q, c) implies forall([ii, jj], ii in interval(1, m) implies jj in interval(1, n) implies not(entry(c, ii, jj) = vzero(r)) implies (gauge(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r))))(entry(q, 1, 1)) <= (gauge(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r))))(entry(c, ii, jj))))))
- `clf-def` — clf == {mce_ in expr-set: wf-fml(mce_) and expr-lc(mce_)}
- `closed-intervals-def` — closed-intervals == {oci_ in power(rr): oci_ = empty-set or forsome([oca_ in rr, ocb_ in rr], oca_ <= ocb_ and oci_ = ccint(oca_, ocb_))}
- `clt-def` — clt == {mce_ in expr-set: wf-term(mce_) and expr-lc(mce_)}
- `cluster-point` — forall([s, f, x], cluster-point(s, f, x) iff is-metric-space(s) and f in fun(nn, pts(s)) and x in pts(s) and forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forall([m in nn], forsome([n in nn], m <= n and (dist(s))(f(n), x) < eps))))
- `cnf-c-neg-eq-cnvs-as-module` — forall([r], is-complex-normed-vector-space(r) implies scal(r) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies forall([cna_ in cc], (neg(scal(r)))(cna_) = -cna_))
- `cnf-c-neg-eq-sip-as-module` — forall([r], is-semi-inner-product-space(r) implies scal(r) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies forall([cna_ in cc], (neg(scal(r)))(cna_) = -cna_))
- `cnf-c-neg-eq-sip-as-module-csip-as-sip` — forall([r], is-complex-semi-inner-product-space(r) implies scal(r) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(cc-normed-field) implies forall([cna_ in cc], (neg(scal(r)))(cna_) = -cna_))
- `col-equiv` — forall([r, n, a, b], col-equiv(r, n, a, b) iff forsome([cep_ in elem-gen(r, n)], b = matmul(r, a, cep_)))
- `col-step-row` — forall([r, n, b, i], col-step-row(r, n, b, i) iff forall([csj_ in interval(1, n)], i < csj_ implies entry(b, i, csj_) = zero(r)) and (i in interval(1, n) implies (entry(b, i, i) = zero(r) or entry(b, i, i) = one(r)) and (entry(b, i, i) = one(r) implies forall([csj_ in interval(1, n)], not(csj_ = i) implies entry(b, i, csj_) = zero(r)))))
- `comb-kk-succ` — forall([r, x, y, m in nn], comb-kk(r, x, y, succ(m)) == vnb-lambda(k, zz, (add(r))((mul(r))(x, (comb-kk(r, x, y, m))(k - 1)), (mul(r))(y, (comb-kk(r, x, y, m))(k)))))
- `comb-kk-zero` — forall([r, x, y], comb-kk(r, x, y, 0) == vnb-lambda(k, zz, if(k = 0, one(r), zero(r))))

- `commutative-banach-algebra-class` — forall([s], s in commutative-banach-algebra iff is-commutative-banach-algebra(s))

- `companion-congruence-uba-as-ring` — forall([r], is-unital-banach-algebra(r) implies forall([nv_ in nn, av_], forall([i_ in interval(1, nv_)], av_(i_) in vec(r)) implies forall([bv_], forall([i_ in interval(1, nv_)], bv_(i_) in vec(r)) implies forall([i_ in interval(1, nv_)], av_(i_) = bv_(i_)) implies companion(uba-as-ring(r), av_, nv_) = companion(uba-as-ring(r), bv_, nv_))))
- `companion-congruence-uba-as-ring-uiba-as-uba` — forall([r], is-unital-involutive-banach-algebra(r) implies forall([nv_ in nn, av_], forall([i_ in interval(1, nv_)], av_(i_) in vec(r)) implies forall([bv_], forall([i_ in interval(1, nv_)], bv_(i_) in vec(r)) implies forall([i_ in interval(1, nv_)], av_(i_) = bv_(i_)) implies companion(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), av_, nv_) = companion(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), bv_, nv_))))

- `ell-one-def` — ell-one = {x_ in sqn(cc): series-converges(vnb-lambda(k_, nn, magnitude(x_(k_))))}
- `ell-two-def` — ell-two = {x_ in sqn(cc): series-converges(vnb-lambda(k_, nn, magnitude(x_(k_)) * magnitude(x_(k_))))}
- `empty-in-tuples` — forall([a], [] in tuples(a))
- `enc-ande-succ` — forall([mcl_, mca_, mcn_ in nn], enc-ande(mcl_, mca_, succ(mcn_)) == enc-and(enc-ande(mcl_, mca_, mcn_), enc-in(nth(succ(mcn_), mcl_), mca_)))
- `enc-ande-zero` — forall([mcl_, mca_], enc-ande(mcl_, mca_, 0) == enc-truth)
- `enc-andl-succ` — forall([mcx_, mcl_, mcn_ in nn], enc-andl(mcx_, mcl_, succ(mcn_)) == enc-and(enc-andl(mcx_, mcl_, mcn_), enc-in(mcx_, nth(succ(mcn_), mcl_))))
- `enc-andl-zero` — forall([mcx_, mcl_], enc-andl(mcx_, mcl_, 0) == enc-truth)
- `enc-cartl-succ` — forall([mcx_, mcl_, mcn_ in nn], enc-cartl(mcx_, mcl_, succ(mcn_)) == enc-and(enc-cartl(mcx_, mcl_, mcn_), enc-in(enc-nth(enc-num(succ(mcn_)), mcx_), nth(succ(mcn_), mcl_))))
- `enc-cartl-zero` — forall([mcx_, mcl_], enc-cartl(mcx_, mcl_, 0) == enc-truth)
- `enc-cch-succ` — forall([mix_, mia_, min_, mik_ in nn], enc-cch(mix_, mia_, min_, succ(mik_)) == enc-ex(enc-and(enc-in(ebvar(0), nth(min_ - mik_, mia_)), enc-cch(mix_, mia_, min_, mik_))))
- `enc-cch-zero` — forall([mix_, mia_, min_], enc-cch(mix_, mia_, min_, 0) == enc-eq(mix_, enc-list(idx-list(min_))))
- `enc-eql-succ` — forall([mcl_, mca_, mcn_ in nn], enc-eql(mcl_, mca_, succ(mcn_)) == enc-and(enc-eql(mcl_, mca_, mcn_), enc-eq(nth(succ(mcn_), mcl_), nth(succ(mcn_), mca_))))
- `enc-eql-zero` — forall([mcl_, mca_], enc-eql(mcl_, mca_, 0) == enc-truth)
- `enc-falsity-def` — enc-falsity == eapp(1, [])
- `enc-nnc-def` — enc-nnc == econst(3)
- `enc-ordc-def` — enc-ordc == econst(5)
- `enc-orl-succ` — forall([mcx_, mcl_, mcn_ in nn], enc-orl(mcx_, mcl_, succ(mcn_)) == enc-or(enc-orl(mcx_, mcl_, mcn_), enc-in(mcx_, nth(succ(mcn_), mcl_))))
- `enc-orl-zero` — forall([mcx_, mcl_], enc-orl(mcx_, mcl_, 0) == enc-falsity)
- `enc-setc-def` — enc-setc == econst(1)
- `enc-truth-def` — enc-truth == eapp(0, [])
- `eplus-def` — eplus == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(rr-pos-star, rr-pos-star), if(x_ = pos-inf or y_ = pos-inf, pos-inf, binplus(x_, y_)))
- `equiv-mul-both-uba-as-ring` — forall([r], is-unital-banach-algebra(r) implies forall([m, n, a, u, v], a in mat(m, n, vec(r)) implies is-invertible-mat(uba-as-ring(r), m, u) implies is-invertible-mat(uba-as-ring(r), n, v) implies mat-equiv(uba-as-ring(r), m, n, a, matmul(uba-as-ring(r), matmul(uba-as-ring(r), u, a), v))))
- `equiv-mul-both-uba-as-ring-uiba-as-uba` — forall([r], is-unital-involutive-banach-algebra(r) implies forall([m, n, a, u, v], a in mat(m, n, vec(r)) implies is-invertible-mat(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), m, u) implies is-invertible-mat(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), n, v) implies mat-equiv(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), m, n, a, matmul(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), matmul(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), u, a), v))))
- `eqv-ok` — forall([mrt_, mrx_], eqv-ok(mrt_, mrx_) iff forsome([mrg_, mre_, mrf_], mrx_ = [2, mrg_, mre_, mrf_] and mre_ in clf and mrf_ in clf and [mrg_, enc-iff(mre_, mrf_)] in derivable(mrt_) or mrx_ = [1, mrg_, mre_, mrf_] and mre_ in clt and mrf_ in clt and [mrg_, enc-qeq(mre_, mrf_)] in derivable(mrt_)))
- `etimes-def` — etimes == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(rr-pos-star, rr-pos-star), if(x_ = pos-inf or y_ = pos-inf, if(x_ = 0 or y_ = 0, 0, pos-inf), bintimes(x_, y_)))
- `euclidean-ring-class` — forall([s], s in euclidean-ring iff is-euclidean-ring(s))
- `euler-gamma-def` — euler-gamma == 1 - series-limit(vnb-lambda(egk_, nn, log(succ(succ(egk_))) - log(succ(egk_)) - recip(succ(succ(egk_)))))
- `even` — forall([x], even(x) iff forsome([k in zz], x = 2 * k))
- `even-def` — forall([x], even(x) iff forsome([k in zz], x = 2 * k))
- `ex-confined` — forall([mnbb_], ex-confined(mnbb_) iff forsome([mnbqd_, mnbqc_], mnbqd_ in nn and mnbqc_ in expr-set and [enc-in(ebvar(mnbqd_), mnbqc_), mnbqd_] in ex-spine(mnbb_)))
- `ex-spine-closed` — forall([mnbw_], ex-spine-closed(mnbw_) iff forall([mnbce_ in mnbw_, mnbcf_ in cartesian(expr-set, nn)], ex-spine-step(mnbce_, mnbcf_) implies mnbcf_ in mnbw_))
- `ex-spine-step` — forall([mnbu_, mnbt_], ex-spine-step(mnbu_, mnbt_) iff forsome([mnbsc_, mnbsd_], mnbsc_ in expr-set and mnbsd_ in nn and mnbu_ = [enc-ex(mnbsc_), mnbsd_] and mnbt_ = [mnbsc_, mnbsd_ + 1]) or forsome([mnbsx_, mnbsy_, mnbse_], mnbsx_ in expr-set and mnbsy_ in expr-set and mnbse_ in nn and mnbu_ = [enc-and(mnbsx_, mnbsy_), mnbse_] and (mnbt_ = [mnbsx_, mnbse_] or mnbt_ = [mnbsy_, mnbse_])))

- `good-approx` — forall([hmu_, hmg_, hmr_, hma_, hmb_], good-approx(hmu_, hmg_, hmr_, hma_, hmb_) iff is-path(hmg_, hma_, hmb_) and is-path(hmr_, hma_, hmb_) and trace(hmg_, hma_, hmb_) subset hmu_ and trace(hmr_, hma_, hmb_) subset hmu_ and hmr_(hma_) = hmg_(hma_) and hmr_(hmb_) = hmg_(hmb_) and forsome([hmn_ in nn], 1 <= hmn_ and forsome([hmt_ in fun(nn, rr)], hmt_(0) = hma_ and hmt_(hmn_) = hmb_ and forsome([hmd_ in fun(nn, power(cc))], forall([hmk_ in nn], hmk_ < hmn_ implies hmt_(hmk_) < hmt_(succ(hmk_)) and is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), hmd_(hmk_)) and is-convex-cc(hmd_(hmk_)) and hmd_(hmk_) subset hmu_ and forall([hmw_ in ccint(hmt_(hmk_), hmt_(succ(hmk_)))], hmg_(hmw_) in hmd_(hmk_) and hmr_(hmw_) in hmd_(hmk_)))))))
- `good-sub` — forall([m, s, f, t], good-sub(m, s, f, t) iff forsome([g_], npe(m, s, f, t, g_)))
- `good-sub-in-power-cnvs-as-nvs` — forall([r], is-complex-normed-vector-space(r) implies forall([s, f, t], good-sub(cnvs-as-nvs(r), s, f, t) implies t in power(vec(r))))
- `gpow-succ` — forall([gpg_, gpx_, gpn_ in nn], gpow(gpg_, gpx_, succ(gpn_)) == (opr(gpg_))(gpx_, gpow(gpg_, gpx_, gpn_)))
- `gpow-zero` — forall([gpg_, gpx_], gpow(gpg_, gpx_, 0) == iden(gpg_))
- `group-class` — forall([s], s in group iff is-group(s))
- `group-famprod-succ` — forall([gfam_, gfn_ in nn], group-famprod(gfam_, succ(gfn_)) == group-prod(group-famprod(gfam_, gfn_), gfam_(succ(gfn_))))
- `group-famprod-zero` — forall([gfam_], group-famprod(gfam_, 0) == triv-group)
- `group-famtuple-succ` — forall([xfam_, xfn_ in nn], group-famtuple(xfam_, succ(xfn_)) == [group-famtuple(xfam_, xfn_), xfam_(succ(xfn_))])
- `group-famtuple-zero` — forall([xfam_], group-famtuple(xfam_, 0) == 0)
- `half-sq-iter-succ` — forall([g4a_, g4y_, g4n_ in nn], half-sq-iter(g4a_, g4y_, succ(g4n_)) == (act(g4a_))(num(1/2), (vadd(g4a_))(g4y_, (vmul(g4a_))(half-sq-iter(g4a_, g4y_, g4n_), half-sq-iter(g4a_, g4y_, g4n_)))))
- `half-sq-iter-zero` — forall([g4a_, g4y_], half-sq-iter(g4a_, g4y_, 0) == vzero(g4a_))
- `has-characteristic` — forall([ghc_, gcp_], has-characteristic(ghc_, gcp_) iff is-prime-nat(gcp_) and zz-act(ring-additive-ag(ghc_), gcp_, one(ghc_)) = zero(ghc_))
- `has-closed-graph` — forall([m1, fam1, m2, fam2, tt], has-closed-graph(m1, fam1, m2, fam2, tt) iff is-linear-map(m1, m2, tt) and forall([seq in fun(nn, vec(m1)), p1 in vec(m1), p2 in vec(m2)], fr-conv(m1, fam1, seq, p1) and fr-conv(m2, fam2, vnb-lambda(i, nn, tt(seq(i))), p2) implies p2 = tt(p1)))
- `has-countable-nbhd-base` — forall([cbs_, cbx_], has-countable-nbhd-base(cbs_, cbx_) iff forsome([cbn_ in fun(nn, opens(cbs_))], forall([cbk_ in nn], cbx_ in cbn_(cbk_)) and forall([cbw_ in opens(cbs_)], cbx_ in cbw_ implies forsome([cbk_ in nn], cbn_(cbk_) subset cbw_))))
- `has-deriv-at` — forall([f, a, l], has-deriv-at(f, a, l) iff forsome([ice_], pos-rr(ice_) and is-diff-on(rr-normed-field, ooint(a - ice_, a + ice_), restrict(f, ooint(a - ice_, a + ice_)), a, l)))
- `has-deriv-at-within` — forall([f, w, x, l], has-deriv-at-within(f, w, x, l) iff restrict(f, w) in fun(w, rr) and x in w and l in rr and forsome([osp_ in fun(w, rr)], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(rr-ms, w), rr-ms, osp_, x) and osp_(x) = l and forall([ost_ in w], f(ost_) - f(x) = osp_(ost_) * (ost_ - x))))
- `has-deriv-on-ccint` — forall([hdcg_, hdcd_, hdca_, hdcb_], has-deriv-on-ccint(hdcg_, hdcd_, hdca_, hdcb_) iff hdca_ in rr and hdcb_ in rr and hdca_ < hdcb_ and hdcg_ in fun(ccint(hdca_, hdcb_), rr) and hdcd_ in fun(ccint(hdca_, hdcb_), rr) and forall([hdct_ in ooint(hdca_, hdcb_)], has-deriv-at(hdcg_, hdct_, hdcd_(hdct_))) and has-right-deriv-at(hdcg_, hdca_, hdcd_(hdca_)) and has-left-deriv-at(hdcg_, hdcb_, hdcd_(hdcb_)))
- `has-dir-deriv` — forall([m, f, a, eta, l], has-dir-deriv(m, f, a, eta, l) iff has-deriv-at(seg-curve(m, f, a, eta), 0, l))
- `has-div-remainder` — forall([s, dg], has-div-remainder(s, dg) iff forall([a_ in carr(s), b in carr(s)], not(b = zero(s)) implies forsome([q in carr(s), r in carr(s)], a_ = (add(s))((mul(s))(q, b), r) and (r = zero(s) or succ(dg(r)) <= dg(b)))))
- `has-finite-subcover` — forall([s, c], has-finite-subcover(s, c) iff forsome([tpg_ in set], tpg_ subset c and card(tpg_) in nn and big-union(tpv_, tpg_, tpv_) == pts(s)))
- `has-fip` — forall([s, c], has-fip(s, c) iff is-metric-space(s) and forsome([a0], a0 in c) and forall([a in c], is-closed(s, a)) and forall([f], f subset c implies card(f) in nn implies forsome([a0], a0 in f) implies forsome([p], p in intersection-of(f))))
- `has-inverses` — forall([op, unit, invop, crr], has-inverses(op, unit, invop, crr) iff forall([u in crr], op(invop(u), u) = unit and op(u, invop(u)) = unit))
- `has-left-deriv-at` — forall([f, x, l], has-left-deriv-at(f, x, l) iff forsome([ose_], pos-rr(ose_) and has-deriv-at-within(f, ocint(x - ose_, x), x, l)))
- `has-mean-value-property` — forall([mvu_, mvf_], has-mean-value-property(mvu_, mvf_) iff is-open(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), mvu_) and mvf_ in fun(mvu_, cc) and forall([rgy_ in mvu_], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), mvu_), nf-metric-space(cc-normed-field), mvf_, rgy_)) and forall([mvc_ in cc, mvr_ in rr], 0 < mvr_ implies closure(cc-ms, ball(cc-ms, mvc_, mvr_)) subset mvu_ implies mvf_(mvc_) = recip(2 * pi) * cc-int(vnb-lambda(mvt_, ccint(0, 2 * pi), mvf_(mvc_ + mvr_ * cc-exp(1i * mvt_))), 0, 2 * pi)))
- `has-right-deriv-at` — forall([f, x, l], has-right-deriv-at(f, x, l) iff forsome([ose_], pos-rr(ose_) and has-deriv-at-within(f, coint(x, x + ose_), x, l)))
- `has-zero-of-order` — forall([zou_, zof_, zoa_, zom_], has-zero-of-order(zou_, zof_, zoa_, zom_) iff holomorphic-on(zou_, zof_) and zoa_ in zou_ and zom_ in nn and forsome([zoh_], holomorphic-on(zou_, zoh_) and not(zoh_(zoa_) = 0) and forall([zox_ in zou_], zof_(zox_) = (zox_ - zoa_) ^ zom_ * zoh_(zox_))))
- `hbg-diff-norm-cnvs-as-nvs` — forall([r], is-complex-normed-vector-space(r) implies forall([w_ in vec(r), z_ in vec(r), v_ in vec(r)], (vnrm(r))((vadd(r))(w_, (act(r))(-1, z_))) <= (vnrm(r))((vadd(r))(w_, v_)) + (vnrm(r))((vadd(r))(z_, v_))))

- `hbg-scale-back-cnvs-as-nvs` — forall([r], is-complex-normed-vector-space(r) implies forall([y_ in vec(r), r_ in rr], not(r_ = 0) implies (act(r))(r_, (act(r))(recip(r_), y_)) = y_))

- `inf-subsets-membership` — forall([a, s], s in inf-subsets(a) iff s in set and s subset a and not(card(s) in nn))
- `infiltrated-space-class` — forall([s], s in infiltrated-space iff is-infiltrated-space(s))
- `injection-membership-iff` — forall([x, y, phi], phi in injection(x, y) iff phi in fun(x, y) and forall([a in x, b in x], phi(a) = phi(b) implies a = b))
- `injective-star` — forall([f], injective-star(f) iff forall([u_, v_], f(u_) = f(v_) implies u_ = v_))
- `inst-closed` — forall([md12l_, md12x_], inst-closed(md12l_, md12x_) iff forall([md12p_, md12q_], md12p_ in md12x_ implies md12q_ in set implies inst-step(md12l_, md12p_, md12q_) implies md12q_ in md12x_))
- `inst-step` — forall([md12l_, md12f_, md12g_], inst-step(md12l_, md12f_, md12g_) iff forsome([md12b_, md12i_], md12f_ = enc-all(md12b_) and md12i_ in nn and 2 <= md12i_ and md12i_ <= length(md12l_) and md12g_ = expr-open(md12b_, 0, nth(md12i_, md12l_))))
- `integral-domain-class` — forall([s], s in integral-domain iff is-integral-domain(s))
- `inverse-is-invertible-uba-as-ring` — forall([r], is-unital-banach-algebra(r) implies forall([n, pm, qm], pm in mat(n, n, vec(r)) implies qm in mat(n, n, vec(r)) implies matmul(uba-as-ring(r), pm, qm) = identmat(uba-as-ring(r), n) implies matmul(uba-as-ring(r), qm, pm) = identmat(uba-as-ring(r), n) implies is-invertible-mat(uba-as-ring(r), n, qm)))
- `inverse-is-invertible-uba-as-ring-uiba-as-uba` — forall([r], is-unital-involutive-banach-algebra(r) implies forall([n, pm, qm], pm in mat(n, n, vec(r)) implies qm in mat(n, n, vec(r)) implies matmul(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), pm, qm) = identmat(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), n) implies matmul(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), qm, pm) = identmat(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), n) implies is-invertible-mat(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r)), n, qm)))
- `iota-confined` — forall([mnbb_], iota-confined(mnbb_) iff forsome([mnbqc_ in expr-set], enc-in(ebvar(0), mnbqc_) in conj-reach(mnbb_)))
- `ip-normed-ag-carrier` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies carr(ip-normed-ag(v)) == vec(v))
- `ip-normed-ag-norm-value` — forall([v], is-complex-inner-product-space(v) implies forall([x in vec(v)], (nrm(ip-normed-ag(v)))(x) == ip-norm(v, x)))
- `is-abelian-group` — forall([s], is-abelian-group(s) iff length(s) = 4 and carr(s) in set and opr(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and iden(s) in carr(s) and inv(s) in fun(carr(s), carr(s)) and is-associative(opr(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(opr(s), iden(s), carr(s)) and has-inverses(opr(s), iden(s), inv(s), carr(s)) and is-commutative(opr(s), carr(s)) and s in set)
- `is-abelian-group-is-set-ring-additive-ag` — forall([r], is-ring(r) implies ring-additive-ag(r) in set)
- `is-abelian-group-is-set-ring-additive-ag-uba-as-ring` — forall([r], is-unital-banach-algebra(r) implies ring-additive-ag(uba-as-ring(r)) in set)
- `is-abelian-group-is-set-ring-additive-ag-uba-as-ring-uiba-as-uba` — forall([r], is-unital-involutive-banach-algebra(r) implies ring-additive-ag(uba-as-ring(uiba-as-uba(r))) in set)
- `is-absolutely-continuous` — forall([omega, ca, mu, nu], is-absolutely-continuous(omega, ca, mu, nu) iff forall([ace_ in ca], nu(ace_) = 0 implies mu(ace_) = 0))
- `is-absolutely-summable` — forall([grp, f], is-absolutely-summable(grp, f) iff esum(vnb-lambda(i, dom(f), (nrm(grp))(f(i)))) in rr)
- `is-absorbing-subset` — forall([m, cs], is-absorbing-subset(m, cs) iff cs subset vec(m) and forall([abx_ in vec(m)], forsome([abr_ in rr], 0 < abr_ and forsome([aby_ in cs], abx_ = (act(m))(abr_, aby_)))))
- `is-accumulation-point` — forall([apts_, apta_, aptx_], is-accumulation-point(apts_, apta_, aptx_) iff is-metric-space(apts_) and aptx_ in pts(apts_) and forall([aptr_], pos-rr(aptr_) implies forsome([apty_ in apta_], apty_ in ball(apts_, aptx_, aptr_) and not(apty_ = aptx_))))
- `is-add-character` — forall([chk_, chc_], is-add-character(chk_, chc_) iff chc_ in fun(carr(chk_), unit-circle) and forall([chx_ in carr(chk_), chy_ in carr(chk_)], chc_((add(chk_))(chx_, chy_)) = chc_(chx_) * chc_(chy_)) and is-continuous(nf-metric-space(chk_), cc-ms, chc_))
- `is-add-subgroup` — forall([asgk_, asgu_], is-add-subgroup(asgk_, asgu_) iff forall([asx_ in asgu_], asx_ in carr(asgk_)) and zero(asgk_) in asgu_ and forall([asx_ in asgu_, asy_ in asgu_], (add(asgk_))(asx_, asy_) in asgu_) and forall([asx_ in asgu_], (neg(asgk_))(asx_) in asgu_))
- `is-adversary-node` — forall([sai_, san_], is-adversary-node(sai_, san_) iff nth(2, san_) in adv-ids(sai_))
- `is-adversary-trace` — forall([sasp_, sap_, sas_], is-adversary-trace(sasp_, sap_, sas_) iff is-text-trace(sasp_, sap_, sas_) or is-flush-trace(sasp_, sas_) or is-tee-trace(sasp_, sas_) or is-concat-trace(sasp_, sas_) or is-separate-trace(sasp_, sas_) or is-encrypt-trace(sasp_, sas_) or is-decrypt-trace(sasp_, sas_))
- `is-affine-isometry-group` — forall([aim_, aia_, aig_], is-affine-isometry-group(aim_, aia_, aig_) iff aig_ subset fun(aia_, aia_) and forall([aif_ in aig_, aiu_ in aia_, aiv_ in aia_, ait_ in rr], 0 <= ait_ implies ait_ <= 1 implies aif_((vadd(aim_))((act(aim_))(1 - ait_, aiu_), (act(aim_))(ait_, aiv_))) = (vadd(aim_))((act(aim_))(1 - ait_, aif_(aiu_)), (act(aim_))(ait_, aif_(aiv_)))) and forall([aif_ in aig_, aiu_ in aia_, aiv_ in aia_], (dist(nvs-metric-space(aim_)))(aif_(aiu_), aif_(aiv_)) = (dist(nvs-metric-space(aim_)))(aiu_, aiv_)) and forall([aif_ in aig_], forsome([aih_ in aig_], forall([aix_ in aia_], aif_(aih_(aix_)) = aix_))))
- `is-alg-hom` — forall([baa_, bab_, baf_], is-alg-hom(baa_, bab_, baf_) iff baf_ in fun(vec(baa_), vec(bab_)) and forall([bax_ in vec(baa_), bay_ in vec(baa_)], baf_((vadd(baa_))(bax_, bay_)) = (vadd(bab_))(baf_(bax_), baf_(bay_))) and forall([baz_ in cc, bax_ in vec(baa_)], baf_((act(baa_))(baz_, bax_)) = (act(bab_))(baz_, baf_(bax_))) and forall([bax_ in vec(baa_), bay_ in vec(baa_)], baf_((vmul(baa_))(bax_, bay_)) = (vmul(bab_))(baf_(bax_), baf_(bay_))) and baf_(vone(baa_)) = vone(bab_))
- `is-alg-subspace` — forall([baa_, bai_], is-alg-subspace(baa_, bai_) iff bai_ subset vec(baa_) and vzero(baa_) in bai_ and forall([bax_ in bai_, bay_ in bai_], (vadd(baa_))(bax_, bay_) in bai_) and forall([baz_ in cc, bax_ in bai_], (act(baa_))(baz_, bax_) in bai_))
- `is-algebra-of-sets` — forall([omega, ca], is-algebra-of-sets(omega, ca) iff omega in set and ca subset power(omega) and forsome([a_], a_ in ca) and forall([a_ in ca], complement-in(omega, a_) in ca) and forall([a_ in ca, b_ in ca], union(a_, b_) in ca) and forall([a_ in ca, b_ in ca], intersection(a_, b_) in ca))
- `is-algebraic-of-degree-le` — forall([kk, th, n], is-algebraic-of-degree-le(kk, th, n) iff th in cc and forsome([anan_ in nn], anan_ <= n and forsome([anac_ in fun(nn, kk)], forall([anak_ in nn], succ(anan_) <= anak_ implies anac_(anak_) = 0) and not(anac_(anan_) = 0) and cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(pfj_, nn, anac_(pfj_) * th ^ pfj_), succ(anan_)) = 0)))
- `is-algebraic-over` — forall([aa, r], is-algebraic-over(aa, r) iff r in cc and forsome([anan_ in nn, anac_ in fun(nn, aa)], forall([anak_ in nn], succ(anan_) <= anak_ implies anac_(anak_) = 0) and anac_(anan_) = 1 and cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(pfj_, nn, anac_(pfj_) * r ^ pfj_), succ(anan_)) = 0))
- `is-algebraic-over-field` — forall([kk, th], is-algebraic-over-field(kk, th) iff th in cc and forsome([anan_ in nn, anac_ in fun(nn, kk)], forall([anak_ in nn], succ(anan_) <= anak_ implies anac_(anak_) = 0) and not(anac_(anan_) = 0) and cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(pfj_, nn, anac_(pfj_) * th ^ pfj_), succ(anan_)) = 0))
- `is-amplification` — forall([amv_, ams_, amw_, amf_], is-amplification(amv_, ams_, amw_, amf_) iff is-hilbert-space(amw_) and is-star-rep(amv_, amw_, amf_) and is-intertwined(amv_, amw_, id-rep(amv_), amf_, amv_, ams_) and is-intertwined(amw_, amv_, amf_, id-rep(amv_), amv_, ams_) and is-intertwined(amw_, amw_, amf_, amf_, amv_, ams_))
- `is-analytic-at` — forall([anlf_, anlu_, anla_], is-analytic-at(anlf_, anlu_, anla_) iff is-open(cc-ms, anlu_) and anlf_ in fun(anlu_, cc) and anla_ in anlu_ and forsome([anlcf_ in fun(nn, cc), anlr_ in rr], 0 < anlr_ and anlr_ < cps-radius(anlcf_) and ball(cc-ms, anla_, anlr_) subset anlu_ and forall([anlz_ in ball(cc-ms, anla_, anlr_)], anlf_(anlz_) = cc-series-limit(vnb-lambda(anlk_, nn, anlcf_(anlk_) * (anlz_ - anla_) ^ anlk_)))))
- `is-annihilating-poly` — forall([gan-md_, gan-t_, gan-v_, gan-k_], is-annihilating-poly(gan-md_, gan-t_, gan-v_, gan-k_) iff is-monic(scal(gan-md_), gan-k_) and poly-op(gan-md_, gan-t_, gan-k_, gan-v_) = vzero(gan-md_) and forall([ganq_ in carr(poly(scal(gan-md_)))], not(ganq_ = zero(poly(scal(gan-md_)))) implies poly-op(gan-md_, gan-t_, ganq_, gan-v_) = vzero(gan-md_) implies deg(scal(gan-md_), gan-k_) <= deg(scal(gan-md_), ganq_)))
- `is-antiderivable` — forall([phi, a, b], is-antiderivable(phi, a, b) iff forsome([f_], is-antiderivative(f_, phi, a, b)))
- `is-antiderivative` — forall([f, phi, a, b], is-antiderivative(f, phi, a, b) iff f in fun(rr, rr) and phi in fun(rr, rr) and a in rr and b in rr and a < b and forall([x_ in ccint(a, b)], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, x_)) and forall([th_], th_ in rr and a < th_ and th_ < b implies is-diff-at(f, th_, phi(th_))))
- `is-antisymmetric-op` — forall([v, jo], is-antisymmetric-op(v, jo) iff forall([x_ in vec(v), y_ in vec(v)], (rip(v))(jo(x_), y_) = -(rip(v))(x_, jo(y_))))
- `is-associative` — forall([op, crr], is-associative(op, crr) iff forall([u in crr, v in crr, w in crr], op(op(u, v), w) = op(u, op(v, w))))
- `is-atom` — forall([ca, a], is-atom(ca, a) iff a in ca and not(a = empty-set) and forall([mab_ in ca], mab_ subset a implies not(mab_ = empty-set) implies mab_ = a))
- `is-baire-continuous` — forall([s, f], is-baire-continuous(s, f) iff f in fun(fun(nn, nn), pts(s)) and forall([bcz_ in fun(nn, nn), bce_], pos-rr(bce_) implies forsome([bcn_ in nn], forall([bcw_ in fun(nn, nn)], restrict(bcw_, ord-segment(bcn_)) = restrict(bcz_, ord-segment(bcn_)) implies (dist(s))(f(bcz_), f(bcw_)) <= bce_))))
- `is-bicharacter` — forall([chk_, chw_], is-bicharacter(chk_, chw_) iff chw_ in fun(cartesian(carr(chk_), carr(chk_)), unit-circle) and forall([chy_ in carr(chk_)], is-add-character(chk_, vnb-lambda(chx_, carr(chk_), chw_(chx_, chy_)))) and forall([chy_ in carr(chk_)], is-add-character(chk_, vnb-lambda(chx_, carr(chk_), chw_(chy_, chx_)))))
- `is-bilinear-bicharacter` — forall([chk_, chw_], is-bilinear-bicharacter(chk_, chw_) iff is-bicharacter(chk_, chw_) and forall([cha_ in carr(chk_), chx_ in carr(chk_), chy_ in carr(chk_)], chw_((mul(chk_))(cha_, chx_), chy_) = chw_(chx_, (mul(chk_))(cha_, chy_))))
- `is-bk-sequence` — forall([bss_, bsg_, bsv_], is-bk-sequence(bss_, bsg_, bsv_) iff bsv_ in fun(nn, opens(bss_)) and bsv_(0) = pts(bss_) and forall([bsk_ in nn], iden(bsg_) in bsv_(bsk_) and forall([bsp_ in bsv_(bsk_)], (inv(bsg_))(bsp_) in bsv_(bsk_)) and forall([bsp_ in bsv_(succ(bsk_)), bsq_ in bsv_(succ(bsk_)), bsr_ in bsv_(succ(bsk_))], (opr(bsg_))((opr(bsg_))(bsp_, bsq_), bsr_) in bsv_(bsk_))))
- `is-bounded-l1-functional` — forall([omega, ca, mu, f, cb], is-bounded-l1-functional(omega, ca, mu, f, cb) iff f in fun(l1-set(omega, ca, mu), rr) and cb in rr and 0 <= cb and forall([bfx_ in l1-set(omega, ca, mu), bfy_ in l1-set(omega, ca, mu)], f(vnb-lambda(sx_, omega, bfx_(sx_) + bfy_(sx_))) = f(bfx_) + f(bfy_)) and forall([bfr_ in rr, bfx_ in l1-set(omega, ca, mu)], f(vnb-lambda(sx_, omega, bfr_ * bfx_(sx_))) = bfr_ * f(bfx_)) and forall([bfx_ in l1-set(omega, ca, mu)], abs(f(bfx_)) <= cb * integral(omega, ca, mu, abs-fn(omega, bfx_))))
- `is-bounded-linear-arrow-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-bounded-linear-arrow(a, b, f) iff is-normed-vector-space(a) and is-normed-vector-space(b) and f in fun(vec(a), vec(b)) and scal(a) = scal(b) and forall([x1_ in vec(a), x2_ in vec(a)], f((vadd(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (vadd(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))) and forall([x1_ in carr(scal(a)), x2_ in vec(a)], f((act(a))(x1_, x2_)) = (act(b))(x1_, f(x2_))) and forsome([blk_ in rr], 0 <= blk_ and forall([x1_ in vec(a)], (vnrm(b))(f(x1_)) <= blk_ * (vnrm(a))(x1_))))
- `is-bounded-linear-functional` — forall([m, f], is-bounded-linear-functional(m, f) iff is-linear-functional(m, f) and forsome([c_ in rr], 0 <= c_ and forall([x_ in vec(m)], abs(f(x_)) <= c_ * (vnrm(m))(x_))))
- `is-bounded-linear-functional-on` — forall([m, s, f], is-bounded-linear-functional-on(m, s, f) iff is-linear-functional-on(m, s, f) and forsome([c_ in rr], 0 <= c_ and forall([x_ in s], abs(f(x_)) <= c_ * (vnrm(m))(x_))))
- `is-bounded-metric-space` — forall([s], is-bounded-metric-space(s) iff is-metric-space(s) and forsome([b in rr], forall([x, y], x in pts(s) implies y in pts(s) implies (dist(s))(x, y) <= b)))
- `is-bounded-op` — forall([bov_, bow_, bot_], is-bounded-op(bov_, bow_, bot_) iff is-linear-op(bov_, bow_, bot_) and forsome([bom_ in rr], 0 <= bom_ and forall([box_ in vec(bov_)], ip-norm(bow_, bot_(box_)) <= bom_ * ip-norm(bov_, box_))))
- `is-boundedly-equivalent` — forall([phi, psi], is-boundedly-equivalent(phi, psi) iff phi in fun(nnreal, nnreal) and psi in fun(nnreal, nnreal) and forsome([bel_, beu_], pos-rr(bel_) and pos-rr(beu_) and forall([ber_ in rr], 0 < ber_ implies bel_ * phi(ber_) <= psi(ber_) and psi(ber_) <= beu_ * phi(ber_))))
- `is-bundle` — forall([s], is-bundle(s) iff length(s) = 3 and is-strand-space(bspace(s)) and bnodes(s) in set and bsend(s) in power(cartesian(bnodes(s), bnodes(s))) and forall([ssx_ in bnodes(s)], ssx_ in nodes(bspace(s))) and card(bnodes(s)) in nn and forall([ssx_, ssy_], [ssx_, ssy_] in bsend(s) implies sends-to(bspace(s), ssx_, ssy_)) and forall([ssy_ in bnodes(s)], is-received(bspace(s), ssy_) implies forsome([ssx_], [ssx_, ssy_] in bsend(s) and forall([ssz_], [ssz_, ssy_] in bsend(s) implies ssz_ = ssx_))) and forall([ssy_ in bnodes(s), ssx_], same-strand-before(bspace(s), ssx_, ssy_) implies ssx_ in bnodes(s)) and forall([ssx_], not([ssx_, ssx_] in prec-strict(bspace(s), bnodes(s), bsend(s)))) and s in set)
- `is-c-continuous-arrow-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-c-continuous-arrow(a, b, f) iff is-c-metric-space(a) and is-c-metric-space(b) and f in fun(pts(a), pts(b)) and is-continuous(c-metric(a), c-metric(b), f))
- `is-c-metric-space` — forall([s], is-c-metric-space(s) iff length(s) = 2 and pts(s) in set and dists(s) in fun(nn, fun(cartesian(pts(s), pts(s)), rr)) and forall([k_ in nn], is-pseudometric((dists(s))(k_), pts(s))) and forall([u in pts(s), v in pts(s)], forall([k_ in nn], ((dists(s))(k_))(u, v) = 0) implies u = v) and s in set)
- `is-caratheodory-measurable` — forall([omega, mu, es], is-caratheodory-measurable(omega, mu, es) iff es subset omega and forall([a_ in power(omega)], mu(a_) = eplus(mu(intersection(a_, es)), mu(difference(a_, es)))))
- `is-cauchy-net` — forall([m, t, d, x], is-cauchy-net(m, t, d, x) iff is-directed-set(d) and x in fun(pts(d), vec(m)) and forall([cnu_ in opens(t)], vzero(m) in cnu_ implies forsome([cni_ in pts(d)], forall([cnj_ in pts(d)], [cni_, cnj_] in dleq(d) implies forall([cnk_ in pts(d)], [cni_, cnk_] in dleq(d) implies (vadd(m))(x(cnj_), (vneg(m))(x(cnk_))) in cnu_)))))
- `is-cauchy-seq` — forall([s, f], is-cauchy-seq(s, f) iff is-metric-space(s) and f in fun(nn, pts(s)) and forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([n in nn], forall([m in nn, n_ in nn], n <= m and n <= n_ implies (dist(s))(f(m), f(n_)) <= eps))))
- `is-cc-diff-at` — forall([g, a, l], is-cc-diff-at(g, a, l) iff g in fun(rr, cc) and a in rr and l in cc and is-diff-at(vnb-lambda(sv_, rr, real-part(g(sv_))), a, real-part(l)) and is-diff-at(vnb-lambda(sv_, rr, imag-part(g(sv_))), a, imag-part(l)))
- `is-cc-linear-functional` — forall([v, f], is-cc-linear-functional(v, f) iff f in fun(vec(v), cc) and forall([hlx_ in vec(v), hly_ in vec(v)], f((vadd(v))(hlx_, hly_)) = f(hlx_) + f(hly_)) and forall([hlc_ in cc, hlx_ in vec(v)], f((act(v))(hlc_, hlx_)) = hlc_ * f(hlx_)))
- `is-cc-linear-on` — forall([baa_, baf_], is-cc-linear-on(baa_, baf_) iff baf_ in fun(vec(baa_), cc) and forall([bax_ in vec(baa_), bay_ in vec(baa_)], baf_((vadd(baa_))(bax_, bay_)) = baf_(bax_) + baf_(bay_)) and forall([baz_ in cc, bax_ in vec(baa_)], baf_((act(baa_))(baz_, bax_)) = baz_ * baf_(bax_)))
- `is-cc-module-over` — forall([aa, vv], is-cc-module-over(aa, vv) iff vv subset cc and 0 in vv and forall([amx_ in vv, amy_ in vv], amx_ + amy_ in vv) and forall([amx_ in vv], -amx_ in vv) and forall([ama_ in aa, amx_ in vv], ama_ * amx_ in vv))
- `is-cc-space-dim-le` — forall([kk, vv, n], is-cc-space-dim-le(kk, vv, n) iff is-cc-module-over(kk, vv) and forsome([amn_ in nn], amn_ <= n and forsome([amg_ in fun(interval(1, amn_), vv)], forall([amv_ in vv], forsome([amb_ in fun(interval(1, amn_), kk)], amv_ = cc-lincomb(amn_, amb_, amg_))))))
- `is-cc-subring` — forall([kk], is-cc-subring(kk) iff kk subset cc and 0 in kk and 1 in kk and forall([psu_ in kk, psv_ in kk], psu_ + psv_ in kk) and forall([psu_ in kk, psv_ in kk], psu_ * psv_ in kk))
