- `is-convex-rr` — forall([cvra_], is-convex-rr(cvra_) iff cvra_ subset rr and forall([cvrx_ in cvra_, cvry_ in cvra_, cvrt_ in ccint(0, 1)], cvrx_ + cvrt_ * (cvry_ - cvrx_) in cvra_))
- `is-convex-subset` — forall([v, cs], is-convex-subset(v, cs) iff cs subset vec(v) and forall([sxa_ in cs, sxb_ in cs, sxt_ in rr], 0 <= sxt_ implies sxt_ <= 1 implies (vadd(v))((act(v))(1 - sxt_, sxa_), (act(v))(sxt_, sxb_)) in cs))
- `is-countable` — forall([rpc_], is-countable(rpc_) iff rpc_ in set and (rpc_ = empty-set or forsome([rpen_ in fun(nn, rpc_)], forall([rpy_ in rpc_], forsome([rpn_ in nn], rpy_ = rpen_(rpn_))))))
- `is-countable-pseudometric-family` — forall([fam, ground], is-countable-pseudometric-family(fam, ground) iff forall([n_ in nn], is-pseudometric-space(fam(n_)) and pts(fam(n_)) == ground))
- `is-countably-separated` — forall([ys, cb], is-countably-separated(ys, cb) iff is-sigma-algebra(ys, cb) and forsome([csf_ in fun(nn, cb)], forall([csx_ in ys, csy_ in ys], not(csx_ = csy_) implies forsome([csk_ in nn], csx_ in csf_(csk_) and not(csy_ in csf_(csk_)) or csy_ in csf_(csk_) and not(csx_ in csf_(csk_))))))
- `is-cyclic-for` — forall([vnv_, vns_, vnx_], is-cyclic-for(vnv_, vns_, vnx_) iff vnx_ in vec(vnv_) and forall([vny_ in vec(vnv_), vne_], pos-rr(vne_) implies forsome([vna_ in vns_], ip-norm(vnv_, (vadd(vnv_))(vny_, (vneg(vnv_))(vna_(vnx_)))) < vne_)))
- `is-cyclic-vector` — forall([gcv-md_, gcv-t_, gcv-v_], is-cyclic-vector(gcv-md_, gcv-t_, gcv-v_) iff gcv-v_ in vec(gcv-md_) and forall([gcvw_ in vec(gcv-md_)], forsome([gcvq_ in carr(poly(scal(gcv-md_)))], gcvw_ = poly-op(gcv-md_, gcv-t_, gcvq_, gcv-v_))))
- `is-cyclic-vector-rep` — forall([g4a_, g4v_, g4p_, g4e_], is-cyclic-vector-rep(g4a_, g4v_, g4p_, g4e_) iff g4e_ in vec(g4v_) and closure(ip-metric-space(g4v_), rep-orbit(g4a_, g4v_, g4p_, g4e_)) = vec(g4v_))
- `is-decrypt-trace` — forall([sasp_, sas_], is-decrypt-trace(sasp_, sas_) iff forsome([sak_ in keys(sasp_), sag_ in msg-set(tokens(sasp_), keys(sasp_))], sas_ = [[received, (kinv(sasp_))(sak_)], [received, encr(sag_, sak_)], [sent, sag_]]))
- `is-degree-function` — forall([gfs_, gfn_], is-degree-function(gfs_, gfn_) iff is-integral-domain(gfs_) and gfn_ in fun(carr(gfs_), nn) and forall([gfa_ in carr(gfs_), gfb_ in carr(gfs_)], not(gfa_ = zero(gfs_)) implies not(gfb_ = zero(gfs_)) implies gfn_(gfa_) <= gfn_((mul(gfs_))(gfa_, gfb_))) and forall([gfa_ in carr(gfs_), gfb_ in carr(gfs_)], not(gfa_ = zero(gfs_)) implies forsome([gfq_ in carr(gfs_)], gfb_ = (mul(gfs_))(gfa_, gfq_) or gfn_((add(gfs_))(gfb_, (neg(gfs_))((mul(gfs_))(gfa_, gfq_)))) < gfn_(gfa_))))
- `is-dense` — forall([dns_, dna_], is-dense(dns_, dna_) iff is-metric-space(dns_) and dna_ subset pts(dns_) and pts(dns_) subset closure(dns_, dna_))
- `is-dense-seq` — forall([s, dseq], is-dense-seq(s, dseq) iff is-metric-space(s) and dseq in fun(nn, pts(s)) and forall([x in pts(s), eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([m in nn], (dist(s))(x, dseq(m)) < eps)))
- `is-diagonal` — forall([a, m, n, d], is-diagonal(a, m, n, d) iff forall([i, j], i in interval(1, m) implies j in interval(1, n) implies not(i = j) implies entry(d, i, j) = zero(a)))
- `is-diff-at` — forall([f, a, l], is-diff-at(f, a, l) iff f in fun(rr, rr) and a in rr and l in rr and forsome([phi in fun(rr, rr)], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, phi, a) and phi(a) = l and forall([x in rr], f(x) - f(a) = phi(x) * (x - a))))
- `is-diff-at-v` — forall([m, f, a, l], is-diff-at-v(m, f, a, l) iff is-normed-vector-space(m) and f in fun(rr, vec(m)) and a in rr and l in vec(m) and forsome([phi in fun(rr, vec(m))], is-continuous-at(rr-ms, nvs-metric-space(m), phi, a) and phi(a) = l and forall([x_ in rr], (vadd(m))(f(x_), (vneg(m))(f(a))) = (act(m))(x_ - a, phi(x_)))))
- `is-diff-on` — forall([k, u, f, a, l], is-diff-on(k, u, f, a, l) iff is-normed-field(k) and is-open(nf-metric-space(k), u) and f in fun(u, carr(k)) and a in u and l in carr(k) and forsome([phi in fun(u, carr(k))], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(nf-metric-space(k), u), nf-metric-space(k), phi, a) and phi(a) = l and forall([x in u], (add(k))(f(x), (neg(k))(f(a))) = (mul(k))(phi(x), (add(k))(x, (neg(k))(a))))))
- `is-dir-diff-at` — forall([m, f, a, eta, dl], is-dir-diff-at(m, f, a, eta, dl) iff is-diff-at(seg-curve(m, f, a, eta), 0, dl))
- `is-directed-set` — forall([s], is-directed-set(s) iff length(s) = 2 and pts(s) in set and dleq(s) in power(cartesian(pts(s), pts(s))) and forsome([dsn_], dsn_ in pts(s)) and forall([dsa_ in pts(s)], [dsa_, dsa_] in dleq(s)) and forall([dsa_ in pts(s), dsb_ in pts(s), dsc_ in pts(s)], [dsa_, dsb_] in dleq(s) implies [dsb_, dsc_] in dleq(s) implies [dsa_, dsc_] in dleq(s)) and forall([dsa_ in pts(s), dsb_ in pts(s)], forsome([dsc_ in pts(s)], [dsa_, dsc_] in dleq(s) and [dsb_, dsc_] in dleq(s))) and s in set)
- `is-discrete-ms` — forall([dms_], is-discrete-ms(dms_) iff forall([dmx_ in pts(dms_)], forsome([dmr_], pos-rr(dmr_) and forall([dmy_ in ball(dms_, dmx_, dmr_)], dmy_ = dmx_))))
- `is-distributive` — forall([addop, mulop, crr], is-distributive(addop, mulop, crr) iff forall([u in crr, v in crr, w in crr], mulop(u, addop(v, w)) = addop(mulop(u, v), mulop(u, w)) and mulop(addop(u, v), w) = addop(mulop(u, w), mulop(v, w))))
- `is-doubling` — forall([mhf_], is-doubling(mhf_) iff mhf_ in fun(nnreal, nnreal) and mhf_(0) = 0 and forall([mhr_ in nnreal, mhq_ in nnreal], mhr_ <= mhq_ implies mhf_(mhr_) <= mhf_(mhq_)) and forsome([mhp_], pos-rr(mhp_) and forall([mhr_ in rr], 0 < mhr_ implies mhf_(2 * mhr_) <= mhp_ * mhf_(mhr_))))
- `is-dualizing-character` — forall([c5k_, c5c_], is-dualizing-character(c5k_, c5c_) iff is-nontrivial-character(c5k_, c5c_) and forall([c5t_], is-add-character(c5k_, c5t_) implies forsome([c5a_ in carr(c5k_)], c5t_ = duality-map(c5k_, c5c_, c5a_))))
- `is-dynkin-system` — forall([omega, dd], is-dynkin-system(omega, dd) iff omega in set and dd subset power(omega) and omega in dd and forall([dya_ in dd, dyb_ in dd], dya_ subset dyb_ implies complement-in(dyb_, dya_) in dd) and forall([dyf_ in fun(nn, dd)], forall([dyn_ in nn], dyf_(dyn_) subset dyf_(succ(dyn_))) implies big-union(dyk_, nn, dyf_(dyk_)) in dd))
- `is-e-bicharacter` — forall([c6vk_, c6vm_, c6vw_], is-e-bicharacter(c6vk_, c6vm_, c6vw_) iff c6vw_ in fun(cartesian(vec(c6vm_), vec(c6vm_)), unit-circle) and forall([c6vx_ in vec(c6vm_), c6vy_ in vec(c6vm_), c6vz_ in vec(c6vm_)], c6vw_((vadd(c6vm_))(c6vx_, c6vy_), c6vz_) = c6vw_(c6vx_, c6vz_) * c6vw_(c6vy_, c6vz_) and c6vw_(c6vz_, (vadd(c6vm_))(c6vx_, c6vy_)) = c6vw_(c6vz_, c6vx_) * c6vw_(c6vz_, c6vy_)) and forall([c6vx_ in vec(c6vm_), c6vy_ in vec(c6vm_)], is-add-character(c6vk_, vnb-lambda(c6va_, carr(c6vk_), c6vw_((act(c6vm_))(c6va_, c6vx_), c6vy_))) and is-add-character(c6vk_, vnb-lambda(c6va_, carr(c6vk_), c6vw_(c6vy_, (act(c6vm_))(c6va_, c6vx_))))))
- `is-e-bilinear-bicharacter` — forall([c6vk_, c6vm_, c6vw_], is-e-bilinear-bicharacter(c6vk_, c6vm_, c6vw_) iff is-e-bicharacter(c6vk_, c6vm_, c6vw_) and forall([c6va_ in carr(c6vk_), c6vx_ in vec(c6vm_), c6vy_ in vec(c6vm_)], c6vw_((act(c6vm_))(c6va_, c6vx_), c6vy_) = c6vw_(c6vx_, (act(c6vm_))(c6va_, c6vy_))))
- `is-e-character` — forall([c6vk_, c6vm_, c6vc_], is-e-character(c6vk_, c6vm_, c6vc_) iff c6vc_ in fun(vec(c6vm_), unit-circle) and forall([c6vx_ in vec(c6vm_), c6vy_ in vec(c6vm_)], c6vc_((vadd(c6vm_))(c6vx_, c6vy_)) = c6vc_(c6vx_) * c6vc_(c6vy_)) and forall([c6vx_ in vec(c6vm_)], is-add-character(c6vk_, vnb-lambda(c6va_, carr(c6vk_), c6vc_((act(c6vm_))(c6va_, c6vx_))))))
- `is-e-unipolar` — forall([c6vk_, c6vm_, c6vn_, c6vw_], is-e-unipolar(c6vk_, c6vm_, c6vn_, c6vw_) iff is-norm-on(c6vk_, c6vm_, c6vn_) and is-e-bilinear-bicharacter(c6vk_, c6vm_, c6vw_) and e-polar(c6vm_, c6vw_, norm-ball(c6vm_, c6vn_, 1)) = norm-ball(c6vm_, c6vn_, 1))
- `is-eigenvalue` — forall([kqv_, kqt_, kqc_], is-eigenvalue(kqv_, kqt_, kqc_) iff kqc_ in cc and forsome([kqx_ in eigenspace(kqv_, kqt_, kqc_)], not(kqx_ = vzero(kqv_))))
- `is-element-order` — forall([g, x, d], is-element-order(g, x, d) iff d in nn and 1 <= d and gpow(g, x, d) = iden(g) and forall([eod_ in nn], 1 <= eod_ implies gpow(g, x, eod_) = iden(g) implies d <= eod_))
- `is-elementary` — forall([r, n, e], is-elementary(r, n, e) iff forsome([elk_, ell_], elk_ in interval(1, n) and ell_ in interval(1, n) and not(elk_ = ell_) and e = elem-f(r, n, elk_, ell_)) or forsome([elr_, elk_, ell_], elr_ in carr(r) and elk_ in interval(1, n) and ell_ in interval(1, n) and not(elk_ = ell_) and e = elem-g(r, n, elr_, elk_, ell_)) or forsome([elr_, elk_], elr_ in carr(r) and forsome([els_ in carr(r)], (mul(r))(elr_, els_) = one(r) and (mul(r))(els_, elr_) = one(r)) and elk_ in interval(1, n) and e = elem-h(r, n, elr_, elk_)))
- `is-encrypt-trace` — forall([sasp_, sas_], is-encrypt-trace(sasp_, sas_) iff forsome([sak_ in keys(sasp_), sag_ in msg-set(tokens(sasp_), keys(sasp_))], sas_ = [[received, sak_], [received, sag_], [sent, encr(sag_, sak_)]]))
- `is-entry-point` — forall([ssp_, ssn_, ssi_], is-entry-point(ssp_, ssn_, ssi_) iff ssn_ in nodes(ssp_) and is-sent(ssp_, ssn_) and node-content(ssp_, ssn_) in ssi_ and forall([ssm_], same-strand-before(ssp_, ssm_, ssn_) implies not(node-content(ssp_, ssm_) in ssi_)))
- `is-eps-cauchy-seq` — forall([s, eps, y], is-eps-cauchy-seq(s, eps, y) iff is-metric-space(s) and y in fun(nn, pts(s)) and forall([m in nn, n_ in nn], (dist(s))(y(m), y(n_)) <= eps))
- `is-equicontinuous` — forall([s, t, fam], is-equicontinuous(s, t, fam) iff is-metric-space(s) and is-metric-space(t) and fam in fun(nn, fun(pts(s), pts(t))) and forall([x in pts(s), eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([del], pos-rr(del) and forall([k in nn, y in pts(s)], (dist(s))(x, y) < del implies (dist(t))((fam(k))(x), (fam(k))(y)) < eps))))
- `is-equicontinuous-set` — forall([eqss_, eqst_, eqse_], is-equicontinuous-set(eqss_, eqst_, eqse_) iff is-metric-space(eqss_) and is-metric-space(eqst_) and eqse_ subset fun(pts(eqss_), pts(eqst_)) and forall([eqsx_ in pts(eqss_), eqsp_], pos-rr(eqsp_) implies forsome([eqsd_], pos-rr(eqsd_) and forall([eqsf_ in eqse_, eqsy_ in pts(eqss_)], (dist(eqss_))(eqsx_, eqsy_) < eqsd_ implies (dist(eqst_))(eqsf_(eqsx_), eqsf_(eqsy_)) < eqsp_))))
- `is-equicontinuous-t` — forall([t, ee], is-equicontinuous-t(t, ee) iff ee subset fun(pts(t), rr) and forall([eqx_ in pts(t), eqe_], pos-rr(eqe_) implies forsome([eqv_ in opens(t)], eqx_ in eqv_ and forall([eqf_ in ee, eqy_ in eqv_], abs(eqf_(eqx_) - eqf_(eqy_)) < eqe_))))
- `is-equivalence` — forall([rho, crr], is-equivalence(rho, crr) iff rho in power(cartesian(crr, crr)) and forall([u in crr], [u, u] in rho) and forall([u in crr, v in crr], [u, v] in rho implies [v, u] in rho) and forall([u in crr, v in crr, w in crr], [u, v] in rho and [v, w] in rho implies [u, w] in rho))
- `is-ess-self-adjoint-graph` — forall([ubv_, ubg_], is-ess-self-adjoint-graph(ubv_, ubg_) iff is-self-adjoint-graph(ubv_, graph-closure(ubv_, ubg_)))
- `is-essential-singularity` — forall([mrf_, mra_], is-essential-singularity(mrf_, mra_) iff mra_ in cc and not(is-removable-singularity(mrf_, mra_)) and not(forsome([mrn_], is-pole(mrf_, mra_, mrn_))))
- `is-euclidean-domain` — forall([ges_], is-euclidean-domain(ges_) iff is-integral-domain(ges_) and forsome([gen_], is-degree-function(ges_, gen_)))
- `is-euclidean-ring-def` — forall([s], is-euclidean-ring(s) iff is-integral-domain(s) and forsome([dg in fun(carr(s), nn)], forall([a in carr(s), b in carr(s)], not(b = zero(s)) implies forsome([q in carr(s), r in carr(s)], a = (add(s))((mul(s))(q, b), r) and (r = zero(s) or succ(dg(r)) <= dg(b))))))
- `is-eventually-in` — forall([d, x, u], is-eventually-in(d, x, u) iff forsome([evi_ in pts(d)], forall([evj_ in pts(d)], [evi_, evj_] in dleq(d) implies x(evj_) in u)))
- `is-extremal-subset` — forall([v, b, a], is-extremal-subset(v, b, a) iff is-convex-subset(v, b) and forsome([exz_], exz_ in b) and b subset a and forall([exx_, exy_, ext_], exx_ in a implies exy_ in a implies ext_ in rr implies 0 < ext_ implies ext_ < 1 implies (vadd(v))((act(v))(ext_, exx_), (act(v))(1 - ext_, exy_)) in b implies exx_ in b and exy_ in b))
- `is-extreme-point` — forall([epm_, epk_, epx_], is-extreme-point(epm_, epk_, epx_) iff epx_ in epk_ and forall([epu_ in epk_, epv_ in epk_, ept_ in rr], 0 < ept_ implies ept_ < 1 implies epx_ = (vadd(epm_))((act(epm_))(1 - ept_, epu_), (act(epm_))(ept_, epv_)) implies epu_ = epx_ and epv_ = epx_))
- `is-extreme-state` — forall([g4ha_, g4hp_], is-extreme-state(g4ha_, g4hp_) iff g4hp_ in states(g4ha_) and forall([g4hg_ in states(g4ha_), g4hh_ in states(g4ha_), g4hr_ in rr], 0 < g4hr_ implies g4hr_ < 1 implies forall([g4hy_ in vec(g4ha_)], g4hp_(g4hy_) = g4hr_ * g4hg_(g4hy_) + (1 - g4hr_) * g4hh_(g4hy_)) implies forall([g4hz_ in vec(g4ha_)], g4hg_(g4hz_) = g4hp_(g4hz_) and g4hh_(g4hz_) = g4hp_(g4hz_))))
- `is-faithful-bicharacter` — forall([c5k_, c5w_], is-faithful-bicharacter(c5k_, c5w_) iff is-bicharacter(c5k_, c5w_) and forall([c5c_], is-add-character(c5k_, c5c_) implies forsome([c5x_ in carr(c5k_)], c5c_ = vnb-lambda(c5h_, carr(c5k_), c5w_(c5h_, c5x_)) and forall([c5y_ in carr(c5k_)], c5c_ = vnb-lambda(c5h_, carr(c5k_), c5w_(c5h_, c5y_)) implies c5y_ = c5x_)) and forsome([c5x_ in carr(c5k_)], c5c_ = vnb-lambda(c5h_, carr(c5k_), c5w_(c5x_, c5h_)) and forall([c5y_ in carr(c5k_)], c5c_ = vnb-lambda(c5h_, carr(c5k_), c5w_(c5y_, c5h_)) implies c5y_ = c5x_))) and forall([c5x_ in carr(c5k_)], not(c5x_ = zero(c5k_)) implies forsome([c5c_], is-add-character(c5k_, c5c_) and not(c5c_(c5x_) = 1))))
- `is-fg-cc-module-over` — forall([aa, vv], is-fg-cc-module-over(aa, vv) iff is-cc-module-over(aa, vv) and forsome([amn_ in nn, amg_ in fun(interval(1, amn_), vv)], forall([amv_ in vv], forsome([amb_ in fun(interval(1, amn_), aa)], amv_ = cc-lincomb(amn_, amb_, amg_)))))
- `is-field` — forall([s], is-field(s) iff length(s) = 8 and carr(s) in set and add(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and mul(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and neg(s) in fun(carr(s), carr(s)) and zero(s) in carr(s) and one(s) in carr(s) and non-zero(s) in set and non-zero(s) = difference(carr(s), singleton(zero(s))) and mul-inv(s) in fun(non-zero(s), non-zero(s)) and is-associative(add(s), carr(s)) and is-commutative(add(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(add(s), zero(s), carr(s)) and has-inverses(add(s), zero(s), neg(s), carr(s)) and is-associative(mul(s), carr(s)) and is-commutative(mul(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(mul(s), one(s), carr(s)) and is-distributive(add(s), mul(s), carr(s)) and not(zero(s) = one(s)) and forall([a_ in non-zero(s)], (mul(s))(a_, (mul-inv(s))(a_)) = one(s)) and s in set)
- `is-field-ring-def` — forall([s], is-field-ring(s) iff is-commutative-ring(s) and not(one(s) = zero(s)) and forall([a_ in carr(s)], not(a_ = zero(s)) implies forsome([b_ in carr(s)], (mul(s))(a_, b_) = one(s))))
- `is-fin-ext` — forall([x4k_, x4f_, x4md_, x4n_, x4u_], is-fin-ext(x4k_, x4f_, x4md_, x4n_, x4u_) iff is-normed-field(x4k_) and is-field-ring(x4f_) and is-module(x4md_) and scal(x4md_) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(x4k_) and vec(x4md_) = carr(x4f_) and vadd(x4md_) = add(x4f_) and vzero(x4md_) = zero(x4f_) and vneg(x4md_) = neg(x4f_) and forall([x4r_ in carr(x4k_), x4x_ in carr(x4f_), x4y_ in carr(x4f_)], (mul(x4f_))(x4x_, (act(x4md_))(x4r_, x4y_)) = (act(x4md_))(x4r_, (mul(x4f_))(x4x_, x4y_))) and x4n_ in nn and 1 <= x4n_ and x4u_ in mat(x4n_, 1, carr(x4f_)) and generates(x4md_, x4n_, x4u_) and rel-free(x4md_, x4n_, x4u_))
- `is-finite-cover` — forall([c, a], is-finite-cover(c, a) iff c in set and card(c) in nn and a subset big-union(u, c, u))
- `is-finite-dimensional` — forall([m], is-finite-dimensional(m) iff is-vector-space(m) and is-noetherian(m))
- `is-finite-measure` — forall([omega, ca, mu], is-finite-measure(omega, ca, mu) iff is-measure(omega, ca, mu) and mu(omega) in rr)
- `is-finite-rank-op` — forall([kqv_, kqw_, kqt_], is-finite-rank-op(kqv_, kqw_, kqt_) iff kqt_ in bounded-ops(kqv_, kqw_) and forsome([kqi_ in set], card(kqi_) in nn and forsome([kqa_ in fun(kqi_, vec(kqv_)), kqb_ in fun(kqi_, vec(kqw_))], forall([kqx_ in vec(kqv_)], kqt_(kqx_) = finsum(normed-ag-as-abelian-group(ip-normed-ag(kqw_)), vnb-lambda(kqk_, kqi_, (act(kqw_))((ip(kqv_))(kqx_, kqa_(kqk_)), kqb_(kqk_))), kqi_)))))
- `is-flat-regular` — forall([frp_], is-flat-regular(frp_) iff is-pk-space(frp_) and forall([frn_ in nodes(ispace(pk-inf(frp_)))], is-regular-node(pk-inf(frp_), frn_) implies forsome([frk_ in keys(ispace(pk-inf(frp_)))], forsome([frx_ in {frd_ in tokens(ispace(pk-inf(frp_))): not(frd_ in keys(ispace(pk-inf(frp_))))}], node-content(ispace(pk-inf(frp_)), frn_) = encr(frx_, frk_)) or forsome([frl_ in tuples({frd_ in tokens(ispace(pk-inf(frp_))): not(frd_ in keys(ispace(pk-inf(frp_))))})], node-content(ispace(pk-inf(frp_)), frn_) = encr(lst(frl_), frk_)))))
- `is-flush-trace` — forall([sasp_, sas_], is-flush-trace(sasp_, sas_) iff forsome([sag_ in msg-set(tokens(sasp_), keys(sasp_))], sas_ = [[received, sag_]]))
- `is-fr-bounded` — forall([m, fam, aa], is-fr-bounded(m, fam, aa) iff aa subset vec(m) and forall([k in nn], forsome([bd in rr], forall([y in aa], (fam(k))(y) <= bd))))
- `is-fr-equicont` — forall([m1, fam1, m2, fam2, ix, tf], is-fr-equicont(m1, fam1, m2, fam2, ix, tf) iff tf in fun(ix, fun(vec(m1), vec(m2))) and forall([k in nn], forsome([nb in nn, ck], pos-rr(ck) and forall([i in ix, x in vec(m1), r in rr], forall([j in nn], j <= nb implies (fam1(j))(x) <= r) implies (fam2(k))((tf(i))(x)) <= ck * r))))
- `is-fractions-of` — forall([cwk_, cwa_], is-fractions-of(cwk_, cwa_) iff forall([cwx_ in carr(cwk_)], forsome([cwu_ in cwa_, cwv_ in cwa_], not(cwv_ = zero(cwk_)) and (mul(cwk_))(cwx_, cwv_) = cwu_)))
- `is-frechet-structure` — forall([fld, m, fam], is-frechet-structure(fld, m, fam) iff is-seminorm-family(fld, m, fam) and forall([seq in fun(nn, vec(m))], fr-cauchy(m, fam, seq) implies forsome([lim in vec(m)], fr-conv(m, fam, seq, lim))))
- `is-fubini-set` — forall([xs, ca, mu, ys, cb, nu, cs], is-fubini-set(xs, ca, mu, ys, cb, nu, cs) iff is-measurable-fn(xs, ca, x-section-measure(xs, ys, nu, cs)) and is-measurable-fn(ys, cb, y-section-measure(xs, ys, mu, cs)) and integral(xs, ca, mu, x-section-measure(xs, ys, nu, cs)) = integral(ys, cb, nu, y-section-measure(xs, ys, mu, cs)))
- `is-functional-graph` — forall([ubv_, ubg_], is-functional-graph(ubv_, ubg_) iff forall([ubx_ in vec(ubv_), uby_ in vec(ubv_), ubz_ in vec(ubv_)], [ubx_, uby_] in ubg_ implies [ubx_, ubz_] in ubg_ implies uby_ = ubz_))
- `is-gauge-countable` — forall([s], is-gauge-countable(s) iff is-top-space(s) and forsome([fam], is-countable-pseudometric-family(fam, pts(s)) and pseudo-gauge-top(fam, pts(s)) == s))
- `is-gcd-set` — forall([ggs_, ggt_, ggd_], is-gcd-set(ggs_, ggt_, ggd_) iff ggd_ in carr(ggs_) and forall([ggx_ in ggt_], divides(ggs_, ggd_, ggx_)) and forall([gge_ in carr(ggs_)], forall([ggx_ in ggt_], divides(ggs_, gge_, ggx_)) implies divides(ggs_, gge_, ggd_)))
- `is-generator` — forall([g, x], is-generator(g, x) iff x in carr(g) and forall([geny_ in carr(g)], forsome([genk_ in zz], geny_ = group-zpow(g, x, genk_))))
- `is-group` — forall([s], is-group(s) iff length(s) = 4 and carr(s) in set and opr(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and iden(s) in carr(s) and inv(s) in fun(carr(s), carr(s)) and is-associative(opr(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(opr(s), iden(s), carr(s)) and has-inverses(opr(s), iden(s), inv(s), carr(s)) and s in set)
- `is-group-metric` — forall([mgm_, mgg_], is-group-metric(mgm_, mgg_) iff is-metric-space(mgm_) and is-group(mgg_) and pts(mgm_) = carr(mgg_) and forall([mgu_ in carr(mgg_), mgv_ in carr(mgg_), mge_], pos-rr(mge_) implies forsome([mgd_], pos-rr(mgd_) and forall([mgp_ in carr(mgg_), mgq_ in carr(mgg_)], (dist(mgm_))(mgu_, mgp_) <= mgd_ implies (dist(mgm_))(mgv_, mgq_) <= mgd_ implies (dist(mgm_))((opr(mgg_))(mgu_, mgv_), (opr(mgg_))(mgp_, mgq_)) <= mge_))) and is-continuous(mgm_, mgm_, inv(mgg_)))
- `is-group-norm` — forall([nm, op, invop, unit, crr], is-group-norm(nm, op, invop, unit, crr) iff nm in fun(crr, rr) and forall([u in crr], 0 <= nm(u) and (nm(u) = 0 iff u = unit) and nm(invop(u)) = nm(u) and forall([v in crr], nm(op(u, v)) <= nm(u) + nm(v))))
- `is-group-segment` — forall([gss_, gsg_, gsa_, gsp_], is-group-segment(gss_, gsg_, gsa_, gsp_) iff pos-rr(gsa_) and gsp_ in fun(ccint(0, gsa_), carr(gsg_)) and forall([gsr_ in ccint(0, gsa_), gsu_ in ccint(0, gsa_)], gsr_ + gsu_ <= gsa_ implies gsp_(gsr_ + gsu_) = (opr(gsg_))(gsp_(gsr_), gsp_(gsu_))) and forall([gst_ in ccint(0, gsa_), gsw_ in opens(gss_)], gsp_(gst_) in gsw_ implies forsome([gsd_], pos-rr(gsd_) and forall([gsv_ in ccint(0, gsa_)], abs(gsv_ - gst_) < gsd_ implies gsp_(gsv_) in gsw_))))
- `is-group-topology` — forall([tgs_, tgg_], is-group-topology(tgs_, tgg_) iff is-top-space(tgs_) and is-group(tgg_) and pts(tgs_) = carr(tgg_) and forall([tga_ in carr(tgg_), tgb_ in carr(tgg_), tgw_ in opens(tgs_)], (opr(tgg_))(tga_, (inv(tgg_))(tgb_)) in tgw_ implies forsome([tgu_ in opens(tgs_)], tga_ in tgu_ and forsome([tgv_ in opens(tgs_)], tgb_ in tgv_ and forall([tgp_ in tgu_, tgq_ in tgv_], (opr(tgg_))(tgp_, (inv(tgg_))(tgq_)) in tgw_)))))
- `is-haar-integral` — forall([hig_, hiu_], is-haar-integral(hig_, hiu_) iff is-metric-group(hig_) and is-compact(metric-group-ms(hig_)) and is-positive-functional(metric-group-ms(hig_), hiu_) and hiu_(vnb-lambda(hix_, pts(metric-group-ms(hig_)), 1)) = 1 and forall([hia_ in pts(metric-group-ms(hig_)), hif_ in cont-fns(metric-group-ms(hig_))], hiu_(vnb-lambda(hix_, pts(metric-group-ms(hig_)), hif_((opr(hig_))(hia_, hix_)))) = hiu_(hif_)))
- `is-hausdorff` — forall([s], is-hausdorff(s) iff is-top-space(s) and forall([a, b], a in pts(s) implies b in pts(s) implies not(a == b) implies forsome([u, v], u in opens(s) and v in opens(s) and a in u and b in v and intersection(u, v) == empty-set)))
- `is-hausdorff-dim` — forall([mhm_, mhs_, mhl_], is-hausdorff-dim(mhm_, mhs_, mhl_) iff mhl_ in rr and 0 <= mhl_ and forall([mhr_ in rr], mhl_ < mhr_ implies (hausdorff(mhm_, mhr_))(mhs_) = 0) and forall([mhr_ in rr], 0 < mhr_ implies mhr_ < mhl_ implies (hausdorff(mhm_, mhr_))(mhs_) = pos-inf))
- `is-hereditary` — forall([ca, cb], is-hereditary(ca, cb) iff cb subset ca and forall([hde_ in cb, hdf_ in ca], hdf_ subset hde_ implies hdf_ in cb))
- `is-hermitian-form` — forall([ipfm_, ipff_], is-hermitian-form(ipfm_, ipff_) iff ipff_ in fun(cartesian(vec(ipfm_), vec(ipfm_)), cc) and forall([ipfx_ in vec(ipfm_), ipfy_ in vec(ipfm_), ipfz_ in vec(ipfm_)], ipff_((vadd(ipfm_))(ipfx_, ipfy_), ipfz_) = ipff_(ipfx_, ipfz_) + ipff_(ipfy_, ipfz_)) and forall([ipfa_ in cc, ipfx_ in vec(ipfm_), ipfy_ in vec(ipfm_)], ipff_((act(ipfm_))(ipfa_, ipfx_), ipfy_) = ipfa_ * ipff_(ipfx_, ipfy_)) and forall([ipfx_ in vec(ipfm_), ipfy_ in vec(ipfm_)], ipff_(ipfy_, ipfx_) = conjugate(ipff_(ipfx_, ipfy_))))
- `is-hilbert-schmidt` — forall([kqv_, kqw_, kqt_], is-hilbert-schmidt(kqv_, kqw_, kqt_) iff kqt_ in bounded-ops(kqv_, kqw_) and forsome([kqi_ in set, kqe_ in fun(kqi_, vec(kqv_))], is-orthonormal-basis(kqv_, kqi_, kqe_) and hs-sum(kqv_, kqw_, kqi_, kqe_, kqt_) in rr))

- `is-hom-metric-space-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-hom-metric-space(a, b, f) iff is-metric-space(a) and is-metric-space(b) and f in fun(pts(a), pts(b)) and forall([x1_ in pts(a), x2_ in pts(a)], (dist(a))(x1_, x2_) = (dist(b))(f(x1_), f(x2_))))

- `is-k-bilinear-form` — forall([c6vk_, c6vm_, c6vl_], is-k-bilinear-form(c6vk_, c6vm_, c6vl_) iff c6vl_ in fun(cartesian(vec(c6vm_), vec(c6vm_)), carr(c6vk_)) and forall([c6vx_ in vec(c6vm_), c6vy_ in vec(c6vm_), c6vz_ in vec(c6vm_)], c6vl_((vadd(c6vm_))(c6vx_, c6vy_), c6vz_) = (add(c6vk_))(c6vl_(c6vx_, c6vz_), c6vl_(c6vy_, c6vz_)) and c6vl_(c6vz_, (vadd(c6vm_))(c6vx_, c6vy_)) = (add(c6vk_))(c6vl_(c6vz_, c6vx_), c6vl_(c6vz_, c6vy_))) and forall([c6va_ in carr(c6vk_), c6vx_ in vec(c6vm_), c6vy_ in vec(c6vm_)], c6vl_((act(c6vm_))(c6va_, c6vx_), c6vy_) = (mul(c6vk_))(c6va_, c6vl_(c6vx_, c6vy_)) and c6vl_(c6vx_, (act(c6vm_))(c6va_, c6vy_)) = (mul(c6vk_))(c6va_, c6vl_(c6vx_, c6vy_))))
- `is-k-linear` — forall([m, f], is-k-linear(m, f) iff is-module(m) and f in fun(vec(m), carr(scal(m))) and forall([x in vec(m), y in vec(m)], f((vadd(m))(x, y)) = (add(scal(m)))(f(x), f(y))) and forall([lam in carr(scal(m)), x in vec(m)], f((act(m))(lam, x)) = (mul(scal(m)))(lam, f(x))))
- `is-k-linear-on` — forall([m, s, f], is-k-linear-on(m, s, f) iff is-module(m) and is-submodule(m, s) and f in fun(s, carr(scal(m))) and forall([x in s, y in s], f((vadd(m))(x, y)) = (add(scal(m)))(f(x), f(y))) and forall([lam in carr(scal(m)), x in s], f((act(m))(lam, x)) = (mul(scal(m)))(lam, f(x))))
- `is-k-vector-space` — forall([c6vk_, c6vm_], is-k-vector-space(c6vk_, c6vm_) iff is-module(c6vm_) and scal(c6vm_) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(c6vk_))
- `is-key-ideal` — forall([sbit_, sbik_, sbiks_, sbii_], is-key-ideal(sbit_, sbik_, sbiks_, sbii_) iff forall([sbix_ in sbii_], sbix_ in msg-set(sbit_, sbik_)) and forall([sbil_, sbij_], sbil_ in tuples(msg-set(sbit_, sbik_)) implies sbij_ in nn implies 1 <= sbij_ implies sbij_ <= length(sbil_) implies nth(sbij_, sbil_) in sbii_ implies lst(sbil_) in sbii_) and forall([sbih_, sbiy_], sbih_ in sbii_ implies sbiy_ in sbiks_ implies encr(sbih_, sbiy_) in sbii_))
- `is-laurent` — forall([lrk_, lrf_], is-laurent(lrk_, lrf_) iff lrf_ in fun(zz, carr(lrk_)) and forsome([lrb_ in zz], forall([lrj_ in zz], lrj_ < lrb_ implies lrf_(lrj_) = zero(lrk_))))
- `is-left-ideal` — forall([baa_, bai_], is-left-ideal(baa_, bai_) iff is-alg-subspace(baa_, bai_) and forall([bay_ in vec(baa_), bax_ in bai_], (vmul(baa_))(bay_, bax_) in bai_))
- `is-left-invariant` — forall([lim_, lig_], is-left-invariant(lim_, lig_) iff forall([lia_ in carr(lig_), lix_ in carr(lig_), liy_ in carr(lig_)], (dist(lim_))((opr(lig_))(lia_, lix_), (opr(lig_))(lia_, liy_)) = (dist(lim_))(lix_, liy_)))
- `is-left-limit` — forall([f, x, l], is-left-limit(f, x, l) iff f in fun(rr, rr) and x in rr and l in rr and forall([eps_], pos-rr(eps_) implies forsome([delta_], pos-rr(delta_) and forall([t_], t_ in rr and x - delta_ <= t_ and t_ < x implies abs(f(t_) - l) <= eps_))))
- `is-left-limit-within` — forall([rpf_, rpw_, rpx_, rpl_], is-left-limit-within(rpf_, rpw_, rpx_, rpl_) iff rpw_ subset rr and rpf_ in fun(rpw_, rr) and rpx_ in rr and rpl_ in rr and forall([rple_], pos-rr(rple_) implies forsome([rpld_], pos-rr(rpld_) and forall([rplt_ in rpw_], rpx_ - rpld_ < rplt_ implies rplt_ < rpx_ implies abs(rpf_(rplt_) - rpl_) < rple_))))
- `is-limit-along` — forall([lmas_, lmat_, lmaa_, lmaf_, lmax_, lmay_], is-limit-along(lmas_, lmat_, lmaa_, lmaf_, lmax_, lmay_) iff is-metric-space(lmas_) and is-metric-space(lmat_) and lmay_ in pts(lmat_) and forall([lmae_], pos-rr(lmae_) implies forsome([lmad_], pos-rr(lmad_) and forall([lmaz_ in lmaa_], (dist(lmas_))(lmax_, lmaz_) <= lmad_ implies (dist(lmat_))(lmaf_(lmaz_), lmay_) <= lmae_))))
- `is-linear-functional` — forall([m, f], is-linear-functional(m, f) iff f in fun(vec(m), rr) and forall([x_ in vec(m), y_ in vec(m)], f((vadd(m))(x_, y_)) = f(x_) + f(y_)) and forall([r_ in rr, x_ in vec(m)], f((act(m))(r_, x_)) = r_ * f(x_)))
- `is-linear-functional-on` — forall([m, s, f], is-linear-functional-on(m, s, f) iff f in fun(s, rr) and forall([x_ in s, y_ in s], f((vadd(m))(x_, y_)) = f(x_) + f(y_)) and forall([r_ in rr, x_ in s], f((act(m))(r_, x_)) = r_ * f(x_)))
- `is-linear-graph` — forall([ubv_, ubg_], is-linear-graph(ubv_, ubg_) iff is-submodule(hsum(ubv_, ubv_), ubg_))
- `is-linear-map` — forall([m1, m2, tt], is-linear-map(m1, m2, tt) iff is-module(m1) and is-module(m2) and scal(m1) = scal(m2) and tt in fun(vec(m1), vec(m2)) and forall([x in vec(m1), y in vec(m1)], tt((vadd(m1))(x, y)) = (vadd(m2))(tt(x), tt(y))) and forall([lam in carr(scal(m1)), x in vec(m1)], tt((act(m1))(lam, x)) = (act(m2))(lam, tt(x))))
- `is-linear-op` — forall([bov_, bow_, bot_], is-linear-op(bov_, bow_, bot_) iff bot_ in fun(vec(bov_), vec(bow_)) and forall([box_ in vec(bov_), boy_ in vec(bov_)], bot_((vadd(bov_))(box_, boy_)) = (vadd(bow_))(bot_(box_), bot_(boy_))) and forall([boc_ in cc, box_ in vec(bov_)], bot_((act(bov_))(boc_, box_)) = (act(bow_))(boc_, bot_(box_))))
- `is-lipschitz-arrow-def` — forall([a, b, f], is-lipschitz-arrow(a, b, f) iff is-metric-space(a) and is-metric-space(b) and f in fun(pts(a), pts(b)) and forsome([lpk_ in rr], 0 <= lpk_ and forall([lpx_ in pts(a), lpy_ in pts(a)], (dist(b))(f(lpx_), f(lpy_)) <= lpk_ * (dist(a))(lpx_, lpy_))))
- `is-local-hom` — forall([lhs1_, lhg1_, lhs2_, lhg2_, lhv_, lhf_], is-local-hom(lhs1_, lhg1_, lhs2_, lhg2_, lhv_, lhf_) iff lhv_ in opens(lhs1_) and iden(lhg1_) in lhv_ and lhf_ in fun(lhv_, carr(lhg2_)) and forall([lhx_ in lhv_, lho_ in opens(lhs2_)], lhf_(lhx_) in lho_ implies forsome([lhu_ in opens(lhs1_)], lhx_ in lhu_ and forall([lhy_ in lhu_], lhy_ in lhv_ implies lhf_(lhy_) in lho_))) and forsome([lhw_ in opens(lhs1_)], iden(lhg1_) in lhw_ and forall([lhx_ in lhw_], (inv(lhg1_))(lhx_) in lhw_) and forall([lhx_ in lhw_, lhy_ in lhw_], (opr(lhg1_))(lhx_, lhy_) in lhv_ and lhf_((opr(lhg1_))(lhx_, lhy_)) = (opr(lhg2_))(lhf_(lhx_), lhf_(lhy_)))))
- `is-local-max-at` — forall([f, d, lmt_], is-local-max-at(f, d, lmt_) iff f in fun(d, rr) and lmt_ in d and forsome([lma_], pos-rr(lma_) and forall([lmx_ in d], abs(lmx_ - lmt_) <= lma_ implies f(lmx_) <= f(lmt_))))
- `is-local-measure` — forall([omega, ca, cb, rho], is-local-measure(omega, ca, cb, rho) iff is-sigma-algebra(omega, ca) and is-hereditary(ca, cb) and rho in fun(cb, rr-pos-star) and forall([lme_ in cb], is-measure(lme_, restrict-sigma(ca, lme_), restrict(rho, restrict-sigma(ca, lme_)))))
- `is-local-min-at` — forall([f, d, lmt_], is-local-min-at(f, d, lmt_) iff f in fun(d, rr) and lmt_ in d and forsome([lma_], pos-rr(lma_) and forall([lmx_ in d], abs(lmx_ - lmt_) <= lma_ implies f(lmt_) <= f(lmx_))))
- `is-local-nv-field` — forall([lck_], is-local-nv-field(lck_) iff is-nv-field(lck_) and not(is-discrete-ms(nf-metric-space(lck_))) and is-locally-compact(nf-metric-space(lck_)))
- `is-local-uniformizer` — forall([c5k_, c5u_], is-local-uniformizer(c5k_, c5u_) iff is-compact-nv-domain(c5k_, nv-integers(c5k_)) and c5u_ in nv-integers(c5k_) and nv-maximal(c5k_, nv-integers(c5k_)) = nv-principal(c5k_, nv-integers(c5k_), c5u_) and not(c5u_ = zero(c5k_)))
- `is-locally-compact` — forall([lcs_], is-locally-compact(lcs_) iff is-metric-space(lcs_) and forall([lca_ in pts(lcs_)], forsome([lcr_], pos-rr(lcr_) and is-compact(subspace-ms(lcs_, closed-ball(lcs_, lca_, lcr_))))))
- `is-locally-constant-fn` — forall([c5k_, c5f_], is-locally-constant-fn(c5k_, c5f_) iff forall([c5x_ in carr(c5k_)], forsome([c5r_], pos-rr(c5r_) and forall([c5y_ in carr(c5k_)], (fnrm(c5k_))((add(c5k_))(c5y_, (neg(c5k_))(c5x_))) <= c5r_ implies c5f_(c5y_) = c5f_(c5x_)))))
- `is-locally-convex-tvs` — forall([m, t], is-locally-convex-tvs(m, t) iff is-tvs(rr-normed-field, m, t) and forall([lcx_ in vec(m), lcu_ in opens(t)], lcx_ in lcu_ implies forsome([lcv_ in opens(t)], lcx_ in lcv_ and lcv_ subset lcu_ and is-convex-subset(m, lcv_))))
- `is-locally-null` — forall([ca, cb, rho, es], is-locally-null(ca, cb, rho, es) iff es in ca and forall([lna_ in cb], rho(intersection(lna_, es)) = 0))
- `is-lower-triangular` — forall([a, n, d], is-lower-triangular(a, n, d) iff forall([ltu_, ltv_], ltu_ in interval(1, n) implies ltv_ in interval(1, n) implies ltu_ < ltv_ implies entry(d, ltu_, ltv_) = zero(a)))
- `is-lusin` — forall([s, e], is-lusin(s, e) iff forsome([lzt_], is-complete(lzt_) and is-separable(lzt_) and forsome([lzh_], is-continuous(lzt_, subspace-ms(s, e), lzh_) and image(lzh_, pts(lzt_)) = e and forall([lzx_ in pts(lzt_), lzy_ in pts(lzt_)], lzh_(lzx_) = lzh_(lzy_) implies lzx_ = lzy_))))
- `is-mat-bound` — forall([k, m, n, a, c], is-mat-bound(k, m, n, a, c) iff a in mat(m, n, carr(k)) and forall([cbvi_ in interval(1, m), cbvj_ in interval(1, n)], (fnrm(k))(entry(a, cbvi_, cbvj_)) <= c))
- `is-mat-close` — forall([k, m, n, a, b, e], is-mat-close(k, m, n, a, b, e) iff a in mat(m, n, carr(k)) and b in mat(m, n, carr(k)) and forall([cdvi_ in interval(1, m), cdvj_ in interval(1, n)], (fnrm(k))((add(k))(entry(a, cdvi_, cdvj_), (neg(k))(entry(b, cdvi_, cdvj_)))) <= e))
- `is-matrix-of` — forall([gmx-md_, gmx-n_, gmx-u_, gmx-t_, gmx-a_], is-matrix-of(gmx-md_, gmx-n_, gmx-u_, gmx-t_, gmx-a_) iff gmx-a_ in mat(gmx-n_, gmx-n_, carr(scal(gmx-md_))) and forall([gmxj_ in interval(1, gmx-n_)], gmx-t_(entry(gmx-u_, gmxj_, 1)) = lincomb(gmx-md_, gmx-n_, col-as-row(gmx-a_, gmx-n_, gmxj_), gmx-u_)))
- `is-maximal` — forall([grd, porel, mx], is-maximal(grd, porel, mx) iff mx in grd and forall([y in grd], [mx, y] in porel implies [y, mx] in porel))
- `is-maximal-ideal` — forall([baa_, bai_], is-maximal-ideal(baa_, bai_) iff is-two-sided-ideal(baa_, bai_) and not(bai_ = vec(baa_)) and forall([baj_], is-two-sided-ideal(baa_, baj_) implies bai_ subset baj_ implies not(baj_ = vec(baa_)) implies baj_ = bai_))
- `is-maximal-left-ideal` — forall([baa_, bai_], is-maximal-left-ideal(baa_, bai_) iff is-left-ideal(baa_, bai_) and not(bai_ = vec(baa_)) and forall([baj_], is-left-ideal(baa_, baj_) implies bai_ subset baj_ implies not(baj_ = vec(baa_)) implies baj_ = bai_))
- `is-maximal-right-ideal` — forall([baa_, bai_], is-maximal-right-ideal(baa_, bai_) iff is-right-ideal(baa_, bai_) and not(bai_ = vec(baa_)) and forall([baj_], is-right-ideal(baa_, baj_) implies bai_ subset baj_ implies not(baj_ = vec(baa_)) implies baj_ = bai_))
- `is-meager` — forall([s, a], is-meager(s, a) iff is-metric-space(s) and a subset pts(s) and forsome([ee in fun(nn, power(pts(s)))], forall([n in nn], is-nowhere-dense(s, ee(n))) and a subset big-union(n, nn, ee(n))))
- `is-measurable-fn` — forall([omega, ca, f], is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, f) iff is-sigma-algebra(omega, ca) and f in fun(omega, rr-pos-star) and forall([alpha_ in rr], {x_ in omega: alpha_ < f(x_)} in ca))
- `is-measurable-map` — forall([omega, ca, omega2, cb, f], is-measurable-map(omega, ca, omega2, cb, f) iff is-sigma-algebra(omega, ca) and is-sigma-algebra(omega2, cb) and f in fun(omega, omega2) and forall([b_ in cb], {x_ in omega: f(x_) in b_} in ca))
- `is-measurable-space` — forall([s], is-measurable-space(s) iff length(s) = 2 and pts(s) in set and sigma(s) in power(power(pts(s))) and is-sigma-algebra(pts(s), sigma(s)) and s in set)
- `is-measurable-step-fn` — forall([omega, ca, s], is-measurable-step-fn(omega, ca, s) iff is-real-measurable-fn(omega, ca, s) and card(image(s, omega)) in nn)
- `is-measure` — forall([omega, ca, mu], is-measure(omega, ca, mu) iff is-sigma-algebra(omega, ca) and mu in fun(ca, rr-pos-star) and mu(empty-set) = 0 and forall([f_ in fun(nn, ca)], forall([i_, j_], i_ in nn implies j_ in nn implies not(i_ = j_) implies intersection(f_(i_), f_(j_)) = empty-set) implies mu(big-union(n_, nn, f_(n_))) = esum(vnb-lambda(n_, nn, mu(f_(n_))))))
- `is-measure-isomorphism` — forall([omega, ca, mu, omega2, cb, nu, tt], is-measure-isomorphism(omega, ca, mu, omega2, cb, nu, tt) iff is-measurable-map(omega, ca, omega2, cb, tt) and forall([mib_ in cb], nu(mib_) = mu({mix_ in omega: tt(mix_) in mib_})) and forsome([mis_], is-measurable-map(omega2, cb, omega, ca, mis_) and forall([mix_ in omega], mis_(tt(mix_)) = mix_) and forall([miy_ in omega2], tt(mis_(miy_)) = miy_)))
- `is-measure-space` — forall([s], is-measure-space(s) iff length(s) = 3 and pts(s) in set and sigma(s) in power(power(pts(s))) and meas(s) in fun(sigma(s), rr-pos-star) and is-measure(pts(s), sigma(s), meas(s)) and s in set)
- `is-meromorphic-at` — forall([mrf_, mra_], is-meromorphic-at(mrf_, mra_) iff mra_ in cc and forsome([mrn_ in nn, mrr_ in rr], 0 < mrr_ and forsome([mrg_], holomorphic-on(ball(cc-ms, mra_, mrr_), mrg_) and forall([mrz_ in difference(ball(cc-ms, mra_, mrr_), singleton(mra_))], mrf_(mrz_) = recip(mrz_ - mra_) ^ mrn_ * mrg_(mrz_)))))
- `is-metric` — forall([dst, crr], is-metric(dst, crr) iff forall([u in crr], dst(u, u) = 0 and forall([v in crr], 0 <= dst(u, v) and (dst(u, v) = 0 implies u = v) and dst(u, v) = dst(v, u) and forall([w in crr], dst(u, w) <= dst(u, v) + dst(v, w)))))
- `is-metric-group` — forall([s], is-metric-group(s) iff length(s) = 5 and carr(s) in set and opr(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and iden(s) in carr(s) and inv(s) in fun(carr(s), carr(s)) and gdist(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), rr) and is-associative(opr(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(opr(s), iden(s), carr(s)) and has-inverses(opr(s), iden(s), inv(s), carr(s)) and is-metric(gdist(s), carr(s)) and forall([mgu_ in carr(s), mgv_ in carr(s), mge_], pos-rr(mge_) implies forsome([mgd_], pos-rr(mgd_) and forall([mgp_ in carr(s), mgq_ in carr(s)], (gdist(s))(mgu_, mgp_) <= mgd_ implies (gdist(s))(mgv_, mgq_) <= mgd_ implies (gdist(s))((opr(s))(mgu_, mgv_), (opr(s))(mgp_, mgq_)) <= mge_))) and forall([mga_ in carr(s), mge_], pos-rr(mge_) implies forsome([mgd_], pos-rr(mgd_) and forall([mgb_ in carr(s)], (gdist(s))(mga_, mgb_) <= mgd_ implies (gdist(s))((inv(s))(mga_), (inv(s))(mgb_)) <= mge_))) and s in set)
- `is-metric-outer-measure` — forall([m, mu], is-metric-outer-measure(m, mu) iff is-metric-space(m) and is-outer-measure(pts(m), mu) and forall([moa_ in power(pts(m)), mob_ in power(pts(m))], not(set-dist(m, moa_, mob_) = 0) implies mu(union(moa_, mob_)) = eplus(mu(moa_), mu(mob_))))
- `is-metric-space` — forall([s], is-metric-space(s) iff length(s) = 2 and pts(s) in set and dist(s) in fun(cartesian(pts(s), pts(s)), rr) and is-metric(dist(s), pts(s)) and s in set)
- `is-metrizable-top-space-def` — forall([s], is-metrizable-top-space(s) iff is-top-space(s) and forsome([md in set], is-metric-space(md) and s == [pts(md), {u in power(pts(md)): is-open(md, u)}]))
- `is-minimal-poly` — forall([gmp-md_, gmp-t_, gmp-k_], is-minimal-poly(gmp-md_, gmp-t_, gmp-k_) iff is-monic(scal(gmp-md_), gmp-k_) and forall([gmpw_ in vec(gmp-md_)], poly-op(gmp-md_, gmp-t_, gmp-k_, gmpw_) = vzero(gmp-md_)) and forall([gmpq_ in carr(poly(scal(gmp-md_)))], not(gmpq_ = zero(poly(scal(gmp-md_)))) implies forall([gmpw_ in vec(gmp-md_)], poly-op(gmp-md_, gmp-t_, gmpq_, gmpw_) = vzero(gmp-md_)) implies deg(scal(gmp-md_), gmp-k_) <= deg(scal(gmp-md_), gmpq_)))
- `is-module` — forall([s], is-module(s) iff length(s) = 6 and is-ring(scal(s)) and vec(s) in set and vadd(s) in fun(cartesian(vec(s), vec(s)), vec(s)) and vzero(s) in vec(s) and vneg(s) in fun(vec(s), vec(s)) and act(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(scal(s)), vec(s)), vec(s)) and is-associative(vadd(s), vec(s)) and is-commutative(vadd(s), vec(s)) and is-identity(vadd(s), vzero(s), vec(s)) and has-inverses(vadd(s), vzero(s), vneg(s), vec(s)) and forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)], (act(s))(r_, (vadd(s))(x_, y_)) = (vadd(s))((act(s))(r_, x_), (act(s))(r_, y_))) and forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), s_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)], (act(s))((add(scal(s)))(r_, s_), x_) = (vadd(s))((act(s))(r_, x_), (act(s))(s_, x_))) and forall([r_ in carr(scal(s)), s_ in carr(scal(s)), x_ in vec(s)], (act(s))((mul(scal(s)))(r_, s_), x_) = (act(s))(r_, (act(s))(s_, x_))) and forall([x_ in vec(s)], (act(s))(one(scal(s)), x_) = x_) and s in set)
- `is-module-is-set-cna-as-module` — forall([r], is-complex-normed-algebra(r) implies cna-as-module(r) in set)
- `is-module-is-set-cnvs-as-module` — forall([r], is-complex-normed-vector-space(r) implies cnvs-as-module(r) in set)
- `is-module-is-set-sip-as-module` — forall([r], is-semi-inner-product-space(r) implies sip-as-module(r) in set)
- `is-module-is-set-sip-as-module-csip-as-sip` — forall([r], is-complex-semi-inner-product-space(r) implies sip-as-module(csip-as-sip(r)) in set)
- `is-module-is-set-uba-as-module` — forall([r], is-unital-banach-algebra(r) implies uba-as-module(r) in set)
- `is-module-is-set-uba-as-module-uiba-as-uba` — forall([r], is-unital-involutive-banach-algebra(r) implies uba-as-module(uiba-as-uba(r)) in set)
- `is-monic` — forall([gmo-f_, gmo-p_], is-monic(gmo-f_, gmo-p_) iff gmo-p_ in carr(poly(gmo-f_)) and gmo-p_(deg(gmo-f_, gmo-p_)) = one(gmo-f_))

- `is-open-lin-map` — forall([m1, fam1, m2, fam2, tt], is-open-lin-map(m1, fam1, m2, fam2, tt) iff is-linear-map(m1, m2, tt) and forall([n in nn, eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([n_ in nn, eps_], pos-rr(eps_) and fr-ball(m2, fam2, n_, eps_) subset image(tt, fr-ball(m1, fam1, n, eps)))))
- `is-or-init` — forall([orip_, oris_, oria_, orib_, orin_, orim_, orik_], is-or-init(orip_, oris_, oria_, orib_, orin_, orim_, orik_) iff oria_ in sk-names(orip_) and orib_ in sk-names(orip_) and is-or-text(orip_, orin_) and is-or-text(orip_, orim_) and orik_ in keys(ispace(sk-inf(orip_))) and oris_ = [[sent, lst([orim_, oria_, orib_, encr(lst([orin_, orim_, oria_, orib_]), (ltkey(orip_))(oria_))])], [received, lst([orim_, encr(lst([orin_, orik_]), (ltkey(orip_))(oria_))])]])
- `is-or-resp` — forall([orrp_, orrs_, orra_, orrb_, orrn_, orrm_, orrk_, orrh_, orrg_], is-or-resp(orrp_, orrs_, orra_, orrb_, orrn_, orrm_, orrk_, orrh_, orrg_) iff orra_ in sk-names(orrp_) and orrb_ in sk-names(orrp_) and is-or-text(orrp_, orrn_) and is-or-text(orrp_, orrm_) and orrk_ in keys(ispace(sk-inf(orrp_))) and orrh_ in msg-set(tokens(ispace(sk-inf(orrp_))), keys(ispace(sk-inf(orrp_)))) and orrg_ in msg-set(tokens(ispace(sk-inf(orrp_))), keys(ispace(sk-inf(orrp_)))) and not(orrn_ = orrm_) and not(is-subterm(tokens(ispace(sk-inf(orrp_))), keys(ispace(sk-inf(orrp_))), orrn_, orrh_)) and orrs_ = [[received, lst([orrm_, orra_, orrb_, orrh_])], [sent, lst([orrm_, orra_, orrb_, orrh_, encr(lst([orrn_, orrm_, orra_, orrb_]), (ltkey(orrp_))(orrb_))])], [received, lst([orrm_, orrg_, encr(lst([orrn_, orrk_]), (ltkey(orrp_))(orrb_))])], [sent, lst([orrm_, orrg_])]])
- `is-or-serv` — forall([orsp_, orss_, orsa_, orsb_, orsn_, orso_, orsm_, orsk_], is-or-serv(orsp_, orss_, orsa_, orsb_, orsn_, orso_, orsm_, orsk_) iff orsa_ in sk-names(orsp_) and orsb_ in sk-names(orsp_) and is-or-text(orsp_, orsn_) and is-or-text(orsp_, orso_) and is-or-text(orsp_, orsm_) and orsk_ in keys(ispace(sk-inf(orsp_))) and not(orsk_ in adv-tokens(sk-inf(orsp_))) and forall([orsx_ in sk-names(orsp_)], not(orsk_ = (ltkey(orsp_))(orsx_))) and (kinv(ispace(sk-inf(orsp_))))(orsk_) = orsk_ and orss_ = [[received, lst([orsm_, orsa_, orsb_, encr(lst([orsn_, orsm_, orsa_, orsb_]), (ltkey(orsp_))(orsa_)), encr(lst([orso_, orsm_, orsa_, orsb_]), (ltkey(orsp_))(orsb_))])], [sent, lst([orsm_, encr(lst([orsn_, orsk_]), (ltkey(orsp_))(orsa_)), encr(lst([orso_, orsk_]), (ltkey(orsp_))(orsb_))])]])
- `is-or-space` — forall([orqp_], is-or-space(orqp_) iff is-sk-space(orqp_) and forall([orqi_ in ids(ispace(sk-inf(orqp_)))], orqi_ in adv-ids(sk-inf(orqp_)) or forsome([orqa_, orqb_, orqn_, orqm_, orqk_], is-or-init(orqp_, (strand-map(ispace(sk-inf(orqp_))))(orqi_), orqa_, orqb_, orqn_, orqm_, orqk_)) or forsome([orqa_, orqb_, orqn_, orqm_, orqk_, orqh_, orqg_], is-or-resp(orqp_, (strand-map(ispace(sk-inf(orqp_))))(orqi_), orqa_, orqb_, orqn_, orqm_, orqk_, orqh_, orqg_)) or forsome([orqa_, orqb_, orqn_, orqo_, orqm_, orqk_], is-or-serv(orqp_, (strand-map(ispace(sk-inf(orqp_))))(orqi_), orqa_, orqb_, orqn_, orqo_, orqm_, orqk_))))
- `is-or-text` — forall([ortp_, ortx_], is-or-text(ortp_, ortx_) iff ortx_ in tokens(ispace(sk-inf(ortp_))) and not(ortx_ in sk-names(ortp_)) and not(ortx_ in keys(ispace(sk-inf(ortp_)))))
- `is-ord` — forall([x], is-ord(x) iff x in ord)
- `is-order-iso` — forall([oisf_, oisa_, oisb_], is-order-iso(oisf_, oisa_, oisb_) iff oisf_ in bijection(oisa_, oisb_) and forall([oisx_ in oisa_, oisy_ in oisa_], oisx_ < oisy_ implies oisf_(oisx_) < oisf_(oisy_)))
- `is-orthogonal-projection` — forall([v, ks, pk], is-orthogonal-projection(v, ks, pk) iff pk in fun(vec(v), vec(v)) and forall([opz_ in vec(v)], pk(opz_) in ks and (vadd(v))(opz_, (vneg(v))(pk(opz_))) in perp(v, ks)))
- `is-orthonormal-basis` — forall([v, ix, e], is-orthonormal-basis(v, ix, e) iff is-orthonormal-family(v, ix, e) and forall([onx_ in vec(v)], forall([oni_ in ix], (ip(v))(onx_, e(oni_)) = 0) implies onx_ = vzero(v)))
- `is-orthonormal-family` — forall([v, ix, e], is-orthonormal-family(v, ix, e) iff e in fun(ix, vec(v)) and forall([oni_ in ix], (ip(v))(e(oni_), e(oni_)) = 1) and forall([oni_ in ix, onj_ in ix], not(oni_ = onj_) implies (ip(v))(e(oni_), e(onj_)) = 0))
- `is-orthonormal-set` — forall([v, os], is-orthonormal-set(v, os) iff os subset vec(v) and forall([osa_ in os], (ip(v))(osa_, osa_) = 1) and forall([osa_ in os, osb_ in os], not(osa_ = osb_) implies (ip(v))(osa_, osb_) = 0))
- `is-outer-measure` — forall([omega, mu], is-outer-measure(omega, mu) iff omega in set and mu in fun(power(omega), rr-pos-star) and mu(empty-set) = 0 and forall([a_, b_], a_ in power(omega) implies b_ in power(omega) implies a_ subset b_ implies mu(a_) <= mu(b_)) and forall([f_ in fun(nn, power(omega))], mu(big-union(n_, nn, f_(n_))) <= esum(vnb-lambda(n_, nn, mu(f_(n_))))))
- `is-partial-isometry` — forall([bov_, bot_], is-partial-isometry(bov_, bot_) iff bot_ in bounded-ops(bov_, bov_) and forsome([bok_], is-submodule(bov_, bok_) and is-closed(ip-metric-space(bov_), bok_) and is-isometric-on(bov_, bov_, bot_, bok_) and forall([box_ in perp(bov_, bok_)], bot_(box_) = vzero(bov_))))
- `is-partial-order` — forall([grd, porel], is-partial-order(grd, porel) iff grd in set and porel in set and forall([x in grd], [x, x] in porel) and forall([x in grd, y in grd], [x, y] in porel and [y, x] in porel implies x = y) and forall([x in grd, y in grd, z in grd], [x, y] in porel and [y, z] in porel implies [x, z] in porel))
- `is-partition` — forall([p, n, a, b], is-partition(p, n, a, b) iff n in nn and 1 <= n and a in rr and b in rr and a < b and p in fun(nn, rr) and p(0) = a and p(n) = b and forall([i_, j_], i_ in interval(0, n) and j_ in interval(0, n) and i_ < j_ implies p(i_) < p(j_)))
- `is-path` — forall([pgam, a, b], is-path(pgam, a, b) iff a in rr and b in rr and a < b and pgam in fun(ccint(a, b), cc) and forall([pax_ in ccint(a, b)], is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(rr-ms, ccint(a, b)), cc-ms, pgam, pax_)))
- `is-path-connected` — forall([pcs_, pca_], is-path-connected(pcs_, pca_) iff is-metric-space(pcs_) and pca_ subset pts(pcs_) and forall([pcx_ in pca_, pcy_ in pca_], forsome([pcg_ in fun(ccint(0, 1), pca_)], is-continuous(subspace-ms(rr-ms, ccint(0, 1)), pcs_, pcg_) and pcg_(0) = pcx_ and pcg_(1) = pcy_)))
- `is-pi-system` — forall([pp], is-pi-system(pp) iff forall([pya_ in pp, pyb_ in pp], intersection(pya_, pyb_) in pp))
- `is-pid-def` — forall([s], is-pid(s) iff is-integral-domain(s) and forall([i in set], is-ideal(s, i) implies forsome([a in carr(s)], i = principal-ideal(s, a))))
- `is-piecewise-continuous` — forall([f, a, b], is-piecewise-continuous(f, a, b) iff f in fun(rr, rr) and a in rr and b in rr and a < b and forsome([n_, p_], is-partition(p_, n_, a, b) and forall([i_], i_ in interval(0, n_) and i_ < n_ implies forall([t_], t_ in rr and p_(i_) < t_ and t_ < p_(succ(i_)) implies is-continuous-at(rr-ms, rr-ms, f, t_)))))
- `is-pk-space` — forall([s], is-pk-space(s) iff length(s) = 3 and is-infiltrated-space(pk-inf(s)) and names(s) in set and pubkey(s) in fun(names(s), keys(ispace(pk-inf(s)))) and forall([nlx_ in names(s)], nlx_ in tokens(ispace(pk-inf(s)))) and forall([nlx_ in names(s)], not(nlx_ in keys(ispace(pk-inf(s))))) and forall([nlx_, nly_], nlx_ in names(s) implies nly_ in names(s) implies (pubkey(s))(nlx_) = (pubkey(s))(nly_) implies nlx_ = nly_) and s in set)
- `is-point-separating` — forall([rst_, rsa_], is-point-separating(rst_, rsa_) iff forall([rsp_ in pts(rst_), rsq_ in pts(rst_)], not(rsp_ = rsq_) implies forsome([rsf_ in rsa_], not(rsf_(rsp_) = rsf_(rsq_)))))
- `is-pointed-cone` — forall([g4rm_, g4rc_], is-pointed-cone(g4rm_, g4rc_) iff g4rc_ subset vec(g4rm_) and vzero(g4rm_) in g4rc_ and forall([g4rx_ in g4rc_, g4ry_ in g4rc_], (vadd(g4rm_))(g4rx_, g4ry_) in g4rc_) and forall([g4rt_ in rr], 0 <= g4rt_ implies forall([g4rx_ in g4rc_], (act(g4rm_))(g4rt_, g4rx_) in g4rc_)))
- `is-pole` — forall([mrf_, mra_, mrn_], is-pole(mrf_, mra_, mrn_) iff mra_ in cc and mrn_ in nn and 1 <= mrn_ and forsome([mrr_ in rr], 0 < mrr_ and forsome([mrg_], holomorphic-on(ball(cc-ms, mra_, mrr_), mrg_) and not(mrg_(mra_) = 0) and forall([mrz_ in difference(ball(cc-ms, mra_, mrr_), singleton(mra_))], mrf_(mrz_) = recip(mrz_ - mra_) ^ mrn_ * mrg_(mrz_)))))
- `is-polish` — forall([s], is-polish(s) iff is-complete(s) and is-separable(s))
- `is-poly-deg` — forall([kk, a, f, n], is-poly-deg(kk, a, f, n) iff a subset kk and f in fun(a, kk) and forsome([pfc_ in fun(nn, kk)], forall([pfk_ in nn], succ(n) <= pfk_ implies pfc_(pfk_) = 0) and not(pfc_(n) = 0) and forall([pfz_ in a], f(pfz_) = cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(pfj_, nn, pfc_(pfj_) * pfz_ ^ pfj_), succ(n)))))
- `is-poly-fn-on` — forall([kk, a, f], is-poly-fn-on(kk, a, f) iff a subset kk and f in fun(a, kk) and forsome([pfn_ in nn, pfc_ in fun(nn, kk)], forall([pfk_ in nn], pfn_ <= pfk_ implies pfc_(pfk_) = 0) and forall([pfz_ in a], f(pfz_) = cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(pfj_, nn, pfc_(pfj_) * pfz_ ^ pfj_), pfn_))))
- `is-positive-form` — forall([ubv_, ubd_, ubf_], is-positive-form(ubv_, ubd_, ubf_) iff is-quadratic-form(ubv_, ubd_, ubf_) and forall([ubx_ in ubd_], ubf_(ubx_, ubx_) in rr and 0 <= ubf_(ubx_, ubx_)))
- `is-positive-functional` — forall([s, lam], is-positive-functional(s, lam) iff lam in fun(cont-fns(s), rr) and forall([pff_ in cont-fns(s), pfg_ in cont-fns(s)], lam(vnb-lambda(sx_, pts(s), pff_(sx_) + pfg_(sx_))) = lam(pff_) + lam(pfg_)) and forall([pfc_ in rr, pff_ in cont-fns(s)], lam(vnb-lambda(sx_, pts(s), pfc_ * pff_(sx_))) = pfc_ * lam(pff_)) and forall([pff_ in cont-fns(s)], forall([pfx_ in pts(s)], 0 <= pff_(pfx_)) implies 0 <= lam(pff_)))
- `is-positive-lf` — forall([g4a_, g4f_], is-positive-lf(g4a_, g4f_) iff is-cc-linear-on(g4a_, g4f_) and forall([g4x_ in vec(g4a_)], g4f_((vmul(g4a_))((vstar(g4a_))(g4x_), g4x_)) in rr and 0 <= g4f_((vmul(g4a_))((vstar(g4a_))(g4x_), g4x_))))
- `is-positive-op` — forall([kqv_, kqt_], is-positive-op(kqv_, kqt_) iff is-self-adjoint-op(kqv_, kqt_) and forall([kqx_ in vec(kqv_)], (ip(kqv_))(kqt_(kqx_), kqx_) in rr and 0 <= (ip(kqv_))(kqt_(kqx_), kqx_)))
- `is-positive-op-functional` — forall([tdv_, tdf_], is-positive-op-functional(tdv_, tdf_) iff forall([tda_], is-positive-op(tdv_, tda_) implies tdf_(tda_) in rr and 0 <= tdf_(tda_)))
- `is-power-bounded` — forall([k, n, tm], is-power-bounded(k, n, tm) iff forsome([cbvc_], is-power-bounded-by(k, n, tm, cbvc_)))
- `is-power-bounded-by` — forall([k, n, tm, c], is-power-bounded-by(k, n, tm, c) iff tm in mat(n, n, carr(k)) and c in rr and 0 <= c and forall([cbvk_ in nn], is-mat-bound(k, n, n, mat-power(k, n, tm, cbvk_), c)))
- `is-pre-hilbert-space-def` — forall([s], is-pre-hilbert-space(s) iff is-semi-inner-product-space(s) and forall([x_ in vec(s)], (rip(s))(x_, x_) = 0 implies x_ = vzero(s)))
- `is-prec-closed` — forall([spc_, snd_, ssd_, srl_], is-prec-closed(spc_, snd_, ssd_, srl_) iff forall([ssx_, ssy_], [ssx_, ssy_] in ssd_ implies [ssx_, ssy_] in srl_) and forall([ssx_ in snd_, ssy_ in snd_], same-strand-before(spc_, ssx_, ssy_) implies [ssx_, ssy_] in srl_) and forall([ssx_, ssy_, ssz_], [ssx_, ssy_] in srl_ implies [ssy_, ssz_] in srl_ implies [ssx_, ssz_] in srl_))
- `is-premeasure` — forall([omega, cls, pm], is-premeasure(omega, cls, pm) iff omega in set and cls subset power(omega) and empty-set in cls and pm in fun(cls, rr-pos-star) and pm(empty-set) = 0)
- `is-prime-element` — forall([gps_, gpp_], is-prime-element(gps_, gpp_) iff gpp_ in carr(gps_) and not(gpp_ = zero(gps_)) and not(is-unit(gps_, gpp_)) and forall([gpa_ in carr(gps_), gpb_ in carr(gps_)], gpp_ = (mul(gps_))(gpa_, gpb_) implies is-unit(gps_, gpa_) or is-unit(gps_, gpb_)))
- `is-prime-nat` — forall([gpn_], is-prime-nat(gpn_) iff gpn_ in nn and is-prime-element(zz-ring, gpn_))
- `is-prime-seq` — forall([gqs_, gqp_, gqn_], is-prime-seq(gqs_, gqp_, gqn_) iff forall([gqi_ in interval(1, gqn_)], is-prime-element(gqs_, gqp_(gqi_))))
- `is-primitive` — forall([rpg_, rpf_, rpa_, rpb_], is-primitive(rpg_, rpf_, rpa_, rpb_) iff rpa_ in rr and rpb_ in rr and rpa_ < rpb_ and rpg_ in fun(ccint(rpa_, rpb_), rr) and rpf_ in fun(ccint(rpa_, rpb_), rr) and is-continuous-on(rpg_, ccint(rpa_, rpb_)) and forsome([rps_], is-countable(rps_) and rps_ subset ccint(rpa_, rpb_) and forall([rpt_ in ooint(rpa_, rpb_)], not(rpt_ in rps_) implies has-deriv-at(rpg_, rpt_, rpf_(rpt_)))))
- `is-principal-sequence` — forall([md, n, sm, es, dm], is-principal-sequence(md, n, sm, es, dm) iff es in mat(n, 1, vec(md)) and generates(md, n, es) and rel-free(md, n, es) and dm in mat(n, n, zz) and is-diagonal(zz-ring, n, n, dm) and forall([psi_ in interval(1, n)], 0 <= entry(dm, psi_, psi_)) and forall([psi_, psj_], psi_ in interval(1, n) implies psj_ in interval(1, n) implies psi_ <= psj_ implies zz-divides(entry(dm, psi_, psi_), entry(dm, psj_, psj_))) and spans(md, n, matact(md, dm, es), sm))
- `is-projection-el` — forall([baa_, bax_], is-projection-el(baa_, bax_) iff bax_ in vec(baa_) and (vstar(baa_))(bax_) = bax_ and (vmul(baa_))(bax_, bax_) = bax_)
- `is-projection-op` — forall([bov_, bot_], is-projection-op(bov_, bot_) iff bot_ in bounded-ops(bov_, bov_) and op-adjoint(bov_, bov_, bot_) = bot_ and bop-comp(bov_, bot_, bot_) = bot_)
- `is-psd-form` — forall([ipfm_, ipff_], is-psd-form(ipfm_, ipff_) iff is-hermitian-form(ipfm_, ipff_) and forall([ipfx_ in vec(ipfm_)], ipff_(ipfx_, ipfx_) in rr) and forall([ipfx_ in vec(ipfm_)], 0 <= ipff_(ipfx_, ipfx_)))
- `is-pseudometric` — forall([dst, crr], is-pseudometric(dst, crr) iff forall([u in crr], dst(u, u) = 0 and forall([v in crr], 0 <= dst(u, v) and dst(u, v) = dst(v, u) and forall([w in crr], dst(u, w) <= dst(u, v) + dst(v, w)))))
- `is-pseudometric-space` — forall([s], is-pseudometric-space(s) iff length(s) = 2 and pts(s) in set and dist(s) in fun(cartesian(pts(s), pts(s)), rr) and is-pseudometric(dist(s), pts(s)) and s in set)
- `is-pt-open` — forall([t, u], is-pt-open(t, u) iff u subset cartesian(pts(t), rr) and forall([ptw_ in u], forsome([ptv_ in opens(t)], nth(1, ptw_) in ptv_ and forsome([pte_], pos-rr(pte_) and pt-box(t, ptv_, nth(2, ptw_), pte_) subset u))))
- `is-ptwise-cauchy` — forall([s, fam], is-ptwise-cauchy(s, fam) iff is-metric-space(s) and fam in fun(nn, fun(pts(s), rr)) and forall([x in pts(s), eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([cap in nn], forall([k], k in nn and cap <= k implies forall([l], l in nn and cap <= l implies abs((fam(k))(x) - (fam(l))(x)) < eps)))))
- `is-pure-state` — forall([g4a_, g4f_], is-pure-state(g4a_, g4f_) iff g4f_ in states(g4a_) and forall([g4g_], is-positive-lf(g4a_, g4g_) implies functional-le(g4a_, g4g_, g4f_) implies forsome([g4l_ in rr], 0 <= g4l_ and g4l_ <= 1 and forall([g4x_ in vec(g4a_)], g4g_(g4x_) = g4l_ * g4f_(g4x_)))))
- `is-pw-antiderivable` — forall([pphi_, a, b], is-pw-antiderivable(pphi_, a, b) iff forsome([paw_], is-primitive(paw_, pphi_, a, b)))
- `is-pw-continuous-on` — forall([pphi_, a, b], is-pw-continuous-on(pphi_, a, b) iff a in rr and b in rr and a < b and pphi_ in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) and forsome([pas_ in set], card(pas_) in nn and pas_ subset ccint(a, b) and forall([pat_ in ooint(a, b)], not(pat_ in pas_) implies is-continuous-at(subspace-ms(rr-ms, ccint(a, b)), rr-ms, pphi_, pat_))))
- `is-qp-digits` — forall([qsp_, qta_, qtn_], is-qp-digits(qsp_, qta_, qtn_) iff qta_ in fun(zz, zz) and forall([qtk_ in zz], 0 <= qta_(qtk_) and qta_(qtk_) < qsp_ and (qtk_ < qtn_ implies qta_(qtk_) = 0)))
- `is-qp-expansion` — forall([qsp_, qta_, qtn_, qtx_], is-qp-expansion(qsp_, qta_, qtn_, qtx_) iff is-qp-digits(qsp_, qta_, qtn_) and converges-to(qp(qsp_), vnb-lambda(qtm_, nn, qp-psum(qsp_, qta_, qtn_, qtm_)), qtx_))
- `is-quadratic-form` — forall([ubv_, ubd_, ubf_], is-quadratic-form(ubv_, ubd_, ubf_) iff is-submodule(ubv_, ubd_) and is-dense(ip-metric-space(ubv_), ubd_) and ubf_ in fun(cartesian(ubd_, ubd_), cc) and forall([ubx_ in ubd_, uby_ in ubd_, ubz_ in ubd_], ubf_((vadd(ubv_))(ubx_, uby_), ubz_) = ubf_(ubx_, ubz_) + ubf_(uby_, ubz_)) and forall([ubk_ in cc, ubx_ in ubd_, uby_ in ubd_], ubf_((act(ubv_))(ubk_, ubx_), uby_) = ubk_ * ubf_(ubx_, uby_)) and forall([ubx_ in ubd_, uby_ in ubd_], ubf_(uby_, ubx_) = conjugate(ubf_(ubx_, uby_))))
- `is-r-net` — forall([s, f, a, r], is-r-net(s, f, a, r) iff f subset a and forall([p in a], forsome([c in f], (dist(s))(c, p) <= r and not((dist(s))(c, p) = r))))
- `is-rcont-subalgebra` — forall([rst_, rsa_], is-rcont-subalgebra(rst_, rsa_) iff rsa_ subset rcont(rst_) and forall([rsc_ in rr], vnb-lambda(rsz_, pts(rst_), rsc_) in rsa_) and forall([rsf_ in rsa_, rsg_ in rsa_], vnb-lambda(rsz_, pts(rst_), rsf_(rsz_) + rsg_(rsz_)) in rsa_) and forall([rsf_ in rsa_, rsg_ in rsa_], vnb-lambda(rsz_, pts(rst_), rsf_(rsz_) * rsg_(rsz_)) in rsa_))
- `is-real-hilbert-space` — forall([v], is-real-hilbert-space(v) iff is-pre-hilbert-space(v) and is-complete(sip-metric-space(v)))
- `is-real-linear-op` — forall([v, jo], is-real-linear-op(v, jo) iff jo in fun(vec(v), vec(v)) and forall([x_ in vec(v), y_ in vec(v)], jo((vadd(v))(x_, y_)) = (vadd(v))(jo(x_), jo(y_))) and forall([a_ in rr, x_ in vec(v)], jo((act(v))(a_, x_)) = (act(v))(a_, jo(x_))))
- `is-real-measurable-fn` — forall([omega, ca, f], is-real-measurable-fn(omega, ca, f) iff f in fun(omega, rr) and is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, pos-part(omega, f)) and is-measurable-fn(omega, ca, neg-part(omega, f)))
- `is-real-orthogonal-projection` — forall([v, ks, pk], is-real-orthogonal-projection(v, ks, pk) iff pk in fun(vec(v), vec(v)) and forall([sop_ in vec(v)], pk(sop_) in ks and (vadd(v))(sop_, (vneg(v))(pk(sop_))) in sip-perp(v, ks)))
- `is-received` — forall([ssp_, ssn_], is-received(ssp_, ssn_) iff node-dir(ssp_, ssn_) = received)

- `is-submodule` — forall([m, s], is-submodule(m, s) iff s subset vec(m) and vzero(m) in s and forall([x_ in s, y_ in s], (vadd(m))(x_, y_) in s) and forall([x_ in s], (vneg(m))(x_) in s) and forall([r_ in carr(scal(m)), x_ in s], (act(m))(r_, x_) in s))
- `is-subnet` — forall([d, x, e, y], is-subnet(d, x, e, y) iff is-directed-set(d) and is-directed-set(e) and forsome([snh_], is-cofinal-monotone(e, d, snh_) and forall([snj_ in pts(e)], y(snj_) = x(snh_(snj_)))))
- `is-subring-of-cc` — forall([aa], is-subring-of-cc(aa) iff is-cc-subring(aa) and forall([ansn_ in aa], -ansn_ in aa))
- `is-subsequence` — forall([s, y, f], is-subsequence(s, y, f) iff f in fun(nn, pts(s)) and forsome([phi], strictly-mono-nn(phi) and y = subseq(f, phi)))
- `is-subspace` — forall([m, s], is-subspace(m, s) iff is-submodule(m, s))
- `is-subterm` — forall([smt_, smk_, sma_, smb_], is-subterm(smt_, smk_, sma_, smb_) iff [sma_, smb_] in subterm-rel(smt_, smk_))
- `is-subterm-closed` — forall([smt_, smk_, smr_], is-subterm-closed(smt_, smk_, smr_) iff forall([sma_ in msg-set(smt_, smk_)], [sma_, sma_] in smr_) and forall([sma_, sml_, smi_], sml_ in tuples(msg-set(smt_, smk_)) implies smi_ in nn implies 1 <= smi_ implies smi_ <= length(sml_) implies [sma_, nth(smi_, sml_)] in smr_ implies [sma_, lst(sml_)] in smr_) and forall([sma_, smg_, smy_], smg_ in msg-set(smt_, smk_) implies smy_ in smk_ implies [sma_, smg_] in smr_ implies [sma_, encr(smg_, smy_)] in smr_))
- `is-summable` — forall([grp, f], is-summable(grp, f) iff forsome([r in carr(grp)], sums-to(grp, f, r)))
- `is-symmetric-graph` — forall([ubv_, ubg_], is-symmetric-graph(ubv_, ubg_) iff ubg_ subset graph-adjoint(ubv_, ubg_))
- `is-symmetric-subset` — forall([m, cs], is-symmetric-subset(m, cs) iff cs subset vec(m) and forall([syx_ in cs], (act(m))(-1, syx_) in cs))
- `is-taylor-family` — forall([d, n, a, b], is-taylor-family(d, n, a, b) iff n in nn and 1 <= n and a in rr and b in rr and a < b and d(n) in fun(ooint(a, b), rr) and forall([tk_ in nn], tk_ < n implies d(tk_) in fun(ccint(a, b), rr) and is-continuous-on(d(tk_), ccint(a, b)) and forall([tx_ in ooint(a, b)], has-deriv-at(d(tk_), tx_, (d(succ(tk_)))(tx_)))))
- `is-tee-trace` — forall([sasp_, sas_], is-tee-trace(sasp_, sas_) iff forsome([sag_ in msg-set(tokens(sasp_), keys(sasp_))], sas_ = [[received, sag_], [sent, sag_], [sent, sag_]]))

- `is-token-set` — forall([smt_], is-token-set(smt_) iff smt_ in set and forall([smx_ in smt_], not(smx_ in tuples(set))))

- `is-top-family` — forall([ix, tf], is-top-family(ix, tf) iff ix in set and forall([tpi_ in ix], is-top-space(tf(tpi_))))
- `is-top-group` — forall([s], is-top-group(s) iff length(s) = 5 and carr(s) in set and opr(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(s), carr(s)), carr(s)) and iden(s) in carr(s) and inv(s) in fun(carr(s), carr(s)) and topology(s) in power(power(carr(s))) and is-associative(opr(s), carr(s)) and is-identity(opr(s), iden(s), carr(s)) and has-inverses(opr(s), iden(s), inv(s), carr(s)) and empty-set in topology(s) and carr(s) in topology(s) and forall([u in topology(s), v in topology(s)], intersection(u, v) in topology(s)) and forall([fam in set], fam subset topology(s) implies big-union(u, fam, u) in topology(s)) and forall([tga_ in carr(s), tgb_ in carr(s), tgw_ in topology(s)], (opr(s))(tga_, (inv(s))(tgb_)) in tgw_ implies forsome([tgu_ in topology(s)], tga_ in tgu_ and forsome([tgv_ in topology(s)], tgb_ in tgv_ and forall([tgp_ in tgu_, tgq_ in tgv_], (opr(s))(tgp_, (inv(s))(tgq_)) in tgw_)))) and s in set)
- `is-top-space` — forall([s], is-top-space(s) iff length(s) = 2 and pts(s) in set and opens(s) in power(power(pts(s))) and empty-set in opens(s) and pts(s) in opens(s) and forall([u in opens(s), v in opens(s)], intersection(u, v) in opens(s)) and forall([fam in set], fam subset opens(s) implies big-union(u, fam, u) in opens(s)) and s in set)
- `is-totally-bounded-in` — forall([tbm_, tba_], is-totally-bounded-in(tbm_, tba_) iff forall([tbr_], pos-rr(tbr_) implies forsome([tbf_ in set], card(tbf_) in nn and tbf_ subset pts(tbm_) and forall([tbp_ in tba_], forsome([tbc_ in tbf_], (dist(tbm_))(tbc_, tbp_) < tbr_)))))
- `is-tprod-open` — forall([ix, tf, u], is-tprod-open(ix, tf, u) iff u subset tprod-pts(ix, tf) and forall([tpw_ in u], forsome([tpf_ in set], tpf_ subset tprod-constr(ix, tf) and card(tpf_) in nn and tpw_ in tprod-box(ix, tf, tpf_) and tprod-box(ix, tf, tpf_) subset u)))
- `is-trace-class` — forall([kqv_, kqt_], is-trace-class(kqv_, kqt_) iff kqt_ in bounded-ops(kqv_, kqv_) and forsome([kqa_], is-hilbert-schmidt(kqv_, kqv_, kqa_) and forsome([kqb_], is-hilbert-schmidt(kqv_, kqv_, kqb_) and kqt_ = bop-comp(kqv_, kqa_, kqb_))))
- `is-tvs` — forall([fld, m, t], is-tvs(fld, m, t) iff is-normed-field(fld) and is-module(m) and scal(m) = normed-field-as-commutative-ring(fld) and is-hausdorff(t) and pts(t) == vec(m) and forall([tvx_, tvy_, tvu_], tvx_ in vec(m) implies tvy_ in vec(m) implies tvu_ in opens(t) implies (vadd(m))(tvx_, tvy_) in tvu_ implies forsome([tvv_ in opens(t)], tvx_ in tvv_ and forsome([tvw_ in opens(t)], tvy_ in tvw_ and forall([tva_ in tvv_, tvb_ in tvw_], (vadd(m))(tva_, tvb_) in tvu_)))) and forall([tvr_, tvx_, tvu_], tvr_ in carr(scal(m)) implies tvx_ in vec(m) implies tvu_ in opens(t) implies (act(m))(tvr_, tvx_) in tvu_ implies forsome([tvd_], pos-rr(tvd_) and forsome([tvw_ in opens(t)], tvx_ in tvw_ and forall([tvs_ in carr(scal(m))], (fnrm(fld))((add(scal(m)))(tvs_, (neg(scal(m)))(tvr_))) < tvd_ implies forall([tva_ in tvw_], (act(m))(tvs_, tva_) in tvu_))))))
- `is-two-sided-ideal` — forall([baa_, bai_], is-two-sided-ideal(baa_, bai_) iff is-left-ideal(baa_, bai_) and is-right-ideal(baa_, bai_))
- `is-ufd` — forall([gus_], is-ufd(gus_) iff is-integral-domain(gus_) and forall([gua_ in carr(gus_)], not(gua_ = zero(gus_)) implies forsome([guu_], is-unit(gus_, guu_) and forsome([gun_ in nn, gup_], is-prime-seq(gus_, gup_, gun_) and gua_ = (mul(gus_))(guu_, prod-ring(gus_, gup_, interval(1, gun_)))))) and forall([gun_ in nn, gup_], is-prime-seq(gus_, gup_, gun_) implies forall([gum_ in nn, guq_], is-prime-seq(gus_, guq_, gum_) implies forall([guu_], is-unit(gus_, guu_) implies forall([guv_], is-unit(gus_, guv_) implies (mul(gus_))(guu_, prod-ring(gus_, gup_, interval(1, gun_))) = (mul(gus_))(guv_, prod-ring(gus_, guq_, interval(1, gum_))) implies gun_ = gum_ and forsome([gus2_ in bijection(interval(1, gun_), interval(1, gum_))], forall([gui_ in interval(1, gun_)], associated(gus_, gup_(gui_), guq_(gus2_(gui_))))))))))
- `is-ultrametric` — forall([ums_], is-ultrametric(ums_) iff is-metric-space(ums_) and forall([umx_ in pts(ums_), umy_ in pts(ums_), umz_ in pts(ums_)], (dist(ums_))(umx_, umy_) <= max((dist(ums_))(umx_, umz_), (dist(ums_))(umz_, umy_))))
- `is-unif-cauchy` — forall([s, fam], is-unif-cauchy(s, fam) iff is-metric-space(s) and fam in fun(nn, fun(pts(s), rr)) and forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([cap in nn], forall([k], k in nn and cap <= k implies forall([l], l in nn and cap <= l implies forall([x in pts(s)], abs((fam(k))(x) - (fam(l))(x)) < eps))))))
- `is-unif-limit-on` — forall([fam, g, a, b], is-unif-limit-on(fam, g, a, b) iff fam in fun(nn, fun(rr, rr)) and g in fun(rr, rr) and a in rr and b in rr and a < b and forall([eps_], pos-rr(eps_) implies forsome([n_ in nn], forall([k_], k_ in nn and n_ <= k_ implies forall([x_ in ccint(a, b)], abs(g(x_) - (fam(k_))(x_)) <= eps_)))))
- `is-uniformly-continuous` — forall([s, t, f], is-uniformly-continuous(s, t, f) iff is-metric-space(s) and is-metric-space(t) and f in fun(pts(s), pts(t)) and forall([eps], pos-rr(eps) implies forsome([delta], pos-rr(delta) and forall([a in pts(s), b in pts(s)], (dist(s))(a, b) <= delta implies (dist(t))(f(a), f(b)) <= eps))))

- `is-unipolar` — forall([c5k_, c5w_], is-unipolar(c5k_, c5w_) iff is-bilinear-bicharacter(c5k_, c5w_) and bichar-polar(c5k_, c5w_, nv-integers(c5k_)) = nv-integers(c5k_))
- `is-unit` — forall([gus_, guu_], is-unit(gus_, guu_) iff guu_ in carr(gus_) and forsome([guv_ in carr(gus_)], (mul(gus_))(guu_, guv_) = one(gus_)))
- `is-unital-banach-algebra` — forall([s], is-unital-banach-algebra(s) iff length(s) = 9 and is-ring(scal(s)) and vec(s) in set and vadd(s) in fun(cartesian(vec(s), vec(s)), vec(s)) and vzero(s) in vec(s) and vneg(s) in fun(vec(s), vec(s)) and act(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(scal(s)), vec(s)), vec(s)) and vnrm(s) in fun(vec(s), rr) and vmul(s) in fun(cartesian(vec(s), vec(s)), vec(s)) and vone(s) in vec(s) and is-complex-banach-algebra([scal(s), vec(s), vadd(s), vzero(s), vneg(s), act(s), vnrm(s), vmul(s)]) and carr(scal(s)) = cc and forall([x_ in vec(s)], (vmul(s))(vone(s), x_) = x_) and forall([x_ in vec(s)], (vmul(s))(x_, vone(s)) = x_) and (vnrm(s))(vone(s)) = 1 and s in set)

- `is-unital-c-star-subalgebra` — forall([c2a_, c2b_], is-unital-c-star-subalgebra(c2a_, c2b_) iff is-unital-c-star-algebra(c2a_) and is-unital-c-star-algebra(c2b_) and forall([c2x_ in vec(c2a_)], c2x_ in vec(c2b_)) and vone(c2a_) = vone(c2b_) and forall([c2x_ in vec(c2a_), c2y_ in vec(c2a_)], (vadd(c2a_))(c2x_, c2y_) = (vadd(c2b_))(c2x_, c2y_)) and forall([c2x_ in vec(c2a_), c2y_ in vec(c2a_)], (vmul(c2a_))(c2x_, c2y_) = (vmul(c2b_))(c2x_, c2y_)) and forall([c2z_ in cc, c2x_ in vec(c2a_)], (act(c2a_))(c2z_, c2x_) = (act(c2b_))(c2z_, c2x_)) and forall([c2x_ in vec(c2a_)], (vneg(c2a_))(c2x_) = (vneg(c2b_))(c2x_)) and forall([c2x_ in vec(c2a_)], (vstar(c2a_))(c2x_) = (vstar(c2b_))(c2x_)) and forall([c2x_ in vec(c2a_)], (vnrm(c2a_))(c2x_) = (vnrm(c2b_))(c2x_)))
- `is-unital-involutive-banach-algebra` — forall([s], is-unital-involutive-banach-algebra(s) iff length(s) = 10 and is-ring(scal(s)) and vec(s) in set and vadd(s) in fun(cartesian(vec(s), vec(s)), vec(s)) and vzero(s) in vec(s) and vneg(s) in fun(vec(s), vec(s)) and act(s) in fun(cartesian(carr(scal(s)), vec(s)), vec(s)) and vnrm(s) in fun(vec(s), rr) and vmul(s) in fun(cartesian(vec(s), vec(s)), vec(s)) and vone(s) in vec(s) and vstar(s) in fun(vec(s), vec(s)) and is-unital-banach-algebra([scal(s), vec(s), vadd(s), vzero(s), vneg(s), act(s), vnrm(s), vmul(s), vone(s)]) and carr(scal(s)) = cc and forall([x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)], (vstar(s))((vadd(s))(x_, y_)) = (vadd(s))((vstar(s))(x_), (vstar(s))(y_))) and forall([r_ in cc, x_ in vec(s)], (vstar(s))((act(s))(r_, x_)) = (act(s))(conjugate(r_), (vstar(s))(x_))) and forall([x_ in vec(s)], (vstar(s))((vstar(s))(x_)) = x_) and forall([x_ in vec(s), y_ in vec(s)], (vstar(s))((vmul(s))(x_, y_)) = (vmul(s))((vstar(s))(y_), (vstar(s))(x_))) and forall([x_ in vec(s)], (vnrm(s))((vstar(s))(x_)) = (vnrm(s))(x_)) and s in set)
- `is-unitary-el` — forall([baa_, bax_], is-unitary-el(baa_, bax_) iff bax_ in vec(baa_) and (vmul(baa_))((vstar(baa_))(bax_), bax_) = vone(baa_) and (vmul(baa_))(bax_, (vstar(baa_))(bax_)) = vone(baa_))
- `is-unitary-graph` — forall([ubv_, ubg_], is-unitary-graph(ubv_, ubg_) iff is-linear-graph(ubv_, ubg_) and is-isometric-graph(ubv_, ubg_) and graph-dom(ubv_, ubg_) = vec(ubv_) and graph-ran(ubv_, ubg_) = vec(ubv_))

- `nary-minus-2` — forall([x, y], x - y == binplus(x, binneg(y)))
- `nary-neg-1` — forall([x], -x == binneg(x))
- `nary-plus-2` — forall([x, y], x + y == binplus(x, y))
- `nary-plus-3` — forall([x, y, z], x + y + z == binplus(binplus(x, y), z))
- `nary-plus-4` — forall([w, x, y, z], w + x + y + z == binplus(binplus(binplus(w, x), y), z))
- `nary-plus-5` — forall([v, w, x, y, z], v + w + x + y + z == binplus(binplus(binplus(binplus(v, w), x), y), z))
- `nary-times-2` — forall([x, y], x * y == bintimes(x, y))
- `nary-times-3` — forall([x, y, z], x * y * z == bintimes(bintimes(x, y), z))
- `nary-times-4` — forall([w, x, y, z], w * x * y * z == bintimes(bintimes(bintimes(w, x), y), z))
- `nary-times-5` — forall([v, w, x, y, z], v * w * x * y * z == bintimes(bintimes(bintimes(bintimes(v, w), x), y), z))

- `qq-field-def` — qq-field = [qq, vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(qq, qq), x_ + y_), vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(qq, qq), x_ * y_), vnb-lambda(x_, qq, -x_), 0, 1, difference(qq, singleton(0)), vnb-lambda(x_, difference(qq, singleton(0)), recip(x_))]
- `qq-field@add` — add(qq-field) == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(qq, qq), x_ + y_)
- `qq-field@carr` — carr(qq-field) == qq
- `qq-field@mul` — mul(qq-field) == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(qq, qq), x_ * y_)
- `qq-field@mul-inv` — mul-inv(qq-field) == vnb-lambda(x_, difference(qq, singleton(0)), recip(x_))
- `qq-field@neg` — neg(qq-field) == vnb-lambda(x_, qq, -x_)
- `qq-field@non-zero` — non-zero(qq-field) == difference(qq, singleton(0))
- `qq-field@one` — one(qq-field) == 1
- `qq-field@zero` — zero(qq-field) == 0
- `qq-line-def` — qq-line = [field-as-integral-domain(qq-field), qq, vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(qq, qq), x_ + y_), 0, vnb-lambda(x_, qq, -x_), vnb-lambda([r_, x_], cartesian(qq, qq), r_ * x_)]
- `qq-line@act` — act(qq-line) == vnb-lambda([r_, x_], cartesian(qq, qq), r_ * x_)
- `qq-line@scal` — scal(qq-line) == field-as-integral-domain(qq-field)
- `qq-line@vadd` — vadd(qq-line) == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(qq, qq), x_ + y_)
- `qq-line@vec` — vec(qq-line) == qq
- `qq-line@vneg` — vneg(qq-line) == vnb-lambda(x_, qq, -x_)
- `qq-line@vzero` — vzero(qq-line) == 0
- `qq-ring-def` — qq-ring = [qq, vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(qq, qq), x_ + y_), vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(qq, qq), x_ * y_), vnb-lambda(x_, qq, -x_), 0, 1]
- `qq-ring@add` — add(qq-ring) == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(qq, qq), x_ + y_)
- `qq-ring@carr` — carr(qq-ring) == qq
- `qq-ring@mul` — mul(qq-ring) == vnb-lambda([x_, y_], cartesian(qq, qq), x_ * y_)
- `qq-ring@neg` — neg(qq-ring) == vnb-lambda(x_, qq, -x_)
- `qq-ring@one` — one(qq-ring) == 1
- `qq-ring@zero` — zero(qq-ring) == 0

- `real-part-def` — forall([z], real-part(z) == (z + conjugate(z)) * recip(2))
- `received-def` — received = 1
- `recip-gamma-def` — recip-gamma == vnb-lambda(egz_, cc, (egz_ * cc-exp(euler-gamma * egz_)) * (prod-fun(cc, vnb-lambda(c6k_, nn, vnb-lambda(c6x_, cc, (1 - c6x_ * recip((vnb-lambda(c6gk_, nn, -succ(c6gk_)))(c6k_))) * cc-exp(cc-series-partial-sum(vnb-lambda(clhk_, nn, recip-star(clhk_) * (c6x_ * recip((vnb-lambda(c6gk_, nn, -succ(c6gk_)))(c6k_))) ^ clhk_), succ((vnb-lambda(c6gk_, nn, 1))(c6k_)))) - 1))))(egz_))
- `reduce-one` — forall([op, f], reduce(op, f, 1) == f(0))
- `reduce-succ` — forall([op, f, n], n in nn and 1 <= n implies reduce(op, f, succ(n)) == op(reduce(op, f, n), f(n)))
